title: Performance Study of Serverless Workloads in Confidential Virtual Machines
summary: Confidential serverless computing is rapidly emerg- ing as a critical paradigm for application domains requiring strong confidentiality guarantees, such as healthcare, finance, and machine learning. To enable this paradigm in untrusted cloud environments, Confidential Virtual Machines (CVMs) provide isolation by encrypting the entire guest memory, and thus securing serverless workloads against host-level access and inter- ference. However, the implications of CVMs for serverless systems remain insufficiently understood. This paper presents an empirical study of serverless work- loads in CVMs, systematically covering memory efficiency and runtime overhead on both warm-starts and cold-starts. Our results show that CVMs incur substantial memory overhead because encrypted memory disables cross-VM page deduplication and reduces memory reclaimability, thereby limiting warm- container capacity under a fixed memory budget. Runtime overhead in warm-starts is workload dependent. Workloads with frequent VMEXITs, particularly idle transitions, suffer substantial slowdowns. These slowdowns are further amplified by common serverless deployment practice that couples vCPU allocation to memory size, as higher-memory configurations expose more vCPUs than some functions can use effectively. For cold starts, the study focuses on container creation, a common and major contributor to startup latency. Motivated by the memory-efficiency results, we consider the deployments in which multiple containers of the same function are consolidated within the same CVM to improve efficiency, and show that selectively relaxing certain isolation mechanisms in this setting can substan- tially reduce startup overhead. These results clarify the main performance tradeoffs of confidential serverless computing and suggest practical ways to improve efficiency and latency.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证研究系统性地分析了机密虚拟机（CVM）中无服务器工作负载的内存效率和运行时开销，涵盖热启动和冷启动两方面。研究发现CVM因加密内存禁用跨VM页去重并降低内存可回收性，导致显著内存开销；热启动中频繁VMEXIT（特别是空闲转换）的工作负载严重减速，且该减速会因vCPU分配与内存大小耦合的常见部署实践而被放大。针对冷启动，研究考虑在同CVM内整合同一函数的多个容器，并证明选择性放宽隔离机制可大幅降低启动开销。
AI.motivation: 机密无服务器计算正快速成为医疗、金融、机器学习等需要强机密性保证的应用领域的關鍵范式。尽管CVM通过加密整块客户机内存在不可信云环境中提供隔离保障，但CVM对无服务器系统的影响尚未被充分理解，因此需要对机密无服务器场景下的CVM工作负载进行系统性实证研究。
AI.method: 采用实证研究方法，系统性地对CVM中的无服务器工作负载进行测量与分析。实验覆盖三个维度：(1) 内存效率，考察加密内存对跨VM页去重和内存可回收性的影响；(2) 热启动的运行时开销，关注VMEXIT频率与部署中vCPU与内存耦合配置的影响；(3) 冷启动开销，聚焦容器创建延迟，并探索将同一函数的多个容器整合到同一CVM中通过选择性放宽隔离机制提升效率的方案。
AI.result: (1) CVM产生显著内存开销，加密内存禁用跨VM页去重并降低内存可回收性，限制了固定内存预算下的热容器容量；(2) 热启动运行时开销取决于工作负载，VMEXIT频繁的工作负载（特别是空闲转换）遭受严重减速，且该减速会因vCPU与内存耦合部署被进一步放大；(3) 冷启动中，容器创建是主要延迟来源，将同函数多容器整合于同一CVM并选择性放宽部分隔离机制可显著降低启动开销。
AI.conclusion: 该研究阐明了机密无服务器计算的主要性能权衡，包括CVM内存开销、VMEXIT带来的运行时减速以及冷启动瓶颈，并为提高机密无服务器系统的效率和降低延迟提出了切实可行的改进方案，如同一CVM内的容器整合与选择性隔离放宽策略。

title: Atlas: Optimizing Deployment of Compound AI Workflows on Heterogeneous Clusters
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the IEEE/ACM Symposium on Edge Computing (SEC 2026)
summary: Compound AI workflows are increasingly used to serve complex AI tasks by coordinating multiple AI models and software components. This approach enables deployment flexibility, as each workflow stage can expose different model variants and resource requirements, but it also expands the deployment choices. A deployment must choose an execution plan that selects AI models for each compound AI workflow stage and places them on a heterogeneous cluster in order to satisfy SLOs. Deployment optimizers therefore need estimates to compare many candidate plans and identify feasible ones. System metrics can often be profiled per stage and composed according to workflow topology, but accuracy cannot, as errors and information loss at upstream stages affect the accuracy of downstream stages. Existing approaches either profile complete configurations end to end, which scales poorly, or use product-based accuracy surrogates that treat stages as independent and can misrank candidate plans. We introduce Atlas, a framework for optimizing compound AI deployments under SLO constraints. Atlas uses MAP, a Markovian Accuracy Predictor, to estimate configuration accuracy from local conditional accuracy transitions between adjacent workflow stages. MAP discretizes intermediate outputs into accuracy buckets and composes transition profiles according to workflow topology, giving the optimizer an accuracy estimate without exhaustive end-to-end profiling. Atlas formulates execution-plan selection as a mixed-integer linear program that maximizes predicted accuracy subject to SLOs. Across four compound AI workflows, MAP achieves Spearman correlation up to 0.947 while reducing profiling cost by up to 2.6x relative to exhaustive end-to-end profiling. Guided by MAP, the Atlas optimizer selects execution plans within 0.03 of oracle accuracy while reducing deployment cost by up to 42% through heterogeneous placement.

AI.tldr: Atlas是一个在SLO约束下优化复合AI工作流部署的框架，通过马尔可夫精度预测器(MAP)从相邻工作流阶段之间的局部条件精度转换来估计配置精度，并将执行计划选择建模为混合整数线性规划以最大化预测精度。
AI.motivation: 复合AI工作流通过协调多个AI模型和软件组件来执行复杂AI任务，但每个阶段可暴露不同的模型变体和资源需求，导致部署选择空间急剧膨胀。现有的部署优化方案要么端到端完整配置画像（扩展性差），要么使用将各阶段视为独立的产品式精度替代指标（可能错误排序候选方案）。缺少能够在工作流拓扑中准确估计配置精度且可扩展的方法。
AI.method: Atlas引入MAP（马尔可夫精度预测器），将中间输出离散化为精度桶，根据相邻工作流阶段之间的条件精度转换来组合转换画像，从而无需穷举端到端画像即可估计配置精度。Atlas将执行计划选择建模为混合整数线性规划(MILP)，在SLO约束下最大化预测精度，并通过异构集群上的位置分配实现成本优化。
AI.result: 在四个复合AI工作流中，MAP实现了高达0.947的Spearman相关系数，同时将画像成本相比穷举端到端画像降低最多2.6倍。在MAP引导下，Atlas优化器选择的执行计划与oracle精度的差距在0.03以内，并通过异构放置将部署成本降低高达42%。
AI.conclusion: Atlas通过马尔可夫式精度预测方法有效解决了复合AI部署中精度估计的难题，在保持高精度估计的同时大幅降低画像开销，实现了SLO约束下的优化部署。

title: Revisiting MemGuard Overhead: A Reproduction Report
summary:
As an increasing number of embedded platforms incorporate multiple processing units, shared resource contention induced unpredictable execution time poses a challenge for real-time system design. Memory bandwidth regulation is a popular mitigation approach, and MemGuard is the canonical example. Recently, MemPol introduced a new bandwidth regulation mechanism, which was compared with MemGuard. Specifically, they reported significant overheads for MemGuard, citing up to a 1.79x slowdown, to contextualize MemPol's comparative benefits.
  This report is meant to clarify and add the necessary nuance to the experiments carried out in that prior work. Specifically, we show that the MemGuard overheads presented in these prior evaluations were unintentionally amplified as the result of using a suboptimal configuration with an older version of MemGuard, wherein the benchmark under test was pinned directly to the master core responsible for handling global timer interrupts. By faithfully reproducing these specific experiments using a modern, decentralized implementation of MemGuard, we demonstrate that the actual execution overhead drops significantly under identical conditions.
  Consequently, when evaluated with a properly configured recent version, MemGuard exhibits an overhead that is highly comparable to MemPol's overhead. By revisiting these baseline metrics, this report provides an updated and comprehensive perspective required for future evaluations of memory bandwidth regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文澄清了MemPol先前工作中对MemGuard内存带宽调节机制性能开销的评估偏差，指出其使用旧版MemGuard且在次优配置下运行（测试基准被固定在与主核心相同的位置导致全局定时器中断干扰），通过在现代去中心化实现下复现实验证明MemGuard的实际开销远低于先前报告的1.79倍减速，与MemPol相当。
AI.motivation: 在嵌入式多处理平台中，共享资源争用导致执行时间不可预测，内存带宽调节是重要缓解手段。MemPol此前声称MemGuard存在高达1.79倍的开销，本文旨在纠正这一被意外放大的评估结果，为未来的内存带宽调节器研究提供准确基线。
AI.method: 作者使用现代去中心化版本的MemGuard实现，在与被测实验完全相同的条件下忠实复现了MemPol的原始实验设置，同时指出了先前配置中的关键缺陷：基准测试被直接固定在与负责处理全局定时器中断的主核心上。
AI.result: 在相同实验条件下，现代去中心化MemGuard的实际执行开销显著低于先前报告的水平。正确配置的MemGuard与MemPol的开销高度可比，先前的1.79倍减速幅度被证明是配置不当和旧版本实现共同导致的假象。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为内存带宽调节器的评估提供了更新且全面的视角，强调了实验配置和实现版本对基准测试结果的重要影响，提醒研究者在进行比较评估时需使用恰当的基线设置。

title: Improving Progressive Compression with Adaptive Interpolation and Coefficient Decomposition
summary: Exascale simulations generate data far faster than it can be stored or analyzed, making efficient data reduction essential. Error-controlled lossy compression offers high compression ratios under user-specified error bounds, but the target tolerance must be fixed at compression time. Progressive compression relaxes this restriction, yet existing methods still rely on fixed refactoring strategies and do not fully exploit correlations among decomposed coefficients, limiting the efficiency of progressive retrieval. In this work, we present an adaptive progressive compression framework that improves retrieval efficiency for two common targets, namely error-bound and peak Signal-to-Noise ratios. Our contributions are fourfold. (1) We propose to leverage two complementary interpolation schemes for adaptive progressive compression toward different targets, and we optimize them to achieve high efficiency. (2) We propose coefficient decomposition, a novel method that exploits the commonly overlooked spatial correlations among decorrelated data, which further improves the efficiency. (3) We develop the adaptive progressive compression workflow with automatic selection of the best-fit refactoring pipeline and tailored optimizations. (4) We evaluate the proposed framework on five real-world scientific datasets against three state-of-the-art progressive compressors. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework improves the compression ratio by up to $42.3\%$ under the same requested error tolerance and up to $92.5\%$ at the same PSNR, compared with the best-performing existing methods. When transferring $512$ GB of scientific data to remote sites, the framework delivers up to $1.26\times$ speedup in the end-to-end data transfer performance. Furthermore, our method achieves the highest visualization quality while retrieving the least amount of data from storage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应渐进压缩框架（adaptive progressive compression framework），通过互补插值方案、系数分解（coefficient decomposition）方法以及自动选择最佳重构（refactoring）流水线，在误差边界和峰值信噪比（PSNR）两种常见目标下显著提升压缩比和检索效率。
AI.motivation: 百亿亿次级（Exascale）模拟产生的数据远超存储与分析能力，急需高效数据缩减手段。传统的容错有损压缩虽能在用户指定误差范围内提供高压缩比，但目标容差必须在压缩时固定；渐进压缩虽解决了此限制，但现有方法仍依赖固定重构策略，未充分利用分解系数间的相关性，导致渐进检索效率受限。
AI.method: （1）提出利用两种互补插值方案实现面向不同目标的自适应渐进压缩并优化效率；（2）提出系数分解方法，利用去相关数据间常被忽视的空间相关性进一步提升效率；（3）开发自适应渐进压缩工作流，自动选择最佳重构流水线并进行针对性优化；（4）在五个真实科学数据集上与三种最先进渐进压缩器对比评估。
AI.result: 在相同误差容差下压缩比最高提升42.3%，在相同PSNR下压缩比最高提升92.5%；传输512GB科学数据到远程站点时端到端数据传输性能最高提升1.26倍；在检索最少存储数据量的同时实现了最高可视化质量。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的自适应渐进压缩框架在压缩比、数据传输性能和可视化质量方面均全面超越现有最先进方法，证明自适应重构策略与系数间相关性挖掘是提升渐进压缩效率的有效途径。

title: Advancing Alzheimer's Disease Treatment: Synergistic Ligand Combinations Targeting BACE1 via Multi-Ligand Simultaneous Docking
comment: \c{opyright} 2025 by the Author(s). This article is an open access article distributed under the terms and conditions of the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License
summary: Alzheimer's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by memory loss, cognitive decline, and behavioral changes, primarily affecting the elderly. Current treatments focus on symptom management as no therapies effectively halt or reverse disease progression. Newer therapies targeting BACE1, a key enzyme in amyloid plaque formation, have shown promise in clinical trials, though they have been limited by side effects and insufficient efficacy in slowing cognitive decline. This is the first study where multi-ligand simultaneous docking (MLSD) was employed to identify potential synergistic inhibitor combinations from among thousands of small molecules that could yield better results than the current phase-III inhibitors of BACE1. The recent phase III drugs such as Atabecestat, Elenbecestat, Lanabecestat, and Verubecestat were considered to be standards for comparison in this study. A library of small molecules with known IC50 values against BACE1 was filtered for flagging Pan-Assay Interference (PAINS) and "Brenk" compounds. Single-ligand docking revealed individual ligand interactions with the protein, forming the basis for creating ligand pairs tested in MLSD. Among these combinations, CHEMBL4078427 and CHEMBL3656158, CHEMBL4078427 and CHEMBL3695732, Verubecestat and CHEMBL3656158, and CHEMBL4078427 and Lanabecestat demonstrated excellent binding affinity of -19.90 kcal/mol, -18.45 kcal/mol, -18.07 kcal/mol, and -17.67 kcal/mol with the protein, which is significantly greater than those of phase-III inhibitors, along with inter-ligand interactions indicative of a synergistic effect. These findings underscore the transformative potential of MLSD in identifying synergistic compound interactions, paving the way for novel combination therapies in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次采用多配体同时对接（MLSD）技术，从数千个小分子中筛选出能够与BACE1酶协同结合的抑制剂组合，发现四组配体对的结合亲和力（-17.67至-19.90 kcal/mol）显著优于当前III期临床药物（Atabecestat、Elenbecestat、Lanabecestat、Verubecestat），为阿尔茨海默病的联合治疗提供了新方向。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病尚无有效阻止或逆转疾病进展的疗法，现有III期BACE1抑制剂（如Atabecestat等）因副作用和认知衰退减缓效果不足而受限，亟需寻找更有效的治疗策略。
AI.method: 从已知IC50值的小分子文库中筛选BACE1抑制剂，排除PAINS和Brenk化合物；先进行单配体对接以了解各配体与蛋白的相互作用，再基于此构建配体对，通过多配体同时对接（MLSD）评估协同结合效果，以III期药物为对照标准。
AI.result: 四组配体组合（CHEMBL4078427+CHEMBL3656158、CHEMBL4078427+CHEMBL3695732、Verubecestat+CHEMBL3656158、CHEMBL4078427+Lanabecestat）展现出优异的结合亲和力（-19.90、-18.45、-18.07、-17.67 kcal/mol），显著优于III期抑制剂，且存在配体间相互作用，提示协同效应。
AI.conclusion: MLSD技术在识别协同性化合物相互作用方面展现了变革性潜力，为阿尔茨海默病的新型组合疗法开发奠定了理论基础。

title: Budgeting Bytes: A Windowed Storage Roofline and Dual-Budget Architecture Ablations for Storage-Bound LLM Decoding
comment: Workshop draft. Deployment numbers are single-run per configuration; negatives (prefetch/oracle) reported honestly. Code, data, and paper source: https://github.com/William2333ZZ/budgeting-bytes
summary: Autoregressive decoding on cheap hardware is bound not by FLOPs but by the bytes each generated token must move across the slowest populated tier of a memory hierarchy. We treat bytes-per-token as a first-class design axis, organized by an address-determinism taxonomy that classifies parameters by when their fetch address becomes known during a token's forward pass (A0: at token sampling; A1: before attention; A2: layerwise data-dependent; A3: always read). This reduces prefetch scheduling to single-machine feasibility with release times, yielding a closed-form windowed roofline. We run dual-budget (bytes-per-token times storage) ablations across three sub-100M scales, then take the framework to real large-MoE deployment and report a substantial negative result the roofline predicts: on an 8GB edge board running Qwen3-30B-A3B (4-bit, 18GB), the model overflows RAM and decode is pinned at the eMMC bandwidth ceiling; predictive expert prefetch does not help -- not temporal-locality prefetch (net-negative), not even a trace-driven oracle with perfect prediction -- because the binding constraint is byte volume over a saturated bus, which prefetch cannot reduce. The lever that works is reducing bytes-per-token until the model fits the fast tier: quantized to fit a 16GB unified-memory device, the same model runs GPU-resident at 11.5 tok/s (22x). We reconcile this with GPU-serving expert-prefetch predictors: a frozen-model probe predicts Qwen3-30B routing from the pre-attention state at 91.2%, a scale-invariant predictability property, but this converts to throughput only where the fast tier caches most of the model and per-token transfer is comparable to compute -- measured to hold on an A100 PCIe-offload path and to fail on bandwidth-walled edge storage. Predictability is not speedup; we chart where the gap closes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"每token字节数"（bytes-per-token）作为自回归解码的一等设计轴，通过地址确定性分类（A0/A1/A2/A3）将预取调度简化为带释放时间的单机可行问题，推导出闭式窗口化roofline。在真实大MoE部署中发现：在8GB边缘板上，Qwen3-30B-A3B溢出RAM，解码被eMMC带宽天花板固定，专家预测性预取（包括完美预言机）均无效，因为约束是饱和总线上的字节量而非预取可减少的时延。有效杠杆是压缩至适配快速层：16GB统一内存设备上GPU驻留达11.5 tok/s（22x加速）。预取器的预测精度（91.2%）只有在快速层缓存大部分模型时才转化为吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归解码优化大多以FLOPs为中心，但在廉价硬件上实际瓶颈是生成每个token必须跨内存层级最慢层搬运的字节数。作者主张将bytes-per-token作为首要设计维度，并通过理论框架指导实际部署。
AI.method: 引入地址确定性（address-determinism）分类法：按token前向传播中参数取址地址何时可知（A0: token采样时；A1: attention前；A2: 逐层数据依赖；A3: 总是读取）对参数分类。将预取调度建模为带释放时间的单机调度问题，推导闭式窗口化roofline。在三个sub-100M规模上进行双预算消融，并将框架用于8GB边缘板上的Qwen3-30B-A3B（4-bit, 18GB）真实部署。
AI.result: 在8GB边缘板上模型溢出RAM，解码被eMMC带宽天花板固定；时序局部性预取为净负效应，甚至完美预测的轨迹驱动预言机也无法帮助。将模型量化至适配16GB统一内存设备后，GPU驻留运行达11.5 tok/s（22x）。预测性预取器在A100 PCIe-offload路径上可转化为吞吐（快速层缓存大部分模型且每token传输量与计算相当），但在带宽受限的边缘存储上失效。
AI.conclusion: 预测性不等于加速：专家预取的预测精度（91.2%）只有在快速层能缓存大部分模型时才转化为实际吞吐提升。密集量化以减小bytes-per-token（直至模型适配快速层）才是带宽受限场景下的有效杠杆。

title: Self-Supervised Pretraining of Molecular Graph Encoders with LeJEPA
summary: Self-supervised pretraining has transformed language and vision, but its value for molecular graph neural networks remains contested. We ask whether pretraining on a large unlabelled corpus improves molecular property prediction. We adapt LeJEPA, a predictor-free joint-embedding predictive architecture regularised by Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularisation (SIGReg), to molecular graphs, evaluating GPS and Chemprop-style D-MPNN encoders on the Wong et al. [1] antibiotic-activity dataset and ogbg-molhiv using a multi-seed, bootstrap-based protocol. Pretraining improves learned representations but does not robustly improve finetuning. A frozen probe on pretrained embeddings exceeds random initialisation on both tasks (ogbg-molhiv ROC-AUC 0.788 vs 0.665; +0.123), reaching the published self-supervised band, but this does not translate into finetuning gains. On the antibiotic scaffold split, a canonical partition is significant (delta AUPRC +0.041, p = 0.010), but the effect vanishes across five partitions (pooled +0.013, p = 0.095). Finetuning is null on the random split, ogbg-molhiv, and D-MPNN. The representational edge is nevertheless recoverable. Embeddings saturate at ~16-32 effective dimensions, whereas Morgan fingerprints improve to 1024 bits. At matched dimensionality, fingerprints lead validation (0.799 vs 0.782 at 128 dimensions) but trail shifted test scaffolds (0.759 vs 0.788). Truncating embeddings and combining them with a 1024-bit Morgan fingerprint raises ogbg-molhiv ROC-AUC from 0.805 to 0.832 (delta +0.027; 95% CI [+0.003, +0.054]; p = 0.014); an untrained encoder gains nothing (delta -0.003). Thus, pretraining supplies complementary information best realised through feature-level combination, while finetuning gains are weak and partition-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了自监督预训练对分子图神经网络的价值，发现预训练虽能改善学习到的表示（嵌入质量），但不能稳健地提升微调性能。然而，通过将截断的预训练嵌入与Morgan指纹在特征层面结合，可在ogbg-molhiv上实现显著的ROC-AUC提升（+0.027），表明预训练的互补信息最好通过特征级组合来释放。
AI.motivation: 自监督预训练已在语言和视觉领域取得巨大成功，但其对分子图神经网络的贡献仍存在争议。作者希望厘清：在大型无标注语料上的预训练究竟能否真正提升分子性质预测任务的表现，以及这种提升（如果存在）以何种形式最有效地体现。
AI.method: 作者将LeJEPA（无预测器的联合嵌入预测架构，辅以Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularisation, SIGReg）适配到分子图，评估GPS和Chemprop风格D-MPNN编码器。实验在Wong抗生素活性数据集和ogbg-molhiv上进行，采用多种子、bootstrap协议。具体包括：冻结探针评估、五种分区下的抗生素支架分裂测试、嵌入维度饱和度分析、以及与Morgan指纹的维度匹配和特征级组合实验。
AI.result: (1) 预训练改善表示但不稳健提升微调：冻结探针在ogbg-molhiv上ROC-AUC从0.665提升到0.788（+0.123）；(2) 抗生素支架分裂仅在一个规范分区显著（ΔAUPRC +0.041, p=0.010），跨五分区汇聚后不显著（+0.013, p=0.095）；(3) 嵌入在约16-32有效维度即饱和，Morgan指纹可达1024位；(4) 维度匹配时指纹在验证集占优（0.799 vs 0.782），但在位移测试支架上落后（0.759 vs 0.788）；(5) 截断嵌入+1024位Morgan指纹组合将ogbg-molhiv ROC-AUC从0.805提升至0.832（Δ+0.027, p=0.014），未训练编码器组合无增益（Δ-0.003）。
AI.conclusion: 自监督预训练为分子图网络提供了互补于传统描述符（Morgan指纹）的信息，其价值主要体现在特征级组合（而非微调）上。微调增益薄弱且依赖具体分区选择，说明当前预训练范式对分子性质预测的实践收益需要更审慎的评估协议和更有效的利用方式。

title: FailureSpot: Label-Efficient Timestamp-Level Failure Detection for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but they can still fail unpredictably during long-horizon execution, making reliable failure detection essential for safe deployment. Existing methods either rely on visual models that typically detect failures only after erroneous actions have occurred, or use lightweight proactive detectors trained on VLA internal representations. However, these proactive methods are often supervised with trajectory-level labels, causing normal pre-failure behavior in unsuccessful trajectories to be incorrectly labeled as failure. This supervision mismatch introduces label noise and limits both trajectory-level detection accuracy and precise timestamp-level failure localization. In this work, we study fine-grained timestamp-level VLA failure detection while addressing the cost of dense annotation. We propose a data-efficient framework that first leverages unlabeled VLA action chunks to construct action-derived weak supervision signals, capturing abnormal patterns such as inconsistent consecutive chunks, frozen or idle actions, and aggressive random motions. We then use active learning to select only the most uncertain trajectories for timestamp-level annotation and fine-tune the detector with these informative labels. Experiments across multiple VLA policies show that our method improves both timestamp-level and trajectory-level failure detection performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据高效的框架用于VLA策略的细粒度时间戳级失败检测，通过利用无标签动作块构建弱监督信号，并结合主动学习选择最不确定的轨迹进行标注，从而在降低密集标注成本的同时提升时间戳级和轨迹级的失败检测性能。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在长时程机器人操作中可能不可预测地失败，需要可靠的失败检测机制以保证安全部署。现有方法要么依赖视觉模型在错误动作发生后才检测失败（滞后），要么使用基于VLA内部表示训练的轻量级主动检测器，但后者通常使用轨迹级标签进行监督，导致未成功轨迹中正常的失败前行为被错误标记为失败，引入标签噪声，限制了轨迹级检测精度和精确的时间戳级失败定位能力。
AI.method: 本文提出一种数据高效的框架，包含两个关键步骤：(1) 利用无标签的VLA动作块构建动作衍生的弱监督信号，捕捉异常模式，如连续动作块不一致、冻结或空闲动作、以及过度随机的运动；(2) 采用主动学习策略，仅选择最不确定的轨迹进行时间戳级标注，并用这些信息量丰富的标签对检测器进行微调。
AI.result: 在多种VLA策略上的实验表明，该方法在时间戳级和轨迹级失败检测性能上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法解决了现有主动式VLA失败检测方法中轨迹级标签监督不匹配导致标签噪声的问题，通过动作衍生的弱监督和主动学习在控制标注成本的前提下，实现了更精确的时间戳级失败检测以及更优的轨迹级检测效果。

title: FailSAE: Towards Interpretable Failure Prediction for Vision-Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, have achieved strong performance across multimodal tasks by aligning visual and textual representations in a shared embedding space. As VLMs are increasingly used for high-stakes domains, failure prediction becomes critical for risk-aware deployment and human intervention. Existing failure prediction methods typically rely on confidence scores or auxiliary classifiers. Although these methods are effective on predicting VLM failures, they provide limited interpretability. In this work, we investigate the use of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) for interpretable failure prediction in VLMs. We formulate failure prediction as a classification task over sparse SAE latent activations and introduce a three-stage failure-aware training pipeline that encourages the learned latent directions to remain interpretable while becoming more informative for failure prediction. Our experiments show that the resulting framework outperforms the evaluated baselines in failure prediction. Further analysis suggests that failure-aware training encourages SAE latent directions to capture more class-specific concepts. We also use the SAE to provide a concept-level analysis of how model representations change during failures, revealing a shift from class-specific concepts toward more ambiguous or style-related concepts. Finally, we explore how the learned SAE latent directions can support runtime failure recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）实现视觉-语言模型（VLM）的可解释失败预测，通过一个三阶段的失败感知训练框架，在保持潜在方向可解释性的同时提升失败预测性能，并支持失败恢复。
AI.motivation: VLM（如CLIP）在多模态任务中表现出色，但常被用于高风险领域。现有失败预测方法（如置信度评分或辅助分类器）虽能有效预测失败，但可解释性有限，无法帮助用户理解模型为何失败，进而难以进行人为干预。
AI.method: 将失败预测形式化为对稀疏SAE潜在激活的分类任务，引入三阶段失败感知训练流水线：该流水线鼓励学习的潜在方向保持可解释性的同时，更能提供与失败预测相关的信息。
AI.result: 实验表明所提出的框架在失败预测上优于评估的基线方法；进一步分析显示失败感知训练促使SAE潜在方向捕捉更多类特定的概念。通过SAE的概念级分析揭示了模型表示在失败过程中从类特定概念向模糊或风格相关概念转移的现象。
AI.conclusion: SAE不仅能够实现可解释的VLM失败预测，其学到的潜在方向还可用于概念级的失败原因分析和运行时失败恢复，为高风险场景下的VLM可靠部署提供了可行路径。

title: Spectral-Target Physical Latent Structuring for JEPA-Style World Models
summary: Latent world models have become increasingly popular as a method to predict and plan in latent space rather than pixel space. Recent architectures, such as LeWorldModel (LeWM), jointly train the encoder and predictor using regularization techniques like SIGReg to prevent representation collapse. Even with such regularization preventing representation collapse, we identify a new world model failure mode of \textit{physical representation laziness}, particularly noted in highly dynamic environments. For these lazy cases, the learned latent states do not collapse but nonetheless fail to represent key physical properties, causing ubiquitous downstream planning failure. To resolve this issue, we propose training-time auxiliary supervision with a lightweight "Fourier auxiliary head", which enforces physically-informed structuring of the latent space with no additional inference-time cost and can be generalized to any environment. Experimentally, we show that the auxiliary head substantially improves planning success rates in dynamic environments where the baseline LeWM exhibits physical representation laziness. It also leads to modest improvements in other environments, even when the baseline does not exhibit physical representation laziness. We further observe superior planning performance being accompanied by higher latent space correlations with key physical properties, indicating both the ability of our method to physically structure latent states and the potential planning-side benefit to the learned representation being physically structured. We also see in low-data regimes, auxiliary supervision is particularly impactful in increasing success rate. These findings support the use of our Fourier auxiliary head method to improve both overall success rate and data efficiency, while avoiding representation laziness in latent world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"傅里叶辅助头"（Fourier auxiliary head）训练时监督方法，用以解决潜世界模型（LeWorldModel）在高动态环境中出现的"物理表征惰性"（physical representation laziness）问题——即潜状态虽未坍缩但未能表征关键物理属性，导致下游规划失败。该方法无推理时开销，可推广至任意环境，显著提升动态环境中的规划成功率，并在低数据场景下尤为有效。
AI.motivation: 现有潜世界模型通过正则化（如SIGReg）防止表征坍缩，但作者发现在高动态环境中存在一种新的失败模式——"物理表征惰性"：潜状态没有坍缩，却未能捕捉关键的物理属性（如速度、动量等），导致下游规划普遍失败。这一问题与表征坍缩不同，需要针对性的解决方案。
AI.method: 在训练阶段引入轻量级的"傅里叶辅助头"（Fourier auxiliary head），通过辅助监督信号强制潜空间具备物理信息结构。该方法仅在训练时使用，不增加推理计算开销，且具有适用于任意环境的通用性。
AI.result: 实验表明：1）在LeWM表现出物理表征惰性的动态环境中，辅助头显著提升了规划成功率；2）在基线无惰性问题的环境中，也有适度提升；3）方法使潜空间与关键物理属性之间呈现更高的相关性，说明其对潜状态的物理结构化有效；4）在低数据场景下，辅助监督对成功率的提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 傅里叶辅助头方法能有效改善潜世界模型的规划成功率与数据效率，避免物理表征惰性问题，且不产生额外推理成本。潜空间中物理信息结构的增强与规划性能改善之间的正相关关系，进一步支持了物理结构化表征对规划任务的重要性。

title: How Much Does Corpus Choice Change Dependency-Distance Estimates?
summary: Dependency-distance estimates derived from a single corpus are routinely treated as properties of a language, yet this assumption has not been tested across independently compiled corpora. We compared mean dependency-distance estimates across 38 same-language treebank pairs from Universal Dependencies v2.18, using concordance correlation, Bland-Altman analysis, and a twelve-specification multiverse design. Cross-treebank agreement was moderate at best: substituting one treebank for another reversed nearly 40 percent of pairwise language orderings, and treebank choice accounted for roughly 29 percent of between-group variance. This disagreement substantially exceeded within-treebank sampling error and persisted across all twelve preprocessing specifications. Nevertheless, every treebank confirmed dependency-length minimization (normalized ratio below 1). The data are more consistent with MDD as a corpus-conditioned composite of grammatical, register, and annotation factors than as a stable language-level parameter: the qualitative DLM universal survives corpus substitution, but the ordinal cross-linguistic ranking does not.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过38对同语言树库（Universal Dependencies v2.18）的跨语料库比较，检验了平均依存距离（MDD）是否可被视为稳定的语言属性。结果显示跨树库一致性仅为中等：替换树库会逆转约40%的语言排序，树库选择解释了约29%的组间方差，且所有12种预处理规格下结论均稳定。但所有树库都确认了依存长度最小化（DLM）普遍性。因此MDD更像是一个受语法、语域和标注因素共同影响的语料库条件性综合指标，而非稳定的语言级参数。
AI.motivation: 此前研究常将基于单一语料库估算的依存距离数据视为语言的固有属性，但这一前提从未在独立编译的语料库之间得到系统检验。该研究旨在填补这一方法论空白，检验MDD估计的跨语料库可重复性和跨语言可比性。
AI.method: 使用Universal Dependencies v2.18中38对同语言树库，采用三种互补方法进行分析：(1) 一致性相关系数（concordance correlation）评估跨树库一致性；(2) Bland-Altman分析量化偏见和一致范围；(3) 十二规格多宇宙设计（multiverse design）检验预处理选择的影响，同时对照树库内抽样误差作为基线。
AI.result: 跨树库一致性最多为中等等级：替换树库导致近40%的语言两两排序发生反转；树库选择约占组间方差的29%；这一不一致性显著超过树库内抽样误差，并在所有12种预处理规格下保持不变。但每个树库均证实了依存长度最小化（归一化比率低于1）。
AI.conclusion: 数据更支持将MDD视为语法、语域和标注因素交织作用下的语料库条件性综合指标，而非稳定的语言级参数。定性的DLM普遍规律（qualitative universal）在语料库替换后依然成立，但定量的跨语言排序（ordinal ranking）不具备可重复性。

title: EXAONE Forecast for Finance
summary: This technical report presents EXAONE Forecast for Finance (EXAONE Finance), a financial time series (TS) foundation model (TSFM) tailored to financial forecasting. Recent TSFMs achieve strong zero-shot performance through large-scale pretraining. However, they are primarily developed for general-domain TS and largely rely on self-attention backbones whose computational cost grows quadratically with sequence length and variate count. Moreover, they assume fully observed inputs and are pretrained on corpora that fail to capture the unique dynamics of financial markets. These limitations hinder their applicability to finance, where long, many-channel, intermittently observed panels are common. To address these challenges, EXAONE Finance adopts an attention-free architecture, replacing self-attention with two simple yet effective linear-time operators: 1) a causal 1D convolution for temporal mixing and 2) a group-aware pooling multi-layer perceptron (MLP) for variate mixing. Furthermore, a masked context augmentation exposes the model to contiguous missing spans during training, improving robustness to the missingness pervasive in financial markets. EXAONE Finance is pretrained on a large-scale financial corpus covering not only equities but also foreign exchange, commodities, crypto-assets, fixed income, and macroeconomic indicators. On FinVerse, a financial forecasting benchmark covering diverse asset classes, EXAONE Finance attains state-of-the-art performance, ranking first across all three evaluation tiers---point-forecast accuracy, cross-sectional asset ranking, and portfolio profitability.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍EXAONE Finance，一个专为金融时间序列预测设计的无注意力基础模型（TSFM）。它采用因果一维卷积进行时间混合、分组感知池化MLP进行变量混合，并通过掩码上下文增强提高对缺失数据的鲁棒性。该模型在大规模多资产金融语料上预训练，在FinVerse基准上取得三个评估层级（点预测精度、横截面资产排序、组合盈利）全面最优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有通用时间序列基础模型存在三个局限：一是基于自注意力架构，计算复杂度随序列长度和变量数量呈二次增长；二是假设输入完全观测，无法处理金融市场普遍存在的数据缺失；三是预训练语料未能捕捉金融市场的独特动态。这些限制阻碍了其在金融领域（长序列、多通道、间歇观测的面板数据）的应用。
AI.method: 采用无注意力架构：1）用因果一维卷积替代自注意力实现时间混合；2）用分组感知池化MLP实现变量混合。此外提出掩码上下文增强训练策略，在训练阶段向模型暴露连续缺失片段，增强对金融数据普遍缺失的鲁棒性。在大规模金融预训练语料上训练，覆盖股票、外汇、大宗商品、加密资产、固定收益和宏观经济指标。
AI.result: 在覆盖多种资产类别的FinVerse金融预测基准上，EXAONE Finance达到目前最优性能，在点预测精度、横截面资产排序和组合盈利三个评估层级均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: EXAONE Finance验证了无注意力线性时间算子（一维卷积+分组池化MLP）结合金融专属预训练语料和缺失鲁棒训练策略，能够有效解决金融时间序列预测中长序列、多通道、高缺失率的挑战，展现出金融领域专用TSFM的可行性。

title: Blockchain-Enabled Secure Logging for Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms: Evaluation of the Greek eSEND and myDATA Tax Systems
summary: This paper analyzes the implementation of blockchain-based integrity mechanisms in Greek Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms (FEMs) and the central tax information system eSEND. The study examines the cryptographic architecture of fiscal devices, including Electronic Cash Registers, Fiscal Printers, Fiscal Signing Machines, and FEMAS devices, which implement double or triple hash-chain structures to ensure transaction immutability. The transmission protocol between fiscal devices and the central database is also evaluated with respect to encryption, sequential validation, and blockchain verification. In contrast, the architecture of Electronic Invoicing Provider Services and the myDATA central platform is analyzed, highlighting the absence of blockchain-based integrity guarantees. The comparison demonstrates that hardware-based fiscal mechanisms provide stronger guarantees for transaction completeness and tamper resistance than purely software-based invoicing infrastructures. The findings highlight architectural weaknesses in the current e-invoicing framework and propose improvements for ensuring transaction integrity in digital tax ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了希腊税务系统中硬件型财政电子机制（FEMs）与软件型电子发票平台（myDATA/eSEND）在区块链完整性保障方面的架构差异，指出硬件方案在防篡改与交易完整性上更强，并针对现有电子发票框架的架构弱点提出改进建议。
AI.motivation: 希腊税务系统同时部署了基于硬件的财政电子机制（采用区块链技术确保交易不可篡改）和基于软件的电子发票基础设施（缺乏区块链完整性保障），但两者在完整性保障能力上的系统性比较尚不明确。作者旨在揭示当前电子发票框架的架构性弱点，为数字税务生态系统的交易完整性改进提供依据。
AI.method: 对希腊财政电子机制（包括电子收银机、财政打印机、财政签名机及FEMAS设备）的密码学架构进行分析，重点考察其双重或三重哈希链结构；同时评估财政设备与中央数据库（eSEND）之间的传输协议在加密、顺序验证和区块链验证方面的实现；并与电子发票服务提供商和myDATA中央平台的架构进行对比分析。
AI.result: 研究发现硬件型财政机制（采用哈希链和区块链验证）相比纯软件型电子发票基础设施（缺少区块链完整性保障）能提供更强的交易完整性与防篡改保证；电子发票框架在架构上存在明显弱点，且当前系统无法提供与硬件设备同等的完整性保障水平。
AI.conclusion: 电子发票系统的交易完整性保障需要借鉴硬件型财政机制的区块链设计理念进行强化，作者提出改进措施以增强数字税务生态系统中交易完整性的整体表现。

title: CIERA: Cross-Iteration Exponent Reuse for Lossless Allgather in Sharded MoE Training
summary: In training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, sharded data parallelism partitions each expert's parameters across GPUs, requiring an Allgather operation to reconstruct the full weight matrix before each layer executes. This communication often dominates iteration time. Prior work often reduces this overhead using lossy compression methods that sacrifice numerical fidelity, while existing lossless methods do not exploit cross-iteration exponent stability. In this paper, we propose Cross-Iteration Exponent Reuse Allgather (CIERA), a lossless, system-aware communication method for sharded MoE training. We observe that after a brief warmup phase, the exponent values of most weights remain unchanged across iterations. Based on this, we cache exponents locally and transmit only the sign and mantissa when exponents are unchanged. The receiver reconstructs the original weights exactly by combining the cached exponents with the received data. Since parameter matrices vary in shape across layers, compression is applied only when it yields net time savings. Moreover, the compression operation is overlapped with both Allgather communication and computation. Our real experiments and large-scale trace-driven simulator show that on OLMoE-1B-7B at 16 GPUs, CIERA achieves a 3.70x speedup over the lossless baseline and 3.68x over the lossy baseline, projected to reach 4.28x and 4.42x respectively at 128 GPUs, while preserving bitwise-exact parameter reconstruction in all evaluated runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIERA，一种用于MoE模型分片分布式训练的无损通信方法。该方法利用跨迭代权重指数值稳定性，缓存指数并在指数不变时仅传输符号和尾数，实现bitwise精确重建权重，同时大幅减少Allgather通信开销。在OLMoE-1B-7B上相比无损和有损基线分别实现3.70x和3.68x加速（16 GPU），并外推至128 GPU的更高性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在MoE模型训练中，分片数据并行需要在每层执行前通过Allgather操作重建完整的专家权重矩阵，该通信开销常主导迭代时间。现有损失压缩方法牺牲数值精度，而现存无损方法未利用跨迭代指数稳定性这一特性，因此需要一种既能无损又高效降低通信开销的方法。
AI.method: CIERA的核心思路：1) 观察到短暂预热后大多数权重的指数值在迭代间保持不变；2) 在本地缓存指数，当指数不变时仅传输符号和尾数部分；3) 接收方结合缓存指数与接收数据精确重建原始权重；4) 根据参数矩阵形状（逐层）判断压缩是否带来净时间节省，仅对有利情况应用压缩；5) 将压缩操作与Allgather通信和计算重叠以隐藏开销。
AI.result: 在OLMoE-1B-7B、16 GPU真实实验中，CIERA相比无损基线实现3.70x加速，相比有损基线实现3.68x加速；通过大规模trace驱动模拟器外推，在128 GPU下预计分别达到4.28x和4.42x加速。所有评估运行中保持位级精确的参数重建。
AI.conclusion: CIERA证明了跨迭代指数稳定性可以在MoE分片训练中实现无损且高效通信，克服了以往有损压缩精度损失与无损方法效率不足的权衡，为大规模MoE训练提供了可扩展的高性能通信方案。

title: The physical foundation beneath protein generative modeling
summary: Physical equations in protein modeling appear to have been replaced by generative models trained directly on structure data. By learning a mapping from noise to data, sampling de novo protein structures has become much more efficient. However, such models can also learn non-physical features and break down with out-of-distribution settings which are typical in protein design campaigns. In this review, we highlight where the physics persists in protein generative modeling pipelines and the issues that linger when physically relevant components of a macromolecular system are left unmodeled. We present a perspective that respecting the underlying physics of macromolecular systems, increasingly through learned representations that are physically grounded and updating generative models with experimental data, is foundational to generative modeling for functional protein design.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述性观点文章，探讨蛋白质生成式建模中物理规律的持续作用，主张将物理知识——尤其是通过学习得到的物理基元表征和实验数据更新——融入生成模型，是实现功能性蛋白质设计的基础。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型在蛋白质从头设计中已取代基于物理方程的建模方法，但这类数据驱动模型可能学习到非物理特征，且在蛋白质设计场景中常见的分布外（out-of-distribution）条件下容易失效。因此需要审视物理规律在生成式建模管线中的角色与缺失带来的问题。
AI.method: 以综述+观点（perspective）形式，系统梳理蛋白质生成建模管线中物理规律仍然存在的环节，并指出当大分子系统中具有物理相关性的组分未被建模时所遗留的问题。
AI.result: 提出核心观点：尊重大分子系统底层物理规律（日益通过物理基元的表征学习来实现），并利用实验数据持续更新生成模型，是功能性蛋白质设计生成式建模的基石。
AI.conclusion: 物理并未在生成式蛋白质建模中被完全取代，而是以更隐性的方式融入；将物理合理性重新纳入生成式框架将提升模型在真实设计场景中的泛化性与功能性。

title: MonoMoE: An Efficient Fused Mega-kernel for Quantized MoE Decoding
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without proportionally increasing arithmetic, but their sparse expert computation is difficult to execute efficiently during autoregressive decode. Existing grouped and batched GEMMs are token-major: they construct expert-local token tiles and obtain parallelism from the token dimension. When few tokens reach each expert, this organization incurs tile padding and preprocessing, launches short-lived grids that underutilize memory bandwidth, and exposes quantization, activation, and reduction as separate stages. We present \textbf{MonoMoE}, a weight-major persistent megakernel for block-wise quantized MoE decode. MonoMoE places the complete decode-step token tile on the fine-grained tensor-core $N$ dimension and partitions CTAs over expert-weight tiles, eliminating expert-local token materialization and reducing padded arithmetic. A persistent grid fuses routing, top-$k$ selection, quantization, both expert projections, activation, and reduction in one launch; warp specialization and readiness flags overlap auxiliary work with the dominant expert-weight stream. MonoMoE is integrated with vLLM and supports multiple model shapes through generated kernel specializations and offline schedule tuning. On NVIDIA H200 GPUs, MonoMoE accelerates the complete routed-MoE operator by up to $\mathbf{1.54\times}$ over vLLM Triton Grouped GEMM, is $\mathbf{2.20}$--$\mathbf{3.84\times}$ faster than FlashMoE-FP8 adaptation across various models and batch sizes, and reduces end-to-end time per output token by up to $\mathbf{18.7\%}$ across the evaluated FP8 models, while preserving task accuracy. The MonoMoE implementation and supporting artifacts are open source and available in the \href{https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/tree/main/csrc/fused_moe/monomoe}{FlashInfer repository}.

AI.tldr: MonoMoE 是一种面向块级量化 MoE 解码的持久化 megakernel 设计，采用 weight-major 的数据组织方式，将完整解码 token tile 放置在细粒度张量核心 N 维上，通过持久化网格融合路由、top-k 选择、量化、专家投影、激活和归约等操作为一个启动，利用 warp specialization 和就绪标志实现辅助工作与专家权重流重叠。在 H200 上比 vLLM Triton Grouped GEMM 快 1.54×，比 FlashMoE-FP8 快 2.20–3.84×，端到端每 token 时间最多降低 18.7%。
AI.motivation: MoE 层在自回归解码阶段，由于每个 token 仅路由到少数专家，导致 token-major 的 grouped/batched GEMM 存在 tile 填充与预处理开销、短暂网格导致内存带宽利用不充分，以及量化、激活和归约等阶段分离的问题，亟需更高效的解码执行方案。
AI.method: MonoMoE 采用 weight-major 的数据布局，将完整解码步的 token tile 映射到张量核心的 N 维，CTA 按专家权重 tile 划分，从而避免专家局部 token 物化和填充计算；使用持久化网格将路由、top-k、量化、双专家投影、激活和归约融合为单次启动；通过 warp specialization 和就绪标志将辅助工作与专家权重主数据流重叠；并通过生成的内核专门化和离线调度调优支持多种模型形状。
AI.result: 在 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上，MonoMoE 将完整 routed-MoE 算子加速至 vLLM Triton Grouped GEMM 的 1.54×；相较 FlashMoE-FP8 适配，不同模型和批大小下快 2.20–3.84×；端到端每输出 token 时间在 FP8 模型上最多降低 18.7%，且保持任务精度不变。
AI.conclusion: MonoMoE 通过 weight-major 持久化 megakernel 设计有效解决了 MoE 解码中稀疏专家计算效率低下的问题，显著提升吞吐并集成于 vLLM，代码已开源至 FlashInfer 仓库。

title: Towards AI-Driven Nanomedicine Discovery: A Benchmark and Multimodal Learning Framework for Nano Self-Assembly Prediction
summary: Nano self-assembly organizes molecular components into bioactive nanoscale structures. Self-assembled nanoparticles (NAPs) derived from Chinese herbal formulas and applications such as anti-lung-cancer therapy demonstrate the substantial potential of self-assembly for nanomedicine discovery. Yet discovery still relies on costly wet-lab screening, while existing machine learning approaches lack standardized tasks, effective pairwise compatibility modeling, and public benchmarks with unified evaluation. To address these limitations, we formalize NSA prediction as a binary classification task for predicting self-assembly between molecular pairs and then establish NSA-Bench, the first public benchmark with curated molecular combinations, experimental conditions, self-assembly labels, and standardized evaluation protocols. We further develop NSA-Net, an interaction-aware multimodal framework that integrates complementary molecular evidence from graph topology, sequence semantics, and physicochemical descriptors to learn molecular-pair representations for self-assembly prediction. Extensive experiments on NSA-Bench show that NSA-Net achieves a ROC-AUC of $0.9470\pm0.0112$ (Small) and $0.9492\pm0.0062$ (Large). On the Small track, it surpasses the strongest machine-learning and graph-based baselines by 3.9 and 17.1 percentage points, respectively. Representation analyses reveal interpretable molecular characteristics associated with self-assembly prediction captured by the learned representations. Moreover, an NSA-Agent case study further demonstrates how NSA-Net predictions can support formulation refinement through experimental-condition-aware reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/developer-hq/NSA-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出纳米自组装（NSA）预测的标准化基准NSA-Bench与多模态交互感知框架NSA-Net，将自组装预测形式化为分子对二分类任务，在基准上达到0.947-0.949的AUC，显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 纳米自组装源于中药组方的纳米组装体在抗肺癌等应用中潜力巨大，但新药发现仍依赖昂贵的湿实验筛选。现有机器学习方法缺乏标准化任务、有效的分子对相容性建模以及统一评估的公共基准。
AI.method: 将NSA预测形式化为分子对二元分类任务；构建首个公共基准NSA-Bench（含分子组合、实验条件、自组装标签及标准化评估协议）；提出NSA-Net，一个交互感知的多模态框架，融合图拓扑、序列语义和物理化学描述符合分子对表征学习。
AI.result: 在NSA-Bench上，NSA-Net在Small和Large轨道的ROC-AUC分别达0.9470±0.0112和0.9492±0.0062；在Small轨道上超越最强机器学习与图基线3.9和17.1个百分点。表征分析揭示可解释的分子特征；NSA-Agent案例验证预测可支持配方优化。
AI.conclusion: NSA-Net与NSA-Bench为纳米自组装预测提供了统一的规范化基准和高效的AI预测工具，可减少湿实验筛选成本，推动基于自组装的纳米药物发现。

title: VLA-Precision: Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for Efficient Real-World Online RL of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models enable broad manipulation but remain unreliable in tasks demanding precision and repeatability. Applying real-world online reinforcement learning (RL) to VLA post-training enables autonomous trial-and-error improvement beyond demonstrations alone, but exposes two bottlenecks: 1) unreliable value signals can induce policy drift; 2) large-VLA overhead constrains throughput and sample efficiency. To address these challenges, we present VLA-Precision, an efficient real-world online RL framework featuring the Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping (ACoB) algorithm and the ACoB-Stream architecture. Specifically, ACoB establishes asymmetric co-bootstrapping across timescales: early intervention-guided behavioral learning rapidly improves policy performance while enhancing online experience quality. As autonomous experience accumulates, global return propagation and local preference ranking progressively calibrate value estimates, yielding relative action advantages for reference-regularized policy improvement while suppressing drift. To enable ACoB on large VLAs, we develop ACoB-Stream, a closed-loop experience--policy architecture that establishes invariant-state decoupling and on-demand streaming as design principles, delivering up to 10.9$\times$ improvements in throughput and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations on nine high-precision chemistry tasks across four categories and four robot embodiments show that VLA-Precision achieves 98.3\% mean success rate in 45.8 min/task, with 27.6 s episodes running at 1.2$\times$ and 1.8$\times$ the speeds of VLA and RL baselines. Resources are available at https://vla-precision.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLA-Precision框架，包含ACoB算法和ACoB-Stream架构，用于在真实世界对预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行高效在线强化学习后训练，解决精度任务中价值信号不可靠和大型VLA吞吐量受限两大瓶颈。在九项高精度化学任务上平均成功率98.3%，每任务仅需45.8分钟。
AI.motivation: 预训练VLA模型在需要高精度和可重复性的任务中仍不可靠。真实世界在线RL可以使VLA通过自主试错改进超越仅靠演示学习，但存在两个瓶颈：1)不可靠的价值信号可能导致策略漂移；2)大型VLA的计算开销限制吞吐量和样本效率。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：1) ACoB（非对称协同自举）算法，建立跨时间尺度的非对称协同自举——早期介入引导的行为学习快速提升策略性能并提升在线经验质量；随自主经验积累，全局回报传播与局部偏好排序逐步校准价值估计，产生相对动作优势用于参考正则化的策略改进，抑制策略漂移。2) ACoB-Stream架构，一种闭环经验-策略架构，采用不变量状态解耦和按需流式处理作为设计原则，支持大型VLA上的ACoB训练，提升吞吐量和计算效率达10.9倍。
AI.result: 在涵盖四个类别的九项高精度化学任务及四种机器人本体上评估，VLA-Precision实现98.3%的平均成功率，每任务训练仅需45.8分钟；27.6秒的回合以1.2倍（相比VLA基线）和1.8倍（相比RL基线）的速度运行。
AI.conclusion: VLA-Precision通过非对称协同自举策略正则化与专用流式架构，成功解决了VLA模型在真实世界在线RL训练中的价值信号漂移和大模型效率瓶颈，实现了高精度、高效率的运动后训练，证明了VLA在线强化学习在实际精细操作任务中的可行性和高效性。

title: When Seeing Overrides Knowing: Visual Dominance and Deferral-Based Method for Personalized Safety in VLMs
comment: Published as a main conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, where a response that is reasonable in general may still be unsafe for a particular user whose medical, emotional, or situational context is unknown to the model. We study this problem of personalized safety in multimodal systems and introduce MPS-Bench, a benchmark of 5,181 scenarios from 584 real-world images across 12 high-risk domains, each paired with a hidden user profile. Evaluating eight frontier VLMs, we find that they almost always respond directly (86-99%) rather than seek missing context, and none exceeds 2.6/5 on personalized safety. To understand why these failures arise, we analyze multimodal interactions and identify visual dominance: visual information enters text representations early and suppresses textual risk signals during multimodal fusion. Causal interventions reveal a two-stage mechanism in which visual affect is first transferred into the text stream in early layers and then shapes the final decision through this altered text representation, making late-stage internal remediation unreliable. Motivated by this mechanism, we propose PRISM, a lightweight input monitor that uses bidirectional cross-modal modulation to predict when a query is likely to require deferral. PRISM achieves 0.978 AUC and strictly dominates the safety-utility Pareto frontier across all tested models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MPS-Bench基准（包含5,181个场景、584张真实图片、12个高风险领域），评估8个前沿VLM在个性化安全任务上的表现，发现它们几乎总是直接作答而非寻求缺失上下文，个性化安全得分均不超过2.6/5。通过因果干预分析揭示了"视觉主导"的两阶段机制：视觉信息在早期层向文本流转移并抑制文本风险信号。基于此提出PRISM轻量级输入监视器，利用双向跨模态调制预测是否需要延迟作答，达到0.978 AUC并支配所有测试模型的效用-安全帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: VLM在高风险场景下可能对一般用户合理但对特定用户不安全，因为模型不了解用户的医疗、情感或情境背景。现有研究缺乏对这种"个性化安全"问题的系统性评估和理解。
AI.method: 构建MPS-Bench基准（5,181个场景、584张真实图像、12个高风险领域，配对隐藏用户画像）；评估8个前沿VLM；通过因果干预进行机制分析；提出PRISM轻量级输入监视器，使用双向跨模态调制预测查询是否需要延迟处理。
AI.result: 8个VLM几乎总是直接回答（86-99%）而非寻求缺失的上下文信息；没有一个模型个性化安全得分超过2.6/5。PRISM达到0.978 AUC，并在所有测试模型上严格支配安全-效用帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: VLM存在系统性个性化安全缺陷，其根源在于多模态融合中视觉信息主导并抑制文本风险信号的"视觉主导"机制，使得晚期内部修复不可靠。PRISM作为输入侧轻量级解决方案可以有效预测需要延迟的查询，为个性化安全提供可行路径。

title: ProToMEx: Rapid, Interpretable Explanations via Structured Representations
summary: Existing post-hoc explainers for machine learning classifiers primarily focus on feature attribution, assigning importance scores to individual features. While valuable, this approach struggles to articulate the complex, combinatorial patterns that often drive a model's decision-making process. To overcome this limitation, we introduce ProToMEx, a new paradigm for explainability that leverages Probabilistic Topic Models (PTMs). Our model-agnostic framework learns latent ''topics'' that represent distinct, high-level reasons for a classification, moving beyond simple feature importance to reveal underlying semantic structures. ProToMEx naturally provides both global explanations of a model's overall behaviour and local explanations that can disentangle multiple co-existing reasons for a specific prediction. We demonstrate empirically that ProToMEx not only produces explanations of comparable fidelity to popular methods like SHAP and LIME but also drastically reduces the amortised computational cost of generating local explanations, making it highly suitable for real-time applications. Specifically, we show that ProToMEx is ~30-40x faster than SHAP and LIME over standardised tabular datasets and synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProToMEx，一种基于概率主题模型的无模型依赖可解释性框架，通过学习潜在"主题"来揭示模型决策背后的高阶语义结构，在保持与SHAP和LIME相当保真度的同时，实现约30-40倍的提速，适用于实时应用。
AI.motivation: 现有的后验解释方法（如SHAP、LIME）主要聚焦于特征归因，仅分配单个特征的重要性分数，但难以表达驱动模型决策的复杂组合模式。作者希望超越简单的特征重要性，揭示底层的语义结构。
AI.method: ProToMEx利用概率主题模型（PTMs）学习潜在的"主题"，每个主题代表一个独立的、高层次的分类原因。该框架是模型无关的，能同时提供全局解释（模型整体行为）和局部解释（通过分离多个共存原因来解析特定预测）。
AI.result: 在标准表格数据集和合成数据集上，ProToMEx生成的解释保真度与SHAP和LIME相当，但生成局部解释的摊销计算成本比SHAP和LIME快约30-40倍。
AI.conclusion: ProToMEx为可解释性提供了一种新范式，在保持高保真度的同时大幅降低计算开销，特别适合对实时性要求较高的场景，代表了从特征归因向语义结构解释的重要范式转变。

title: Memory as transformation: LETHE, a self-referential gan-inspired architecture
comment: Accepted at XXV CIM - Colloquio di Informatica Musicale, L'Aquila, 2026
summary: LETHE (Latent-parameter Evolution with Temporal Hierarchical quasi-Equilibrium) is a self-referential sonic-oblivion system implemented in SuperCollider. It adopts the formal vocabulary of Generative Adversarial Networks in a closed configuration without external datasets or supervision after initialization. Audio is processed by a 3 x 3 mixing matrix built around two delay lines; its nine coefficients and two delay times evolve through the interaction of a five-feature linear discriminator and a random-perturbation optimizer analogous to single-sample REINFORCE. The discriminator compares current energy behavior with an archive of the initial state and guides parameter updates. Circular, fixed, and live sources can be mixed independently. Across fixed and circular sessions with an ablation control, the active generator is necessary for parametric evolution ($Δc_{22}=0.000$ in all 15 ablation sessions). Situated in the tradition of self-referential electroacoustic music, LETHE delegates the sonic outcome to an adaptive closed loop whose parametric space is defined by the composer.

AI.tldr: LETHE是一个用SuperCollider实现的自指涉"声学湮灭"系统，采用封闭式生成对抗网络形式（无外部数据集或监督），通过3×3混合矩阵（含两条延迟线）处理音频，由五特征线性判别器与类单样本REINFORCE的随机扰动优化器驱动参数演化。消融实验表明主动生成器对参数演化必不可少（15次消融会话中Δc₂₂=0.000）。
AI.motivation: 在自指涉电子音乐传统中，探索将生成过程的"指挥权"委托给自适应封闭回路，使声音结果由作曲者定义的参数空间内的系统自身演化决定，而非依赖外部数据或持续人工监督。
AI.method: 系统采用3×3混合矩阵（两条延迟线），九个系数与两个延迟时间通过五特征线性判别器与随机扰动优化器（类比单样本REINFORCE）相互作用而演化。判别器将当前能量行为与初始状态档案比较以指导参数更新。支持循环、固定与实时音源的独立混合；并通过消融对照（移除主动生成器）验证其必要性。
AI.result: 在固定与循环音源会话中，包含消融对照组，结果表明主动生成器是参数演化的必要条件——所有15次消融会话中Δc₂₂=0.000，即关闭生成器后参数完全不演化。
AI.conclusion: LETHE将生成对抗网络的词汇以封闭、无外部监督的形态引入声音艺术创作，开创性地实现了一个由判别器与优化器驱动、持续自我演化的声音系统，其参数空间由作曲者定义而声学结果由系统自适应决定。

title: From Matching Models to Recruiting Agents: A Systematized Narrative Review of AI Recruitment Systems, Evaluation, and Governance
comment: 53 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables; companion literature-coding and search-log CSVs included in the source package
summary: Artificial intelligence in recruitment has shifted the object being automated from profile pairs and ranked lists to multi-stage workflows that retrieve evidence, compare candidates, and support or execute actions. This systematized narrative review traces that development from bilateral retrieval and behavioral ranking through neural person--job matching, large language model (LLM) components, and tool-using recruiting agents. Using a purposive search and coding protocol updated through 23 July 2026, plus targeted updates through 2 September 2026, we organize 40 representative works with supporting industrial and legal sources. This synthesis is not a prevalence estimate. We analyze three coupled transitions: from similarity to reciprocal suitability, from a model to a compound workflow, and from offline prediction to evidence- and productivity-aligned evaluation. Across document understanding, retrieval, ranking, assessment, interviewing, sourcing, and human handoff, we distinguish field-, pair-, list-, case-, trajectory-, and outcome-level evidence. Persistent gaps arise because behavioral labels confound exposure, preference, and qualification; private and synthetic data limit external validity; final-output scores conceal pipeline failures; and, within the coded set, privacy is not directly evaluated and no row jointly evaluates utility, fairness, privacy, and security. These observations describe the coded set rather than the field as a whole. We therefore introduce a staged mapping from evaluation evidence to the strongest defensible claim, together with an agenda for reciprocal, evidence-grounded, temporally controlled, selective, and auditable systems. Progress should be judged by whether workflows retrieve the right evidence, preserve uncertainty, support contestable decisions, and improve outcomes under explicit cost and risk constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文对招聘领域人工智能的发展进行了系统化叙事综述，追踪了从双边检索/排序到神经人岗匹配、大语言模型组件及工具型招聘代理的演进，并分析三个耦合转型（相似性→互适性、单一模型→复合工作流、离线预测→证据与生产力导向评估），提出基于证据强度的阶段性映射及面向互惠、可审计系统的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 招聘中AI的自动化对象已从简档对和排序列表扩展到多阶段工作流（检索证据、比较候选人、支持或执行行动），但缺乏对该演进及伴随而来的评估框架变化的系统性梳理。作者旨在厘清这一发展轨迹，并揭示当前证据评估中因行为标签混杂、数据外部效度受限、管道失败被掩盖等造成的持久性缺口。
AI.method: 采用有目的的检索与编码协议（更新至2026年7月23日，另经2026年9月2日的定向补充），共组织40篇代表性工作并辅以工业和法律来源。作者明确声明该综述非患病率估计，而是对三个耦合转型（相似性到互适性、模型到复合工作流、离线预测到证据/生产力对齐评估）的结构化分析。按领域区分字段级、配对级、列表级、案例级、轨迹级与结果级六类证据。
AI.result: 发现持久性缺口：行为标签混淆了曝光、偏好与资质；私人与合成数据限制外部效度；最终输出分数掩盖管道故障；编码集内未直接评估隐私，且没有任何一行同时评估效用、公平、隐私与安全。基于此提出从评估证据到最强可辩护主张的分阶段映射，以及面向互惠、证据扎实、时间受控、选择性与可审计系统的议程。
AI.conclusion: 进展应依据工作流是否检索到正确证据、是否保留不确定性、是否支持可质疑决策，以及在明确成本与风险约束下是否改善结果来评判。同时强调观察结论仅描述编码集而非整个领域。

title: Privacy Failure in Split-LLM Training, The Returned Gradient Nullifies the Decoys
summary: We present a systems-security case study of a two-node split-LLM training system whose privacy evaluation passed while leaving an observable channel untested. The Trusted Local Node (TLN) sends protected activations to the Untrusted Cloud Node (UCN), the UCN returns its output, and TLN, holding the private loss, returns the output gradient. The frame the UCN receives mixes real rows with decoys, and the loss ignores the decoys. Their gradients are exactly zero, so the pattern of zeros reveals which rows were real. We measure it with a protocol fixed in advance: a leak injected at known strength to prove the instrument can see one, a shuffled-label control to prove it does not report absent leaks, and a threshold set before the runs. Across nine seeds, the zeros identified the real rows on every frame, 4,096 of 4,096 per run. An attack on the frame contents recovered about one extra token per hundred over a constant-guess baseline (+0.65 to +1.50 percentage points); the shuffled controls recovered nothing. A second set of runs repeated this on a configuration that keeps model quality within budget, so the finding is not confined to a setting nobody would deploy. On both datasets, every such run passed the forward-channel privacy check and the quality check, yet failed that same check once the returned gradient was included. Clipping and noising each row of the gradient closed the leak for about 0.01 nats of held-out cross-entropy. The system is not thereby safe: five classes of attack, including those accumulating observations across training steps, were never measured.

AI.tldr: 本文对两节点split-LLM训练系统进行系统安全案例研究，发现其隐私评估虽然通过，但存在一个未经测试的可观察信道：架构中UCN收到的帧混合真实行与诱饵行，而损失忽略诱饵导致其梯度恰好为零，从而通过零模式泄露哪些行是真实的。实验在九个种子上4,096/4,096的每帧都能识别真实行；帧内容攻击每百个token可比基线多恢复约1个token（+0.65至+1.50个百分点），随机打乱标签的对照组无恢复。在保持模型质量在预算内的配置上重复验证后发现，正向信道隐私检查和质量检查均通过，但包含返回梯度后即失败。对梯度每行进行裁剪和加噪以约0.01纳特保留交叉熵代价封闭了该泄露，但系统并非因此安全：五类攻击（包括跨训练步骤累积观测的攻击）从未被测量。
AI.motivation: 现有split-LLM联邦式训练系统的隐私评估往往只检查特定信道而忽略其他可观察侧信道，作者旨在通过一个真实案例表明：即使一个系统的隐私评估通过，仍可能存在完全未测试的、可被利用的信息泄露信道，从而警示安全评估方法论的局限性。
AI.method: 采用系统性案例研究法：构建两节点split-LLM训练系统，通过预置固定协议测量泄露——以已知强度的注入泄露验证仪器灵敏度、以打乱标签的对照组证明其不误报、预先设定检测阈值；在九个随机种子上对每帧零模式分析识别真实行；跨两个数据集在保持模型质量预算内的配置上重复验证前向信道、质量信道和含梯度回流信道的隐私检查；最后以每行梯度裁剪和加噪作为缓解措施评估其代价。
AI.result: 零模式在所有帧上100%识别真实行（4,096/4,096每轮）；对帧内容的攻击比常量猜测基线每百个token多恢复约一个token（提升幅度+0.65到+1.50个百分点）；打乱标签对照组无任何恢复。在质量受限的配置下，所有运行均通过前向信道隐私检查和质量检查，但将返回梯度纳入检查后全部失败。梯度行级裁剪加噪以约0.01纳特交叉熵代价封闭泄露。
AI.conclusion: 即使隐私评估已通过，系统的安全性也不能被确认，因为可观察但未测试的信道可能构成重大泄露。梯度零模式是一个此前被遗漏的实际可利用信道；虽然提出的梯度行级防护以极低成本封堵了该泄露，但仍有五类未测量的攻击类别（包括跨步累积型）使系统无法被判定为安全，凸显了更全面的安全评估框架的必要性。

title: GreenPipe: Power Modeling for Containerized DNN Inference on Kubernetes Edge Nodes
comment: Accepted to Workshop proceeding of Euro-Par 2026; 6th International Workshop on Performance and Energy Efficiency in Concurrent and Distributed Systems
summary: Distributed DNN inference is increasingly deployed in containerized edge-cloud environments, where workloads run on-device or are exposed to remote clients over the network. Accurate online power estimation on resource-constrained ARM nodes without hardware power counters such as RAPL remains a challenge, and CPU-only models fail to capture multi-resource behavior. We present GreenPipe, an automated profiling-training-validation pipeline that builds multi-resource regression models from external power meter measurements and attributes power to containers proportionally. GreenPipe is evaluated on a Raspberry Pi 4 edge node in a K3s edge-cloud testbed, covering DNN inference with three vision models, multiple precisions, thread counts, and both local and serving scenarios. System-level MAPE is 6.3-9.4%, improving over CPU-stress and utilization-only baselines by 26.9% MAPE on average. We jointly report inference latency and energy per inference, exposing performance-energy trade-offs across workload configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GreenPipe，一种自动化的配置-训练-验证流水线，用于在缺乏硬件功率计数器（如RAPL）的ARM边缘节点上构建多资源回归模型，实现容器级功率估计。在Raspberry Pi 4和K3s边缘云测试平台上，针对多种DNN推理工作负载，系统级MAPE为6.3%-9.4%，相比CPU压力和仅利用率基线平均提高了26.9%的MAPE。
AI.motivation: 分布式DNN推理越来越多地部署在容器化的边缘-云环境中，但在资源受限的ARM节点上缺乏RAPL等硬件功率计数器，难以实现准确的在线功率估计；且仅基于CPU的模型无法捕捉多资源（CPU、GPU、内存等）的行为特征。
AI.method: GreenPipe采用自动化的profile-training-validation三步流水线：首先从外部功率计收集测量数据，然后构建多资源回归模型，最后将功率按比例归属于各个容器。评估在Raspberry Pi 4边缘节点上的K3s边缘云平台进行，涵盖三种视觉模型的DNN推理、多种精度、线程数以及本地和服务两种场景。
AI.result: 系统级平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为6.3%-9.4%，相较CPU压力和仅利用率基线平均减少26.9%的MAPE。同时联合报告推理延迟和每个推理的能量消耗，揭示了不同工作负载配置下的性能-能量权衡。
AI.conclusion: GreenPipe为无硬件功率计数器的ARM节点提供了可行的功率估计方案，能够将功率准确归属于容器，并支持在推理延迟与能量消耗之间进行权衡分析，有助于边缘云场景中的能效管理。

title: Hardware-conscious Software Training for Deep Neural Network Inference Accelerator Chips to Recover Accuracy Degradation due to Hardware Variabilities
comment: 2 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables. Presented at SSDM 2023
summary: Deep neural network (DNN) has been widely applied in various industries. Specialized chips are being discussed for the purpose of achieving lower power consumption with higher throughput. Hardware variations introduced during the process of chip manufacturing are the main reason for affecting the inference accuracies. In this paper, we propose hardware-conscious software training (HCST) method which enables high inference accuracies even under the influence of hardware variations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种硬件感知的软件训练方法（HCST），即使芯片制造过程中存在硬件偏差，仍能实现高推理精度，解决了深度神经网络在专用芯片上因制造工艺变化导致的精度下降问题。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络已广泛用于各行业，为追求更低功耗和更高吞吐量，专用芯片成为讨论热点。但芯片制造过程中引入的硬件偏差是影响推理精度的主要原因，需要一种方法来缓解硬件偏差对推理精度的影响。
AI.method: 提出硬件感知软件训练（HCST）方法，通过在软件训练阶段考虑硬件变异的因素，使得训练出的模型即使在硬件变异存在的情况下仍能保持高推理精度。
AI.result: 该方法能够在硬件变异的影响下实现高推理精度，克服了硬件制造偏差带来的精度损失。
AI.conclusion: 通过将硬件变异因素纳入软件训练过程的HCST方法，可以有效提升深度神经网络在受硬件偏差影响的专用芯片上的推理精度鲁棒性。

title: When Quantization Breaks Memory: Recurrent-State Write-Back in Low-Precision Temporal Inference
summary: Quantization is widely used to reduce the computational and memory demands of neural-network inference. In recurrent networks, however, the quantized state is stored and returned at the next time step, so the rule used to store that state can alter subsequent computations. Here, we introduce recurrent-state write-back to denote this rule and isolate its effect in a compact GRU encoder--decoder for fluorescence lifetime imaging, a molecular imaging modality used in quantitative biological imaging. A central task is estimating two lifetime parameters, the short-lived component τ1 and the long-lived component τ2, from high-noise time-resolved fluorescence signals. Holding the trained model fixed, replacing continuous state propagation with deterministic 4-bit state storage increases estimation errors for τ1 and τ2 by approximately 70x and 300x, respectively. Failure occurs when repeated small updates remain below the write threshold, leaving the stored state nearly fixed while the network continues to propose change. Error feedback, residual memory, and direction memory carry information from these suppressed updates across time and recover accuracy without retraining. Precision sweeps show that increasing state precision can worsen a fixed recurrent solution, while matched training shows that compatibility with the state interface can be learned. To test whether this behavior extends beyond the GRU, we repeat the post-training intervention in an independently trained LSTM, where coarse write-back reproduces the failure, error feedback restores accuracy, and state-specific interventions reveal greater sensitivity of the cell state than the hidden state. Our results establish recurrent-state write-back as a key determinant of low-precision recurrent dynamics and identify the state-storage interface as a central design consideration for quantized recurrent inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"循环状态写回"(recurrent-state write-back)概念，揭示量化循环网络中状态存储规则对后续计算的关键影响。在荧光寿命成像的GRU编码器-解码器中，将训练好的模型从连续状态传播替换为确定性的4-bit状态存储，使τ1和τ2的估计误差分别增加约70倍和300倍。错误反馈、残差记忆和方向记忆机制能在不重训的情况下恢复精度。该行为在LSTM中同样复现，且细胞状态比隐状态更敏感。
AI.motivation: 量化广泛应用于降低神经网络推理的计算和内存开销，但在循环网络中，量化后的状态会被存储并在下一时间步返回，因此状态存储规则可能改变后续计算。此前研究对此规则的影响缺乏系统隔离和分析，本文旨在引入"循环状态写回"概念并独立考察其对低精度循环动态的影响。
AI.method: 在紧凑的GRU编码器-解码器中完成荧光寿命成像任务（估计τ1和τ2两个寿命参数），固定训练好的模型，将连续状态传播替换为确定性4-bit状态存储以隔离写回规则的影响。随后引入错误反馈、残差记忆和方向记忆机制跨时间传递被抑制更新的信息。通过精度扫描和匹配训练探索不同状态精度的影响，并在独立训练的LSTM上重复后训练干预以验证行为泛化性。
AI.result: 替换为4-bit确定性状态存储后，τ1和τ2的估计误差分别增加约70倍和300倍。失效机制为：重复的小幅更新低于写入阈值时，存储状态近乎固定而网络仍持续提出变化。错误反馈、残差记忆和方向记忆可在不重训的情况下恢复精度。增加状态精度有时会恶化固定循环解，而匹配训练表明模型可学习兼容状态接口。LSTM实验中粗粒度写回复现了失效，错误反馈恢复精度，且细胞状态比隐状态对该干预更敏感。
AI.conclusion: 循环状态写回是低精度循环动态的关键决定因素，状态存储接口应成为量化循环推理的核心设计考量。该结论对GRU和LSTM均成立，具有跨架构的普适性。

title: Scalable Edge-assisted Fusion and Path Prediction for Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary:
The planning algorithms inside an Autonomous Vehicle (AV) rely on information from on-board sensors whose line of sight is limited by emerging traffic conditions and occlusions. Edge-assisted creation of a unified world model fusing information from AVs and Road Side Units (RSUs) in a geographical locale, and the prediction of AVs' future trajectories, can enhance the
  planning algorithms inside AVs to improve quality metrics, such as better traffic flow and collision prevention. AVs participating in such enhancements are called Connected Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs). However, such information generated by the edge (world model and motion predictions) must reach the planners within a tight Age of Information (AoI) time budget to be
  useful. The state of the art fuses per-CAV information: each AV fuses inputs from other actors locally, which limits both scalability with actor count and quality of results.
  We present Conductor, an edge-based solution for creating a unified world model from the perspective of a fixed anchor (e.g., an RSU) in a locale and predicting future trajectories of AVs in that locale. Our solution adheres to the AoI time budget by dynamically limiting the number of AVs that would lead to the best quality of results. Specifically, we introduce an
  occlusion-aware selector that favors information contribution by AVs that detect objects in the locale not covered by RSUs. We pair this selector with a runtime controller that adapts both the number of AV inputs to fuse and the amount of trajectory predictions in each cycle to stay within the AoI time budget. Evaluation on CAV simulation infrastructure shows our joint
  selector-controller meets the AoI safety bound across traffic scenarios with up to 31 CAVs, with fusion fidelity close to an Oracle and much better than a random selector under the same AoI constraint.

AI.tldr: Conductor是一个基于边缘计算的车联网（CAV）解决方案，通过锚点（如RSU）视角创建统一世界模型并预测车辆未来轨迹，同时通过遮挡感知选择器与运行时控制器协同，在严格AoI时间预算内动态限制融合的AV数量，实现了最高31辆CAV场景下的安全边界满足和接近Oracle的融合保真度。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆（AV）的规划算法受限于车载传感器的视线遮挡和交通条件限制。现有方案采用每辆AV本地融合其他参与者信息的架构，在参与者数量增加时存在可扩展性差和结果质量受限的问题。同时，边缘生成的世界模型和运动预测必须在严格的AoI时间预算内送达规划器才能发挥作用，而现有工作未能同时解决融合质量与AoI约束的平衡问题。
AI.method: Conductor采用边缘计算架构，以固定锚点（如RSU）视角构建统一世界模型并预测区域内AV的轨迹。核心包含两个组件：(1) 遮挡感知选择器（occlusion-aware selector），优先选择能够检测到RSU未覆盖区域内物体的AV进行信息贡献；(2) 运行时控制器，在每个周期中动态调整融合的AV输入数量及轨迹预测量，以确保在AoI时间预算内完成处理。
AI.result: 在CAV仿真基础设施上的评估表明，Conductor的联合选择器-控制器方案在最多31辆CAV的交通场景中满足AoI安全约束，其融合保真度接近Oracle（理想最优），且远优于在相同AoI约束下的随机选择器。
AI.conclusion: Conductor通过将信息贡献选择与运行时资源控制联合优化，在主流的每AV本地融合方案之外提供了一种可扩展的边缘协同范式，能够在实际CAV规模下同时保障信息时效性和融合质量，为边缘辅助的自动驾驶规划提供了有效的基础设施支撑。

title: Step Back to Move Forward: Reflection-Aware Preference Optimization for Visual Generation
summary: Diffusion models have become the mainstream paradigm for modern visual generation and have substantially advanced multimedia content synthesis, especially in text-to-image and text-to-video tasks. To further align such generative models with human preferences, reinforcement learning (RL) has recently shown strong potential as a post-training strategy. Nevertheless, existing policy gradient-based methods often explore inefficiently, making them vulnerable to local optima that may degrade semantic faithfulness and visual realism. To address these challenges, we present Reflection-Aware GRPO (RA-GRPO), a new RL-based preference alignment framework for diffusion generative models. The core idea is to improve "forward" generation by incorporating "backward" reflection during optimization. We first introduce Diffusion Reflection, which rectifies intermediate sampling trajectories by inverting the diffusion process with a weak estimator, guiding latent states toward higher-probability regions of the true data manifold. Furthermore, we introduce Counterfactual Path Synthesis to implicitly distill these rectified trajectories into the policy, enabling the model to internalize the benefits of search-based exploration without incurring inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments on T2I and T2V models demonstrate that RA-GRPO significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly in mitigating reward hacking and improving generalization. The method remains architecture-agnostic and integrates seamlessly with standard pipelines, suggesting a promising direction for stable preference alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RA-GRPO，一种基于强化学习的偏好对齐框架，通过结合扩散反向反射和反事实路径合成来改善扩散生成模型的偏好对齐效果，在T2I和T2V任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型已成为现代视觉生成的主流范式，但现有的基于策略梯度的强化学习后训练方法探索效率低下，容易陷入局部最优，导致语义保真度和视觉真实感退化。
AI.method: RA-GRPO框架包含两个核心创新：(1) Diffusion Reflection，通过弱估计器反转扩散过程来修正中间采样轨迹，将潜在状态引导至真实数据流形的高概率区域；(2) Counterfactual Path Synthesis，将这些修正轨迹隐式蒸馏到策略中，使模型内化基于搜索的探索收益，且不引入推理时开销。
AI.result: 在T2I和T2V模型的广泛实验中，RA-GRPO显著优于现有方法，特别是在缓解奖励黑客（reward hacking）行为和改善泛化能力方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 该方法与架构无关，能与标准pipeline无缝集成，为稳定偏好对齐提供了一条有前景的方向。

title: A Data Fusion Framework for Grounding Aerospace Surrogate Model via Experimental Wind-Tunnel Observations
summary: Aerodynamic surrogate models trained on high-fidelity CFD data reproduce numerical predictions of both scalar outputs and entire fields accurately, yet their predictive fidelity is limited by systematic discrepancies between CFD and experimental observations. We present an experimentally grounded correction framework that adapts a CFD-trained deep learning surrogate using wind-tunnel PSP measurements. A Geotransolver surrogate trained on 2,300 high-fidelity CFD simulations of the NASA CRM wing-body configuration, spanning geometric variation, Mach 0.70-0.85, and angles of attack 0 to 4 degrees, reproduces the CFD integrated aerodynamic forces and pitching moment to R2 > 0.99 but does not match the experimental data. To incorporate experimental information without retraining the surrogate, a correction network is trained on spatially registered PSP measurements at two freestream Mach numbers (0.70 and 0.85) across the same angle-of-attack range, learning the discrepancy between the surrogate-predicted and experimentally measured surface-pressure distributions. At Mach 0.85 the correction substantially improves agreement with PSP, particularly at the wing suction peak, shock location, and subsequent pressure recovery, reducing both the magnitude of the prediction error and the fraction of wetted surface on which it exceeds 0.05 in Cp, and it does so from a limited experimental dataset without modifying the pretrained surrogate parameters. On held-out angles of attack the grounded surrogate agrees with measurement to within 2.3-2.7% of the measured Cp range, and outperforms direct interpolation between the measured conditions at every state tested. Experimental measurements can therefore ground a large-scale simulation-trained surrogate by learning systematic CFD-to-experiment discrepancies while preserving its generalization capability and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种实验接地校正框架，利用风洞PSP测量数据校正基于CFD训练的深度学习气动代理模型，学习CFD与实验之间的系统性偏差，无需重新训练代理模型即可显著改善对激波位置、吸力峰等关键区域的预测精度，同时保持代理模型的泛化能力和计算效率。
AI.motivation: 高保真CFD训练的深度学习气动代理模型虽然在再现CFD数值预测方面非常准确（R2>0.99），但其预测保真度受限于CFD与实验观测之间的系统性差异。单纯依赖CFD数据的代理模型无法匹配实验数据，限制了其在实际工程应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: 该方法包含两个关键组件：(1) Geotransolver代理模型，基于NASA CRM翼身构型的2300个高保真CFD仿真训练，覆盖几何变化、马赫数0.70-0.85和攻角0-4度；(2) 一个校正网络，在空间配准的PSP（压敏涂料）测量数据上训练，学习代理模型预测与实验测量表面压力分布之间的差异。校正网络在不重新训练或修改预训练代理模型参数的情况下，从有限的实验数据集中学习系统性CFD-实验偏差。
AI.result: 在马赫数0.85条件下，校正显著改善了与PSP测量的一致性，特别是在翼面吸力峰、激波位置及后续压力恢复区域，减少了预测误差的幅值以及预测误差超过0.05 in Cp的湿润表面比例。在未见的攻角上，校正后的代理模型与测量的偏差在实测Cp范围的2.3-2.7%以内，且在所有测试状态下优于直接对测量条件进行插值的性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验测量可以有效地接地大规模仿真训练的代理模型，通过学习系统的CFD到实验的偏差来校正预测，同时保留代理模型的泛化能力和计算效率。这项工作为弥合数值仿真与实验之间的差距提供了一种实用的框架。

title: Evidence Integration in Large Language Models
summary: Despite increasing reliance on LLMs that reason with external evidence supplied by tools, retrieval-augmented generation, other agents, and users, how LLMs integrate such evidence into decisions they have already begun to form remains largely unclear. We present a distributional theory in which evidence shifts the receiver's distribution of initial answers, driven by a receiver prior weight and a candidate evidence tilt, leading to three predictions. First, candidates more probable to the receiver are more persuasive. Second, receivers more readily integrate characteristic errors of their own than foreign errors from different sources. Third, identical evidence can improve weaker models and harm stronger ones. We confirm these over ten million trials, twelve LLMs from four families, and eight domains, four of them scientific discovery tasks in the physical and life sciences: quantum mechanics, physics, genetics, and molecular biology. The law also yields a receiver-relative reliability frontier: receiver-congruent errors depress performance more steeply than random errors of the same rate. LLMs also integrate candidates even after internally verifying their invalidity (93-100% with propositional constraints; up to 99.4% on held-out physical and life-sciences reasoning), demonstrating evidence integration is a receiver-specific control policy over existing distributions, determined by receiver properties rather than scalar trust in the evidence source. Causal interventions show candidate integration is implemented late in the network, as a structured sequence of steps admitting external candidate answers, promoting them, and transporting them into the answer state. Representations of verification are decodable but have little causal impact on answers. A J-lens decomposition shows the state underlying verbalized verification is fully dissociable from that underlying candidate integration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个分布性理论框架，解释LLM如何将外部证据（来自工具、RAG、其他智能体或用户）整合到已开始形成的答案中。该理论由接收者先验权重和候选证据倾斜驱动，产生三个预测：更可能被接收的候选者更具说服力；接收者更易整合来自自身来源的特征性错误而非外来错误；相同证据可改善较弱模型但损害较强模型。作者在超过一千万次试验、12个LLM、4个模型家族和8个领域（含物理与生命科学）中验证了该定律。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM越来越依赖外部证据进行推理（如RAG、工具调用、其他智能体等），但LLM如何将这些外部证据整合进它们已经开始形成的内部决策中，目前仍缺乏清晰的理论理解。现有工作主要关注RAG系统性能而非更深层的机制解释，本文旨在揭示证据整合的底层机制及其与模型自身属性之间的关系。
AI.method: 作者提出一种分布性理论：外部证据通过接收者先验权重和候选证据倾斜两种参数来改变接收者对初始答案的分布。通过大规模实证（超千万次试验、12个来自4个家族的LLM、8个领域）验证理论预测；通过因果干预实验揭示证据整合在网络的后期以结构化步骤序列实现；使用J-lens分解等方法证明验证状态与候选整合状态可完全分离。
AI.result: 三个预测均被验证：候选更符合接收者先验时更具说服力；接收者更易整合自己的特征性错误而非外部源错误；相同证据能提升弱模型但损害强模型。LLMs即使在内部验证候选无效后仍会整合（命题约束下93-100%，物理/生命科学推理任务中高达99.4%）。因果干预表明候选整合在网络后期以结构化步骤实现，而验证的表征虽可解码但对答案影响甚微。
AI.conclusion: 证据整合是接收者特定的控制策略，作用于现有分布之上，由接收者属性而非对证据源的标量信任决定。这引出了"接收者相对可靠性前沿"概念：与接收者一致的错误比同概率的随机错误对性能降低更陡峭。该研究揭示了证据整合与内部验证在机制上的可分离性，对AI系统安全性和多智能体协作设计具有重要意义。

title: Harbor Adapters and Harbor-Index: Infrastructure and a Curated Meta-Dataset for Large-Scale Agentic Evaluation
summary: Evaluating agents on the growing number of agentic benchmarks is challenging because they often require complex environments and agent integrations. We introduce Harbor Adapters, a unified evaluation infrastructure for agentic benchmarks. Our work makes three contributions. First, we develop benchmark adapters that port more than 80 benchmarks to evaluate arbitrary agents, and validate them through rigorous code review and parity experiments. Second, we conduct a large-scale evaluation of 8 models spanning capability tiers across 54 benchmarks; every model is run with Terminus-2 and with one of 3 native harnesses. This enables a broader analysis of agent capabilities and failure modes than was previously possible. Third, we introduce Harbor-Index, a curated set of 82 difficult, diverse, and high-quality tasks spanning 29 benchmarks, refined from the adapted suite through difficulty filtering, AI and human audit, and an audit-and-fix loop. Harbor-Index preserves the challenge and breadth of large-scale agentic evaluations while being affordable to run; no evaluated model-harness configuration exceeds 30% pass rate, and the strongest (GPT-5.5 with Codex) reaches 28.0%. We release the adapters, evaluation results, in-depth analysis, and Harbor-Index as open-source artifacts to support more reliable and comprehensive evaluation of language-model agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Harbor Adapters，一个统一的智能体基准评估基础设施，将80多个基准适配为可评估任意智能体的统一格式，并基于54个基准对8个模型进行了大规模评估；同时引入Harbor-Index，一个经过难度筛选、AI与人类审计的82个高难度任务的精选集合。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体基准数量快速增长，但评估这些基准往往需要复杂的环境和智能体集成，缺乏统一的评估基础设施，导致跨基准、跨模型的比较困难且不可靠。
AI.method: (1) 开发benchmark adapters，将80多个基准移植为统一格式以评估任意智能体，并通过严格的代码审查和parity实验进行验证；(2) 在54个基准上大规模评估8个模型（每个模型都搭配Terminus-2及3种原生harness之一）；(3) 通过难度过滤、AI与人类审计及审计-修复循环，构建Harbor-Index（82个任务，覆盖29个基准）。
AI.result: 所有评测的模型-harness配置的通过率均不超过30%，最强配置（GPT-5.5搭配Codex）达到28.0%的通过率。
AI.conclusion: Harbor Adapters及Harbor-Index在保持大规模智能体评估的挑战性和广度的同时大幅降低运行成本，并作为开源成果发布，以支持对语言模型智能体进行更可靠、更全面的评估。

title: Candidate Comparability Before Promotion: Conditional Validation in Adaptive Network Intrusion Detection
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Supplementary material (Online Resource 1) is included as an ancillary file
summary: Adaptive network intrusion detection systems retrain classifiers after drift alarms, but an alarm detects change; it does not establish that a challenger should replace the deployed incumbent. Promotion is security-relevant because it changes the model responsible for subsequent attack detection, and evaluating it has a methodological problem: promotion conclusions may depend on how the challenger was constructed and on how much evidence supports it. We test that dependence on CICIDS2017, UNSW-NB15 and ToN-IoT with self-contained challenger pipelines, nested candidate-size controls, a common-harness comparison of nine update policies, and a final sensitivity confining every exact feature vector to one evaluation, training or probe role. Incumbent-owned frozen preprocessing amplified apparent promotion harm; with self-contained challenger pipelines the mean full-drift harm did not persist. Raising nominal candidate evidence from 512 to 2,000 samples per class improved promotion under pool-constructed progressive drift by +0.53, +1.67 and +0.38 balanced-accuracy points: positive and statistically resolved in all three benchmarks, but materially benchmark-dependent rather than homogeneous, and driven mainly by fewer false positives. Policy conclusions were partially robust: policy ordering changed with candidate comparability, no policy globally dominated, and earlier compatibility statements for a label-free estimator and a calibrated ensemble narrowed. Validation helped evidence-disadvantaged challengers but added no average benefit at parity. Thirteen replays on real, time-ordered traffic showed no net harm from always deploying. Challenger construction and evidence should be controlled, reported and interpreted explicitly when promotion is evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文指出自适应网络入侵检测中"模型晋升"（用挑战者替换已部署模型）的评估存在方法学缺陷：晋升结论可能依赖于挑战者的构建方式和支撑证据量。作者在CICIDS2017、UNSW-NB15和ToN-IoT三个基准上，通过自包含挑战者流水线、嵌套候选规模控制、九种更新策略的通用对比测试及严格的特征隔离敏感性分析，验证了这一依赖性。结果表明：强化候选证据能显著提升晋升表现但在不同基准间差异明显且主要受益于减少误报；策略结论部分稳健但无全局占优；13次真实时间顺序流量回放显示持续部署无净危害。
AI.motivation: 自适应入侵检测系统在漂移告警后重训练分类器，但告警只检测到变化，并不能证明挑战者应取代已部署的驻留模型。晋升操作涉及安全关键决策——它改变负责后续攻击检测的模型，而评估晋升存在方法学问题：晋升结论可能取决于挑战者如何被构建以及有多少证据支持它。因此需要系统检验这种依赖性。
AI.method: 在CICIDS2017、UNSW-NB15和ToN-IoT三个基准上，采用自包含挑战者流水线、嵌套候选规模控制、九种更新策略的通用对比框架，以及将每个精确特征向量严格限制于单一评估、训练或探测角色的敏感性分析来测试晋升结论的依赖性。
AI.result: 驻留模型自有的冻结预处理放大了表观晋升危害；使用自包含挑战者流水线后，平均全漂移危害不再持续。将名义候选证据从每类512增加到2000个样本，在池构建的渐进漂移下晋升提升分别为+0.53、+1.67和+0.38平衡准确率点：三个基准中均正向且统计显著，但呈明显基准依赖而非齐性，主要由更少的误报驱动。策略结论部分稳健：候选可比性变化会改变策略排序，无任何策略全局占优，先前对无标签估计器和校准集成的一致性声明被收窄。验证帮助证据劣势的挑战者，但在证据对等时无平均增益。13次真实时间顺序流量回放显示持续部署无净危害。
AI.conclusion: 在评估模型晋升时，挑战者的构建方式和支撑证据量应当被显式控制、报告和解释。晋升评估不能仅依赖告警驱动的重训练，需要将挑战者构建和证据规模作为系统评估中的关键因素纳入考量。

title: Quality Recovery for Quantized KV Caches via Low-Rank Attention Adaptation
summary: Low-bit key--value (KV) caches reduce the memory required for autoregressive decoding, but the resulting quality loss depends on the model and quantizer. We keep the quantizer fixed and distill the floating-cache model's behavior into low-rank Q/K/V projection updates while the student executes a physically packed incremental cache. Across three seeds, 4-bit affine-cache adapters recover $54.24\%\pm2.47\%$ of the held-out perplexity gap on TinyLlama-1.1B and $75.96\%\pm4.04\%$ on Gemma-4-12B. On the same frozen NF4 Llama-3.1-8B base, one validation-selected run per quantizer recovers $60.42\%$ under KIVI K2V2 and $37.61\%$ under KVarN K4V2, while preserving 180-case associative retrieval. Gemma's score on an official 4K/8K RULER subset rises from 42.80 with the unadapted 4-bit cache to 48.33 after adaptation (46.15 floating), with substantial task heterogeneity. Finally, a 2-bit rank--token sweep reduces TinyLlama's 2-bit PPL from 576.10 to $11.4000\pm0.0059$ across three seeds, versus 10.3988 floating, but restores only 11--12 of 180 retrieval cases. These results show that low-rank projection adaptation can recover held-out quality across fixed cache formats, while perplexity recovery need not restore long-context retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在低比特KV缓存场景下通过低秩Q/K/V投影适配（蒸馏浮点缓存行为）来恢复模型质量的方法。实验表明该方法在4-bit缓存下能恢复54-76%的困惑度差距，在2-bit下能将困惑度从576降至11.4，但困惑度恢复并不等同于长上下文检索能力的恢复。
AI.motivation: 低比特KV缓存能降低自回归解码的内存占用，但会导致质量损失，且损失程度依赖具体模型和量化器。作者希望在固定量化器的情况下恢复浮点缓存模型的行为，减少低比特量化带来的质量退化。
AI.method: 保持量化器固定不变，通过将浮点缓存模型的行为蒸馏到低秩Q/K/V投影更新中（即对Q/K/V线性投影施加低秩适配器），同时学生模型在推理时执行物理打包的增量缓存（physically packed incremental cache）。
AI.result: 1) 4-bit仿射缓存适配器在TinyLlama-1.1B上恢复54.24%±2.47%的留出困惑度差距，在Gemma-4-12B上恢复75.96%±4.04%。2) 在冻结的NF4 Llama-3.1-8B基础上，KIVI K2V2恢复60.42%，KVarN K4V2恢复37.61%，且保留180个关联检索案例。3) Gemma在官方4K/8K RULER子集上从42.80升至48.33（浮点为46.15），但任务间存在显著异质性。4) 2-bit秩-令牌扫描将TinyLlama的PPL从576.10降至11.4000±0.0059（浮点为10.3988），但仅恢复11-12/180个检索案例。
AI.conclusion: 低秩投影适配能在固定缓存格式下有效恢复留出质量，但困惑度恢复并不保证长上下文检索能力的恢复，两者之间存在解耦关系。

title: Simulation-free Unbalanced Dynamic Optimal Transport with General Growth Penalty
summary: Inferring cellular dynamics from unpaired single-cell snapshots requires modeling both state transitions and population growth or death.
