Experimental evaluation compares adaptive HMAS with static only, static plus dynamic and exhaustive analysis policies across binary ransomware detection and multiclass family attribution. The complete HMAS achieved 96.57% accuracy, 0.96 F1-score and 0.99 ROC-AUC for binary detection. It also achieved 0.90 macro-F1 for family attribution. At the same time, the HMAS reduced average analysis cost by 43.97% relative to exhaustive analysis and substantially reduced average analysis latency except for the case where LLM is used. Routing analysis showed that 56.05% of cases were resolved using static evidence alone. Only 4.33% required the complete evidence pipeline. These findings demonstrate that adaptive HMAS can provide accuracy cost tradeoff for ransomware analysis while retaining support for heterogeneous and incomplete modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种成本感知的分层多智能体系统（HMAS），用于自适应勒索软件检测和家族归因。系统通过元协调器分层组织专业智能体，以静态分析为初始低成本检测手段，仅在置信度不足或专家分歧时选择性调用动态和内存等高级模态分析。实验表明该系统在保持高准确率（96.57%二进制检测准确率、0.90宏F1家族归因）的同时，相比穷举分析降低了43.97%的平均分析成本，56.05%的案例仅通过静态证据即可解决。
AI.motivation: 勒索软件可采用加壳、混淆、进程操纵和运行时规避技术，因此需要多模态分析。然而传统多模态方法对每个样本都使用全部可用模态，导致不必要的计算开销和延迟增加。作者旨在设计一种能够根据样本特点自适应选择模态的检测框架，在准确性与计算成本之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出成本感知的分层多智能体系统（HMAS），架构包含：1）Meta Orchestrator协调层级结构；2）将专业智能体组织为分层域控制器；3）以静态分析作为初始低成本模态，当置信度不足或专家智能体意见分歧时，选择性启用动态和内存模态；4）构建包含模态使用和处理开销的成本模型来指导编排策略；5）在困难案例中本地部署的大型语言模型（LLM）提供验证，但不替代确定性流水线。
AI.result: 在二进制勒索软件检测中HMAS达到96.57%准确率、0.96 F1分数和0.99 ROC-AUC；在家族归因中达到0.90宏F1。相比穷举分析，平均分析成本降低了43.97%，平均分析延迟显著降低（使用LLM的情况除外）。路由分析显示56.05%的案例仅通过静态证据即可解决，仅4.33%需要完整证据流水线。
AI.conclusion: 自适应HMAS能够在勒索软件分析中提供精度-成本权衡，同时保留对异构和不完整模态的支持。该系统展示了按需、分层编排多条分析路径的有效性，为勒索软件检测中计算资源的合理分配提供了可行的解决方案。

title: CoLMIN: LLM-based Multi-Decision Path Negotiation for Cooperative Autonomous Driving
summary: Multi-vehicle cooperative autonomous driving enhances the safety and reliability of autonomous driving systems through information sharing among connected vehicles, demonstrating significant potential for improving traffic safety. LLM-based approaches leverage strong reasoning capabilities of LLMs to enable effective inter-vehicle negotiation and improve cooperative driving performance. However, driving decisions in complex traffic scenarios are inherently multi-solution in nature. As a result, existing negotiation-based methods often converge prematurely to suboptimal solutions, hindering consensus formation and limiting the practical deployment of cooperative autonomous driving systems. To address this challenge, we propose CoLMIN, the LLM-based multi-decision path negotiation framework for cooperative autonomous driving, achieving stable decision consensus through multi-decision path negotiation and reflective reasoning. To achieve stable and high-quality consensus in cooperative autonomous driving, CoLMIN consists of three key components: (i) an LLM-based Multi-Intent Negotiation module (LMin), which adopts a Negotiator-Evaluator paradigm and generates multiple candidate driving intentions for joint evaluation; (ii) an Evaluation-based Shallow Reflection Module (ESRM), which analyzes negotiation outcomes and provides feedback to guide subsequent negotiations, thereby accelerating consensus formation; and (iii) an LLM-based Deep Reflection Module (LDRM), which performs long-term reflection over negotiation histories to mitigate cognitive fixation and prevent the system from converging to suboptimal solutions. Experimental results in the CARLA simulation environment demonstrate that CoLMIN significantly outperforms existing methods in challenging interactive driving scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoLMIN，一种基于LLM的多决策路径协商框架，用于多车协同自动驾驶。通过多决策路径协商与反思推理机制，解决现有基于协商的方法在多解性复杂交通场景中过早收敛到次优解的问题，在CARLA仿真环境中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多车协同自动驾驶通过车车间信息共享提升系统安全性与可靠性，LLM方案利用其强推理能力实现有效协商。然而，复杂交通场景中的驾驶决策本质上是多解的，现有协商方法常过早收敛到次优方案，阻碍共识形成，限制协同自动驾驶系统的实际部署。
AI.method: CoLMIN由三个关键组件构成：(i) LMin——基于LLM的多意图协商模块，采用Negotiator-Evaluator范式，生成多个候选驾驶意图进行联合评估；(ii) ESRM——基于评估的浅层反思模块，分析协商结果并提供反馈以引导后续协商，加速共识形成；(iii) LDRM——基于LLM的深度反思模块，对协商历史进行长期反思，缓解认知固着并防止系统收敛到次优解。
AI.result: 在CARLA仿真环境中的实验结果表明，CoLMIN在具有挑战性的交互驾驶场景中显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CoLMIN通过多决策路径协商与反思推理机制，实现了稳定且高质量的决策共识，为协同自动驾驶系统的实际部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: VISTA: Dense Multi-Label Classroom Coding with Vision-Language Models
comment: DataMFM Workshop @ Computer Vision & Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Video-language benchmarks are usually constructed by the dataset authors without published reliability statistics, leaving the noise floor of the construct unknown. We argue that multimodal benchmarking benefits from methods taken from research communities that have already invested in strategies to ensure reliability. We illustrate the case with the Classroom Observation Protocol for Undergraduate STEM (COPUS): a 24-code multi-label observation instrument with a decade of peer-reviewed reliability literature. We recast COPUS as a video benchmark for multimodal foundation models, where it provides a dense set of structured labels (a 24-dimensional binary vector every 2 minutes across a 50-90 minute lecture), an externally validated vocabulary, and established literature that provides a per-code reliability target based on human evaluators. Annotations in our evaluation corpus are produced by a 5-person human-evaluator panel whose consensus matrix is our reference. We propose VISTA, a baseline that runs MiniCPM-V-4.5 over a dense sliding window, refines its per-window outputs with a lightweight multi-layer perceptron (MLP) head trained on top of the frozen backbone, and max-pools the resulting predictions onto the 2-minute COPUS grid. On three held-out chemistry lectures, VISTA reaches 80.1% restricted macro accuracy versus 74.9% for the zero-shot variant, with the largest residual errors on visually similar instructor codes and on rare audio-dependent codes. We characterize three systematic failure modes (audio-partial observability, fine-grained group-work discrimination, long-tail recall) and release the benchmark tooling, prompts and baseline code at https://github.com/ajfranck/VISTA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将COPUS（大学STEM课堂观察协议）重构为视频-语言多模态基准，引入VISTA基线模型，在冻结的MiniCPM-V-4.5骨干上叠加MLP头进行密集滑窗预测并池化到2分钟网格，在三个化学讲座上达到80.1%的受限宏平均准确率，并系统性地刻画了三个失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有视频-语言基准通常由数据集作者自行构建，缺乏已发表的可靠性统计（即噪声下限未知）。作者主张多模态基准应从已投入可靠性策略研究的社区借鉴方法，COPUS正是这样一个具有十年同行评审可靠性文献的多标签观测工具，可将其重铸为视频基准以解决该问题。
AI.method: 将COPUS重新定义为视频-语言多模态基准：每2分钟输出24维二进制标签向量（覆盖50-90分钟讲座）。注释由5人人类评估者小组产生，其共识矩阵作为参考。提出的VISTA基线采用MiniCPM-V-4.5进行密集滑窗推理，在冻结骨干上训练轻量MLP头以细化每个窗口的输出，再通过max-pooling将预测聚合到2分钟的COPUS时间网格上。
AI.result: 在三个留出的化学讲座上，VISTA达到80.1%的受限宏平均准确率，显著高于零样本变体的74.9%。最大的残余错误出现在视觉相似的教学者代码以及稀有的音频依赖代码上。此外识别出三个系统性失败模式：音频部分可观测性、细粒度小组工作判别、长尾召回。
AI.conclusion: VISTA验证了将具有可靠性文献支撑的人类观测协议转化为多模态基准的可行性，该工作发布了基准工具、提示词和基线代码，为多模态基础模型的可靠评估提供了新路径，同时明确了当前模型在音频观测和细粒度行为判别上的局限性。

title: Beyond a Universal Forecasting Selector: Demand-Conditioned Model Selection across Demand Patterns and Horizons
summary: Forecasting-model selection remains difficult in heterogeneous demand because the most suitable decision rule may vary with demand structure, data availability, and forecasting horizon. This study examines whether the selector itself should be treated as a context-dependent component of the forecasting process. Five selection mechanisms - RMSSE, ERA, OWA, CCG-AHSC, and CCG-AHSCD - are compared across 24 optimized forecasting models, nine datasets, three training-testing partitions, and horizons from 1 to 12 cycles. Selector performance is evaluated ex post using Global Relative Accuracy (GRA), statistical tests, and a best-attainable-model reference. No selector dominates across all conditions. CCG-AHSC and CCG-AHSCD are more competitive for Smooth demand and several Erratic configurations, whereas OWA and ERA perform better in Intermittent and Lumpy settings. Selector suitability also changes with historical data availability and horizon, supporting a context-dependent rather than universal approach to forecasting-model selection.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在异构需求预测中，模型选择器本身是否应作为依赖上下文的组件。通过比较五种选择机制（RMSSE、ERA、OWA、CCG-AHSC、CCG-AHSCD），跨越24个优化模型、9个数据集、3种训练-测试划分及1-12个周期视野，发现没有任何选择器在所有条件下占优。CCG-AHSC和CCG-AHSCD更适用于平滑需求及部分零散配置，而OWA和ERA在间歇性和迟缓性需求中表现更佳，选择器的适用性随数据可用性和预测视野变化，支持依赖于上下文的预测模型选择方法。
AI.motivation: 异构需求预测中，最合适的决策规则会随需求结构、数据可用性和预测视野而变化，因此预测模型选择本身仍是一个难题。本文旨在探究选择器是否应被视为预测过程中依赖上下文的组成部分，而非采用通用选择方法。
AI.method: 对五种选择机制（RMSSE、ERA、OWA、CCG-AHSC、CCG-AHSCD）进行系统比较，涉及24个优化预测模型、9个数据集、3种训练-测试数据划分、1至12个周期预测视野。采用事后评估方式，以Global Relative Accuracy (GRA)、统计检验及最佳可实现模型参考来评估选择器性能。
AI.result: 没有任何单一选择器在所有条件下占主导地位。CCG-AHSC和CCG-AHSCD在平滑需求及若干零散配置下更具竞争力，而OWA和ERA在间歇性和迟缓性需求场景中表现更优。选择器的适用性会随历史数据可用性和预测视野的变化而改变。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持采用依赖上下文的而非通用的预测模型选择方法，即选择机制的选择应结合具体需求结构、数据可用性和预测视野来确定。

title: Shared circuits predict whether LLMs generalize across formats in arithmetic reasoning
summary: In many forms of reasoning, including arithmetic reasoning, generalizing across superficial changes in input format is effortless for humans: anyone who can solve 2+5 can also solve 'two plus five'. In contrast, LLMs are more brittle to surface variations of the prompts: for example, they solve numeric arithmetic problems almost perfectly but are substantially less accurate on verbal renditions of the same problems. Here, we ask whether generalization across formats can be predicted from the models' internals. Using attribution patching, we first independently localize the circuit that each model recruits to solve numeric arithmetic problems (2+5) vs. verbal ones, in three languages: English ('two plus five'), Spanish ('dos más cinco'), and Italian ('due più cinque'); then, we test whether overlap with the model's own numeric circuit predicts its generalization to the verbal formats. Indeed, we find support for this idea at three levels: circuit overlap accounts for the relative difficulty of the three verbal formats, for which models generalize best, and for which items are solved correctly, rivaling supervised probes while requiring no labeled data.

AI.tldr: 本文使用归因补丁（attribution patching）方法定位LLM在解决数字算术（2+5）与语言算术（"two plus five"）问题时各自调用的神经回路，发现回路重叠程度能预测模型在不同格式间的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 人类能轻松在不同输入格式间泛化推理（如数字"2+5"和文字"two plus five"），而LLM对此类表面变化较为脆弱。作者希望探究能否从模型内部机制出发，预测模型跨格式泛化的表现，从而理解LLM泛化行为的内部基础。
AI.method: 使用归因补丁（attribution patching）技术，独立定位每个模型在三种语言（英语、西班牙语、意大利语）中解决数字算术问题和语言算术问题时所调用的电路；然后检验模型自身的数字电路与语言电路之间的重叠程度是否能够预测其在语言格式上的泛化能力。
AI.result: 结果表明电路重叠程度能够预测三层次表现：1) 三种语言格式的相对难度；2) 模型对哪种语言格式泛化最好；3) 哪些具体题目能被正确解决。该方法的预测能力与有监督探针（supervised probes）相当，但无需任何标注数据。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部数字电路与语言电路的重叠程度是跨格式泛化的有效预测指标，揭示了LLM泛化局限性与其内部计算结构之间的内在联系，提供了一种无需标注数据即可预测模型泛化行为的无监督方法。

title: BioSync: Transformer-Based Cross-Modal Fusion for a Multimodal Physiological Digital Biomarker
summary: Cardiac, neural, behavioral, and speech measurements from wearable and mobile devices provide partial, noise-sensitive views of physiological state. BioSync combines these measurements into the \textbf{BioSync Index (BSI)}, a continuous composite digital biomarker defined under the BEST framework. The model applies multi-head self-attention to modality tokens and adds a linear branch whose hypothesis class includes standard feature concatenation. This architecture is motivated by latent-variable measurement theory and by the possibility that joint observations contain information unavailable from individual modalities. We evaluated BioSync on two literature-informed synthetic cohorts: a four-modality cognitive-decline cohort using HRV, EEG, actigraphy, and speech, and a metabolic-autonomic cohort structured around the public AI-READI wearable schema. In the cognitive cohort, BioSync and concatenation obtained AUCs of 0.928 and 0.926, respectively. In the metabolic cohort, BioSync obtained accuracy/F1 of 0.764/0.766, compared with 0.756/0.758 for concatenation. The BSI correlated with latent severity in both cohorts ($r=0.91$ and $r=0.68$). A pure-attention ablation obtained cognitive-cohort AUC 0.911, locating the increase to 0.928 in the combined wide-and-deep architecture. With matched modality-dropout training, BioSync led concatenation at five of six cognitive-cohort corruption rates and at the highest metabolic-cohort rate. Its cognitive-cohort AUC was also higher than five published digital-biomarker reference values, although differences in datasets and tasks preclude a controlled benchmark claim. Comparison with single-modality, early-fusion, and late-fusion designs across six prespecified criteria identifies the model's computational properties; validation on real cohorts remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BioSync,一个结合多模态可穿戴/移动设备生理信号(心率变异性、脑电、活动记录、语音)的连续复合数字生物标志物框架。基于BEST框架定义BioSync Index(BSI),采用多头自注意力机制处理模态token并附加线性分支(假设类包含标准特征拼接)。在认知衰退和代谢-自主神经两个合成队列中评估,性能略优于特征拼接,对缺失模态具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴和移动设备提供的心脏、神经、行为和语音测量只能提供对生理状态的部分且带噪声的视角,单一模态信息有限。作者认为联合观测可能包含单个模态无法提供的信息,因此需要一个能够有效融合多模态数据并生成复合数字生物标志物的框架。
AI.method: BioSync架构包含:(1)多头自注意力应用于各模态token;(2)一个线性分支,其假设类包含标准特征拼接。这种宽而深(wide-and-deep)架构受潜变量测量理论和多模态联合观测信息论的启发。在模态随机丢弃训练策略下增强对不完整模态数据的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 认知队列中BioSync与拼接的AUC分别为0.928与0.926;代谢队列中准确率/F1分别为0.764/0.766 vs 0.756/0.758。BSI与潜在严重程度相关性r=0.91和r=0.68。纯注意力消融的AUC为0.911,证实增益来源于宽深组合架构。在六种认知队列模式丢失率中的五种以及代谢队列最高丢失率下,BioSync优于拼接。
AI.conclusion: BioSync在合成队列上展现了对多模态生理数据进行复合数字生物标志物建模的潜力,比传统特征拼接略有优势,且在模态缺失情况下更具鲁棒性。但结果基于合成数据,关联于真实队列的临床验证仍属必要;与现有数字生物标志物的比较也因数据集和任务差异不能作为受控基准。

title: Forgetting Without Restarting: Execution-State Unlearning for Stateful LLM Agents
summary: Long-running LLM agents are stateful: beyond the transcript they accrete compressed summaries, plaintext memory, pending tool plans, and, under every serving API, a KV cache. Yet today's "forget" operations delete a plaintext memory record and stop, leaving every artifact derived from the revoked information intact. We formalize execution-state unlearning: after a forget request, the agent must behave as if it had never observed the target. Modeling the runtime as a deterministic transition system, we prove that the pre-target trajectory prefix is shared with this counterfactual world for free, that the post-target suffix is irreducibly tainted without token-level attribution, and that exact unlearning requires at least $T-τ+1$ recomputed transitions, where $τ$ is the target's injection step. Provenance-Guided Selective Replay attains this bound as a cross-layer contract spanning prompt, compressed memory, and cache: a provenance graph locates the injection point, checkpoint restoration reduces to cropping the KV cache, and sanitized replay regenerates the counterfactual suffix. Audited with elicitation, stochastic, and string-free behavioral tests across three agent suites, nine baselines, and three model families, memory deletion leaves leakage unchanged, instruction-based forgetting collapses under elicitation (Leak@probes = 1.00), and source redaction still acts on a revoked preference in 80% of episodes, while selective replay is indistinguishable from a full reset at up to 9x fewer recomputed tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文正式定义了LLM智能体的"执行状态遗忘"（execution-state unlearning）问题，并提出来源引导的选择性重放（Provenance-Guided Selective Replay）方法，通过跨层契约（提示、压缩记忆与KV缓存）定位注入点、裁剪缓存并重放反事实后缀，实现精确遗忘。实验证明该方法在遗忘效果上与完全重置无显著差异，且重算token量减少最多9倍。
AI.motivation: 长时间运行的LLM智能体是有状态的：除对话记录外，它们还积累压缩摘要、明文记忆、待执行的工具计划以及服务端API中的KV缓存。现有的"遗忘"操作仅删除明文记忆记录即停止，导致所有从被撤销信息派生的产物（如缓存中的隐式状态）仍然保留，无法真正实现遗忘。
AI.method: 将智能体运行时建模为确定性转移系统，形式化证明了遗忘的必要条件：目标前轨迹前缀可免费共享，目标后后缀在缺少token级归属的情况下不可挽回地被污染，精确遗忘至少需要T-τ+1次重计算转换。据此提出Provenance-Guided Selective Replay：用来源图（provenance graph）定位注入点，通过裁剪KV缓存实现检查点恢复，并通过消毒重放（sanitized replay）重新生成反事实后缀，构成覆盖提示、压缩记忆和缓存的跨层契约。
AI.result: 在三个智能体套件、九个基线和三个模型族上进行行为审计（包括诱发测试、随机测试和字符串无关测试）：明文记忆删除不改变泄露，基于指令的遗忘在诱发测试下崩溃（Leak@probes=1.00），来源消融仍在80%的回合中对被撤销的偏好起作用；而选择性重放与完全重置不可区分，且重算token数减少最多9倍。
AI.conclusion: 精确的执行状态遗忘是可行的，但必须超越简单的明文记忆删除，需要覆盖提示、压缩记忆和KV缓存的全栈方案；来源引导的选择性重放在达到精确遗忘界的同时显著降低了计算开销。同时也揭示出现有遗忘方法（基于指令或来源消融）在行为审计下的严重不足。

title: Strict Modes Everywhere - Bringing Order Into Dynamics of Mechanical Systems by a Potential Compatible With the Geodesic Flow
summary: Strict nonlinear normal modes provide very regular families of oscillations within conservative mechanical systems. However, a strict normal mode will generally be an isolated curve within the configuration space of the system. In this letter, we design a potential that will densely fill the configuration space with strict normal modes such that each configuration belongs to one mode and each mode passes through a common point, the equilibrium. As the potential can be realized by (nonlinear) elastic elements it can be used to execute a variety of periodic trajectories very efficiently. Most of the required torques will come from the elastic elements in the system and not from the actuators. We also design a controller stabilizing the system to a desired target mode and a controller performing swing-up and compensating dissipated energy. Finally, we showcase the approach for a two DoF manipulator. The experiments show that the approach performed well for the example system.

AI.tldr: 本文设计了一种势能函数，使得保守力学系统配置空间被严格非线性正常模态稠密填充，每个配置属于一个模态且所有模态通过平衡点。该势能可通过弹性元件实现，使大部分所需力矩由弹性元件而非执行器提供，从而高效执行多种周期轨迹。文中还设计了稳定到目标模态的控制器以及摆起和补偿能量耗散的控制器，并在两自由度机械臂上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 严格非线性正常模态在保守力学系统中提供非常规整的振荡族，但通常仅作为配置空间中的孤立曲线存在，限制了其在多样周期运动中的应用价值。
AI.method: 设计一个特定的势能函数使配置空间被严格正常模态稠密填充；利用弹性元件实现该势能；设计稳定到目标模态的控制器以及摆起与能量补偿控制器。
AI.result: 在两自由度机械臂上进行了实验验证，结果表明该方法在示例系统中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 通过弹性势能设计使系统具备大量严格正常模态，大部分所需力矩来自弹性元件而非执行器，可实现高效多样的周期运动，并配合控制器完成模态稳定与能量补偿。

title: DART: Depth-as-Target Pretraining for Surgical Vision Foundation Models
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) are valuable in data-scarce domains such as surgery, where a single pretrained backbone can provide rich representations for many downstream tasks. Yet the dominant self-supervised pretraining paradigm uses only RGB images, leaving readily available complementary signals, such as depth maps, unused. This is a particular missed opportunity in surgery, where natural-image VFMs transfer poorly while the scene geometry is rich and informative. With strong off-the-shelf models now able to produce pseudo-labeled dense depth for any image corpus, we hypothesize that such signals can be folded into pretraining to learn better representations. We present DART, an RGB-D pretraining recipe that builds on DINOv2 with a simple modification: a pixel-space depth reconstruction objective applied to masked iBOT patches, supervised by pseudo-labeled depth. Depth is used only during pretraining, so fine-tuning and inference remain RGB-only. We find that this pixel-level reconstruction head improves representation quality rather than disrupting it. We further show that depth, which encodes scene geometry, is more effective as a target than alternative dense signals such as Canny edges, confirming that the gains stem from depth rather than added supervision alone. Across eight surgical benchmarks spanning segmentation, depth estimation, and image-level recognition, DART outperforms both natural-image and in-domain baselines, including a vanilla DINOv2 trained on identical data, improving dense prediction while also strengthening image-level understanding. More broadly, DART shows that freely available geometric pseudo-labels can strengthen foundation model pretraining without extra labels or added inference cost, pointing toward stronger backbones for surgery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DART，一种基于RGB-D的预训练方法，通过在DINOv2基础上添加像素空间深度重建目标（使用伪标记深度图），将场景几何信号融入预训练，无需额外标签或推理成本即可提升外科领域下游任务的表示质量。
AI.motivation: 外科等数据稀缺领域依赖视觉基础模型（VFM）提供丰富表示，但现有自监督预训练仅使用RGB图像，忽略了容易获得的互补信号（如深度图）。由于自然图像VFM在外科场景迁移效果差，而外科场景几何信息丰富，作者假设利用现成模型生成的伪标记密度深度可作为预训练目标，学习更好的表示。
AI.method: DART构建于DINOv2之上，核心改动是添加一个像素空间的深度重建目标，该目标作用于被掩码的iBOT patches，并由伪标记深度图监督。深度仅在预训练阶段使用，微调和推理阶段仍仅依赖RGB输入。通过实验对比深度与其他密集信号（如Canny边缘）作为监督目标的有效性。
AI.result: 在八个外科基准任务（涵盖分割、深度估计和图像级识别）上，DART优于自然图像基线、领域内基线以及在相同数据上训练的原版DINOv2，同时提升了密集预测和图像级理解能力。深度作为几何编码比Canny边缘等替代密集信号更有效，表明性能提升源于深度信息本身而非额外监督。
AI.conclusion: 免费可获得的几何伪标签能够强化基础模型预训练，且不增加标签成本或推理开销，为外科领域构建更强骨干网络提供了可行方向。

title: A Repeated-Measurement Study for Cultural Analytics of English Song Lyrics Using Five Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate cultural texts at scales that are impractical for human coders. However, before their outputs are treated as measurements of latent social constructs, it is necessary to establish whether those measurements are reliable. This study evaluates five LLMs as zero-shot annotators of four social constructs expressed in English song lyrics: self-esteem, self-control, seeking belonging, and seeking recognition. Using repeated annotations of a large lyric corpus, we examine three properties of LLM-based measurement: consistency across repeated runs, convergence across models, and transferability of consensus labels to supervised classification. The findings show that LLM-based measurement is not uniformly reliable across constructs. Self-esteem exhibits the strongest repeated-measurement reliability across models, while seeking recognition is generally less stable; self-control and seeking belonging show intermediate but model-dependent reliability. Downstream classification further indicates that consensus LLM labels contain learnable signal, although transferability does not itself establish construct validity. Repeated-measurement stability and cross-model convergence should therefore be reported before LLM annotations are treated as scalable measurements in cultural analytics.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估五种大型语言模型（LLMs）作为零样本注释器，对英文歌词中四种社会建构（自尊、自我控制、寻求归属感、寻求认可）进行测量；通过大规模歌词语料的重复注释，检验LLM测量的三个属性（重复运行一致性、跨模型收敛性、共识标签向监督分类的迁移性），发现LLM测量并非跨建构统一可靠，建议在使用前报告重复测量稳定性与跨模型收敛性。
AI.motivation: LLMs越来越多地被用于大规模文化文本注释，但其输出作为潜在社会建构的测量值前，必须确认测量是否可靠。本文旨在系统评估LLM作为零样本注释器的测量可靠性，填补LLM注释在文化分析中作为可扩展测量的验证空白。
AI.method: 选取五种LLM作为零样本注释器，对英文歌词中四种社会建构（自尊、自我控制、寻求归属、寻求认可）进行重复注释；对大歌词语料进行多次注释后，从三个维度评估测量属性：(1)跨重复运行的内部一致性；(2)跨模型的收敛性；(3)共识标签向监督分类任务的迁移性。
AI.result: LLM测量并非跨建构统一可靠：自尊的重复测量可靠性最强，寻求认可能力最不稳定；自我控制和寻求归属介于两者之间且具有模型依赖性。下游分类表明共识LLM标签包含可学习信号，但迁移性本身并不能确立建构效度。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM注释被当作文化分析中的可扩展测量之前，应报告重复测量稳定性和跨模型收敛性。LLM注释的可靠性因建构而异，需要建立明确的验证标准。

title: Safety for Whom? Boundary-Aware Self-Distillation for Controlled LLM Safety Refusal
summary: Safety alignment is usually posed as a topic-level question: is this subject harmful? Deployments ask a narrower one. A civics tutor and a public-sector assistant may share a base model yet need different boundaries inside the same topic, refusing targeted political manipulation while still answering factual questions about the same election. We formulate this as narrow-boundary safety and introduce an offline self-generated framework combining controlled topic generation, coverage repair, in-distribution compensation data, and harmful-benign pairs for training and evaluation. Single-shot generation leaves 19.88% of prompts without accepted refusal traces, whereas escalating retries leave 0.20%. On political persuasion with Qwen3-8B, training on refusal data completed through Escalate increases target-domain refusal from 9.47% to 84.75% and reduces the mean unsafe-response rate across three broader harmfulness benchmarks from 26.26% to 0.14%, but increases XSTest over-refusal from 2.00% to 74.00%. In a separate matched comparison, replacing external responses with verified target-model responses reduces over-refusal from 15.20% to 5.20%. Boundary-pair data reduces comply-side over-refusal on held-out pairs from 32.94% to 4.16%, while harmful-side refusal decreases only from 91.88% to 87.72%. These results show that data composition controls the safety and usability trade-off, and that safety alignment should be evaluated on both sides of the intended refusal boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"窄边界安全"（narrow-boundary safety）概念，面向实际部署中同一主题内需要精细区分拒绝与回答的场景。作者设计了一套离线自生成框架，包含受控主题生成、覆盖修复、域内补偿数据以及有害-良性配对数据，用于训练和评估。在政治说服场景下使用Qwen3-8B，通过Escalate补全机制将目标域拒绝率从9.47%提升至84.75%，并将三个更广泛危害性基准上的不安全响应率从26.26%降至0.14%，但过度拒绝从2.00%升至74.00%。研究还发现数据组成直接控制安全性与可用性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐通常将问题建模为"主题级"分类（该主题是否有害），但实际部署需要更细粒度的区分：同一主题（如同一场选举）内，既要拒绝党派操控性诱导，又要回答事实性问题。现有方法缺乏对这种"边界内区分"的系统化研究。
AI.method: 提出离线自生成框架，包含四个关键组件：(1) 受控主题生成（controlled topic generation）；(2) 覆盖修复（coverage repair）；(3) 域内补偿数据（in-distribution compensation data）；(4) 有害-良性配对数据（harmful-benign pairs）。同时提出Escalate机制，通过不断重试补充被遗漏的拒绝样本，使单次生成的19.88%遗漏率降至0.20%。训练时使用目标模型自身验证的响应替代外部模型响应。
AI.result: 在政治说服场景中，目标域拒绝率从9.47%提升至84.75%；三个更广泛危害性基准的平均不安全响应率从26.26%降至0.14%；但XSTest过度拒绝率从2.00%升至74.00%。用目标模型自身响应替代外部响应后，过度拒绝率从15.20%降至5.20%。有害-良性配对数据使保持侧（comply-side）过度拒绝率从32.94%降至4.16%，而有害侧拒绝率仅从91.88%降至87.72%。
AI.conclusion: 数据组成直接控制安全性与可用性的权衡；安全对齐应在预设拒绝边界的两侧同时进行评估，而不仅仅是单侧衡量。窄边界安全问题在真实部署中普遍存在，需要专门的框架和评估方法来处理。

title: What Does Multi-Harness RL Learn? Credit Assignment and Portability in Coding Agents
summary: Agent reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly runs through full execution harnesses, and a multi-harness recipe mixes two choices: exposing the policy to several harnesses, and comparing their rewards inside one relative-advantage group. We isolate the second choice in repository-level coding. From one Qwen3-8B supervised warm start we replay the same frozen task-harness records from Aider, OpenHands, Qwen Code, and SWE-agent, with the same number of updates, under two rules for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), Within (one group per task-harness pair) and Cross (harnesses pooled within a task), and score every checkpoint with a sealed SWE-bench Verified oracle on four source harnesses and a minimal harness held out of training. The evaluation harness is the dominant variable: across 24,000 sealed evaluations it moves the mean solve rate from 2.14\% to 9.27\%, a factor of 4.3, where the training recipe moves it by 1.16. The grouping rule is not. On the held-out harness, Cross minus Within is +0.25 pp, 95\% confidence interval [-0.48, +1.02], at eight attempts per task, and +0.16 [-0.41, +0.72] pooled over three training seeds whose individual estimates change sign. Each rule's own seed range, 0.42 to 0.45 pp, exceeds the difference between them. Both rules place their largest gains on the same source harness. The pooled advantage carries the harness: an out-of-fold classifier recovers the generating harness from Cross's advantage +4.48 pp above the shuffled-label baseline and from Within's not at all, and the two rules still reach the same held-out score and action distribution inside each harness. Re-collecting half the training data on-policy does not change this. Cross-harness credit yields configuration adaptation and no more portable capability than within-harness credit. Multi-harness RL reports should state the grouping boundary and test under an unseen harness.

AI.tldr: 本研究在仓库级代码生成任务中隔离了多智能体强化学习"多执行框架配方"中的奖励相对分组规则这一变量，发现评估框架是主导变量（平均解决率从2.14%到9.27%，4.3倍差异），而分组规则（Within vs Cross）对训练效果没有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 智能体强化学习越来越多地在完整执行流程上进行训练，多框架配方包含两个选择：将策略暴露给多个框架，以及在一个相对优势组内比较它们的奖励。已有研究未单独隔离第二个选择（分组规则）在仓库级编码中的影响。
AI.method: 从Qwen3-8B监督微调起点出发，回放来自Aider、OpenHands、Qwen Code和SWE-agent四个框架的冻结任务记录，在相同更新次数下比较两种GRPO分组规则：Within（每个任务-框架对一组）和Cross（同一任务内框架池化）。用密封的SWE-bench Verified oracle在四个源框架和训练中未见的精简框架上对每个检查点打分，共进行24,000次密封评估。
AI.result: 评估框架是主导变量，使平均解决率从2.14%波动至9.27%（4.3倍）。分组规则无显著效果：在未见框架上Cross减Within为+0.25 pp（95%置信区间[-0.48,+1.02]），三个训练种子的个体估计符号变化，汇总仅为+0.16 pp [-0.41,+0.72]。每种规则自身的种子范围（0.42-0.45 pp）超过两者间差异。跨框架信用仅产生配置适应，不产生比较内信用更强的可迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 多框架强化学习报告应声明分组边界并在未见框架下测试，因为跨框架信用估计并未带来超越框架内信用的可迁移能力提升。

title: ReCAST: Restoration-aware Cascaded Stage-wise Training for Obfuscated SMS Risk Classification
summary: Fraudulent messages sent via Short Message Service (SMS) are increasingly obfuscated to evade cost-conscious classifiers in production systems. In Chinese SMS, attackers can exploit a wide range of carefully crafted obfuscation strategies to hide risk-bearing phrases while preserving human readability, making direct classification brittle under real-world latency and throughput constraints. We propose ReCAST, a Restoration-aware Cascaded Stage-wise Training framework for robust obfuscated Chinese SMS classification. ReCAST distills a large teacher model's de-obfuscation ability into a smaller deployable student model by supervising obfuscated span detection, obfuscation type prediction, and text restoration, and then uses the restoration-aware student for downstream risk classification. Experiments on an internally constructed real-world Chinese SMS benchmark show that ReCAST substantially improves classification performance over directly trained baselines under obfuscation. The results suggest that restoration-aware distillation offers a practical path toward robust SMS risk classification with smaller deployable models under production-oriented constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ReCAST框架，一种面向中文短信中混淆欺诈消息的"恢复感知级联分阶段训练"方法。通过将大教师模型的去混淆能力蒸馏到小型可部署学生模型中，监督混淆跨度检测、混淆类型预测和文本恢复三个任务，再利用恢复感知的学生模型进行下游风险分类，在真实中文短信基准上显著优于直接训练基线。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的短信欺诈检测受到延迟和吞吐量限制，攻击者利用中文语言特性精心构造各种混淆策略来隐藏风险短语，同时保持人类可读性，导致直接分类模型在面对真实混淆时表现脆弱。需要一种在计算资源受限条件下依然鲁棒的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出的ReCAST框架包含两个核心阶段：(1) 级联蒸馏阶段，通过混淆跨度检测、混淆类型预测和文本恢复三个监督任务，将大教师模型（LLM）的去混淆能力蒸馏到小型可部署学生模型；(2) 下游阶段，使用具备恢复感知能力的学生模型进行风险分类。
AI.result: 在内部构建的真实世界中文短信基准测试上，ReCAST相比直接训练的基线在混淆场景下显著提升了分类性能，同时保持了可部署的小规模模型。
AI.conclusion: 恢复感知蒸馏为生产约束下的短信风险分类提供了一条实用路径，在较小可部署模型上实现鲁棒性，证明了知识蒸馏中引入恢复监督信号的有效性。

title: Coupled Control and Wireless World Models for Resilient Remote Robotic Control
comment: 13 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Remote robotic systems operating over wireless networks must maintain reliable control despite limited communication resources, changing channel conditions, and environmental disturbances.However, continuously transmitting high-dimensional sensory observations, such as camera images, increases communication overhead and energy consumption while reducing robustness under unreliable connectivity.To address these challenges, this paper proposes a resilient communication-aware remote robotic control framework based on coupled control and wireless Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models that jointly capture robot dynamics and wireless channel evolution from visual observations and a combination of raw and structured radio frequency (RF) representations based on spectrograms and Persistence Images(PIs).The learned latent representations enable predictive communication scheduling by jointly forecasting future robot states and wireless conditions, thereby reducing unnecessary uplink transmissions while maintaining reliable control performance.Furthermore, an adaptive resilience mechanism detects latent prediction discrepancies and efficiently adapts perception embeddings to accommodate wireless and visual environmental changes without retraining the complete control policy.The proposed framework is evaluated in a synchronized Gazebo-Robot Operating System (ROS)-Sionna robot-wireless simulation environment under diverse wireless propagation and perception perturbations.Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in communication efficiency, robustness, and resilience while maintaining navigation performance compared with conventional Proportional Integral Derivative (PID), model-free Deep Q-Network (DQN), and predictive approaches based on Vision Transformers(ViTs).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于耦合控制与无线JEPA世界模型的远程机器人控制框架，通过联合预测机器人状态与无线信道条件实现通信感知的预测性调度，并引入自适应弹性机制应对环境变化，在Gazebo-ROS-Sionna仿真中显著提升通信效率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 远程机器人系统在无线网络下面临高维感知数据持续传输导致的通信开销大、能耗高和鲁棒性差的问题。传统PID和DQN等方法未充分考虑通信资源与信道动态变化，需在有限的通信资源下维持可靠的控制性能。
AI.method: 提出基于耦合控制与无线JEPA世界模型的框架：(1)联合建模机器人动力学与无线信道演化，使用视觉观测并结合频谱图和Persistence Images两种RF表示；(2)通过学习到的潜在表示预测未来机器人状态和无线条件，实现预测性通信调度以减少不必要上行传输；(3)设计自适应弹性机制，检测潜在预测差异并快速调整感知嵌入，适应无线和视觉环境变化而无需重新训练完整控制策略。在同步的Gazebo-ROS-Sionna仿真环境中评估。
AI.result: 在多种无线传播与感知扰动场景下，所提框架相比传统PID、无模型DQN和基于ViT的预测方法，在保持导航性能的同时，显著提升了通信效率、鲁棒性和弹性。
AI.conclusion: 耦合控制与无线JEPA世界模型结合预测性通信调度与自适应弹性机制，是一种在资源受限无线场景下实现可靠、高效远程机器人控制的有效范式。

title: Dual-Part Multi-Lateral Branched Network for Multi-Class Segmentation in Cardiovascular Catheterization Angiograms
summary: Catheterisation image processing requires segmentation models that are fast, accurate and explainable. While most of the existing studies usually focus on binary segmentation, there is a recent demand for simultaneous segmentation of multiple structures found in catheterization scenes. In this study, a dual-part MLBNet architecture is designed with multi-lateral encoder blocks and multi-head decoder branches for class-aware segmentation in cardiovascular catheterization scenes. Lateral branches in the encoder enables repeated feature extraction to learn diverse shared representations, while multiple decoder heads are used to introduce class-skewed branches that specialize in different structural properties in catheterization scenes. To analyze the performances of the dual-part MLBNet architecture, several multi-class segmentation angiogram data obtained during cardiovascular catheterization in phantom models, synthetic human-simulated aorta, and animal model are used for model training and evaluation. Results obtained showed the dual-part models could effectively separate guidewire, catheter, vessels and background pixels to their classes of memberships with high probability. The results demonstrate that all models were able to distinguish the dominant background class from foreground structures with high overall accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双部分MLBNet架构，用于心血管导管插入术场景中的多类语义分割，能够同时分割导丝、导管、血管和背景像素。该架构由多侧向编码器块和多功能解码器分支组成，在多种模型（体模、合成人模拟主动脉和动物模型）的多类分割血管造影数据上验证了高准确率和高置信度的类分离性能。
AI.motivation: 导管插入术图像处理需要快速、准确且可解释的分割模型。现有研究大多聚焦于二元分割，但临床中越来越需要同时分割导管插入场景中的多个结构（导丝、导管、血管等）。因此需要一种支持类感知的多样结构同时分割方法。
AI.method: 设计了一种双部分MLBNet架构：其一为带有多侧向编码器块的编码器部分，通过侧向分支进行重复特征提取以学习多样的共享表征；其二为带有多头解码器分支的解码器部分，每个解码头引入类偏斜分支，专门学习导管插入场景中不同结构特性的类别。模型在体模、合成人模拟主动脉和动物模型中获得的多类分割血管造影数据上进行训练和评估。
AI.result: 双部分模型能够以高概率有效将导丝、导管、血管和背景像素分离到各自的类别中。所有模型均能以较高的整体准确率区分占主导地位的背景类与前景结构。
AI.conclusion: 双部分MLBNet架构在多类导管插入场景分割中表现优异，能够同时高效区分多种解剖/器械结构，具备良好的临床应用潜力。

title: Conformity Breaks Conformal Prediction
summary: A conformal certificate can be valid when an LLM answers alone and invalid when the same LLM sees peers that unanimously assert a wrong answer. The question is unchanged; the model's score for the correct answer changes. We call this a score-mechanism shift: clean calibration certifies how the model scores answers alone, but not how it scores them under peer pressure. We show that this shift silently breaks conformal prediction in multi-agent LLM systems. Across open-weight models and multiple-choice QA tasks, coverage falls from a calibrated 90% to 74% under unanimous-wrong peers at the standard alpha = 0.10 operating point. The average hides a sharper failure: by targeting the low-confidence items the certificate still covers, an attacker nearly halves coverage on that subgroup, from 87% to 47%, while the monitored average remains much higher. The failure also reaches the decision layer: a system that should escalate when uncertain can instead become confident enough to act on the attacker's wrong answer. Standard conformal fixes do not solve the problem, because the question distribution has not changed; the model's scoring behavior has.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多智能体LLM系统中存在一种"评分机制偏移"（score-mechanism shift）现象：当模型看到其他智能体一致断言错误答案时，其答案评分行为会系统性改变，导致基于单独校准的共形预测（conformal prediction）在人群压力下失效，覆盖率从校准的90%骤降至74%，且攻击者可进一步将低置信度子组的覆盖率从87%降至47%。
AI.motivation: 共形预测的校准基于模型单独回答时的评分行为，但在多智能体系统中模型会观察同侪答案，这种群体压力会改变模型的评分机制，使得原本有效的统计保证在部署场景中失效，然而现有研究忽视了这一风险。
AI.method: 作者系统地研究了共形预测证书在单智能体与多智能体环境之间的迁移问题，通过在开源权重模型和多项选择QA任务上，对比模型单独回答与在"一致错误同侪"压力下回答时的覆盖率表现，并进一步分析了攻击者针对低置信度子组的定向攻击效果。
AI.result: 在标准α=0.10工作点下，覆盖率从校准的90%降至74%；平均表现掩盖了更严重的失败——攻击者通过针对低置信度子组，可将该子组覆盖率从87%降至47%；此偏移还传导至决策层，使本应升级处理的系统反而对错误答案产生信心并直接行动。标准共形修正方法无法解决该问题，因为数据分布未变，改变的是模型的评分行为本身。
AI.conclusion: 共形预测在多智能体LLM系统中的安全保证不可靠，评分机制偏移引入了校准未涵盖的新失效模式，需要专门面向评分行为变化的验证与防护机制。

title: Patterns of Priming in Production: Lexical, Semantic and Structural Alignment in Language Model Generation
summary: This paper investigates structural priming in language model (LM) production, examining how preceding structural context influences sentence completion. While prior work has demonstrated priming effects in comprehension of structural alternations, it remained unclear whether these persist in production, where, when generating, an LM samples from many possible continuations at each step. We address this question through a series of controlled sentence-completion experiments on dative constructions. In line with prior work, we find that LMs are susceptible to structural priming, particularly in sentences that are semantically coherent. In terms of priming magnitude, we find that while there is a greater relative increase of double-object datives against our baselines, in line with inverse frequency effects, there is a larger absolute increase in prepositional-objects, the more frequently produced construction. Finally, we not only observe that structural priming is boosted by lexico-semantic coherence, but that structurally primed completions display greater levels of lexico-semantic repetition. Taken together, our evidence supports the view that structural priming in LMs operates across multiple levels of linguistic representation, facilitating, and facilitated by syntactic, lexical, and semantic alignment. Code: https://github.com/the-context-lab/primedproduction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型（LM）生成任务中的结构启动效应，通过控制句子补全实验（双宾构式），发现LM在生成时确实表现出结构启动，且其大小受到语义连贯性、逆频率效应和词汇语义重复等多层次语言表征的共同影响。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已证明结构启动存在于LM的理解过程中，但在生成过程中（每一步从众多可能续文中采样）是否仍然存在尚不清楚。作者希望通过受控实验验证结构启动在LM生产中的普遍性与作用机制。
AI.method: 通过一系列受控的句子补全实验，聚焦于双宾构式（dative constructions）。实验比较了LM在语义连贯与非连贯句子中的结构选择，测量双宾构式与介词构式的相对与绝对增量，并分析结构与词汇语义层面的重复模式。
AI.result: LM在生成中确实表现出结构启动效应，尤其在语义连贯的句子中更明显。相对增量方面，双宾构式增幅更大（符合逆频率效应）；绝对增量方面，更高频产生的介词构式增幅更大。同时，结构启动与词汇-语义连贯性和重复相互促进。
AI.conclusion: 结构启动在LM中跨越句法、词汇、语义等多个语言表征层面运作，既促进又受上述层面的对齐所影响，支持多层级交互的语言处理模型。

title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
summary: Designing and authoring high-performance custom kernels for accelerators is a complex task that requires deep hardware-level expertise. Large Language Models (LLM) can be leveraged together with real-time compiler feedback to build agentic systems for kernel generation. In this work, we present MaxKernel, a multi-agent system that implements three distinct paradigms for TPU kernel development: (1) a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) agent for collaborative, step-by-step design; (2) an Autonomous (Auto) agent that executes a fully automated, metric/trace-driven optimization loop; and (3) a Graph-Based Autonomous Search that scales the Auto agent for global exploration of the design space. All three paradigms leverage a shared pool of specialized sub-agents to handle planning, implementation, self-debugging, testing, and hardware profiling. We evaluate MaxKernel on JaxBench, a comprehensive suite of 50 diverse kernel tasks for TPUs, alongside complex, real-world workloads from state-of-the-art open-source models. We demonstrate that MaxKernel consistently generates highly optimized implementations, matching expert hand-tuned baselines and delivering significant performance across the benchmark. Our agent is open-sourced and available https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/accelerator-agents/tree/main/MaxKernel.

AI.tldr: MaxKernel是一个面向TPU内核开发的多智能体系统，实现了三种范式：人机协同（HITL）、全自主优化（Auto）和基于图的自主搜索。系统利用共享的专业子智能体处理规划、实现、调试、测试和硬件剖析等任务，在包含50个TPU内核任务的JaxBench基准以及真实世界复杂工作负载上展现出媲美专家手工调优的性能。
AI.motivation: 为加速器设计和编写高性能自定义内核是一项复杂任务，需要深厚的硬件级专业知识。利用大语言模型结合实时编译器反馈构建智能体系统，可以自动生成高性能内核，从而降低对硬件专家手工调优的依赖。
AI.method: MaxKernel采用多智能体架构，实现三种内核开发范式：HITL智能体支持分步人机协同设计；Auto智能体执行全自动的基于指标/性能追迹的优化循环；图驱动的自主搜索在Auto基础上扩展到全局设计空间探索。三种范式共享由规划、实现、自调试、测试和硬件剖析等专业子智能体组成的模块化池。
AI.result: 在JaxBench基准（包含50个多样化TPU内核任务）及来自前沿开源模型的复杂真实负载上，MaxKernel一致生成高度优化的内核实现，匹配专家手工调优的基线性能，并在基准测试中带来显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MaxKernel证明了LLM驱动的多智能体系统能够有效实现加速器内核的自动化开发与优化，达到专家级水平，且已开源发布。

title: The Security Feature Location Problem
summary: Software security must be realized through security features such as authentication and encryption, but which features does a system implement, and where? We present security feature location: the task of relating code locations to security features, enabling developers to understand security implementations and assess whether intended security properties are enforced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"安全特征定位"任务，即关联代码位置与安全特征（如认证、加密），帮助开发者理解安全实现并评估预期安全属性是否得到落实。
AI.motivation: 软件安全需要通过认证、加密等安全特征来实现，但开发者往往不清楚系统中哪些特征被实现以及它们位于何处，这阻碍了安全实现的理解和安全属性的验证。
AI.method: 提出安全特征定位（security feature location）这一任务，将代码中的具体位置与系统实现的安全特征建立映射关系。
AI.result: 目前摘要仅提出该任务框架，尚未给出具体的实验结果，可能属于问题定义与研究方向提出的阶段。
AI.conclusion: 通过安全特征定位，开发者能够更好地理解安全实现，并评估所声称的安全属性是否真正被系统所强制执行。

title: Reasoning Without Inference Cost: Latent Semantic Scaffolding for Robot VLA Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained by imitation and capture what action to take but not why; adding causal reasoning improves manipulation, but current methods pay for it at inference time - generating reasoning tokens or rolling out predicted future states at every step, a cost that compounds over long horizons. We ask whether this benefit can instead be captured during training and discarded before deployment. We introduce Latent Semantic Scaffolding (LSS), an auxiliary loss applied during human-demonstration pretraining that aligns a VLA's action-token representations to text embeddings of physical-reasoning rationales through a small projection head. The head is dropped at inference, leaving the unmodified base policy with zero added cost. Our central finding concerns alignment granularity: aligning each action token to the rationale of its own manipulation phase (Dense LSS) rather than to a single pooled episode-level embedding (Pooled LSS) yields representations that transfer markedly better to held-out tasks. Dense LSS attains both the best in-distribution success and the best transfer to tasks unseen during alignment, whereas pooled alignment over-specializes to the training task. A representational probe shows Dense LSS induces roughly twice the per-phase separability in the backbone, supporting that phase-local alignment is the operative mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent Semantic Scaffolding (LSS)，一种只用于训练阶段的辅助损失，通过对齐VLA动作token表征与物理推理rationale的文本嵌入来注入因果推理能力，推理时可完全丢弃投影头，零额外开销。关键发现是细粒度对齐（Dense LSS）优于粗粒度对齐（Pooled LSS）。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通过模仿学习只学到"做什么"而不理解"为什么"。加入因果推理能提升操作能力，但当前方法在推理时需要生成推理token或滚动预测未来状态，长时程任务中开销累积严重。作者问能否将推理能力在训练阶段注入、部署前丢弃，实现零推理开销。
AI.method: 提出Latent Semantic Scaffolding (LSS)：在人类示范预训练阶段添加一个辅助损失，通过小型投影头将VLA的动作token表征与物理推理rationale的文本嵌入进行对齐。推理时丢弃投影头，保持基础策略不变。对比了两种对齐粒度：Dense LSS（逐动作token与所属操作阶段的rationale对齐）与Pooled LSS（与整个episode级池化嵌入对齐）。并用表征探针验证骨干网络相位可分性。
AI.result: Dense LSS在分布内成功率和迁移到未见任务上都达到了最佳性能；Pooled对齐则在训练任务上过拟合。表征探针显示Dense LSS使骨干网络每相位可分性提高约两倍，证实相位局部对齐是有效机制。
AI.conclusion: 因果推理能力可以在训练阶段注入并通过细粒度（相位级）对齐来保留，推理阶段无需任何额外开销即可获得迁移性更强的VLA表征。对齐粒度是核心机制。

title: Hidden In Plain Gaze: Gaze Representations as Privacy Controls for Utility and Re-identification Risk in XR
summary: Intelligent extended reality (XR) systems increasingly use eye and head tracking to infer user intent, task, and attention, but the same signals can also reveal biometric identity. We study whether gaze data representation choice can serve as a lightweight privacy control at feature extraction, before adding perturbation or formal privacy mechanisms. Using the egocentric HoloAssist dataset, we compare three gaze representations under matched model capacity: raw gaze, spatial attention heatmaps, and engineered eye-movement features. We evaluate each representation on action recognition as task utility and closed-set user re-identification as privacy leakage. Representation choice substantially changes the privacy-utility tradeoff. Engineered features retain roughly 85% of raw gaze's action-recognition accuracy while reducing re-identification by about an order of magnitude, to roughly four times the chance rate across 206 identities. This reduction attenuates rather than eliminates identity leakage, and the differences across representations show that abstraction alone does not guarantee privacy. Engineered features expose interpretable and auditable structure, giving designers a transparent privacy lever that complements mechanisms such as differential privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在智能扩展现实（XR）系统中，是否可以通过选择不同的凝视数据表示方式，在特征提取阶段实现轻量级的隐私保护。基于HoloAssist数据集，比较了原始凝视、空间注意力热图和工程化眼动特征三种表示在动作识别（任务效用）和用户再识别（隐私泄露）上的表现，发现工程化特征在保留约85%动作识别精度的同时将再识别率降低约一个数量级（约为随机概率的4倍）。
AI.motivation: 智能XR系统依赖眼动和头部追踪推断用户意图、任务和注意力，但相同信号也能暴露生物特征身份。现有隐私保护通常依赖噪声扰动或形式化隐私机制（如差分隐私），作者希望探索在特征提取阶段，仅通过表示选择（abstraction）作为轻量级隐私控制手段的可能性，以避免额外机制带来的开销。
AI.method: 使用第一人称视角的HoloAssist数据集，在匹配模型容量的条件下比较三种凝视表示：原始凝视（raw gaze）、空间注意力热图（spatial attention heatmaps）、工程化眼动特征（engineered eye-movement features）。分别以动作识别衡量任务效用、以闭集用户再识别衡量隐私泄露，系统性地评估表示选择对隐私-效用权衡的影响。
AI.result: 表示选择显著改变隐私-效用权衡。工程化特征保留了原始凝视约85%的动作识别准确率，同时将用户再识别率降低约一个数量级（降至206个身份中随机概率的约4倍）。然而该降低是削弱而非消除身份泄露，且各表示间的差异表明仅靠抽象化并不保证隐私。
AI.conclusion: 工程化特征具有可解释和可审计的结构，为设计者提供了一个透明的隐私控制杠杆，可作为差分隐私等正式隐私机制的补充手段。研究表明凝视表示选择是一种实用且轻量的隐私保护途径，但需要与更严格的隐私机制结合使用才能充分保护用户身份。

title: When Load-Balancing Goes Too Far: Expert Pruning in Over-Dispersed Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Expert pruning reduces the memory and serving cost of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models by removing low-importance experts identified by the router, assuming router probabilities provide a reliable importance signal. We observe that this assumption breaks down under over-dispersed routing, a regime associated with aggressive load-balancing during training, in which tokens are distributed nearly uniformly across experts and importance signals collapse. In this regime, perplexity does not predict downstream task accuracy: on gpt-oss-20B, the lowest-perplexity pruning configuration yields the worst mathematical reasoning, while the highest-perplexity configuration preserves it. This does not occur under standard routing (e.g., Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct), where perplexity and accuracy degrade together. Pruning under over-dispersed routing also exposes a capability trade-off in which no single scoring metric dominates: activation-aware scoring preserves mathematical reasoning but severely degrades knowledge-intensive science (an 18-point gap on GPQA), whereas frequency-based scoring exhibits the reverse. We propose Minimax Expert Score Allocation (MESA), a domain-aware method that iteratively boosts importance scores for experts serving whichever domain is currently worst-affected, minimizing worst-case domain degradation rather than average accuracy. At 25% expert pruning MESA achieves the smallest worst-case degradation across domains, outperforming activation-aware baselines on 7 of 11 benchmarks at a correspondingly reduced memory footprint, and it generalizes to gpt-oss-120B, Gemma-4-26B-A4B, and OLMoE-1B-7B. Our results indicate that over-dispersed routing is a qualitatively distinct pruning regime in which standard assumptions fail, and that recognizing it is a prerequisite for principled expert pruning of load-balanced MoE models.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示MoE专家剪枝在过离散路由（over-dispersed routing）下失效的问题：路由器概率不再是可靠的重要性信号，困惑度与下游任务准确率脱钩，不同评分指标存在能力权衡。为此提出领域感知的Minimax Expert Score Allocation（MESA）方法，通过迭代提升受影响最严重领域的专家分数来最小化最差领域退化，在25%剪枝率下优于激活感知等基线方法，并泛化至多个大规模MoE模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE专家剪枝方法假设路由器概率能可靠反映专家重要性，但在过离散路由（由训练时的激进负载均衡导致，token近乎均匀分布到各专家）下该假设失效，导致重要性信号崩塌。此前的剪枝研究未识别这一独特机制，导致在负载均衡的MoE模型上无法进行有效的原则性专家剪枝。
AI.method: 提出MESA（Minimax Expert Score Allocation）：一种领域感知的迭代方法，动态识别当前性能退化最严重的领域，并提升服务该领域的专家的重要性分数，以最小化最差领域退化而非平均准确率。该方法在多种专家评分指标基础上进行领域感知调整，实现最坏情况优化的剪枝策略。
AI.result: 在25%专家剪枝率下，MESA取得了最小的跨领域最差退化；在11个基准中7个优于激活感知基线，同时内存占用更低。方法在gpt-oss-120B、Gemma-4-26B-A4B和OLMoE-1B-7B上均验证了泛化性。关键发现包括：过离散路由下困惑度不预测任务准确率（gpt-oss-20B上最低困惑度配置反而数学推理最差）；激活感知评分保留数学推理但导致GPQA上18个百分点的知识密集科学任务退化，而频率感知评分呈现相反趋势。
AI.conclusion: 过离散路由代表一种性质上不同的专家剪枝机制，在此机制下标准假设（路由器概率作为重要性信号、困惑度与准确率一致退化）均失效。识别这一机制是负载均衡MoE模型上进行原则性专家剪枝的前提，而MESA通过领域感知的最小最大优化为这一场景提供了有效方案。

title: Cultural Misalignment in Large Language Models: Detection, Measurement, and Mitigation Through Targeted Fine-Tuning
comment: 33 pages, 14 figures. Extended version of a paper published in the proceedings of OSSConf 2026, Zilina, Slovakia. Code and data: https://github.com/AntoniCzolgowski/llm-cultural-bias
summary: We evaluate three open-weight LLMs (Gemma3-12B from the USA, Bielik-11B-v3 from Poland, and Qwen3-4B from China) against World Values Survey Wave 7 data for 63 demographic personas across three countries, using normalized Wasserstein distance to quantify distributional misalignment. Contrary to expectations, no model favors its home country: the Chinese-built Qwen3-4B performs worst on its own Chinese population (W1 = 0.436, the highest misalignment in the entire model x country matrix). Targeted LoRA fine-tuning on the five worst-case personas, requiring fewer than 1,200 training pairs and under 15 minutes on a single GPU, reduces bias by 16.8% for Bielik-11B (p_Bonf = 0.002, d = -4.4) with all five targets improving. However, country-level decomposition reveals that fine-tuning redistributes rather than removes bias: Bielik's worst-case personas swap entirely from American to Chinese elderly, with zero overlap between pre- and post-correction sets. To our knowledge, this is the first study to target worst-case demographic personas with LoRA fine-tuning for cross-cultural bias mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文评估三个开源LLM（Gemma3-12B、Bielik-11B-v3、Qwen3-4B）在三个国家63个群体画像上的文化价值观偏差，发现没有模型偏向本国；LoRA微调少量最差画像可降低偏差，但偏差会被重新分配而非真正消除。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多关注模型的通用文化偏差，缺乏对开源模型跨文化价值观对齐的系统评估，也没有针对最差群体画像进行定向偏差缓解的研究。
AI.method: 使用世界价值观调查（WVS）第7波数据，为三个国家的63个群体画像生成模型响应，采用归一化Wasserstein距离量化分布失配。对表现最差的5个画像进行LoRA定向微调（少于1200个训练对，单GPU下15分钟内），并评估国家层面偏差再分配效应。
AI.result: 没有模型偏向本国，中国开发的Qwen3-4B在中国人口上表现最差（W1=0.436）。LoRA微调使Bielik-11B偏差降低16.8%（p=0.002, d=-4.4），所有5个最差画像均有改善；但国家分解显示偏差被重新分配——最差画像从美国老年人完全切换到中国老年人，前后集合零重叠。
AI.conclusion: LoRA对最差群体画像的定向微调能有效降低局部偏差，但会以"转移"而非"消除"的方式作用于偏差，提示需要在更全局的约束下设计跨文化偏差缓解策略。

title: Towards a universal language of concepts: A survey
comment: Originally completed as an M.S. capstone project at UCLA in 2022
summary: Humans can learn and generalize novel concepts from sparse data because they express knowledge in rich structural formats. In this paper, we propose that programs are a strong candidate for universal representation of concepts. We review computational models of concept learning that use programs as their concept representation and evaluate their contribution toward a universal representational language.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨程序作为概念的通用表示形式，并综述了使用程序作为概念表征的计算模型，评估它们对实现通用表示语言的贡献。
AI.motivation: 人类能够从稀疏数据中学习和泛化新概念，是因为人类以丰富的结构化格式表达知识。寻找一个通用的概念表示形式对于理解概念学习机制至关重要，而程序被认为是一个强有力的候选方案。
AI.method: 本文采用综述性研究方法，回顾了使用程序作为概念表示的计算模型，并从通用表示语言的角度对这些模型进行评估。
AI.result: 综述表明程序作为概念表征的模型已有多种形式，它们各自从不同角度展示了程序在表示概念方面的潜力，但在构建真正通用的表示语言方面仍面临挑战。
AI.conclusion: 程序是概念通用表示的强有力候选，现有基于程序的概念学习模型为该方向提供了基础，但距离实现真正通用的表示语言仍有进一步探索的空间。

title: Robust Coverless Linguistic Steganography via Sentence Embedding Space with Global Resynchronization
summary: Linguistic steganography enables covert communication through natural language. Existing methods heavily rely on token-level operations and struggle to maintain reliability under word- and sentence-level textual perturbations. Moreover, variable-length coding-based schemes are highly susceptible to bit-slippage under minor disturbances, as perturbations cause desynchronization between embedded and extracted bit sequences. To address these issues, we propose a robust coverless steganographic framework that operates in the sentence embedding space rather than the token space. Specifically, secret messages are encoded as hierarchical clustering paths in the sentence embedding space, which enhances decoding stability against word- and sentence-level textual perturbations. To tackle the bit-slippage problem, we introduce a Global Resynchronization Mechanism (GRM) that reframes variable-length bitstreams as discrete symbols anchored to semantic subspaces, decoupling local embedding failures from global message recovery. Experimental results demonstrate that under word- and sentence-level perturbations, our approach achieves substantial improvements in robustness, while maintaining effective embedding capacity and exhibiting strong resistance to statistical analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于句子嵌入空间的鲁棒无载体隐写框架，将秘密消息编码为层次聚类路径，并通过全局重同步机制解决比特滑动问题，在词级和句级扰动下显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言隐写方法依赖token级操作，在词级和句级文本扰动下可靠性差；变长编码方案在轻微扰动下易发生比特滑动，导致嵌入与提取的比特序列失同步。
AI.method: 在句子嵌入空间而非token空间操作：将秘密消息编码为嵌入空间中的层次聚类路径以增强解码稳定性；提出全局重同步机制（GRM），将变长比特流重构为锚定于语义子空间的离散符号，使局部嵌入失败与全局消息恢复解耦。
AI.result: 在词级和句级扰动下，该方法在鲁棒性方面取得显著提升，同时保持有效的嵌入容量并展现出较强的抗统计分析能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过在语义嵌入空间进行层次聚类编码并引入全局重同步机制，有效解决了现有语言隐写在文本扰动下可靠性差和比特滑动问题，实现了鲁棒性与嵌入容量之间的良好平衡。

title: ToPos: Automated Optimal Positioning on Topographic Manifolds using Constrained Geodesic Voronoi Decomposition
comment: ©2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary:
Reliable autonomous mapping, environmental sampling, last-mile logistics, and infrastructure deployment depend on the optimal surface area-balanced distribution of Spatial Reference Sites (SRS). Conventional 2D Euclidean methods often fail in high-relief environments by neglecting topographic variations and physical obstructions. This leads to significant planimetric distortion, spatial clustering, and the placement of targets in inaccessible or shadowed regions, compromising both data integrity and operational safety. This paper introduces ToPos, an automated framework for TOPography-aware Optimal Sampling on topographic manifolds. We treat the terrain as a discrete 2-dimensional manifold embedded in 3D Euclidean space and replace standard flat-map distances with non-Euclidean geodesic distances that follow the actual surface geometry. The point distribution is formulated as an optimization problem using a Constrained Geodesic Voronoi Decomposition, solved via a Riemannian Nesterov Accelerated Gradient (NAG) engine. Our approach restricts target locations to a feasible "safe zone," accounting for non-traversable slopes, vegetation, environmental occlusions, etc. Through evaluations on non-convex sinusoidal manifolds, we show that ToPos mitigates planimetric distortion by utilizing geodesic metrics. This approach results in a $\sim$74% improvement in optimal surface area-balanced distribution, as measured by the coefficient of variation (CV) of the Voronoi cell areas. The framework is architected as a Geographic Information System (GIS)-ready micro-service to bolster the mentioned applications.
  Index Terms: Topographic Manifolds, Geodesic Voronoi Decomposition, Infrastructure Deployment, 3D Mapping, Spatial Sampling, and Non-Euclidean Optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToPos框架，将地形视为嵌入3D欧几里得空间的离散2维流形，用非欧几里得测地距离替代平面欧氏距离，并通过约束测地Voronoi分解与黎曼Nesterov加速梯度优化引擎，在安全可行区域内实现地形感知的最优空间参考站点(SRS)分布，较传统平面方法在面积均衡分布上提升约74%。
AI.motivation: 自主建图、环境采样、最后一公里物流和基础设施部署等应用依赖于空间参考站点(SRS)在表面上的面积均衡分布。传统2D欧几里得方法在高起伏地形中忽视地形变化和物理障碍，导致明显的平面畸变、空间聚集，并将目标放置在不可达或阴影区域，损害数据完整性和操作安全性。
AI.method: (1) 将地形建模为嵌入3D欧氏空间的离散2维黎曼流形，以沿实际表面几何的测地距离替代平面距离；(2) 将点分布问题形式化为约束测地Voronoi分解的优化问题；(3) 使用黎曼Nesterov加速梯度(NAG)引擎求解该优化问题；(4) 引入可行的"安全区"约束，排除不可穿越陡坡、植被、环境遮挡等区域；(5) 将框架架构为GIS可用的微服务。
AI.result: 在非凸正弦流形上的评估表明，ToPos通过利用测地度量减缓了平面畸变，并以Voronoi单元面积的变异系数(CV)为指标，实现约74%的最优表面面积均衡分布提升。
AI.conclusion: ToPos为高起伏地形中的空间参考站点分布提供了一种地形感知的非欧几里得优化框架，显著优于传统2D平面方法，并以GIS就绪的微服务架构支持自主建图、采样、物流和基础设施部署等实际应用。

title: An Evaluation Framework for Generating Multi-View Images of a Person in a Scene
summary: Recent generative image-editing Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) demonstrate impressive semantic editing capabilities but still struggle with spatially consistent camera angle changes. A primary bottleneck in training foundation models to execute free-form, promptable camera angle changes is the lack of specialized training data. While multi-view datasets exist for generic 3D environments and objects, there remains an absence of paired, multi-view datasets featuring human subjects at fixed locations in natural scenes, including frontal and side-profile views. Capturing such multi-camera data in unconstrained environments is logistically challenging and unscalable. In this paper, we first experiment with multiple state-of-the-art image editing models to create this data synthetically, but find that the outputs are frequently prone to hallucinations involving how much the subject's head turns relative to the background, often producing inconsistent environments. To address this issue, we propose the Head Scene Rotation Difference (HSRD) metric to quantitatively evaluate camera movements around a person. The proposed metric operates by decoupling camera movement from localized head pose manipulation. As demonstrated by the extensive experimentation, HSRD provides the pipeline necessary to evaluate 3D spatial parallax for a person in a scene, paving the way to reliably construct high-quality multi-view synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦于生成式图像编辑DiT模型在一致相机角度变化上的不足，指出根本瓶颈是缺乏含人类主体、固定位置、自然场景下的多视角配对数据集。作者测试了多种SOTA编辑模型以合成此类数据，发现输出常出现头部转动与背景不一致的幻觉问题。为此提出HSRD（头部场景旋转差异）指标，通过解耦相机运动与局部头部姿态操作来定量评估人物周围的相机运动，为构建高质量多视角合成数据集提供可靠评估管道。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式图像编辑DiT模型具备语义编辑能力，但在空间一致的相机角度变化上表现不佳；其根本瓶颈在于缺少包含自然场景中人物固定位置、含正面与侧面视角的多视图配对训练数据。而真实环境中的多相机采集在物流上极具挑战且不可扩展，因此需要可行的数据合成与验证方案。
AI.method: 首先测试多种SOTA图像编辑模型以合成所需的多视角数据，发现输出频繁出现幻觉，尤其在头部转动量与背景之间缺乏一致性。进而提出HSRD指标，将相机运动与人头部局部姿态操作解耦，从而定量度量人物周围的相机运动（三维空间视差），为数据质量评估提供标准化管道。
AI.result: HSRD指标能够有效评估人物场景中的三维空间视差，经大量实验验证，可作为一种可靠性高的评估管道用于筛选和构建高质量的多视角合成数据集。
AI.conclusion: HSRD填补了人物场景多视角数据合成中缺少定量评估手段的空白，为训练可执行自由形式相机角度变化的DiT模型奠定了数据质量保障基础。

title: On-board ML for Trace Gas detection in Imaging Spectroscopy data
comment: 2 pages; presented as a short (2 pages) paper at the IEEE HPEC26
summary: Data collected during aerial and spaceborne imaging spectroscopy campaigns enables the detection of transient events such as trace gas emissions. However, current processing pipelines depend on slow, on-the-ground processing, which delays the time to information of each detected event and prohibits immediate follow-up actions. During the Tokyo Field Campaign of March 2026, we explored on-board processing of Imaging Spectroscopy data from the equipped AVIRIS-5 sensor. Due to communication bottlenecks, full datacubes cannot be downlinked immediately during the flight. Instead we downlink the potential events predicted by our efficient and small machine learning model. We show the first on-board detection of methane point source emission with Imaging Spectroscopy data using Edge ML.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了首次使用边缘机器学习（Edge ML）在机载平台上实时检测成像光谱数据中的甲烷点源排放，克服了传统地面处理延迟和通信瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 传统航空/航天成像光谱数据的处理依赖地面慢速处理，导致从事件发生到信息获取的延迟过长，无法实现即时后续行动。同时，完整数据立方体受通信瓶颈限制无法在飞行中即时下行传输。
AI.method: 在2026年3月东京野外运动期间，AVIRIS-5传感器搭载的高效小型机器学习模型在机载平台上处理成像光谱数据，仅将模型预测出的潜在事件（异常排放）下行传输到地面，而非完整数据立方体。
AI.result: 首次实现了利用成像光谱数据和Edge ML在机载环境中的甲烷点源排放实时检测。
AI.conclusion: 基于边缘计算的机载机器学习方法能够有效缩短成像光谱数据中瞬态事件（如微量气体排放）的检测延迟，为即时响应和后续行动提供支持。

title: Towards Understanding Pause Token Fine-Tuning Dynamics: A Mode Retention Perspective
summary: Pause-token methods improve LLM reasoning by inserting special tokens into sequences. Prior work explains these gains through computational expressivity. However, there is relatively little investigation into the training dynamics of pause tokens. We explore how pause tokens reshape the training dynamics of fine-tuning. Two controlled pilots expose distinct asymmetries. On a synthetic continual-learning task, masked pauses overwrite a previously-learned distribution roughly 4x less at matched final adaptation (H1, mode retention); on a synthetic math-reasoning probe, the boundary-adjacent token comes to encode substantially more downstream-step information (H2, non-myopic compression). We formalize a training rule consistent with both - Masked Boundary Pause (MBP), pause tokens placed at reasoning-step boundaries with their loss masked. Across 1B-8B Qwen and Llama models, MBP consistently improves reasoning, achieving gains of up to 6 points on math and 2.5 points on code, while preserving general language understanding abilities. We further demonstrate that this mode-preserving strategy extend gains to GRPO. These results recast pause tokens as a training-dynamics intervention on the retention-adaptation trade-off, rather than merely an inference-time computation device.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了暂停标记（pause tokens）如何重塑LLM微调的训练动态，发现其带来两种显著的训练不对称性——模式保持和非近视压缩，并提出掩码边界暂停（MBP）方法。在1B-8B的Qwen和Llama模型上，MBP一致性地提升了推理能力（数学上最多提升6分，代码上提升2.5分），同时保持通用语言理解能力，并可将收益扩展到GRPO。作者将暂停标记重新定位为作用于"保留-适应权衡"的训练动态干预，而非仅仅是推理时的计算设备。
AI.motivation: 已有的暂停标记研究主要从计算表达力（computational expressivity）角度解释其推理增益，但对暂停标记的训练动态（training dynamics）缺乏深入探究。作者希望填补这一空白，理解暂停标记在微调过程中如何影响学习行为，进而设计更高效的训练方法。
AI.method: 作者通过两个受控试点实验揭示两种不对称性：（1）在合成持续学习任务中，掩码暂停以匹配的最终适应度几乎将之前学习的分布覆盖率降低约4倍（模式保持，H1）；（2）在合成数学推理探针中，边界相邻标记编码了明显更多的下游步骤信息（非近视压缩，H2）。基于此形式化提出MBP（Masked Boundary Pause）训练规则——将暂停标记放置于推理步骤边界并掩蔽其损失。在1B-8B规模的Qwen和Llama模型上验证，并将该策略扩展到GRPO。
AI.result: MBP在Qwen和Llama系列（1B-8B）上一致性地提升推理性能，数学任务最多提升6个点，代码任务提升2.5个点，同时保持通用语言理解能力不受损。此外，模式保持策略还能将收益进一步扩展到基于GRPO的强化学习训练场景。
AI.conclusion: 暂停标记的作用应被重新理解为一种针对"保留-适应权衡"（retention-adaptation trade-off）的训练动态干预，而非仅仅是推理阶段的计算增强手段。通过掩蔽损失并将暂停标记放置在推理步骤边界，可以在适应新能力的同时更好地保留已学知识并压缩下游步骤信息，从而实现更佳的推理性能。

title: Data-Driven Discovery of Composition-Dependent Constitutive Models for Hyperelasticity and Viscoelasticity of Digital Materials
comment: 40 pages including references, 9 figures in the main manuscript. Supplementary material is available upon request from the corresponding author
summary: Digital materials fabricated by multi-material 3D printing are designed as controlled mixtures of stiff and compliant constituents, yielding effective responses that span more than an order of magnitude in apparent stiffness and exhibit strongly nonlinear, composition-dependent, and rate-dependent dissipative behavior. Classical finite-strain viscoelastic models represent such behavior with closed-form strain energy functions for equilibrium and non-equilibrium stresses as well as evolution of internal variables, which may limit flexibility when a single constitutive model is expected to generalize across materials and loading rates. Here, we present a data-driven multi-material constitutive modeling framework that generalizes a formulation by Bergström and Boyce. The proposed framework retains the structure of the classical model, namely multiplicative kinematics, invariant-based strain-energy functions, and a scalar dissipative evolution law directed along the normalized nonequilibrium deviatoric stress. For the equilibrium branch, the data-driven discovery framework either directly predicts closed-form model parameters as functions of composition or automatically constructs a polyconvex strain-energy function using neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs). The nonequilibrium branch kinetics are learned similarly, either by directly identifying closed-form parameters across compositions or by using appropriately constrained artificial neural networks. Using multi-rate uniaxial compression data across multiple material compositions, we show that the proposed formulation captures rate-dependent stiffness and hysteresis across compositions while preserving thermodynamic consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的多材料本构建模框架，扩展了Bergström-Boyce模型，通过组合封闭形式参数识别或神经微分方程/人工神经网络自动构造方式来描述多材料3D打印数字材料的非线性率相关黏弹性行为。
AI.motivation: 多材料3D打印制备的数字材料表现出强非线性、组分依赖和率依赖的耗散行为，经典有限应变黏弹性模型采用封闭形式应变能函数和内变量演化律，灵活性有限，难以用单一本构模型推广到多种材料和加载速率。
AI.method: 提出数据驱动的多材料本构建模框架：保留Bergström-Boyce模型的乘性运动学、基于不变量的应变能函数和沿归一化非平衡偏应力方向的标量耗散演化律；平衡分支可通过数据驱动直接预测封闭形式参数为组分函数，或用神经常微分方程自动构造多凸应变能函数；非平衡分支动力学通过识别封闭形式参数或使用受约束的人工神经网络学习；采用多速率单轴压缩数据进行验证。
AI.result: 所提框架能够捕捉跨组分的率相关刚度和滞回行为，同时保持热力学一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该数据驱动框架在保留经典模型物理结构的同时实现了跨材料组分与加载速率的泛化能力，为多材料3D打印数字材料的本构建模提供了灵活且物理一致的解决方案。

title: TPMSpy: Validation of Measured Boot Systems by Low-Level Tracing of TPM Usage
summary:
Measured Boot extends trust in a booted system by recording cryptographic measurements of executed software and system state into a Trusted Platform Module (TPM), enabling subsequent verification through remote attestation. Although this mechanism is increasingly deployed in contemporary operating systems, its practical security depends on whether implementations measure the expected components under the expected conditions, yet this is not checked systematically.
  We propose a platform-agnostic method for analysing low-level TPM usage at the level of virtualized system--TPM interactions. It enables independent reconstruction and validation of the TPM Event Log without relying on the quoting mechanism itself. Because it does not depend on implementation details, it is applicable to both open and closed systems. We demonstrate the method on both Linux and Windows and conduct a systematic longitudinal analysis of Linux systems with systemd versions 245--258 (2020--2025), examining how Measured Boot usage evolved and observing wide divergence. No single usage pattern emerged amongst systems, warranting customized analysis.
  The analysis identifies undocumented behavioural changes, reveals inconsistent measurements of user-space systemd services, which prevent reliable remote attestation and LUKS disk decryption on such systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种平台无关的方法，在虚拟化系统与TPM交互层面分析低层TPM使用，重构并验证TPM事件日志而不依赖quoting机制，适用于开放和封闭系统。作者在Linux和Windows上验证了该方法，并对systemd 245–258版本（2020–2025）的Linux系统进行了纵向分析，发现Measured Boot的使用模式存在广泛分歧，且识别出未文档化的行为变化和对用户态systemd服务的不一致测量，导致远程证明和LUKS磁盘解密不可靠。
AI.motivation: Measured Boot通过将软件测量记录到TPM中增强系统信任，但其实际安全性取决于实现是否在预期条件下测量了预期组件，而这一点目前没有被系统性地检查。
AI.method: 提出一种平台无关的分析方法，在虚拟化系统与TPM交互层面上分析低层TPM使用，不依赖quoting机制即可独立重构和验证TPM事件日志，适用于开放和封闭系统。在Linux和Windows上演示该方法，并对systemd 245–258的Linux系统进行纵向分析。
AI.result: 研究发现Measured Boot的使用模式在系统间存在广泛分歧，没有单一的使用模式，需要定制化分析。同时识别出未文档化的行为变化，并发现用户态systemd服务的测量不一致，这会阻止可靠的远程证明和LUKS磁盘解密。
AI.conclusion: Measured Boot的实际实现存在显著的不一致性和未文档化变化，导致其安全保证无法可靠达成，需要针对不同系统进行定制化分析。该平台无关方法为独立验证TPM事件日志提供了有效途径。

title: A Schema Bounded Language Model for Refining Robot Policies Without Destabilizing Local Learning
summary: This paper addresses navigation by composite heterogeneous robots in a decentralized system when policy reasoning and local control operate at different update levels. In a NetLogo--Python implementation, three robots share motion dynamics but use different LLM backends. Each robot independently combines a large language model (LLM) policy agent, an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) bandit, and a Double Deep Q-Network (Double DQN) controller; no central LLM generates team actions. LLM inference is confined to round-level policy generation and refinement rather than tick-level action selection. The robots perform cross-LLM communication through a shared round summary containing policies, outcomes, and learning feedback. UCB performs refinement-mode selection, and the policy-conditioned Double DQN performs tick-level action selection from navigation variables, active policy parameters, and the LLM action prior. Each of the four configurations was evaluated over 30 rounds. In the fixed simulation, the complete configuration reached the goal in all 90 correlated robot--round records and achieved the lowest median completion time (42 ticks) and P90 (73.2 ticks); its median was 25.0--39.1\% lower than those of the other configurations. These observations provide descriptive, configuration-level evidence from the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种去中心化的异构机器人导航系统，将LLM策略推理（回合级）与局部控制（tick级）分离，通过共享回合摘要实现跨LLM通信，并利用UCB和Double DQN分层决策，在固定仿真中完整配置以最低中位完成时间(42 ticks)达成全部目标。
AI.motivation: 解决异构机器人系统在去中心化条件下，策略推理与局部控制运行在不同更新层级时的协调挑战，避免依赖中心化LLM生成团队动作，同时克服LLM在高频（tick级）动作选择中推理开销与不稳定性问题。
AI.method: 在NetLogo-Python平台实现三台共享运动动力学但采用不同LLM后端的机器人。每台机器人独立组合LLM策略智能体、UCB bandit（回合级策略细化模式选择）和策略条件化Double DQN控制器（tick级动作选择）。通过共享回合摘要（含策略、结果和学习反馈）实现跨LLM通信，LLM推理限定在回合级而非tick级。四种配置各评估30轮。
AI.result: 在固定仿真中，完整配置在90条相关的机器人-回合记录中全部达成目标，中位完成时间为42 ticks，P90为73.2 ticks；其单位数比其余配置低25.0%-39.1%。
AI.conclusion: 这些观察提供了来自所评估配置的描述性、配置级证据，表明将LLM策略推理限制在回合级并与分层控制架构集成的去中心化方案在该仿真环境中具有有效性。作者同时强调了证据的局限性（描述性、配置级），表明结论应在更广泛实验条件下进一步验证。

title: Importance-Aware Low-Rank Distillation of Diffusion Transformers
summary:
Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a dominant architecture for high-quality text-to-image generation, yet their scale poses challenges for efficient deployment. While truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) is a principled tool for parameter reduction, evidence from large language models (LLMs) suggests that naive low-rank approximation can cause catastrophic failure. In contrast, we find that truncated SVD in DiTs produces smooth degradation even under substantial global compression, with redundancy distributed across projection matrices throughout the whole network rather than concentrated in a few transformer blocks. Building on these insights, we introduce SVDtrunc, a two-step block-level compression scheme, first allocating ranks across blocks and compressing the least important ones via truncated SVD under a global parameter budget, and then fine-tuning all blocks with modular knowledge distillation and a rectified-flow objective. We apply SVDtrunc to FLUX.dev across compression levels ranging from 40-90% of the original parameter count. Across three benchmarks, GenEval, HPSv2, and DPG, we outperform all competing approaches. Notably, and in contrast to prior work, we retain near-full performance at 68% and remain competitive even at 57% of the original parameter budget. Furthermore, we show that SVDtrunc complements step distillation and achieves strong results even without fine-tuning, positioning it as a practical continuation of efficiency improvements beyond diffusion step reduction for large-scale generative models.
  Project page: https://vislearn.github.io/SVDtrunc/

AI.tldr: 本文提出SVDtrunc，一种面向扩散Transformer（DiT）的分块级压缩方案。作者发现截断SVD在DiT中即使在较高全局压缩率下仍产生平滑的性能衰减，冗余分布在整个网络而非集中于某些块。SVDtrunc先全局分配各块的秩预算并对其截断SVD压缩，再通过模块化知识蒸馏和整流流目标微调。在FLUX.dev上压缩至原始参数量的40-90%，在GenEval、HPSv2和DPG基准上超越所有竞品，在68%参数时保持近满性能，在57%时仍具竞争力，且无需微调也能取得良好结果，并能与步蒸馏互补。
AI.motivation: DiT是高质量文生图的主流架构，但其规模导致部署困难。尽管截断SVD是参数缩减的经典工具，LLM领域的证据表明朴素的低秩近似可能造成灾难性失败，因此需要研究DiT中SVD压缩的可行性并据此设计高效的压缩方案。
AI.method: SVDtrunc采用两步分块级压缩流程：第一步，在全局参数预算下跨块分配秩，对最不重要的块（块间分配秩）执行截断SVD压缩；第二步，用模块化知识蒸馏配合整流流目标对所有块进行微调。
AI.result: 在FLUX.dev上对参数量从40%到90%的多个压缩级别应用SVDtrunc，在GenEval、HPSv2和DPG三个基准上均超越所有竞品。在68%参数量下保持近乎满性能，在57%参数量下仍有竞争力。此外，SVDtrunc可与步蒸馏互补，且无需微调也能取得强结果。
AI.conclusion: SVDtrunc可作为大规模扩散模型超越步数缩减之外的实用效率提升延续方案，为DiT的结构化低秩压缩提供了有效路径，验证了截断SVD在DiT中的平滑衰减特性并加以利用。

title: Nested Inductive Bias Framework for SPD Manifold Learning
summary: In Geometric Deep Learning, inductive biases serve two primary functions: enforcing manifold constraints and embedding relational priors. Currently, representation learning on SPD manifolds frequently relies on pullback Euclidean metrics, such as the Log-Euclidean Metric, to satisfy the former. While computationally efficient in avoiding domain boundary violations, these metrics induce a flat geometry that may fail to capture the intrinsic relational priors of datasets. While metrics such as the Poincaré metric are widely utilized to induce domain-aligned relational priors, generalizing them from standard vector representations to the SPD manifold has remained a challenge. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Nested Inductive Bias framework that utilizes a two-stage diffeomorphic composition to formally pull back non-Euclidean target geometries onto the SPD manifold. This framework enables the construction of curvature-aligned Riemannian classifiers that simultaneously respect matrix constraints and the latent relational geometry of the data. Empirical evaluations on kinematic and signal processing benchmarks, together with synthetic experiments, demonstrate that deep manifold networks experience degradation in class separability unless the metric curvature aligns with the intrinsic data distribution. Furthermore, for standard vectorized architectures, we propose the Rational Conformal Metric (RCM), designed to establish state-of-the-art geometric robustness against outliers by bounding the representation space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出嵌套归纳偏置框架，通过两阶段微分同胚组合将非欧几里得目标几何拉回至SPD流形，实现曲率对齐的黎曼分类器；同时提出有理共形度量以增强向量化架构的几何鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 几何深度学习中的归纳偏置需同时满足流形约束（如SPD）和关系先验编码。现有方法如Log-Euclidean度量虽计算高效并避免域边界违反，但引入平坦几何，难以捕捉数据的内在关系先验；而Poincaré等曲率度量能编码域对齐的关系先验，却难以从标准向量表示推广到SPD流形。
AI.method: 提出嵌套归纳偏置框架，采用两阶段微分同胚组合将非欧几里得目标几何正式拉回到SPD流形上，构建曲率对齐的黎曼分类器；此外针对标准向量化架构提出有理共形度量（RCM），通过有界表示空间建立对异常值的几何鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在运动学和信号处理基准及合成实验上，实验表明若度量曲率与内在数据分布不一致，深度流形网络会出现类别可分性退化；RCM在向量化架构上实现了针对异常值的最优几何鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 度量曲率与数据内在几何的匹配是流形表示学习的关键因素；所提框架与RCM能同时满足矩阵约束与潜在关系几何，为SPD流形上的曲率敏感学习提供了新途径。

title: LentEx: Generalizable Latent Entity Extraction via Synthetic Data and Instruction-Tuned LLMs
summary: Latent entity extraction (LEE) tackles the challenge of identifying implicit, contextually inferred entities within free text-an area where traditional entity extraction methods fall short. In this paper, we introduce LentEx, a novel framework for latent entity extraction that leverages synthetic data generation and instruction fine-tuning to optimize smaller, efficient large language models (LLMs). Latent entities, which are often abstract and thematic, are crucial for applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), customer persona analysis, and knowledge graph enrichment. LentEx addresses the scarcity of labeled datasets by employing a template-based approach to generate diverse, contextually rich synthetic data, ensuring high variability and alignment with real-world distributions. To our knowledge, LentEx is the first to systematically approach LEE through the lens of LLMs. LentEx demonstrates significant performance improvements across multiple tasks, notably surpassing state-of-the-art models on the MTEB Clustering Benchmark. Furthermore, our methodology enables robust generalization to unseen domains, making LentEx highly applicable in real-world NLP tasks, including RAG and clustering, thereby establishing a new paradigm for latent entity understanding and extraction in natural language processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LentEx框架，利用合成数据生成和指令微调来优化小型高效大语言模型，用于解决潜在实体抽取（LEE）任务，并在MTEB聚类基准上超越现有最先进模型。
AI.motivation: 传统实体抽取方法无法识别文本中隐含的、通过上下文推断的潜在实体（latent entities），且这类实体通常具有抽象和主题性的特点，对RAG、客户画像分析和知识图谱增强等应用至关重要。然而，潜在实体抽取面临标注数据稀缺的主要挑战，目前缺乏系统利用大语言模型来解决该问题的方法。
AI.method: LentEx框架采用两阶段策略：(1) 基于模板的合成数据生成方法，生成多样化、上下文丰富且与真实分布对齐的合成数据集，以解决标注数据稀缺问题；(2) 通过指令微调（instruction fine-tuning）优化小型高效LLM，使其具备潜在实体抽取能力。
AI.result: LentEx在多个任务上展现了显著性能提升，尤其在MTEB聚类基准上超越了当前最先进的模型；同时该框架展现出对未见领域的良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LentEx是首个系统性地通过LLM视角解决潜在实体抽取问题的框架，为RAG和聚类等真实NLP应用提供了有效方案，建立了NLP中潜在实体理解与抽取的新范式。

title: From Answers to Interpretations: Rethinking Ambiguity-Induced Aleatoric Uncertainty Estimation in LLMs
summary: A key challenge in reliable LLM deployment is recognizing when uncertainty reflects irreducible variability in the task rather than limitations in the model's knowledge. In language tasks, a central source of such aleatoric uncertainty is input ambiguity or underspecification, where multiple interpretations remain plausible. Existing decomposition methods estimate aleatoric uncertainty by generating multiple clarifications of the input, querying the model for an answer under each clarification, and comparing the resulting answers. We argue that answers are not necessary for identifying ambiguity: they are often redundant, add avoidable cost, and can mislead through epistemic leakage. We support this claim theoretically, and propose a clarification-only approach that estimates this ambiguity-induced component directly from the space of plausible interpretations, without answers to the clarified inputs. Using ambiguity detection as an operational evaluation across three benchmarks, this direct approach improves AUROC (63.34 vs. 60.85), reduces computational cost by 4-26x in output tokens and 2.2-3.5x in API calls, and yields estimates with substantially lower correlation with epistemic uncertainty. Overall, our results suggest that ambiguity-induced aleatoric uncertainty is better estimated from the interpretation space than from the response space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依赖澄清（clarification）而不需要模型回答的估计方法，直接从解释空间中估计由输入歧义引起的偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty），相较传统基于回答的方法在AUROC上提升约2.5个点，同时大幅降低计算成本并减少与认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）的相关性。
AI.motivation: 在LLM部署中，区分不确定性来源于任务本身的不可约变异性（偶然不确定性）还是模型知识局限（认知不确定性）是关键挑战。语言任务中偶然不确定性的核心来源是输入的歧义或欠指定。现有方法通过生成多个澄清、在每种澄清下查询模型回答并比较答案来分解不确定性，但作者认为答案对于识别歧义并非必需，且会引入冗余成本、可能通过认知泄漏产生误导，因此需要更直接高效的估计方法。
AI.method: 作者从理论上论证了鉴别歧义不需要答案，提出了一种仅澄清的方法：直接从可能的解释空间估计由歧义引起的偶然不确定性，而不需要对澄清后的输入生成回答。该方法将问题从"回答空间"转移到"解释空间"进行估计，并通过歧义检测作为操作化评估任务在三个基准上进行验证。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在歧义检测任务上提升了AUROC（63.34 vs 60.85），输出token的计算成本减少4-26倍，API调用次数减少2.2-3.5倍，且估计结果与认知不确定性的相关性显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 整体结果表明，由歧义引起的偶然不确定性更适合从解释空间而非回答空间进行估计，仅澄清的方法在准确性、计算效率和概念纯度上均优于传统的基于回答的分解方法。

title: Has MIMO decoding been proved hard from lattice problems?
summary: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technology is fundamental to modern wireless communication. Physical layer security seeks to protect transmitted information by exploiting properties of the noisy communication channel. Dean and Goldsmith proposed a polynomial time reduction from lattice problems to MIMO decoding by adapting Regev's reduction for learning with errors (LWE). If valid, this reduction would give physical layer security a strong computational foundation based on the hardness of established lattice problems. Subsequent works presented attacks and counterexamples against the resulting construction, casting doubt on its security but leaving the precise validity and limitations of the underlying reduction incompletely understood. We provide a theoretical examination of the revised reduction and identify the structural features of the LWE reduction that fail to carry over to the non-modular MIMO setting, hence showing that its published proof does not establish the claimed hardness of MIMO decoding. Our results distinguish flaws in the hardness proof from direct attacks on particular parameter choices and clarify what would be required of any attempted repair. We do not rule out physical layer security for MIMO systems in general, but show that the claimed lattice hardness guarantee does not follow from the existing reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文对Dean和Goldsmith提出的从格问题到MIMO解码的多项式时间归约进行了理论审查，指出该归约的已发表证明未能确立MIMO解码的格硬度保证，其根本原因在于LWE归约中的某些结构特征无法推广到非模MIMO场景。文章区分了硬度证明中的缺陷与针对特定参数选择的直接攻击，并阐明任何尝试修复所需的条件。
AI.motivation: 物理层安全若能建立在格问题的计算困难性基础上，将获得强大的计算安全基础。然而后续出现的攻击和反例对该构造的安全性提出质疑，但归约本身的精确有效性和局限性尚未被完全理解。本文旨在从理论上澄清这一归约的真实效力。
AI.method: 对修订后的归约进行系统的理论分析，识别LWE归约结构中无法迁移到非模（non-modular）MIMO设置的关键特征，从而定位证明中的根本缺陷。
AI.result: 证明了已发表的归约证明不能确立所声称的MIMO解码硬度；区分了硬度证明缺陷与特定参数直接攻击的差异；阐明了任何修复尝试必须满足的条件。
AI.conclusion: 虽然不能一般性地排除MIMO系统物理层安全的可能性，但已有的归约并不能为其提供所声称的格硬度保证。该结果有助于厘清物理层安全计算基础的可行边界。

title: LIBERO-RECOVER: Beyond Task Success Towards Failure Recovery in Robotic Manipulation Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) or World Action (WAM) models have recently demonstrated remarkable performance in robotic manipulation. On LIBERO, SOTA method have achieved nearly 100\% success rates, seemingly suggesting that the models are ready for deployment in real world. However, near perfect performance on existing benchmarks can be misleading: success under ideal conditions does not imply real world robustness. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate task completion from predefined initial states, while real world interactions inevitably involve failures such as failed grasps, collisions, and unintended object movements. A robot must therefore not only execute tasks successfully, but also recognize and recover from failures to continue the task.
