Yet this capability remains largely unmeasured, revealing a critical gap between benchmark performance and real world reliability. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Recover Benchmark, a large scale benchmark for failure recovery in robotic manipulation. Built upon LIBERO, we collect real execution failures from SOTA embodied models and construct 1,000+ scenarios across four recovery levels: (1) Action Retry, (2) Action Adaptation, (3) Object State Recovery, and (4) Environmental Recovery. We evaluate four core capabilities: spatial understanding, object structure reasoning, interaction understanding, and topological reasoning. As the first large-scale benchmark for embodied failure recovery, LIBERO-Recover shifts evaluation from \emph{Can the robot succeed?''} to \emph{Can the robot recover after failure?''}, promoting robust and generalizable embodied agents. The project will be avaible in \textcolor{blue}{https://liulin815.github.io/LIBERO-Recovery/}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIBERO-Recover基准，首个大规模机器人操作失败恢复评测基准。基于LIBERO采集真实执行失败场景，构建1000+个跨四个恢复级别的场景，评估四项核心能力（空间理解、物体结构推理、交互理解、拓扑推理），将评测关注点从"能否成功"转向"失败后能否恢复"。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA/WAM模型在LIBERO等基准上达到接近100%成功率，但这类基准主要从预定义初始状态评测任务完成情况，忽略了真实世界中不可避免的失败（如抓取失败、碰撞、物体意外移动）。模型需要能识别并从失败中恢复以继续任务，然而这一能力尚未被测量，导致基准性能与现实可靠性之间存在关键差距。
AI.method: 基于LIBERO，从SOTA具身模型中采集真实执行失败，构建超过1000个失败恢复场景，覆盖四个恢复级别：(1)动作重试、(2)动作适应、(3)物体状态恢复、(4)环境恢复；并评估空间理解、物体结构推理、交互理解、拓扑推理四项核心能力。
AI.result: 首次构建大规模具身失败恢复基准LIBERO-Recover，提供1000+个跨四级别的恢复场景，全面评测模型在失败恢复方面的核心能力。
AI.conclusion: 该基准将评测视角从"机器人能否成功"转变为"机器人失败后能否恢复"，推动构建更健壮、可泛化的具身智能代理，弥补现有基准与现实可靠性之间的鸿沟。

title: ReaDiT Guidance: Control for Image and Video Generation using Diffusion Transformer Features
summary: We present DiT Readout (ReaDiT) Guidance, a lightweight framework for controlling generation with Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models via their internal feature representations. ReaDiT Guidance uses features from a single DiT block to steer the generative process according to spatial targets - like depth, pose, or edge maps - provided at test time. Furthermore, since modern text-to-video models are largely built on DiT backbones, ReaDiT Guidance naturally extends to video generation, enabling camera and motion control. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive or improved results compared to existing feature-based and off-the-shelf adapter-based approaches while requiring fewer parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出ReaDiT Guidance（DiT Readout），一种轻量级框架，通过利用扩散Transformer（DiT）模型的内部特征表示来引导生成过程，实现空间目标（深度、姿态、边缘图）以及视频生成中的相机和运动控制。
AI.motivation: 现有控制扩散Transformer生成的方法要么依赖大量参数的适配器，要么未充分利用模型内部丰富的特征表示。作者旨在探索一种更轻量的方案，仅使用单个DiT块的特征即可实现高效且有效的生成控制。
AI.method: ReaDiT Guidance从单个DiT块中读出（readout）内部特征，利用这些特征根据测试时提供的空间目标（如深度图、姿态、边缘图）引导扩散采样过程。该方法利用DiT骨干网络的架构优势，天然地扩展到基于DiT的文本生成视频模型，实现相机和运动控制。
AI.result: 实验表明，与现有的基于特征的方法和现成的适配器方法相比，ReaDiT Guidance取得了有竞争力或更优的结果，同时所需的参数量更少。
AI.conclusion: ReaDiT Guidance证明了利用单个DiT块内部特征进行读出引导是一种高效且有效的轻量级生成控制方案，在图像和视频生成中均能实现精确的空间与运动控制。

title: Hakken: Predicting future discoveries to fill the gaps in today's knowledge
summary: We present Hakken, a domain-agnostic prediction and explanation system performing knowledge prediction, i.e., growing scientific knowledge by establishing novel relationships, ones that are not limited to the deductive hull of previous knowledge. Hakken uses a transformer-based prediction model built on temporal sequences of knowledge graphs extracted from vast bodies of research publications, fused with an LLM's semantic knowledge, to predict the presence and define the type of as-yet undocumented relationships between scientific concepts. It then calls a model-agnostic explanation framework to provide accompanying information for each prediction that allows scientists to evaluate the suggested new relationship. While general purpose, we demonstrate Hakken's practical capabilities by applying it to the biomedical domain. There, Hakken's prediction model establishes a new benchmark for time-aware multi-label relation prediction, and we show that the model's output stays coherent and informative over extended time spans in historic data. In addition, we scored 1.5 million above-confidence-threshold hypotheses related to aging, qualitatively validated batches of these predictions with biologists and progressed three of them for empirical validation in wet-lab. Two predictions with potentially significant impact in the context of drug discovery and repurposing were confirmed, introducing previously undocumented interactions between TP53 and BAMBI, and between RAF1 and TNF, to biomedical science.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Hakken，一个领域无关的知识预测与解释系统，它结合基于Transformer的时序知识图谱预测模型与LLM语义知识，预测科学概念间尚未记录的关系及其类型，并通过模型无关解释框架为科学家提供评估依据。在生物医学领域的应用验证中，Hakken在时间感知多标签关系预测上建立了新基准，筛选出150万条与衰老相关的假设并最终在湿实验中确认了TP53-BAMBI和RAF1-TNF两个此前未知的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 传统科学知识发现受限于已有知识的演绎推理范畴，难以产生真正新颖的关系预测（即超越既有知识外延的关系）。研究者希望构建一个能够主动"提出"此前未被记录的科学概念间关系的系统，从而加速科学发现进程。
AI.method: Hakken系统包含两大核心组件：1）基于Transformer的预测模型，构建于从海量研究文献中提取的时间序列知识图谱之上，并结合LLM的语义知识进行融合，以预测科学概念间尚未记录的关系是否存在及其类型；2）模型无关的解释框架，为每条预测提供伴随信息，帮助科学家评估所建议的新关系。该系统是领域无关的通用工具，但文中以生物医学领域作为实证场景。
AI.result: 在生物医学领域，Hakken的预测模型在时间感知多标签关系预测任务上建立了新的基准。系统筛选出150万条超过置信阈值且与衰老相关的假设，并经生物学家定性验证，其中三条进入湿实验实证验证阶段。两条对药物发现与重定位具有潜在重大影响的预测最终被确认：TP53与BAMBI之间，以及RAF1与TNF之间的此前未被记录的相互作用。同时，模型输出在长历史时段的测试中保持连贯性和信息量。
AI.conclusion: Hakken展示了将时序知识图谱Transformer预测与LLM语义融合的可行性，能够生成高质量、可验证的新科学假设，并证明其在加速真实科学研究（尤其在生物医学与药物发现领域）中的实用价值。

title: Scale-QLoRA: Code-Invariant Adapter Merging for Native 4-bit Microscaling LLMs
summary: Merging a LoRA adapter into its base model is standard deployment practice: it removes the runtime adapter's per-forward overhead and leaves a single standalone checkpoint any serving stack can load. On a native 4-bit microscaling checkpoint (NVFP4, MXFP4) that step stops being free. The merged weights must be written back through a quantizer, which re-derives the checkpoint's discrete E2M1 code plane (roughly 90% of the artifact's bytes), so the deployed artifact becomes coupled to one quantization convention, and every later code-touching event in its lifecycle can move it. Done naively the step is worse than fragile: it deletes the adaptation, by up to 39 pp, because against an already-on-grid base the reconstruction optimum is that base. Scale-QLoRA instead adapts only the native per-block scale field, trains those scales on the deployment grid, and freezes every E2M1 code. Within a fixed native format, scale grid, block layout and code plane, merging is then a bit-exact identity and the merged artifact is code-invariant. Across four models and four tasks, Scale-QLoRA and merge-aware QAT-LoRA are both accuracy-lossless, so we claim no accuracy ordering between them; they differ structurally, in that QAT-LoRA re-derives the code plane through a quantizer while Scale-QLoRA preserves it exactly. That difference is what the lifecycle prices: nearest-rounding implementations disagree by about a point on the measured task, and more extreme rule mismatches can drive the weight-space artifact to ~0%, which we report as a sensitivity bound rather than a deployment frequency. Preserving the code plane also drops the weight-space straight-through estimator from training (3.9x per step on the dense 8B model) and enables exact rollback, code-plane deduplication, and a ~125x faster scale-only task swap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scale-QLoRA方法，仅适配原生4-bit微缩检查点（NVFP4/MXFP4）中按块划分的缩放因子（scale），同时冻结E2M1码平面。这使得LoRA合并成为逐位精确的恒等操作，合并产物与码平面无关，避免了传统合并中码平面重推导带来的量化约定耦合及适应能力丢失问题。实验表明Scale-QLoRA与merge-aware QAT-LoRA在四个模型和四个任务上均无损精度，但在生命周期代价上具有结构性优势。
AI.motivation: 在原生4-bit微缩格式（NVFP4/MXFP4）上将LoRA适配器合并回基座模型是标准部署操作，但合并时需通过量化器重新推导E2M1码平面（约占工件90%字节），导致部署工件依赖于某一量化约定且生命周期内任何涉及码平面的操作都可能使其漂移。朴素合并甚至可能删除适配结果（性能下降最多39个百分点），因为当基座已在网格上时，重建最优点是基座本身。
AI.method: Scale-QLoRA仅适配原生按块缩放的scale字段，在部署网格上训练这些scale，并冻结所有E2M1码。在固定的原生格式、scale网格、块布局和码平面内，合并成为逐位精确的恒等操作，合并后的工件保持码不变性。Scale-QLoRA还在训练中去除了权重空间的直通估计器（STE），使8B稠密模型每步速度提升3.9倍。
AI.result: 在四个模型和四个任务上，Scale-QLoRA与merge-aware QAT-LoRA均精度无损，二者无精度排序差异。但近舍入实现之间在测试任务上约有1个百分点的分歧，而更极端的规则不匹配可将权重空间工件驱动至约0%准确率（作为敏感性边界而非部署频率报告）。保留码平面还带来精确回滚、码平面去重以及约125倍更快的纯scale任务切换。
AI.conclusion: Scale-QLoRA通过仅适配scale字段并冻结码平面，实现了LoRA在原生4-bit微缩检查点上的位精确合并，从结构上消除了量化约定耦合及码平面重推导风险，在保证与QAT-LoRA同等精度的前提下提供了显著更优的部署生命周期属性（精确回滚、去重、快速任务切换等）。

title: IPGeoAI: Transformer-Based Geolocation with LLM Semantic Fusion
summary: Accurate city-level IP Geolocation is an important enabler for the modern digital ecosystem, underpinning services ranging from local content delivery and targeting to digital rights enforcement. However, traditional heuristic and database-driven methods often struggle to resolve the complex, non-linear allocation patterns of modern network infrastructures, particularly within the exploding IPv6 address space and transient mobile networks. In this paper, we introduce IPGeoAI, a novel deep learning model architecture that reframes geolocation from a static lookup problem to a sequential modeling task. Our approach utilizes the Transformer Encoder to capture hierarchical dependencies inherent in IP subnet structures. We propose a method to resolve geographic ambiguity by integrating unstructured semantic context via a Zero-Shot LLM Feature Extraction pipeline. We utilize Large Language Models to transform raw, noisy Autonomous Systems (AS) descriptions into structured, domain-specific metadata (such as 'University' vs. 'ISP' or 'Global' vs. 'Local') via an offline pre-computation process. By fusing these semantic signals into the network via a Multi-Head Cross-Attention module, we bridge the gap between numerical network topology and real-world semantic identity. Extensive offline evaluation on a proprietary dataset spanning 200,000 cities demonstrates that IPGeoAI significantly outperforms a leading external vendor in city-level granularity. By adopting a hierarchical inference strategy that refines coarse-grained country signals, our model achieves a 6% improvement in city-level accuracy while extending coverage to 100% of the traffic. Furthermore, in large-scale online production tests, the model drove a statistically significant +0.35% improvement in our 1st-tier downstream use cases metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IPGeoAI，一种基于Transformer编码器和LLM语义特征融合的深度学习模型，将IP地理定位从静态查找问题重构为序列建模任务，在城市级定位精度上显著超越传统方法及外部商业供应商。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于启发式规则和数据库驱动的IP地理定位方法难以应对现代网络基础设施中复杂非线性的地址分配模式，尤其在快速增长IPv6地址空间和移动网络中表现不佳，因此需要更强大的建模方法。
AI.method: 采用Transformer编码器捕捉IP子网结构中的层次化依赖关系；提出Zero-Shot LLM特征提取管线，利用大语言模型将AS描述转化为结构化的语义元数据（如大学vs ISP、全局vs本地）；通过多头交叉注意力模块融合语义信息与数值型网络拓扑特征；采用层级推理策略，先细化粗粒度国家信号再定位到城市级别。
AI.result: 在覆盖20万城市的数据集上显著超越外部商业供应商；层级推理策略带来6%的城市级精度提升并覆盖100%流量；在线生产环境中，下游用例指标实现了统计显著的+0.35%提升。
AI.conclusion: IPGeoAI验证了将IP定位建模为序列任务并结合LLM语义知识注入的有效性，通过跨模态特征融合弥合网络拓扑数值与真实世界语义身份之间的鸿沟，实现了更精准且覆盖全面的城市级IP地理定位。

title: Operational Roles of QRNG-Derived Quantum Entropy in Bitcoin Proof-of-Work Architectures
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Prepared for the Congresso Brasileiro de Ciências e Tecnologias Quânticas (CBCTQ 2026). Reproducibility script included with the source files
summary: Replacing classical entropy with QRNG output does not change honest Bitcoin PoW success probability when candidate headers remain distinct. The original contribution of this paper is a reproducible benchmark that locates and measures the operational value of quantum entropy in hybrid quantum-classical mining infrastructure through two scheduler-level observables, the entropy-efficiency factor $η$ and the reboot-diversity index $ρ$. Monte Carlo and scheduler simulations with confidence intervals show parity for competent deterministic and strong-classical baselines, while QRNG value emerges in assurance-oriented scenarios involving correlated restart faults, namespace reuse, and entropy provenance. The study is therefore positioned as a simulation-based validation framework rather than as a device-level QRNG demonstration; hardware-in-the-loop validation with recorded or live QRNG streams is identified as the next experimental step.

AI.tldr: 本文通过模拟基准测试表明，在诚实比特币PoW中，用QRNG输出替代经典熵不会改变成功概率（候选区块头保持不同时），但QRNG的价值体现在涉及关联重启故障、命名空间复用和熵来源可信性的保障型场景中。
AI.motivation: 探讨混合量子-经典挖矿基础设施中量子熵的实际运营价值，通过可复现的基准测试来定位和量化QRNG在真实系统层面的作用，而非仅停留在设备级别演示。
AI.method: 提出了两个调度器级可观测指标：熵效率因子η和重启多样性指数ρ；采用蒙特卡洛模拟和调度器仿真，并附带置信区间，对确定性基线、强经典基线和QRNG方案进行对比。
AI.result: 在竞争性场景下，QRNG与合格的确定性及强经典基线在性能上持平（无统计显著差异）；QRNG的价值仅在保障型场景（相关重启故障、命名空间复用、熵来源溯源性）中显现。
AI.conclusion: 本研究定位为基于仿真的验证框架而非设备级QRNG演示，下一步实验方向为引入记录或实时QRNG数据流的硬件在环验证。

title: Morphology and actuation as inductive biases in robotic hand manipulation
summary: Robotic hands vary widely in anatomical fidelity and mechanical complexity, and these structural choices influence the coordination of joint motions and the difficulty of controlling the system. A unified framework is presented in which the kinematic and actuation stages are analysed separately and in composition, through the conditioning of the task Jacobian, the actuation matrix, and their product. It is applied to two hands representing opposing design philosophies, the Shadow Dexterous Hand and the Anatomically Correct, Biomechatronic Hand, along four morphological aspects: joint axis geometry, actuator-to-DOF ratio, coupling architecture, and authority distribution. All parameters are derived from the hands' canonical digital representations. Anatomical fidelity carries no uniform advantage: oblique axes improve thumb conditioning but leave the long fingers worse conditioned than the orthogonal-axis design, while the branching tendon network improves the effective control mapping at every long finger and worsens it significantly at the thumb, where actuator authority is concentrated on thumb opposition. Predictions derived from these metrics are evaluated against reinforcement learning experiments using PPO, DDPG+HER, and TQC+HER, across three different tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，用于分析机器人手的运动学与驱动系统在形态学上的差异如何影响控制难度。该框架通过任务雅可比矩阵、驱动矩阵及其组合的条件数来分别评估两种设计哲学——Shadow Dexterous Hand（正交轴设计）与ACBH手（解剖学精确设计）。结果表明解剖学保真度并不带来统一优势：斜轴改进了拇指但恶化了长指；分支肌腱网络改善了长指的控制映射但对拇指不利。指标预测与三个任务的强化学习实验结果得到验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人手在解剖保真度和机械复杂度上差异巨大，这些结构选择直接影响关节运动协调性和系统控制的难度。然而此前缺乏一个统一的量化框架来评估不同形态学设计（如关节轴几何、驱动-自由度比率、耦合架构和执行力分布）对控制性能的影响，因此作者提出该框架来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将机器人手的分析分为运动学阶段和驱动阶段并分别及组合地评估，具体通过任务雅可比矩阵、驱动矩阵以及两者乘积的条件数来量化控制条件。该框架应用于Shadow Dexterous Hand和Anatomically Correct Biomechatronic Hand两只手，沿四个形态学维度分析：关节轴几何、驱动器与自由度比率、耦合架构和执行力分布。所有参数均从手的标准数字模型中导出，并将指标预测与PPO、DDPG+HER和TQC+HER三种强化学习算法在三个任务上的实验进行对比验证。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）解剖保真度并无统一优势——斜轴设计（ACBH）改善了拇指的条件化但使长指比正交轴设计（Shadow手）更差；2）分支肌腱网络的耦合架构改善了每个长指的有效控制映射，但在拇指处显著恶化，因为驱动器权限集中在拇指对掌动作上。3）衍生指标对控制性能的预测与PPO、DDPG+HER和TQC+HER在三个任务上的强化学习实验结果相符。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明形态学设计对机器人手控制性能的影响是复杂且多维的，不存在某一种设计哲学在所有方面都占优。所提出的基于条件数的统一分析框架能够有效预测不同手部结构在实际学习控制任务中的表现，为机器人手的设计评估提供了理论工具。

title: Retinal OCTA Phenotyping with LLM Reporting for Alzheimer's Disease
comment: 4th IEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, and Internet of Things, (AIBThings)
summary: Early identification of Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains challenging because established assessment methods can be costly, resource-intensive, or unsuitable for population-scale screening. Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) provides non-invasive visualization of retinal microvasculature, but existing approaches often require diagnostic labels and provide limited measurement-level interpretation. We present an explainable OCTA pipeline that integrates annotation-aware vessel segmentation, layer-specific vascular biomarker extraction, label-free phenotyping, and measurement-grounded LLM reporting. Using 117 ROSE-1 images from 39 subjects, we apply annotation-matched segmentation models to superficial vascular complex (SVC), deep vascular complex (DVC), and combined SVC+DVC representations. The models achieve ROC-AUC values of 0.916-0.970 and Dice scores of 0.695-0.781. Six density and fractal-dimension biomarkers form subject-level profiles for exploratory clustering. Analysis of nine held-out subjects identifies an internally consistent lower-density, lower-fractal-dimension phenotype, although the absence of diagnostic labels prevents clinical interpretation. Reports generated using GPT, Gemini, and Llama are evaluated for measurement grounding, citation faithfulness, and diagnostic caution. Overall, the framework provides a transparent, non-diagnostic connection between retinal vascular measurements, exploratory phenotyping, and evidence-linked interpretation for Alzheimer's research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释的OCTA（光学相干断层扫描血管成像）流水线，用于阿尔茨海默病研究。该流水线集成了注释感知的血管分割、层特异性血管生物标志物提取、无标签表型分析以及基于测量数据的大语言模型（LLM）报告生成。基于117张ROSE-1图像（39名受试者）的验证显示，分割模型达到0.916-0.970的ROC-AUC和0.695-0.781的Dice分数，并在9名留出受试者中识别出内部一致的低密度、低分形维数表型，但缺乏诊断标签限制了临床解读。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）的早期识别仍具挑战，现有评估方法昂贵、资源密集或不适合大规模筛查。OCTA虽能无创显示视网膜微血管，但现有方法往往依赖诊断标签且缺乏测量层面的可解释性，亟需一种无需标签且可解释的OCTA分析流水线。
AI.method: 该方法构建了四阶段可解释流水线：(1) 使用注释匹配的分割模型处理浅表血管复合体（SVC）、深层血管复合体（DVC）及SVC+DVC组合；(2) 提取六项密度和分形维数生物标志物；(3) 基于受试者级指标进行无标签探索性聚类；(4) 利用GPT、Gemini和Llama生成测量级落地、引用忠实且具有诊断谨慎性的LLM报告，并加以评估。
AI.result: 分割模型在117张ROSE-1图像（39名受试者）上达到ROC-AUC 0.916-0.970、Dice分数0.695-0.781。基于六项生物标志物的分析在9名留出受试者中识别出内部一致的低密度、低分形维数表型，但因缺少诊断标签无法进行临床解读。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在视网膜血管测量、探索性表型分析及证据关联的解释之间提供了透明且非诊断性的连接，为阿尔茨海默病研究提供了无需诊断标签的大规模筛查潜力和测量层面的可解释性。

title: An Energy-Based Conservative-Dissipative Latent Neural Evolution Operator for Magnetization Dynamics
summary: We develop an energy-based reduced-order model for micromagnetic magnetization dynamics that couples a convolutional autoencoder to a structured latent neural ordinary differential equation. Motivated by the precessional-dissipative structure of the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, the latent vector field is generated from the gradient of a learned scalar potential through an antisymmetric operator and a symmetric positive-semidefinite dissipative operator. This potential is learned in nonunique latent coordinates and is not identified with the Gibbs free energy, but decreases monotonically along autonomous continuous-time solutions, while the antisymmetric component permits motion along its level sets. The encoder, decoder, latent energy, and operators are trained jointly on short trajectory windows using latent and decoded-rollout losses alone, without time-derivative supervision, physical-energy labels, or dissipation penalties. At inference, an initial state is encoded once, evolved in latent space, and decoded only at the requested output times, enabling substantially cheaper trajectory prediction than the micromagnetic solver used to generate the training data. We compare quadratic, deep, and additive deep-quadratic latent energies on two datasets parameterized by field amplitude and generated for the two applied-field directions of the NIST $μ$MAG Standard Problem 4. Dissipative-only and antisymmetric-dissipative models achieve comparable accuracy on short training-style windows but differ substantially on uninterrupted rollouts, for which the antisymmetric-dissipative models provide markedly more accurate trajectory predictions. The deep-quadratic energy gives the best overall accuracy for both field directions and exhibits slower error growth when rollouts are extended to twice the training horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于能量的磁化动力学降阶模型，将卷积自编码器与结构化潜在神经常微分方程相结合，利用Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程的进动-耗散结构，通过反对称算子和对称半正定耗散算子从学习到的标量势的梯度生成潜在向量场。在推断时仅需对初始状态编码一次并在潜在空间演化，解码仅在请求的输出时刻进行，大幅降低了轨迹预测的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 传统微磁求解器求解Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程计算代价高昂，难以支持长时间尺度的磁化动力学轨迹预测。现有基于数据驱动的降阶模型往往忽略了LLG方程固有的进动-耗散几何结构，导致预测精度和物理一致性不足。作者希望构建一个既保留物理结构又具备高效推断能力的降阶模型。
AI.method: 模型由三部分组成：1) 卷积自编码器将高维磁化状态映射到潜在坐标；2) 潜在向量场由学习到的标量势通过反对称算子（进动）和对称半正定耗散算子（耗散）生成，从而耦合潜在神经ODE；3) 编码器、解码器、潜在能量和算子联合训练，仅使用潜在和重建回滚损失，无需时间导数监督、物理能量标签或耗散惩罚。作者比较了二次、深度和加法深度-二次三种潜在能量形式，在NIST μMAG标准问题4的两个外场方向数据集上进行了验证。
AI.result: 在短训练风格窗口内，仅耗散模型与反对称-耗散模型精度相当，但在连续的长时间回滚中，反对称-耗散模型轨迹预测精度显著更高。深度-二次能量形式在两个外场方向上都取得最佳整体精度，且当回滚扩展到训练时域两倍时表现出更慢的误差增长。
AI.conclusion: 结合学习势的进动-耗散结构与能量基元学习的降阶模型能够有效捕捉微磁动力学的长期演化行为。反对称（进动）分量对超出训练窗口的轨迹预测至关重要。深度-二次潜在能量提供了精度和泛化能力的最佳平衡，为高效可靠的微磁模拟提供了一种可行的替代方案。

title: A Calibrated Reflection Approach for Enhancing Confidence Estimation in LLMs
summary: A critical challenge in deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) is developing reliable mechanisms to estimate their confidence, enabling systems to determine when to trust model outputs versus seek human intervention. We present a Calibrated Reflection approach for enhancing confidence estimation in LLMs, a framework that combines structured reasoning with distance-aware calibration technique. Our approach introduces three key innovations: (1) a Maximum Confidence Selection (MCS) method that comprehensively evaluates confidence across all possible labels, (2) a reflection-based prompting mechanism that enhances reasoning reliability, and (3) a distance-aware calibration technique that accounts for ordinal relationships between labels. We evaluate our framework on diverse datasets, including HelpSteer2, Llama T-REx, and a proprietary conversational dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness across both conversational and fact-based classification tasks. This work contributes to the broader goal of developing reliable and well-calibrated confidence estimation methods for LLMs, enabling informed decisions about model trust and human judgement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"校准反思"（Calibrated Reflection）框架，用于增强大语言模型（LLM）的置信度估计能力，通过最大置信度选择（MCS）、基于反思的提示机制和距离感知校准技术三个创新点，在多个对话和事实分类数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 部署LLM的关键挑战在于开发可靠的置信度估计机制，使系统能够判断何时信任模型输出、何时需要人工干预。现有方法在置信度估计的准确性和校准性上存在不足，需要考虑标签间的序关系以及推理过程的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出Calibrated Reflection框架，包含三个关键创新：(1) 最大置信度选择（MCS）方法，全面评估所有可能标签上的置信度；(2) 基于反思的提示机制，增强推理可靠性；(3) 距离感知校准技术，考虑标签之间的序数关系。在HelpSteer2、Llama T-REx及专有对话数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 该方法在对话型任务和基于事实的分类任务中均展现出有效性，验证了框架在不同数据类型上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLM的可靠且校准良好的置信度估计方法做出了贡献，使系统能够在模型信任与人工判断之间做出更明智的决策。

title: Reducing Hallucinated Transcripts in Whisper via Hallucination Space Projection
summary:
Whisper is a widely used foundation model for automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its generative decoder can produce fluent hallucinated transcripts for inputs containing little or no speech. We propose a training-free, inference-time method to reduce these hallucinations using low-rank projection of decoder activations. A compact hallucination-associated subspace is estimated from non-speech calibration data, and decoder hidden states are projected away from this subspace during inference.
  We evaluate two variants: always-on, which applies projection to all inputs, and gated, which applies it only when Whisper predicts that an input is likely non-speech. Across non-speech benchmarks, always-on projection reduces average hallucination rate (HR) from 31.31% to 2.44%, a 92.21% relative reduction, while gated projection reduces HR to 3.74%, an 88.05% relative reduction, with lower false rejection of genuine speech. On LibriSpeech, gated projection increases absolute word error rate (WER) by 0.33-4.39 percentage points and yields false-rejection rates (FRR) of 0.41--9.97% across model and split settings.
  These results show that low-rank activation projection can substantially suppress Whisper hallucinations without retraining, while providing a controllable trade-off between hallucination suppression and speech recognition performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的推理时方法来减少Whisper的幻觉转录问题，通过对解码器激活进行低秩投影，将隐藏状态从估计的幻觉相关子空间中投影出来。在非语音基准上，常开投影将平均幻觉率从31.31%降至2.44%（相对降低92.21%），门控投影降至3.74%（相对降低88.05%），同时对真实语音的误拒绝更低。
AI.motivation: Whisper作为广泛使用的ASR基础模型，其生成式解码器在输入中语音很少或没有语音时会产生流畅但完全是幻觉的转录，严重影响模型可靠性和实用性。需要一种无需重新训练即可有效抑制幻觉的方法。
AI.method: 提出两种低秩激活投影变体：（1）使用非语音校准数据估计一个紧凑的幻觉相关子空间，在推理时将解码器隐藏状态投影远离该子空间；（2）always-on变体对所有输入应用投影，gated变体仅在Whisper预测输入可能为非语音时应用投影。
AI.result: 非语音基准上，always-on投影将平均幻觉率从31.31%降至2.44%（相对降低92.21%），gated投影降至3.74%（相对降低88.05%）。在LibriSpeech上，gated投影的绝对WER增加0.33-4.39个百分点，FRR为0.41%-9.97%。
AI.conclusion: 低秩激活投影无需重训练即可大幅抑制Whisper幻觉，同时在幻觉抑制与语音识别性能之间提供了可控制的权衡。

title: TIER: Threat Implicitness Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Safety Behaviors
summary: Current LLM safety benchmarks largely rely on binary metrics, overlooking how models respond to harmful prompts with varying threat implicitness. We introduce TIER, a Threat Implicitness Benchmark for behavioral safety evaluation of LLMs. TIER covers four risk domains and four threat levels, from explicit harmful requests to sophisticated jailbreaks. Responses are assessed using a six-label behavior scale and two independent LLM judges. Experiments on six open-weight LLMs show that safety behaviors evolve gradually across threat levels rather than shifting directly from refusal to compliance. Contextual prompts yield the most diverse behaviors, while jailbreaks reveal the largest robustness gaps. Furthermore, models with similar Attack Success Rates can exhibit distinct response distributions, highlighting the need for behavior-aware LLM safety evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIER（Threat Implicitness Benchmark），一个面向LLM行为安全评估的威胁隐含度基准。TIER覆盖四个风险域和四个威胁层级（从显式有害请求到复杂越狱），采用六标签行为量表和两个独立LLM裁判进行评估。在六个开源LLM上的实验表明：模型安全行为随威胁层级逐步演变而非直接跳变；上下文提示词引发最多样化的行为；越狱揭示最大的鲁棒性差距；具有相似攻击成功率的模型可能呈现截然不同的响应分布，凸显了行为感知式安全评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全基准大多依赖二元指标（如是否拒绝），忽略了模型在面对不同威胁隐含度的有害提示词时的行为差异，无法细粒度刻画模型的安全响应模式。
AI.method: 构建TIER基准，包含四个风险域和四个威胁层级（从显式有害请求到复杂越狱）；采用六标签行为量表对模型响应进行分类；使用两个独立的LLM裁判进行自动评估；在六个开源LLM上开展系统实验。
AI.result: 安全行为随威胁层级渐进演变而非从拒绝直接跳变为遵从；上下文提示词产生最多样化的行为分布；越狱提示词揭示最大的鲁棒性差距；攻击成功率相近的模型可能具有截然不同的行为分布。
AI.conclusion: 二元安全指标不足以刻画LLM的安全行为，安全评估需要从"是否被攻破"转向"如何响应"的行为感知视角，以更全面地理解模型在不同威胁情境下的安全表现。

title: One Word, Different Action: A Real-Robot Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Embodied Reasoning
summary: Natural-language instruction changes can directly alter robot behavior. A reliable embodied system should preserve its action when the task is unchanged and update it correctly when the task itself changes. We introduce One Word, Different Action, a real-robot benchmark built on physical decision states and executable actions, using task-preserving and task-changing instruction pairs to jointly evaluate Decision Invariance and Decision Sensitivity, with further evaluation under multi-constraint reasoning and real-RGB grounding. Experiments show that modern models are near saturation on single-constraint instruction changes, yet several models degrade noticeably when multiple task constraints must be integrated into one executable decision. These results suggest that the more salient remaining challenge is no longer recognizing an isolated instruction change, but reliably composing multiple task requirements into a correct robot action decision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"One Word, Different Action"真实机器人基准，通过任务保持和任务变化的指令对，联合评估决策不变性与决策敏感性，并进一步在多重约束推理和真实RGB感知条件下评测。结果显示现代模型在单约束指令变化上接近饱和，但在整合多任务约束到单一可执行决策时性能明显下降。
AI.motivation: 自然语言指令变化能直接改变机器人行为，但可靠的具身系统应能在任务不变时保持动作、在任务变化时正确更新动作。现有的评测往往忽略了同时检验决策不变性与决策敏感性这两个维度，也缺乏对多约束推理场景的评估。
AI.method: 构建基于物理决策状态和可执行动作的真实机器人基准，设计任务保持型（Decision Invariance）与任务变化型（Decision Sensitivity）的指令对，并以多约束推理和真实RGB感知为额外评测维度来系统评估模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，现代模型在单约束指令变化的决策不变性与敏感性上已接近饱和，但在需要将多个任务约束整合为一个可执行决策的场景中，多个模型出现显著性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 更突出的剩余挑战不再是识别孤立的指令变化，而是可靠地将多个任务要求组合成正确的机器人动作决策，这为具身多模态智能体的下一步研究指明了方向。

title: Enhancing Multimodal Emotion Recognition via Multi-Feature Encoding and Attention-Based Fusion
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Pre-peer-review version. The final published version appears in ICONIP 2025, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16312, pp. 142-157 (2026)
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition has attracted growing interest due to its importance in human-computer interaction, remote education, and healthcare. This paper proposes a novel multimodal emotion recognition framework that integrates rich audio and visual feature extraction with an attention-based fusion strategy. For audio, we extract three complementary feature types: semantic embeddings from Wav2Vec2, MFCC features, and statistical acoustic descriptors such as pitch, energy, and rhythm. These are aligned and fused via a BiLSTM to capture temporal dependencies. For video, we propose a ResNet50-BiLSTM architecture that combines deep residual learning and sequential modeling to extract expressive spatiotemporal features from facial sequences. To enhance multimodal synergy, we introduce a feature-level fusion mechanism based on multi-head attention, allowing the model to adaptively weigh contributions across modalities. Experiments conducted on the MELD and IEMOCAP datasets demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms baselines in both accuracy and robustness. Furthermore, ablation studies show that the attention-based fusion strategy significantly improves performance in unbalanced data settings. Our findings suggest that the proposed framework effectively captures diverse emotional cues from speech and visual expressions, and offers a practical and generalizable approach for real-world multimodal emotion recognition tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于注意力融合策略的多模态情感识别框架，融合音频（Wav2Vec2语义嵌入、MFCC、韵律声学特征经BiLSTM）与视频（ResNet50-BiLSTM提取时空特征）的多层次特征，通过多头注意力机制实现特征级融合，在MELD和IEMOCAP数据集上显著优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别在人机交互、远程教育和医疗健康等领域具有重要意义，但如何有效整合异构的音频和视觉信息、自适应地平衡各模态的贡献仍是一个挑战。
AI.method: 音频分支提取三类互补特征（Wav2Vec2语义嵌入、MFCC、韵律统计声学描述符），经BiLSTM捕获时序依赖；视频分支采用ResNet50-BiLSTM架构结合深度残差学习与序列建模提取面部序列的时空特征；最后通过基于多头注意力的特征级融合机制自适应加权跨模态贡献。
AI.result: 在MELD和IEMOCAP数据集上的实验表明模型在准确率和鲁棒性方面显著优于基线；消融实验显示注意力融合策略在非平衡数据设置下能显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能有效捕捉语音和视觉表情中的多样化情感线索，为真实世界多模态情感识别任务提供了实用且可泛化的方案。

title: Distilled Continuous Diffusion Language Models Can Write Code in Few Steps---or One
summary: Language generation is almost universally treated as a sequential process: autoregressive models emit one token at a time, while diffusion language models replace token-level seriality with a long trajectory of iterative refinement. In this work, we introduce PlaidQ, a 0.7B continuous diffusion language model for code generation, and show that its trajectory can be aggressively distilled into only a few denoising steps---or even one, enabling efficient code generation. PlaidQ repurposes a pretrained autoregressive model as a bidirectional denoiser over continuous token embeddings. We distill PlaidQ with distribution matching for few-step generation and paired-trajectory supervision for one-step generation. At matched model scale, PlaidQ is competitive with discrete diffusion language models on code generation. Distillation then shifts the quality--compute frontier: a 16-step student reaches 31.78 and 40.49 pass@10 on HumanEval and MBPP+, surpassing the same PlaidQ teacher sampled for 512 steps. At the extreme, paired-trajectory distillation achieves 7.07 pass@1 on HumanEval with a single denoising step, producing functionally correct programs. Together, these results establish continuous diffusion as a viable path to few-step and one-step code generation. Broadly, continuous diffusion is not merely another representation for language: it provides an interface through which language models can inherit the acceleration and distillation machinery of continuous diffusion modeling. Training and inference code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/pengzhangzhi/plaidq.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PlaidQ，一个0.7B参数的连续扩散语言模型用于代码生成，通过蒸馏将去噪轨迹压缩到极少数甚至单步，同时保持与离散扩散模型相当的竞争力，并在质量-计算前沿上取得优势。
AI.motivation: 语言生成通常被顺序建模（自回归逐词生成），而扩散语言模型用长迭代细化取代了词级串行性，但计算成本高昂。本文旨在探索连续扩散模型能否通过蒸馏实现少步乃至单步高效代码生成，并验证连续扩散作为语言建模的一种可行且高效的替代路径。
AI.method: PlaidQ将预训练的自回归模型重新用作连续词嵌入上的双向去噪器。蒸馏采用两种策略：分布匹配用于少步生成，配对轨迹监督用于单步生成。模型规模为0.7B参数，属于连续扩散语言模型。
AI.result: 在相同模型规模下，PlaidQ与离散扩散语言模型在代码生成任务上具有竞争力。蒸馏后，16步学生模型在HumanEval和MBPP+上分别达到31.78和40.49的pass@10，超过512步采样的教师模型。配对轨迹蒸馏在单步去噪下于HumanEval上达到7.07的pass@1，能生成功能正确的程序。
AI.conclusion: 连续扩散为少步和单步代码生成提供了可行的路径；它不仅是语言的另一种表示形式，更提供了一个接口，使语言模型能够继承连续扩散建模的加速与蒸馏机制。

title: Rhythms of Work: Multi-Scale Interpretation of Human Behavioral Traces for Workplace Agents
summary: Runtime traces are becoming a central substrate for understanding agentic systems, yet interpretation has focused largely on what the agent did. Workplace agents face the complementary problem: interpreting the human activity that surrounds them. Hours of low-level events carry rich evidence about a user's state but are too granular to reason over directly, and flattening them into one stream or compressing them into a single embedding both treat "summarize the user's behavior" as if it had one correct answer. We argue instead that behavioral interpretation is resolution-dependent: the same trace should admit multiple addressable interpretations at different temporal resolutions. We construct a multi-resolution vocabulary of semantically normalized operators, recurring motifs, coherent episodes, and day-level rhythms, each preserving the structure salient at its own horizon. Applied to 667 million human-attributed events from a large commercial productivity suite (50,000 users, 100 organizations), it yields 120 operator types, thousands of motifs, 25 episode types, and five day-rhythm archetypes. We validate it on real telemetry: re-running the entire pipeline on a disjoint 2,000-user sample recovers the same taxonomy (structural stability), and on held-out users the full representation forecasts a user's next episode more accurately than a flat-operator baseline, a 17% relative macro-F1 gain (predictive validity), so the abstractions preserve future-relevant information rather than merely describe it. A controlled resolution ablation then shows that no single level is optimal across questions: different agent-facing questions about the same trace are best answered at different resolutions. Behavioral trace interpretation for agents should therefore be multi-resolution and query-conditioned: an agent should access the temporal grain a question needs, not one universal summary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行为痕迹（runtime traces）的解释是"分辨率依赖"的：同一用户行为轨迹应在不同时间粒度下（操作符、动机、片段、日节奏）产生多种可寻址的解释，而非单一的扁平化摘要。作者基于667百万条真实用户事件数据构建了一个多分辨率行为词汇表，并验证其结构稳定性与预测有效性，最终主张agent应依据问题查询所对应的时间粒度来获取行为信息。
AI.motivation: 现有工作场所agent系统对运行时痕迹的解释主要关注"agent做了什么"，但忽略了周围的人类行为。人类行为的低层事件数据过于细粒度无法直接推理，而扁平化或单嵌入压缩方式都错误地假设"总结用户行为"只有一个正确答案。实际中，行为解释是分辨率依赖的——同一轨迹在不同时间尺度下应有不同的可寻址解释。
AI.method: 1) 构建多分辨率行为词汇表：语义规范化操作符（operators）、周期性出现的动机（motifs）、连贯片段（episodes）、日级节奏（rhythms），每层保留其时间尺度上的结构。2) 在大规模数据集（50,000用户、100组织、667百万事件）上应用该词汇表，得到120种操作符、数千种动机、25种片段类型和5种日节奏原型。3) 通过结构稳定性检验（在2,000用户独立样本上重跑全流程验证分类一致）和预测有效性检验（在留出用户上预测下一片段，与扁平操作符基线对比17%相对宏F1提升）进行验证。4) 进行分辨率消融实验，证明不同agent问题在不同分辨率下最优。
AI.result: 多分辨率词汇表在真实遥测数据上产生了120种操作符类型、数千种动机、25种片段类型和5种日节奏原型。结构稳定性验证成功（独立样本恢复相同分类），预测有效性上相比扁平基线提升17%相对宏F1。消融实验显示没有单一分辨率对所有问题最优，不同问题适合不同时间粒度。
AI.conclusion: 行为轨迹解释应面向多分辨率且由查询条件驱动：agent应根据具体问题访问所需的时间粒度，而非依赖一个统一的摘要。行为解释需要保存未来相关信息，而非仅是对过去行为的描述。

title: La Agente Óptima: Towards Agentic Self-Driving Laboratories
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) combine automated experimentation with adaptive decision-making to accelerate scientific discovery. Their operation nevertheless often depends on human specialists who translate scientific objectives into executable closed-loop campaigns. Specialists adjust them as data and operating conditions change. Here, we present La Agente Óptima, an agentic framework that constructs and supervises Bayesian optimization campaigns across computational and experimental systems while maintaining a persistent optimization state. By separating large language model (LLM) reasoning from executed campaigns, Óptima runs repetitive optimization loops consistently, returns control to the agent only when progress requires interpretation or campaign revision, and keeps every decision auditable. We evaluate Óptima across ablation studies, five digital discovery tasks, and two physical platforms. Throughout, Óptima maintained executable campaigns as both the scientific problem and execution environment evolved. In a closed-loop contact angle optimization campaign, Óptima identified and corrected a mid-run measurement failure, bringing the contact angle from 71.4 to 67.8 degrees, just above the 64-66 degree range. From this result, Óptima correctly inferred that the target was likely unattainable with the available reagents and recommended changing the formulation. In a five-day multi-objective flow-chemistry campaign, Óptima increased the yield from 30% to 59% over 23 experiments. Despite substantial inference costs, it cost less and used substantially less starting material than a human-directed campaign, while selecting a more mass-efficient operating point. These results show that LLM-based agents can make rigorous, long-running optimization campaigns accessible to domain scientists without specialist setup, expanding the scope of SDLs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出La Agente Óptima，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，用于在自动化实验室（SDLs）中构建和监督贝叶斯优化实验闭环。该框架将LLM推理与已执行的优化循环分离，仅在需要解释或修改实验方案时才回归智能体控制，并保持持久化优化状态以确保可审计性。在五个数字发现任务和两个物理平台上评估后，Óptima在接触角优化实验中识别并纠正了测量故障，在五天流动化学多目标优化中将产率从30%提升至59%，且比人类主导的实验成本更低、更节约起始材料。
AI.motivation: 自动化实验室虽能加速科学发现，但其运行高度依赖人类专家将科学目标转化为可执行的闭环实验流程，并在数据变化时不断调整。这种人工依赖构成了SDLs扩展应用的瓶颈，因此需要一种框架能够让领域科学家无需专业设置即可运行严谨的长期优化实验。
AI.method: Óptima框架的核心设计是将LLM推理与已执行的贝叶斯优化循环分离：智能体负责构建优化方案、设定目标函数与搜索空间，而重复性的优化迭代由程序化循环独立运行，保持持久化优化状态；仅在进度要求解释或实验方案需要修订时，控制权才交还给LLM智能体。这种架构确保循环运行的一致性，同时保持每一步决策的可审计性。
AI.result: 在闭环接触角优化中，Óptima识别并纠正了运行中期的测量故障，将接触角从71.4度优化至67.8度，并正确推断出目标64-66度范围在当前试剂条件下无法实现，建议更换配方。在五天23次实验的多目标流动化学优化中，Óptima将产率从30%提升至59%，成本低于人类主导实验且显著节省起始材料，并选择了质量效率更高的操作点。评估涵盖消融研究、五个数字发现任务和两个物理平台。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明LLM驱动的智能体能够使严谨的长周期优化实验对领域科学家开放，无需专业设置即可操作，从而扩大了自动化实验室的应用范围。

title: Understanding the Privacy-Preserving Potential of HTTP/2 Against Webpage Fingerprinting
summary:
Website fingerprinting (WF) attacks can infer which webpage a user visits from encrypted HTTPS traffic alone, compromising privacy even without decryption. WF defenses commonly shape traffic through noise, padding, delays, or flow splitting, yet they are most often studied from the perspective of encapsulating protocols like Tor or VPN rather than at the application layer (HTTP).
  In this work, we focus on application-layer defenses enabled by the most widely deployed version of HTTP, HTTP/2. We demonstrate how known defenses can be emulated through HTTP/2 features at the client side (HTTPOS, LLaMA, FRONT, Tamaraw) and the server side (ALPaCA, Tamaraw). We further show that HTTP/2 features, such as proactive resource suggestion, multiplexing, and flow control, offer untapped potential for lightweight yet effective defenses deployable at both endpoints.
  We evaluate these defenses using a unified blueprint that calibrates defense parameters per dataset, then combines practical attacks, information-theoretic leakage estimates, and overhead measurements. For each defense, this framework identifies the strongest hyperparameter-tuned fingerprinting model and estimates the residual uncertainty induced by the defense using two information-theoretic leakage estimators, all while accounting for the defense's privacy-overhead trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究应用层（HTTP/2）的网站指纹防御，将已知防御（HTTPOS、LLaMA、FRONT、Tamaraw、ALPaCA）通过HTTP/2特性在客户端和服务器端进行仿真实现，并利用多路复用、流控等特性提出轻量级防御方案，通过统一评估框架（含信息论泄漏估计）进行系统评测。
AI.motivation: 现有WF防御大多在封装协议层（Tor、VPN）研究，而非应用层（HTTP）。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索利用最广泛部署的HTTP/2协议特性在应用层实现有效且轻量的WF防御。
AI.method: 1) 将已知WF防御（HTTPOS、LLaMA、FRONT、Tamaraw）在客户端通过HTTP/2特性仿真实现，将ALPaCa和Tamaraw在服务器端实现；2) 利用HTTP/2的主动资源推送、多路复用和流控等特性设计新防御；3) 使用统一评估蓝图：按数据集校准防御参数，结合实用攻击（超参数调优的最强指纹模型）、两种信息论泄漏估计器和开销测量，全面评估各防御的隐私-开销权衡。
AI.result: 通过统一评估框架识别了每种防御对应的最强超参数调优指纹攻击模型，并使用两种信息论泄漏估计器量化了防御引入的残余不确定性，同时分析了防御的隐私-开销权衡。证明了HTTP/2特性（如资源推送、多路复用、流控）具备在两端部署轻量级有效WF防御的未开发潜力。
AI.conclusion: 应用层（HTTP/2级别）的WF防御是可行且有前途的方向；HTTP/2原生特性能使双方端点实现轻量级有效防御；所提出的统一评估蓝图能在动态的隐私-开销权衡中系统性地评估防御效果而非仅依赖单一攻击或指标。

title: TacPAC: Tactile Prediction and Real-Time Action Correction in World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: World-action models guide action generation with predicted future observations, but vision-centric predictions miss the local contact cues that decide contact-rich manipulation. However, naively predicting future tactile observations as additional views recovers only a third of the achievable gain in our experiments. This gap reflects a timing mismatch: predictions precede execution, while tactile feedback arrives during it. We introduce TacPAC, which turns tactile prediction into real-time action correction. Once the base model has planned an action chunk, TacPAC caches the predicted contact that plan was conditioned on together with the plan's own representation, and a tactile expert reads each newly observed tactile image against that cache to correct the actions not yet executed. Feedback is thus interpreted against what the plan anticipated rather than in isolation, and one correction is a single pass over that cache, $20.7\times$ cheaper than regenerating the chunk. On five real-robot tasks spanning precision insertion, fragile-object handling, object reorientation, and long-horizon manipulation, TacPAC leads every task and raises the average from 22% for its vision-only base model to 64%. Code is available at https://github.com/LogosRoboticsGroup/TacPAC.

AI.tldr: TacPAC提出了一种将触觉预测转化为实时动作修正的方法，通过缓存计划预期的接触信息与计划表示，由触觉专家将实时触觉图像与该缓存比对，以修正尚未执行的动作。在五个真实机器人任务上，TacPAC将视觉基线的平均成功率从22%提升到64%，且单次修正比重新生成动作块便宜20.7倍。
AI.motivation: 视觉中心的世界-动作模型预测未来观测时缺少局部接触线索，这对接触丰富的操作至关重要。然而简单地将未来触觉观测作为额外视图纳入预测，只能恢复三分之一的可实现增益，因为预测先于执行发生而触觉反馈在执行中才到达，存在时间错配。
AI.method: TacPAC由两阶段构成：(1) 基线世界-动作模型规划出一个动作块后，TacPAC缓存该计划所依赖的预测接触信息及其对应的计划表示；(2) 一个触觉专家模块读取每个新到达的触觉图像，将其与该缓存进行比对，修正尚未执行的动作。触觉反馈不是孤立解读，而是相对计划预期的接触状态进行解读。单次修正只需对缓存做一次pass，计算成本比重新生成整个动作块便宜20.7倍。
AI.result: 在五个真实机器人任务（精密插拔、易碎物处理、物体重定向、长时程操作）上，TacPAC在所有任务上均取得最佳表现，将仅视觉基线的平均成功率从22%提升至64%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: TacPAC证明了将触觉预测从"预先规划"转向"执行中修正"是有效的范式：通过将实时触觉反馈与计划预期的接触状态对齐比较，可以高效且低成本地将触觉信息注入接触丰富的操作，显著优于在生成阶段直接加入触觉视图的做法。

title: LookThere! Sparse Vision by Reinforced Selection
summary: Vision transformers typically treat every image token as equally important, yet for most tasks in computer vision only a fraction are needed. Adaptive computation methods accelerate inference by choosing which tokens to process, but existing methods struggle at extreme sparsity and require heuristics that may not generalize like token diversity and attention scores. We address these limitations with LookThere, achieving a new pareto frontier in performance-compute trade-offs through an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that jointly trains a shallow input selector and a deep representation extractor. The selector learns where to look and the extractor learns what to see, together saving computation by selecting only what is worth processing for a given task without relying on auxiliary signals. We show that LookThere only selects the task-specific input, excelling at sparse recognition in high-resolution settings (traffic signs, billiards), and maintaining accuracy with as little as 0.2% of the input. It generalizes across tasks and models, including global recognition (ImageNet classification), local recognition (ADE20K segmentation), zero-shot classification (by distillation), and regression (counting). Across all settings, LookThere surpasses state-of-the-art selection to provide a general and scalable framework for specialized and efficient adaptive computation.

AI.tldr: LookThere通过端到端强化学习框架联合训练浅层输入选择器和深层特征提取器，实现视觉Transformer中自适应稀疏输入选择，在性能-计算权衡上达到新的帕累托前沿，仅需0.2%的输入即可保持准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉Transformer通常将所有图像token一视同仁地处理，但大多数视觉任务实际上只需要其中一小部分token。现有的自适应计算方法在极端稀疏场景下表现不佳，且依赖token多样性和注意力分数等启发式方法，这些方法可能无法良好泛化。
AI.method: LookThere通过端到端强化学习框架联合训练两个组件：一个浅层输入选择器（学习"看哪里"）和一个深层特征提取器（学习"看什么"）。该方法不依赖任何辅助信号，由选择器仅选择对当前任务有价值的输入部分进行处理，从而节省计算量。
AI.result: LookThere在稀疏识别场景（如交通标志、台球等高分辨率设置）中表现出色，仅使用0.2%的输入即可保持准确性。该方法在全局识别（ImageNet分类）、局部识别（ADE20K分割）、零样本分类（通过蒸馏）和回归（计数）等多种任务和模型中均超越现有最先进的选取方法。
AI.conclusion: LookThere提供了一种通用且可扩展的自适应计算框架，在不依赖启发式辅助信号的条件下，通过任务驱动的输入选择实现高效推理，在性能与计算量的权衡上取得了优于现有方法的结果。

title: Mitra-v2 Technical Report
comment: 38 pages. Model weights, inference and fine-tuning code, and evaluation results: https://huggingface.co/autogluon/mitra-finetune
summary: We introduce Mitra-v2, a tabular foundation model that delivers state-of-the-art performance on real-world classification and regression problems, from credit-risk scoring and clinical prediction to equipment-failure detection and house-price estimation. Mitra-v2 is trained only on synthetic data, with a pretraining distribution that is much larger and more diverse than Mitra-v1's. Built on a small 2D Transformer backbone, Mitra-v2 supports longer contexts and larger feature spaces. Improved optimization lets it learn from this larger task distribution. We evaluate Mitra-v2 on the TabArena and TALENT benchmarks, comprising more than 300 real-world datasets under two evaluation protocols. On the full TabArena benchmark, Mitra-v2 delivers state-of-the-art performance at the level of the industry-scale TabFM and EXAONE Tabular models, while surpassing TabPFN-3 by a wide margin in both classification and regression. Mitra-v2 matches the 1.6B-parameter TabFM with only 5% of its size (77M parameters), delivering frontier performance at a fraction of the cost. On TALENT, Mitra-v2 remains among the leading models, clearly outperforming TabPFN-3 and TabICLv2. It also ranks first on classification tasks with more than ten classes, even though it was pretrained only on tasks with at most ten classes. These results make Mitra-v2 one of the strongest and most broadly applicable open tabular foundation models released to date. We release the model weights, the inference and fine-tuning code, and our evaluation results under the Apache-2.0 license.

AI.tldr: Mitra-v2是一个仅用合成数据训练的表格基础模型，基于小型2D Transformer骨干，在TabArena和TALENT基准上（300多个真实数据集）达到与行业级模型（TabFM、EXAONE Tabular）相当的最先进性能，以77M参数（仅为TabFM的5%）超越TabPFN-3，并在TALENT十类以上分类任务中排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型如TabFM、TabPFN-3等要么规模过大（如1.6B参数）计算成本高昂，要么在真实世界分类和回归任务上性能不足。作者希望构建一个参数高效、仅用合成数据训练且能广泛应用于信贷风险评估、临床预测、设备故障检测、房价估算等多种真实场景的表格基础模型。
AI.method: Mitra-v2使用比v1更大更多样的合成数据预训练分布；采用小型2D Transformer骨干架构，支持更长上下文和更大特征空间；通过改进的优化策略使模型能从更大的任务分布中有效学习。模型仅77M参数，且仅在最多十类的任务上预训练。
AI.result: 在TabArena完整基准上达到与TabFM和EXAONE Tabular相当的最先进性能，大幅超越TabPFN-3；在TALENT上领先所有模型，优于TabPFN-3和TabICLv2，并在十类以上分类任务中排名第一（尽管未在该类数据上预训练）。以TabFM 5%的参数量（77M vs 1.6B）达到同等性能。
AI.conclusion: Mitra-v2是目前发布的最强且适用范围最广的开源表格基础模型之一，在极低成本下实现前沿性能。模型权重、推理与微调代码及评估结果均以Apache-2.0许可证开源发布。

title: When Do Internal Probes Beat Reading the Answer? Miscalibrated Readouts and Behavior-Concealed Knowledge in Language Models
summary: A 0.6B language model, asked to verify 1,200 logical conclusions (half valid, half corrupted by a single semantic edit), answers YES every time. Judged by behavior it discriminates nothing; linear probes on its hidden states read the correct verdict at 0.96 AUC, transferring to unseen logical structures and separating foils built from exactly the words of the true conclusion (0.90). We ask where the verdict is lost, and find the dominant failure is a single scalar. The verdict survives to the model's own output logits (margin AUC 0.89) along a well-aligned readout direction; a saturated decision threshold, offset by +4.6 sigma, erases it. The diagnosis generalizes: across 90 semantic-label configurations of a five-model, three-family factorial, behavioral accuracy collapses onto a single function of threshold offset (Spearman -0.93) while margin ranking moves far less. Across a 13x scale range, internal knowledge saturates while free-form behavior is non-monotone: an 8B model underperforms its 4B sibling through an answer-channel failure rather than the threshold; forced-choice accuracy is monotone. The diagnosis is actionable: a one-parameter correction, never fit on evaluated structures, repairs behavior from 50% to 81% (0.6B); calibrated margin decoding recovers 94% at 8B; few-shot prompting works the same way, recentering the threshold (+4.6 sigma to 0.0 sigma) while preserving ranking. Comparing probe to margin separates three regimes: concealed, miscalibrated, and undetected. On a maze task built so foils carry no surface cues, the audit correctly reports the third. In the standard generation setting, answer-surface features and heuristic labels reproduce published probing results without any internal access.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型在逻辑结论验证中的"内隐知识-外显行为"解耦现象。一个0.6B模型对1200条逻辑结论（一半有效、一半被语义编辑破坏）全部回答YES，行为上无法区分，但其隐藏状态中线性探针能以0.96 AUC读出正确判断。研究发现主要失败源是一个标量决策阈值偏移（+4.6σ），该发现跨模型跨规模泛化：行为准确率与阈值偏移高度相关（Spearman -0.93），且一参数校正可将0.6B模型行为从50%修复到81%，8B模型上校准margin解码恢复94%准确率。文章还区分了三种失效状态（隐藏、失校准、未检测），并警示标准生成设置下表面特征可复现探针结果而无需内部访问。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常表现出"知道但说不对"的现象——行为上无法区分有效与无效结论，但内部表征可能已编码正确答案。理解这种内隐知识与外显行为之间的裂缝在哪里、为何产生、如何修复，对于模型评估、可解释性和安全部署具有重要意义。已有探测研究大多停留在"探针能读出"的表层发现，本工作深入定位知识丢失的具体机制并提出可操作的修复方案。
AI.method: 采用多层次的诊断方法：（1）在隐藏状态上训练线性探针，验证内部知识的存在性与泛化能力；（2）分析模型输出logits的margin及其方向对齐性，定位决策阈值偏移为关键失败机制；（3）构建90个语义标签配置的五模型三家族因子实验进行系统性检验；（4）跨13倍规模范围（0.6B到8B）比较内部知识与自由生成行为；（5）提出一参数阈值校正和校准margin解码两种修复方法；（6）在迷宫任务上测试审计方法对三种失效状态的判别力；（7）对比标准生成设置与探针设置，检验表面特征的混淆效应。
AI.result: 线性探针在隐藏状态上以0.96 AUC读出正确结论，可迁移到未见逻辑结构（0.90 AUC）。模型自身logits的margin已保留判断信息（AUC 0.89），但被一个+4.6σ饱和的决策阈值抹除。行为准确率与阈值偏移的函数关系高度一致（Spearman -0.93）。规模扩展中，内部知识单调饱和而自由行为非单调——8B在行为上反不如4B。一参数校正将0.6B行为从50%修复至81%；校准margin解码在8B上恢复94%。探针与margin的比较可区分三种失效状态（隐藏、失校准、未检测），迷宫实验正确识别第三种。标准生成场景中，表面特征足以复现探针结果。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型中的"知道但说不出来"现象主要源于解码层的标量阈值失校准而非知识的缺失。这是一个可修复的系统性问题：通过单调的阈值标定或margin解码即可大幅恢复行为表现。该诊断框架（探针vs margin）为区分内隐知识的不同失效模式提供了实用工具，同时警示：在缺乏对生成机制精细控制的标准设置下，探测结果可能被表面特征所混淆，需要审慎解读。

title: Extremely Sparse Supervision Incentivizes Reasoning Ability
summary: Large language models demonstrate increasingly strong reasoning capabilities through effective post-training. Yet, prevailing post-training methods optimize over massive numbers of tokens, implicitly assuming that effective learning must be token-intensive. We revisit this assumption in the on-policy distillation (OPD) setting, which naturally admits dense teacher supervision at every generated token. Using the Qwen3 family, we discover a counter-intuitive phenomenon: reasoning can be effectively incentivized by an extremely small fraction of generated tokens--as few as one or two tokens per reasoning trajectory, corresponding to only 0.05% of all tokens. Surprisingly, this sparse supervision in most cases matches or surpasses full-token training in improving reasoning ability, despite excluding the vast majority of generated tokens from the training objective. This phenomenon is consistently observed across nine teacher--student configurations spanning different model scales on mathematical reasoning tasks, and is further validated on coding reasoning, Llama models and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR). Interestingly, such extremely sparse supervision may be closer to the natural learning process: rather than correcting every step word by word, one reflects on a few critical reasoning steps, updates prior understanding, and continues the trial-and-error, avoiding micro-level corrections while remaining remarkably effective. Overall, our results challenge the assumption that effective post-training must be token-intensive and point to a new direction for understanding and designing more efficient post-training algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在线策略蒸馏（OPD）场景下，每个推理轨迹仅用1-2个token（约0.05%）进行极稀疏监督，就能匹配甚至超越全token训练提升推理能力，挑战了后训练必须"token密集"的假设。
AI.motivation: 主流后训练方法依赖海量token进行优化，隐含假设有效学习必须是token密集型的。作者希望重新审视这一假设，探究在teacher监督信息丰富的情况下是否真的需要如此多的训练信号。
AI.method: 在在线策略蒸馏（OPD）设置下，基于Qwen3系列模型展开实验。通过只保留每个推理轨迹中极少量的关键token（少至1-2个）作为训练监督目标，排除绝大多数生成的token，与全token训练进行对比。实验覆盖Qwen3和Llama模型、多个teacher-student规模配置、数学推理和代码推理任务，并扩展到PPO-based RLVR场景。
AI.result: 9种teacher-student配置下均一致观察到该现象：极稀疏监督（0.05%的token）在多数情况下匹配或超越全token训练在推理能力上的提升。此结论在Llama模型、代码推理任务及PPO-based RLVR中均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 有效后训练并非必须token密集型，极稀疏监督更接近自然学习过程（反思关键步骤而非逐词纠正），为设计更高效的后训练算法提供了新方向。

title: Conformal Prediction for Offensive Security
summary: Despite its introduction more than a quarter century ago, Conformal Prediction (CP) has seen surprisingly few applications to the cyber security world thus far. In particular, we observe that, while CP has been employed as a defensive measure in many recent works, its use for carrying out attacks (i.e., for offensive security) is hard to trace in the literature. We explore this gap, by presenting initial findings in two key areas of offensive security: Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning, and network traffic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文指出尽管置信预测（Conformal Prediction, CP）提出已有超过25年，但在网络安全领域应用甚少——尤其是在进攻性安全（offensive security）方面几乎空白。作者探索了这一研究空白，初步研究了CP在隐私保护机器学习和网络流量分析两个关键进攻性安全方向的应用。
AI.motivation: 置信预测（CP）作为一种提供有效不确定性量化的统计框架，已在防御性安全中被广泛采用，但其在进攻性安全（如攻击实施）方面的应用在文献中几乎无法追溯。作者希望通过探索CP在进攻性安全中的潜力来填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 作者识别并分析了CP在进攻性安全领域的两个关键应用方向：一是隐私保护机器学习（Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning），二是网络流量分析（network traffic analysis），并在这些方向上呈现初步研究发现。
AI.result: 本文提供了CP在进攻性安全中的初步探索成果（具体结果需在全文详述），揭示了CP在此领域的应用潜力，并指出当前文献对此方向的关注严重不足。
AI.conclusion: 置信预测虽然在防御性安全中已有广泛应用，但在进攻性安全（如隐私攻击和网络流量分析中的攻击场景）中几乎未被探索。本文的初步研究填补了这一空白，并为CP在进攻性安全中的进一步应用奠定了基础。

title: Temporal Tactile Encoding and Compliance for Intent-Aware Robot-to-Human Bimanual Handover
summary: Reliable robot-to-human handover requires the robot to infer when the person is ready to receive the object, and release it safely, comfortably, and at the right time. This is challenging because visual observations alone may not disambiguate clear taking intent from accidental contact, weak grasping, wrong-direction forces, or transient interactions. In this work we treat human-robot handover as an intrinsically multimodal problem. Our approach couples a VLA model with a compliance controller that reduces interaction forces during object transfer. We finetune the VLA model with human demonstrations using RGB observation, temporally encoded tactile feedback and proprioception. We evaluate the complete system in a human-subject study against two baselines: one without tactile feedback and one using tactile feedback without compliance control. We hypothesize that combining compliance and temporal tactile encoding yields the most reliable and comfortable handovers, as compliance facilitates physical interaction while tactile history captures sustained taking intent. Performance is measured through objective metrics and an ad-hoc questionnaire. The results show that the two components provide complementary benefits and substantially outperform the baselines. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型与柔顺控制器的机器人-人物体交接方法，将交接视为内在多模态问题。方法使用RGB视觉、时间编码触觉反馈和本体感觉微调VLA模型，并耦合柔顺控制器以降低物体传递过程中的交互力。人类受试者研究表明，柔顺控制与时间触觉编码提供互补性收益，显著优于无触觉反馈和无柔顺控制的基线系统。
AI.motivation: 可靠的机器人-人交接要求机器人推断接收者何时准备就绪并安全、舒适、适时地释放物体，但仅凭视觉观测难以区分明确的接收意图与意外接触、弱抓取、错误方向力或瞬时交互，因此需要多模态信息来提升意图判断的可靠性。
AI.method: 将VLA模型与柔顺控制器耦合；使用人类示教数据以RGB观测、时间编码触觉反馈和本体感觉作为输入对VLA模型进行微调；通过人体受试者实验与两个基线（无触觉反馈、有触觉但无柔顺控制）进行对比评估，采用客观指标和问卷度量性能。
AI.result: 柔顺控制与时间触觉编码两个组件提供互补性收益，综合系统在可靠性和舒适度上显著优于两个基线系统。
AI.conclusion: 将柔顺控制与时间触觉编码相结合是实现可靠且舒适的人-机交接的有效方案；柔顺控制促进物理交互，而触觉历史信息能捕捉持续的接收意图，二者互补。

title: AngelFingerprint: A Traceable, Explainable, and White-Box Stealthy Watermark for Text-Guided Image Editing
summary: Text-guided diffusion editing raises disinformation concerns, making reliable image provenance essential. While watermarks are commonly used for this purpose, most methods carry a fixed ID that cannot explain what was changed and which prompt produced it. Furthermore, under open-source white-box access, attackers can easily locate and remove watermarks added as separate modules. Targeting this setting, we propose AngelFingerprint, a novel watermarking framework ensuring edit traceability, explainability, and white-box stealthiness. It integrates a LoRA into the diffusion model to embed the editing prompt's CLIP text embedding directly into the model's weights. An extractor then recovers this embedding from the image pixels alone. This semantic payload explains the edit, while the weight-integrated design makes it hard to detect and isolate even under full white-box access. Two techniques make this possible: a velocity-alignment anchor that preserves edit quality, and a specially designed frequency filter that keeps the watermark imperceptible yet recoverable and robust. On the MagicBrush dataset, our extractor achieves $86\%$ top-1 accuracy in a 200-way prompt retrieval, versus $20\%$ for prompt inversion.

AI.tldr: AngelFingerprint是一种针对文本引导扩散编辑场景的新型水印框架，通过将编辑提示的CLIP文本嵌入直接集成到扩散模型权重（LoRA）中，实现编辑可追溯性、可解释性和白盒隐蔽性，并设计了速度对齐锚点和频率滤波器来保证编辑质量与水印不可感知性。
AI.motivation: 文本引导的扩散编辑技术引发虚假信息传播问题，可靠的图像溯源至关重要。现有水印方法存在两个局限：一是携带固定ID，无法解释编辑内容和触发提示；二是在开源白盒访问下，水印作为独立模块容易被攻击者定位和移除。
AI.method: 核心思路是将LoRA集成到扩散模型中，将编辑提示的CLIP文本嵌入直接写入模型权重，再通过提取器从图像像素中恢复该嵌入从而实现语义负荷的可解释性；权重集成的设计使其即使在完全白盒访问下也难以被检测和隔离。辅助技术包括：速度对齐锚点（velocity-alignment anchor）用于保持编辑质量，以及专门设计的频率滤波器使水印不可感知但可恢复且鲁棒。
AI.result: 在MagicBrush数据集上，提取器在200路提示检索任务中实现86%的top-1准确率，相比之下提示反转（prompt inversion）方法仅为20%。
AI.conclusion: AngelFingerprint通过将语义水印直接嵌入模型权重，在实现编辑可解释性和可追溯性的同时具备白盒隐身能力，为扩散编辑场景中的图像溯源与验证提供了一种更安全、更可靠的解决方案。

title: Fast Surrogate Modeling of Excitable and Oscillatory FitzHugh-Nagumo Dynamics with Parametric Neural Operators
comment: Human Brain & AI @ International Joint Conferences on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI) 2026
summary: The FitzHugh-Nagumo (FHN) system serves as a simplified model of neuronal voltage dynamics, capturing the activator-inhibitor structure behind both isolated action potentials and the rhythmic spiking seen across the brain. Exploring its 5D physiological parameter space is important for neuromodulation and mapping voltage recordings back to biophysics, yet classical finite-difference solvers make rapid parameter sweeps expensive. We train parameter-conditioned Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) as fast, differentiable surrogates for the FHN voltage and recovery fields on a one-dimensional spatial domain, conditioning each Fourier layer on the parameter vector $λ= (D_u, D_v, a, b, τ)$ via feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM). We apply a single bifurcation analysis that delimits the two distinct regimes the model spans, oscillatory (tonic firing) and excitable (action-potential propagation), and we train one operator in each. In the oscillatory regime the surrogate attains sub-$0.1\%$ relative $L^2$ error on both fields, runs nearly three orders of magnitude faster than the finite-difference baseline, generalizes uniformly across the parameter space, and extrapolates to low single-digit percentage errors outside of the training bounds. In the excitable regime the same operator accurately reproduces the firing threshold and the $c \propto \sqrt{D_u}$ conduction-velocity law and replicates full traveling pulses, fully capturing the excitable bifurcation structure rather than just smoothly interpolating fields.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用参数条件化的傅里叶神经算子（FNO）作为FitzHugh-Nagumo系统在1D空间域上的快速可微代理模型，利用特征级线性调制（FiLM）对Fourier层进行参数条件化，分别训练振荡（tonic firing）和可激励（action-potential propagation）两个不同参数区域的操作器。在振荡区代理模型在两个场上达到小于0.1%的相对L2误差，比有限差分基线快近三个数量级，并在参数空间内外均展现良好泛化与外推能力；在可激励区则能准确复现放电阈值、c∝√D_u传导速度定律以及完整传播脉冲，完整捕捉可激励分岔结构。
AI.motivation: 探索FHN系统的5D生理参数空间对神经调节和将电压记录映射回生物物理参数至关重要，但经典有限差分求解器使得快速参数扫描代价高昂，需要构建快速且可微分的替代模型以加速参数空间探索。
AI.method: 采用参数条件化的Fourier神经算子（FNO），通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）将参数向量λ=(D_u, D_v, a, b, τ)注入到每个Fourier层中。首先通过单一分岔分析划分FHN模型的两个不同参数区域（振荡与可激励），然后分别在每个区域训练一个专用操作器来预测电压场和恢复场。
AI.result: 在振荡区域，代理模型在两个场上均达到低于0.1%的相对L2误差，运行速度比有限差分基线快近三个数量级，在参数空间中均匀泛化，且可外推到训练边界外（误差仅为低个位数百分比）。在可激励区域，模型能准确复现放电阈值、c∝√D_u传导速度律并完整复现传播脉冲，完全捕捉可激励分岔结构。
AI.conclusion: 参数条件化FNO能够以极高的精度和速度作为FHN系统的替代模型，不仅实现快速参数扫描，还能保持对不同动力学生理行为（振荡与可激励）的物理结构保真度，展示了FNO在生物物理ODE/PDE系统参数探索中的强大潜力。

title: PetQA: Benchmarking Veterinary Knowledge and Clinical Reasoning
summary: We introduce PetQA, a Korean long-form question-answering (QA) benchmark for evaluating veterinary knowledge and clinical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) and large vision-language models (LVLMs). PetQA contains 10,076 text-only and 8,751 multimodal QA pairs derived from real-world questions about dogs and cats, paired with answers from expert veterinarians. Its test split, PetQA-Bench, further includes annotations for question types and clinical conditions. We evaluate eighteen models using ROUGE, BERTScore, and LLM-as-a-judge metrics for factuality and helpfulness under three settings: zero-shot inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The benchmarking results provide an overview of the strengths and limitations of current models in addressing veterinary clinical queries and highlight the need for more effective adaptation methods to develop clinically reliable AI systems for veterinary care. To facilitate broader use, we additionally provide translated versions of PetQA-Bench in five languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PetQA，一个韩语兽医领域的长文本问答基准数据集，包含10,076个纯文本和8,751个多模态QA对，来源于真实犬猫相关问题并由兽医专家提供答案。作者在多种设置下评估了18个模型，并提供五种语言的翻译版本以促进更广泛的应用。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型和多模态模型在通用领域已取得显著进展，但在专业领域（如兽医临床）的知识掌握和推理能力缺乏系统评估。现有基准通常集中在人医或通用QA，针对动物医疗的韩语长文本QA基准存在空白，阻碍了该领域模型的开发与临床可靠性验证。
AI.method: 构建了PetQA数据集，包含从真实犬猫问答中整理的10,076个纯文本与8,751个多模态QA对，由兽医专家提供标准答案。测试集PetQA-Bench包含问题类型和临床条件的额外标注。评估方面，采用ROUGE、BERTScore和LLM-as-a-judge指标，在三种设置（零样本推理、检索增强生成RAG和监督微调SFT）下全面评测18个模型的事实准确性和有用性。此外，将PetQA-Bench翻译为五种语言。
AI.result: 评测结果揭示了当前模型在处理兽医临床查询时的优势与局限，表明现有模型在兽医专业知识推理方面仍有不足，凸显了需要更有效的适配方法来构建临床可靠的兽医AI系统。
AI.conclusion: PetQA为兽医领域LLM/LVLM评估提供了首个大规模韩语基准资源，证明该领域仍需开发更好的模型适配策略以提升专业临床问答能力，同时多语言版本拓展了其适用范围。

title: Does the Selected Object Reach the Reader? Auditing Identity Handoffs in Grounded Language-Model Pipelines
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 23 tables. Accepted to the GroundLM Workshop (Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Grounded language-model pipelines can be divided into three stages: selecting an object, retrieving passages for it, and using that evidence to answer. If the selected object must reach the reader, losing it breaks the handoff. Benchmark recall checks the dataset-linked object, which can differ. We audit 600 HybridQA questions across three selector families. On 1,463 resolvable records where the selected object matches the dataset-traced passage, exact key lookup and exact title matching return the object every time. With every ranked rule given the same decoded selected title, body-only BM25 omits it on 389 records (26.6%) at cutoff five, while hybrid retrieval with reranking omits it on 14 (1.0%). The two identities differ on 329 of 1,792 resolvable records. With original-question rankings, their top-five checks disagree on 106 records (5.9%). Frozen reader comparisons associate the aligned object's presence with 28.6 to 31.0 points higher exact match. In a deliberately selected 64-item cohort, removing that passage sharply lowers exact match, while removing a similar-length comparison passage does not reproduce the drop. We release the Returned-Object Profile (ROP), an executable record of the target, returned-ID field, cutoff, membership rule, and complete expected population, with data and an offline replay.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于语言模型的检索问答流水线中"选中对象"与"数据集追踪段落"的身份一致性进行了审计，揭示了二者在混合检索中频繁不一致，并验证了该不一致显著影响下游读者模型的答案质量，同时发布了可复现的审计工具Returned-Object Profile (ROP)。
AI.motivation: 在grounded语言模型流水线中，目标是先选中一个对象、检索相关段落、再用证据作答。若最终选中的对象必须到达读者（reader），中途丢失会破坏传递链。然而常规的基准测试（benchmark）只检查数据集关联的段落是否被召回，而不检查实际选中的对象是否被找到，二者可能不一致。这种差异尚未被系统审计，可能使评测结果虚高或误导。
AI.method: 作者对600道HybridQA问题、跨越三类选择器（selector）进行审计。在1,463条可解析记录中，对"选中对象与数据集追踪段落一致"的情况，对比了精确键查找、精确标题匹配、仅正文BM25检索（cutoff为5）以及混合检索+重排序等不同方案的召回表现。同时在1,792条可解析记录上对比两种身份（对象身份与段落身份）的重合度及top-5检索差异。最后通过冻结读者模型（frozen reader）对比测试，并构造64项精选队列做消除实验（移除目标段落vs移除等长对照段落）来验证因果影响。
AI.result: 当选中对象与数据集追踪段落匹配时，精确键查找和精确标题匹配均能100%返回对象。但在解码出相同选中标题的前提下，仅正文BM25在cutoff=5时遗漏389条记录（26.6%），混合检索+重排序仅遗漏14条（1.0%）。两种身份在1,792条可解析记录中有329条不一致；基于原问题排名的top-5检查在106条记录（5.9%）上意见分歧。冻结读者模型中，对齐对象的在场带来28.6~31.0个点的精确匹配（EM）提升；在64项的精选队列里，移除该段落急剧降低EM，而移除等长对照段落不会重现该下降。
AI.conclusion: 选中对象与数据集关联段落并非同一实体，二者在相当比例的问题上不一致，且这种不一致会显著影响下游问答质量。现有仅以数据集段落为召回基准的评测可能低估或误判检索质量。为此作者发布了Returned-Object Profile (ROP)，一个可执行的审计记录工具，包含目标对象、返回ID字段、cutoff、成员判定规则和完整期望群体，并提供数据与离线回放以支持复现。

title: Governing Bring Your Own AI: A Parameterized Maturity Model
summary: Employees are increasingly using personally owned generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude for their daily work. This practice is known as Bring Your Own AI (BYOAI), which is a distinct form of Shadow AI in which employee-authenticated personal accounts are used outside of enterprise identity and security controls. Existing frameworks were designed for AI tools managed by organizations, and their coverage does not extend to unmanaged AI tools used with a personal account. In addressing these issues, we developed a governance model through a systematic review of the literature that produces a risk taxonomy and a framework-engagement profile. We also developed a parameterized governance model that measures how much a level of governance maturity reduces residual risk. A five-level maturity ladder is coupled to a technical control architecture through a chain in which the coverage of the control layer influences the security outcomes. Our study of a curated corpus of 30 records (24 research studies and 6 framework documents) indicated that the most prominent categories identified were data exposure and compliance, and framework engagement was inconsistent. Three mutually supporting pillars (technical, governance, and human) were established to support safeguards. Additionally, the results of the model demonstrated that prohibition-based solutions will result in residual risk levels close to those achieved through baseline solutions. Under the specified parameterization, layered control-based solutions substantially reduce modeled exfiltration risk and increase enforceable coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文针对员工自带个人生成式AI工具（BYOAI）这一影子AI形态缺乏治理框架的问题，通过系统性文献综述构建了风险分类学和框架参与画像，并开发了参数化治理成熟度模型，证明分层次的控制型解决方案比禁令型方案更能降低残余风险。
AI.motivation: 员工越来越多地使用个人拥有的生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude）进行日常工作，即BYOAI实践。这是一种影子AI的特殊形式，使用员工个人账户且不受企业身份和安全控制管理。现有的治理框架仅针对组织管理的AI工具设计，无法覆盖使用个人账户的非受管AI工具，存在治理空白。
AI.method: 通过系统性文献综述产生风险分类学和框架参与画像；开发参数化治理模型，量化治理成熟度水平对残余风险的降低程度；将五级成熟度阶梯通过链条与技术支持控制架构耦合，使控制层覆盖率影响安全结果；对30条策展记录（24项研究、6个框架文档）进行分析。
AI.result: 研究表明最突出的风险类别是数据泄露和合规问题，框架参与不一致；建立了技术、治理和人力三个相互支撑的支柱以支持保障措施；模型结果显示禁令型方案的残余风险水平接近基线方案，而分层控制型方案在指定参数化下能大幅降低模拟的外泄风险并提高可执行的覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 禁令式治理对BYOAI风险抑制效果有限，分层控制型方案才是实质性降低风险的有效途径；需要技术、治理、人力三支柱协同支撑，以弥补现有框架对个人账户使用AI工具的覆盖空白。

title: Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT) for Robot Navigation in Dense and Uncertain Crowds
summary: Safe robot navigation in dense crowds requires reasoning about pedestrian motion and how it may change in response to a robot. However, many learning-based approaches generate pedestrian motion independently of the robot or assume uniform reciprocity, omitting an important source of interaction uncertainty. This paper presents a Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT), a reinforcement learning framework that retains robot-conditioned changes in pedestrian motion during policy learning while allowing responsiveness to vary across pedestrians. Responsiveness affects the crowd dynamics when the robot is visible but is not supplied as a policy input; the policy must instead infer its consequences from robot-centered relative positions. A two-stage gated Transformer progressively encodes human-human and human-robot relations, while a recurrent policy captures their temporal evolution. A curriculum gradually reduces pedestrian responsiveness to increase interaction difficulty. Simulation experiments demonstrate improved navigation safety and robustness over representative baselines across response conditions and crowd densities, and show transfer without retraining to structurally distinct crowd-flow layouts. Ablations support the hierarchical relational encoding and gated updates. Real-robot deployment further verifies that the learned policy can operate with sparse observations in a physical environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出H2INT（人-人 & 人-机交互Transformer），一个强化学习框架，通过两阶段门控Transformer分层编码人-人和人-机关系，并采用循环策略捕捉时间演化，同时通过课程学习逐步降低行人响应度来增加交互难度，从而在密集人群场景中实现更安全稳健的机器人导航，并可在无需重新训练的情况下迁移到结构不同的人群流布局。
AI.motivation: 许多基于学习的行人运动预测方法要么独立于机器人生成行人运动，要么假设行人统一响应机器人，忽略了交互不确定性的重要来源（即不同行人可能对机器人有不同的响应程度），这限制了密集人群导航的安全性和稳健性。
AI.method: 提出H2INT框架，核心要点：(1) 在策略学习中保留机器人条件化的行人运动变化，且允许响应度随行人变化；(2) 响应度影响机器人可见时的人群动态，但不作为策略输入提供，策略需从机器人中心的相对位置推断其后果；(3) 采用两阶段门控Transformer渐进式编码人-人和人-机关系；(4) 使用循环策略捕捉时序演化；(5) 设计课程学习逐步降低行人响应度以增加交互难度。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，该方法在多种响应条件和人群密度下相比代表性基线具有更好的导航安全性和稳健性，并能无需重新训练迁移至结构不同的人群流布局；消融实验验证了层级关系编码和门控更新的有效性；真实机器人实验进一步验证了该策略在物理环境中使用稀疏观测也能正常工作。
AI.conclusion: H2INT通过显式建模异构的行人-机器人响应性以及层级编码人-人与人工交互关系，有效提升了密集人群中的导航性能，证明了考虑机器人在人群中的存在对行人行为的条件影响是安全导航的关键，同时该方法具备良好的跨场景迁移能力和真实环境部署可行性。

title: Counting Beyond Instances: A Benchmark for Group-Individual Object Counting
summary: Visual counting is commonly formulated at the instance level, aiming to estimate how many objects of a queried category appear in an image. However, real-world counting often involves higher-level semantic units formed by multiple instances, such as a bunch of grapes, a stack of plates, or a pair of shoes. This exposes a key limitation of existing counting formulations, which mainly focus on what to count, while largely overlooking at which semantic unit to count. We introduce Group-Individual Object Counting (GIC), a new setting that requires models to count both individual objects and semantic groups within a unified framework. To support this new task, we present BunchCount, a real-world benchmark with 1,330 images, 89,254 individual annotations, and 11,065 group annotations. BunchCount provides paired individual-group annotations within the same image and explicitly records containment relations between each group and its constituent individuals. Experiments on BunchCount show that current advanced counting models perform well on individual instances but fail to count semantic groups more accurately. To mitigate semantic granularity conflict, we propose a counting-unit guided relational counting framework, which exploits group-individual containment relations to regularize cross-granularity representations during training. Our method substantially improves group-level counting while better preserving individual-level counting ability, establishing a strong baseline for counting beyond instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的计数任务——Group-Individual Object Counting (GIC)，要求模型在统一框架中同时计数单个物体和语义分组（如一串葡萄、一叠盘子）。作者构建了BunchCount基准数据集（1,330张图像，89,254个个体标注和11,065个分组标注），并提出了基于计数单元引导的关系计数框架，利用分组-个体包含关系来正则化跨粒度表示，显著提升了分组级计数且保持个体级计数性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉计数方法主要聚焦于实例级别的计数（"数什么"），但现实世界中的计数往往涉及更高层的语义单元（"以什么语义单元来数"），例如一串葡萄、一叠盘子。现有公式化方法忽视了这一关键维度，缺乏同时处理个体和语义分组计数的能力。
AI.method: 首先提出GIC任务设定，要求模型在统一框架中同时计数个体对象和语义分组。构建了BunchCount基准数据集，包含配对的分组-个体标注并显式记录包含关系。在此基础上提出计数单元引导的关系计数框架，通过利用分组-个体包含关系在训练过程中正则化跨粒度表示，解决语义粒度冲突问题。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有的先进计数模型在个体实例计数上表现良好，但在语义分组计数上失败。提出的方法显著提升了分组级计数精度，同时更好地保留了个体级计数能力，建立起超越实例计数的强基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了现有计数范式忽视"语义单元"维度的局限性，提出了GIC新任务和BunchCount基准，证明了包含关系正则化是缓解跨粒度语义冲突的有效手段，为超越实例级别的计数研究提供了新的方向。

title: Training-Free Halving of Activated Experts in Fine-Grained Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Modern fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a small number of experts and renormalize their router probabilities. We show that this renormalization implicitly calibrates expert output gain to the training top-$k$: reducing $k$ at inference changes not only which experts are used but also the strength of the expert branch. We separate these effects by activating the top $k_1$ experts while normalizing by the probability mass of the top $k_2$ experts, introducing one integer with no parameters, training, or measurable compute overhead. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, reducing from 8 to 4 experts causes a 4.65-point MMLU drop under standard renormalization but only 0.35 points with $k_2=16$, while halving routed-expert compute. The result replicates on the $11\times$ larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, where reducing from 10 to 5 experts loses only 0.55 points with an appropriate reference set. Removing renormalization entirely is catastrophic, showing that preserving a suitable reference mass is crucial. We further find that perplexity and downstream accuracy favor different $k_2$, cautioning against selecting MoE compression settings using unlabeled text alone. Analyses also show that expert identity matters substantially more than expert weighting, while balanced and domain-specialized routing leaves limited room for expert pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现细粒度MoE模型中的重归一化操作会在推理时隐式地根据训练时的top-k校准专家输出增益。通过引入一个零参数、零训练开销的整数k2（用top k1激活专家、用top k2的概率质量归一化），可以在大幅削减专家计算的同时保持性能：Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上从8降到4个专家，标准重归一化导致4.65点MMLU下降，而k2=16时仅下降0.35点；该结果在11倍规模的Qwen3.5-397B-A17B上复现。实验还揭示专家身份比专家权重更重要，均衡和领域特化路由留给剪枝的空间有限，且困惑度与下游准确率对k2的偏好不一致。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度MoE路由通常将每个token路由到少量专家并对其路由概率进行重归一化，但这一重归一化与训练时top-k设置之间的关系未被充分理解。作者希望分离专家选择（身份）与专家输出增益（权重）这两个被耦合的效应，从而在不损失性能的前提下实现MoE推理时的专家压缩。
AI.method: 提出一种解耦操作：激活top k1个专家，但使用top k2个专家的概率质量之和进行归一化（k2 ≠ k1），仅引入一个整数参数，无参数、无训练、无可测计算开销。通过在不同的k2参考集下评估模型，分离"哪些专家被使用"（身份）与"专家分支的强度"（增益/权重）的影响。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上将k从8降到4，标准重归一化下MMLU下降4.65点，而k2=16时仅下降0.35点，同时路由专家计算减半。在Qwen3.5-397B-A17B上将k从10降到5，选择合适的参考集后仅损失0.55点。完全移除重归一化会导致灾难性失败。专家身份比专家权重更重要；困惑度与下游准确率对k2偏好不同；均衡路由和领域特化路由下剪枝空间有限。
AI.conclusion: 重归一化中的参考概率质量（k2）是MoE推理压缩的关键调节旋钮，选择合适的k2可以在大幅降低路由计算的同时保留接近原始的性能。这为MoE推理压缩提供了一个零成本的替代方案，同时提示不应仅依赖困惑度等无监督指标来选择MoE压缩设置。

title: Tracing Audio Grounding and Answer Selection in Audio LLMs
summary: Audio Large Language Models (Audio LLMs) have advanced in audio understanding, yet they can still predict the answer by reasoning from textual cues or linguistic priors rather than the provided audio. A common remedy is to train models on data whose answers cannot be inferred from text alone. This approach can improve performance, but what changes within the model remains unclear. In this paper, we ask what must happen inside the model for the audio to actually determine the answer. Our findings are threefold. (1) Replacing the audio with silence or unrelated audio causes substantially larger performance degradation in the trained model than in the pretrained model. (2) Acoustic information most strongly shapes the model's representations of the answer choices in early-to-middle layers, while training mainly increases the influence of audio information on the final prediction in middle-to-late layers. (3) The weights learned during training have their largest impact in specific layer bands. Together, these results provide a mechanistic account of how training strengthens the use of acoustic evidence in Audio LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了音频大语言模型（Audio LLM）在经过专门训练后，音频信息如何在模型内部真正决定答案的机制性问题。通过三个维度的实验（音频替换扰动、表征层面的信息流分析、权重影响层带分析），揭示了训练如何增强模型对声学证据的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有Audio LLM虽然取得了进展，但模型可能通过文本线索或语言先验而非真实音频来预测答案。虽然已有工作通过训练数据中消除文本可推断答案来缓解此问题，但模型内部到底发生了什么变化、音频如何真正主导答案产生，一直是黑箱。理解这一机制对于设计更有效的训练方法和诊断模型行为至关重要。
AI.method: 实验包括三个发现维度：(1) 对比训练前后模型在替换音频为静音或不相关音频时的性能下降幅度；(2) 分析声学信息在不同层中对答案选项表征的影响强度，以及训练如何改变音频信息对最终预测的影响模式；(3) 使用权重分析定位训练过程中学习到的知识在模型特定层带中的最大影响区域。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 训练后的模型在音频被替换为静音或不相关音频时，性能下降显著大于预训练模型，表明训练确实增强了模型对音频的依赖；(2) 声学信息在前到中层对答案选项表征影响最强，而训练主要在中到后层增强音频信息对最终预测的作用；(3) 训练学到的权重在特定的层带中产生最大影响，揭示了对齐声学证据的关键计算路径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了Audio LLM训练如何增强声学证据使用的机制性解释，明确了音频信息在模型内部流动和影响决策的具体层间模式，为未来音频-语言模型的训练策略设计与可解释性研究提供了理论基础。

title: $τ^τ$-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction
summary: LLM agents are rapidly becoming production software, deployed to handle customer service, adjudicate disputes, and operate internal systems. Notably, the work of building them is increasingly handed to coding agents, yet existing benchmarks say little about whether an AI system can deliver one under the conditions of a real client engagement. We introduce $τ^τ$-bench (pronounced hyper-tau-bench), a benchmark that makes agent construction the task. A developer agent is given the records a business actually keeps, a client who holds requirements, a production API that operations must run through, a codebase to inherit, and limits on serving cost and models: the same starting point a real engagement provides. From these it must deliver a complete customer-service agent, scored by deploying that agent against held-out simulated users. Across 53 tasks spanning four domains, the strongest configuration, Claude Opus 5 under Claude Code, passes just 23.9% of evaluation simulations. Meanwhile, an expert-authored reference ceiling scores 82.2%. The failures mirror ones human agent developers see: models issue shallow queries in place of deep comprehension of the records, communicate almost nothing to the client, and experiment too little with agent architecture and serving spend, shipping the first design that runs. We aim for $τ^τ$-bench to turn the work of cooperative agent building into a measurable target for coding agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ττ-bench基准测试，将"构建Agent"作为测评任务本身。开发者Agent面对真实业务记录、客户需求、生产API、遗留代码库及成本限制，须交付一个完整的客服Agent，并通过部署到留出的模拟用户上进行评分。在53个任务、4个领域中，最强配置（Claude Opus 5 + Claude Code）仅通过23.9%的模拟测试，而专家参考上限为82.2%。模型失败模式与人类开发者遇到的常见问题一致：浅层查询、客户沟通不足、缺乏架构与服务成本实验。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent正快速投入生产环境，且构建Agent的工作越来越多地交给编码Agent完成。然而现有基准测试极少评估AI系统在真实客户合作条件下能否交付一个完整的Agent产品，存在明显评估空白。
AI.method: 设计ττ-bench基准：为开发者Agent提供与真实项目相同的起点——企业实际记录、持有需求的客户、生产API、可继承的代码库，以及服务成本和模型使用限制。Agent须交付完整客服Agent，通过将其部署在留出的模拟用户上打分。
AI.result: 基准包含53个任务、覆盖4个领域。最佳配置（Claude Opus 5在Claude Code下运行）仅通过23.9%的评估模拟，而专家编写参考实现可达82.2%的通过率，差距显著。
AI.conclusion: ττ-bench将协作式Agent构建转变为编码Agent可衡量的目标。当前模型在深度理解记录、与客户沟通、对架构和成本进行充分实验等方面存在系统性缺陷，与人类Agent开发者的常见失败模式一致，呼吁未来的编码Agent在这些方面进行改进。

title: CONTINUITY: Security-Context Contracts for Composable LLM Agent Controls
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Code and research artifact available at https://github.com/zast-ai/continuity
summary:
LLM agent systems increasingly combine provenance tracking, authorization, policy enforcement, protocol adapters, and execution controls. However, individually correct security mechanisms do not necessarily compose into an end-to-end secure system: security-critical context may be dropped, widened, rebound, or reinterpreted as actions cross component boundaries. We identify this failure mode as security-context discontinuity and introduce CONTINUITY, a framework for verifiable composition of agent security controls.
  CONTINUITY models each component with an assume-guarantee contract and carries authenticated security context across transitions using signed root grants, provenance commitments, role-bound transition receipts, bounded typed releases, transformation witnesses, and effect-bound execution permits. We formalize end-to-end consequence integrity, requiring every realized external effect to be backed by a valid and current authorization witness linking the principal, task, provenance, delegation, policy state, canonical action, and finality boundary.
  We implement a reference verifier and deterministic cross-layer fault-injection suite covering 32 fault classes across four application domains. In 2,560 parameterized attack instances spanning 128 fault-domain classes, the full CONTINUITY configuration commits no harmful external effect, while completing all 700 benign tasks and escalating all 200 ambiguous cases. These results show that secure agent execution requires not only sound individual controls, but explicit contracts that preserve their guarantees across the complete instruction-to-effect path.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CONTINUITY框架，解决LLM代理系统中安全控件跨组件组合时失效（安全上下文不连续）的问题。该框架通过assume-guarantee契约和携带认证安全上下文的多种机制（如签名根授权、角色绑定转换收据等），实现端到端后果完整性验证。实验覆盖2560个攻击实例，证明其可阻止所有有害外部影响。
AI.motivation: LLM代理系统集成了溯源追踪、授权、策略执行、协议适配器和执行控制等多种安全机制，但单独正确的安全机制组合后不必然构成端到端安全系统：当动作跨越组件边界时，安全关键上下文可能被丢弃、扩大、重新绑定或被重新解释。这种"安全上下文不连续"（security-context discontinuity）是现有系统的关键缺陷。
AI.method: CONTINUITY将每个组件建模为带assume-guarantee契约的模块，通过多种机制跨转换携带经过认证的安全上下文：签名根授权（signed root grants）、溯源承诺（provenance commitments）、角色绑定转换收据（role-bound transition receipts）、有界类型化发布（bounded typed releases）、转换见证（transformation witnesses）和效果绑定执行许可（effect-bound execution permits）。形式化定义了端到端后果完整性（consequence integrity），要求每个实现的外部效果都必须有有效且当前的授权见证，将主体、任务、溯源、委托、策略状态、规范动作和最终边界链接起来。
