  On RAGTruth and DiaHalu hallucination detection datasets, we find that our approach improves on direct prediction and competes with state-of-the-art hallucination detection methods, while not requiring domain-specific fine-tuning. Instead it relies on a low-level general competence already present in LLMs. This warrants further investigation of low-level LLM competences in neurosymbolic approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用LLM的SQL能力进行无需微调的幻觉检测方法：将参考文档构建为SQL数据库，通过数据库查询进行神经符号推理来验证生成内容是否忠实于来源，在RAGTruth和DiaHalu数据集上与最先进方法竞争。
AI.motivation: 幻觉是语言模型的一大挑战，但由于LLM推理过程不透明，幻觉检测十分困难。现有方法通常需要领域特定的微调或依赖模型内部状态，作者希望探索是否可以利用LLM已有的底层符号能力（如SQL）进行无需领域微调的幻觉检测。
AI.method: 作者提出一种神经符号（neuro-symbolic）幻觉检测框架：首先让LLM根据参考文档构建SQL数据库，然后将该数据库作为推理的grounding基础，在幻觉检测流程中通过SQL查询对参考文档和采样响应进行一致性推理验证，形成基于数据库的检测管线。该方法不依赖领域特定的微调，仅利用LLM已有的低级通用能力（SQL编写能力）。
AI.result: 在RAGTruth和DiaHalu两个幻觉检测数据集上，该方法优于直接预测基线，且与最先进的幻觉检测方法性能相当，同时无需领域特定的微调。
AI.conclusion: 利用LLM已有的低级符号能力（如SQL）进行神经符号推理来检测幻觉是可行且有效的方向，值得进一步探索LLM低级能力在神经符号方法中的应用。

title: Long Horizon Transformer Quantile Fault Prediction for Multi Site Industrial Predictive Maintenance
summary: Long-horizon predictive maintenance requires models to distinguish slowly evolving degradation from normal operating-regime variation over planning windows measured in days rather than hours. This paper evaluates whether an explicit conditional-quantile representation provides an informative classifier interface for this problem. The proposed TQRNN30d framework combines a dual-stage quantile regression neural network (QRNN) feature extractor with a multi-stream temporal fusion classifier. Each hourly word of 81-channel machine behaviour is mapped to a 324-dimensional quantile-state representation, and 720 ordered hourly words form the 30-day document supplied to the long-horizon model. The classifier fuses quantile states with dynamic covariates, channel-level static metadata, and a 168-hour latent-history stream using gated residual processing, causal recurrent encoding, and metadata-conditioned cross-modal attention. A bounded instability-aware signal derived from sustained one-word-ahead prediction-error divergence provides auxiliary memory modulation at the longest horizon. Evaluation uses a machine-disjoint 43/14/15 train/validation/test allocation across 72 machines in nine manufacturing facilities. At 30 days, TQRNN30d achieves 79.97% F1, 80.18% recall, 81.82% precision, 82.39% accuracy, and 0.820 ROC-AUC. It leads all 18 evaluated baselines at the 7-, 14-, and 30-day fixed-threshold comparisons, with the largest F1 advantage at 14 days. The results support held-out-machine performance within the observed homogeneous nine-facility fleet, but do not establish unseen-site, cross-equipment, or cross-sector generalisation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TQRNN30d框架，将条件分位数表示作为长时程预测性维护的分类接口。通过双阶段分位数回归神经网络提取324维分位数状态表征，结合多流时序融合分类器处理30天（720小时）的81通道机器行为数据，在72台机器、9个工厂的大规模评估中，30天F1达79.97%，并在7/14/30天固定阈值比较中优于全部18个基线，但未验证跨站点/跨设备/跨行业泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 长时程预测性维护需要模型在数天（而非数小时）的规划窗口上区分缓慢演化的退化过程与正常运行工况的变化。现有方法在此时间尺度上面临严峻挑战，论文旨在评估显式条件分位数表示能否为这一长期预测问题提供信息丰富的分类器接口。
AI.method: TQRNN30d由两部分组成：(1) 双阶段QRNN特征提取器，将每小时81通道机器行为映射为324维分位数状态表示；(2) 多流时序融合分类器，将720个有序小时词（构成30天文档）结合动态协变量、通道级静态元数据及168小时潜在历史流，通过门控残差处理、因果循环编码和元数据条件跨模态注意力进行融合。此外，基于持续的一步前向预测误差发散构造有界的不稳定性感知信号，在最长时程提供辅助记忆调制。
AI.result: 评估采用机器不相交的43/14/15训练/验证/测试划分，覆盖9个工厂的72台机器。30天时达到79.97% F1、80.18%召回率、81.82%精确率、82.39%准确率和0.820 ROC-AUC。在7/14/30天固定阈值比较中全面领先18个基线，其中14天时F1优势最大。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在同质九工厂机队内的留出机器性能，但未证实跨不可见站点、跨设备类型或跨行业的泛化能力，泛化边界需在更广范围数据上进一步验证。

title: Fast Gauss Sums via Flash Attention
summary: Gaussian kernel sums are the computational core of maximum mean discrepancies (MMDs), kernel gradient flows, Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD), and many other kernel methods. At the same time, softmax attention has received an extraordinary amount of hardware-aware code engineering, culminating in flash attention. We show that Gauss kernel sums with arbitrary, signed weights can be evaluated via flash attention: two small input augmentations turn the normalized softmax reduction into the unnormalized Gauss sum, without writing a single line of custom GPU code. For feature dimension D>8 in fp16, this approach beats compiled PyTorch code as well as PyKeOps kernels (often significantly) in speed, memory-overhead and accuracy. Indeed, its memory scaling remains linear.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将任意带符号权重的高斯核和计算转化为Flash Attention的软最大化归约问题，仅需两个小的输入扩充即可实现，无需编写任何自定义GPU代码。在特征维度D>8且fp16精度下，该方法在速度、内存开销和精度上均优于编译的PyTorch代码和PyKeOps核。
AI.motivation: 高斯核求和是MMD、核梯度流、SVGD等许多核方法的核心计算瓶颈，而Flash Attention已拥有大量硬件感知的高效工程实现。作者希望复用这些成熟的注意力优化来加速高斯核求和的评估。
AI.method: 通过两个小的输入增强（augmentations），将归一化的softmax归约（reduction）转化为非归一化的高斯和，从而使得任何实现了flash attention的现有代码都能直接用于计算带符号权重的高斯核和。
AI.result: 在特征维度D>8且使用fp16精度时，该方法在速度上超过编译的PyTorch代码和PyKeOps核（通常显著），内存开销更低，精度更高，且内存扩展保持线性。
AI.conclusion: Flash Attention可以被无缝复用为通用高斯核求和的加速引擎，在无需自定义GPU内核的前提下获得显著性能优势，为核方法社区提供了一条低成本高性能的实现路径。

title: How do LLMs Evaluate Perceived Moral Agency? Investigating Moral Decision-Making in Human-Artificial Agents Interactions
comment: 43 pages, 14 figures, 29 tables. Preprint under review
summary: As LLMs take on roles requiring moral advice, understanding how they attribute moral agency becomes critical. Humans possess moral agency, the capacity to make ethically guided decisions and bear responsibility for their consequences, a well-established construct in moral psychology. Yet as artificial agents (AAs) such as robots, drones, and disembodied AI systems become increasingly embedded in smart city environments, the question of whether and how moral agency is attributed to them takes on new urgency. This paper presents, to the best of our knowledge, the first empirical study comparing how humans and LLMs evaluate perceived moral agency (PMA) across human and autonomous artificial agents varying in embodiment, situated in plausible smart city scenarios. Using an adaptation of a validated PMA scale, we applied a protocol to 190 human participants as well as various LLMs. Our evaluation reveals higher perceptions of moral agency in humans than in AAs. However, when facing moral dilemmas in concrete scenarios, LLMs reason outward from the situation, prioritizing harm severity and contextual urgency over any stable assessment of the agent itself, amplifying a context-sensitivity also present in human raters. These findings are particularly relevant as LLMs become increasingly involved in everyday moral decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证比较了人类与大型语言模型（LLMs）在智能城市场景中对人类及不同具身形态的人工智能体的道德能动性感知（PMA）。研究发现人类被试对人类的道德能动性感知高于对人工智能体，但当面对具体道德困境时，LLM和人类均表现出超出稳定评估的情境敏感性推理，优先考虑伤害严重性和情境紧迫性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM承担更多涉及道德建议的角色，理解它们如何归因道德能动性变得至关重要。而在智能城市环境中，人工代理（如机器人、无人机、无实体AI）日益嵌入，对其道德能动性归因的问题具有紧迫性，但此前缺乏人类与LLM在这一维度上的系统性比较研究。
AI.method: 采用改编自经过验证的感知道德能动性（PMA）量表，对190名人类被试以及多种LLM施加统一实验协议，在拟真的智能城市场景中比较他们对人类和不同具身程度（自主）人工代理的道德能动性评价。
AI.result: 人类被试对人类代理的道德能动性感知高于对人工智能体。但在具体道德困境情境中，LLM从情境出发进行推理，优先考虑伤害严重性和情境紧迫性，而非对代理本身的稳定评估；这种情境敏感性在人类评分者中同样存在但被LLM放大。
AI.conclusion: LLM在具体道德情境中呈现出比人类更强的情境依赖推理模式，这对其日益介入日常道德决策具有重要启示，提示需要关注LLM道德判断的稳定性和情境一致性。

title: ElderBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents for Older Adults
summary: While autonomous mobile agents hold great potential for assisting older adults with smartphone usage, existing GUI benchmarks mainly rely on explicit, goal-oriented instructions and rarely capture the naturally occurring language patterns of older users, such as indirect speech, referential ambiguity, and under-specified requests. This mismatch between benchmark instructions and real-world elderly interactions may hinder reliable agent deployment. To address this gap, we present ElderBench, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile GUI agents in authentic elderly-oriented scenarios. ElderBench is constructed from 249 naturally elicited smartphone tasks collected from older adults across 20 applications. We first characterize the linguistic divergence between elderly instructions and existing GUI benchmark instructions from syntactic, semantic, and pragmatic perspectives. We then evaluate mainstream GUI agents and Vision-Language Models under both online and offline settings, revealing substantial performance degradation when handling elderly-oriented instructions. Through controlled instruction normalization, failure analysis, and fine-grained linguistic feature analysis, we further identify how elderly-specific language patterns contribute to agent failures. Our findings provide actionable design insights toward more adaptive, interpretable, and age-inclusive GUI agents for older adults.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ElderBench，这是第一个用于评估移动GUI智能体在真实老年用户场景下表现的基准。该基准包含从20个应用中收集的249个自然诱发任务，揭示了老年用户指令在句法、语义和语用层面与现有基准的显著差异，并发现主流GUI智能体在处理这些指令时性能大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI基准主要依赖明确的目标导向指令，未能捕捉老年用户的自然语言模式（如间接表达、指代歧义、不完整请求），导致基准指令与真实老年用户交互之间的不匹配，阻碍了移动智能体在协助老年人使用智能手机场景中的可靠部署。
AI.method: 从249个老年用户自然诱发任务构建ElderBench基准，覆盖20个应用；从句法、语义和语用三个角度刻画老年用户指令与现有基准指令的差异；在在线和离线两种设置下评估主流GUI智能体与视觉语言模型；通过受控指令归一化、失败分析和细粒度语言特征分析来识别导致智能体失败的老年特定语言模式。
AI.result: 主流GUI智能体和VLM在处理老年导向指令时表现出明显性能退化；老年用户特有的语言模式（间接指示、指代不清、信息不足等）是导致智能体失败的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究为构建更自适应、可解释且具年龄包容性的GUI智能体提供了可操作的设计洞见，呼吁社区关注老年用户真实语言习惯以提升智能体在现实场景中的可靠性。

title: ARC-Loc: Leveraging Azimuthal Ray Convergence as a Geometric Cue for Direct Cross-View Localization
summary: Cross-view localization (CVL) estimates the pose of a ground image by matching it to a geo-referenced satellite image. To bridge the extreme viewpoint gap, mainstream pipelines rely on Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) transformations or 2D-to-3D lifting. However, deriving 3D structures from a single ground image is fundamentally ill-posed, causing these methods to endure geometric distortions and computational costs during 3D lifting or BEV projection. Furthermore, relying on external depth foundation models to resolve this introduces latency and remains susceptible to noisy predictions. In this work, we present a different approach inspired by a human navigation technique called resection, that can perform direct ground to satellite image matching and localization without relying on external depth foundation models. The key insights of our method are that (i) ground keypoints can be translated into azimuthal rays on the satellite map, and (ii) these rays ideally converge at the user location. Exploiting this geometric constraint through direct line-to-point correspondences, we introduce a minimal Azimuthal Ray Convergence (ARC) solver to identify the intersection, alongside an ARC loss to optimize the matching network. By eliminating dependencies on computationally heavy BEV transformations and external depth foundation models, our approach achieves faster, memory-efficient inference, while its explicit feature matching ensures straightforward compatibility with existing frameworks. Experiments on VIGOR and KITTI demonstrate that ARC-Loc maintains competitive localization accuracy compared to recent approaches, highlighting its practicality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需BEV变换或外部深度模型的跨视角定位方法ARC-Loc，借鉴"后方交会"（resection）导航技术，通过将地面关键点转换为卫星地图上的方位角射线，利用射线交汇约束直接实现地面到卫星图像的匹配与定位。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角定位方法依赖BEV变换或2D-to-3D提升来弥合视角差异，但从单张地面图像推导3D结构本质上是病态问题，导致几何畸变和计算开销；依赖外部深度基础模型则引入延迟且易受噪声预测影响。
AI.method: (1) 将地面关键点翻译为卫星地图上的方位角射线，基于关键洞见：这些射线理想上汇聚于用户位置；(2) 利用直线到点（line-to-point）的对应关系，设计最小求解器Azimuthal Ray Convergence (ARC)来寻找射线交点；(3) 提出ARC损失函数用于优化匹配网络；(4) 整个流程无需BEV变换或外部深度模型，通过显式特征匹配确保与现有框架兼容。
AI.result: 在VIGOR和KITTI数据集上，ARC-Loc在保持与传统方法相当的定位精度的同时，实现了更快且内存效率更高的推理。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了不依赖几何变换和深度模型的直接地面到卫星匹配是可行的，通过消除计算密集的BEV变换和外部深度依赖，实现了高效实用的跨视角定位，具备与现有框架无缝集成的优势。

title: Physics-Aware Random Walk Fingerprints for Scalable Power Grid Graph Classification
comment: power system, power system security, cascading failures, graph classification, random walk fingerprints, physics-aware features
summary: Recent benchmarks such as PowerGraph provide large collections of power-grid graphs for cascading-failure classification. Graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong predictive performance on this task, but typically require end-to-end training and model-specific tuning, while their latent representations can be difficult to relate to physically meaningful propagation patterns. Random Walk Fingerprints (RWF) offer a scalable and interpretable alternative, but existing variants primarily emphasise topology and node-level information, leaving grid-relevant operational edge states in the walk dynamics. We propose Multi-Channel Physics-Aware Random Walk Fingerprints (MC-PA-RWF) for power systems, a lightweight graph-level representation framework that introduces physical edge states into random-walk propagation. The method constructs multiple edge-weighted channels from domain-relevant attributes, extracts a channel-specific fingerprint from each weighted graph, and concatenates the resulting vectors into a compact representation. Experiments on three \textit{PowerGraph} benchmark systems show substantial improvements over topology-only RWF and competitive balanced accuracy against strong GNN baselines, including Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN), Graph Attention Networks (GAT), Graph Isomorphism Networks with edge features (GINE), and Transformer-based Graph Convolutional Networks (TransformerConv). At the largest evaluated settings, the node-edge extension MC-PA-RWF+ achieves around 98.04% - 99.32% balanced accuracy and improves failure-class F1 over the strongest GNN baseline by 1.60 -- 5.84 percentage points, with statistically significant gains across all three systems.

AI.tldr: 提出多通道物理感知随机游走指纹（MC-PA-RWF），一种轻量级图级表示方法，通过将物理边状态融入随机游走动力学来实现电网级联故障分类，在PowerGraph基准上达到与强GNN基线相当甚至更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN在电网级联故障分类上表现优异，但需要端到端训练和模型特定调优，且潜在表示难以关联到具有物理意义的传播模式；已有的随机游走指纹（RWF）虽可扩展且可解释，但主要强调拓扑和节点级信息，未能将电网运行相关的边状态纳入游走动力学。
AI.method: MC-PA-RWF通过以下步骤构建表示：（1）从电网领域相关的物理属性构造多个边加权通道；（2）在每个加权图上提取通道特定的指纹（Random Walk Fingerprint）；（3）将各通道的指纹向量拼接为紧凑的图级表示。另扩展了节点-边联合版本MC-PA-RWF+。
AI.result: 在三个PowerGraph基准系统上的实验表明：相比仅基于拓扑的RWF有显著提升；与强GNN基线（GCN、GAT、GINE、TransformerConv）相比达到有竞争力的平衡准确率；MC-PA-RWF+在最大评估规模下达到98.04%-99.32%的平衡准确率，故障类F1相比最强GNN基线提升1.60-5.84个百分点，且在三个系统上均有统计显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 将物理感知的边状态融入随机游走动力学可有效提升电网级联故障分类的可解释图级表示质量，在保持轻量高效的同时逼近甚至超越强GNN基线，为可解释且物理相关的电网故障检测提供了可行范式。

title: EuroAlpaca: Task-Preserving Localisation of Instruction Data for European Languages
summary: Machine translation (MT) offers a scalable way to extend English instruction-tuning data to multiple languages, but it can distort task-critical constraints and required outputs, creating corrupted training examples and degrading models trained on such data. We introduce EuroAlpaca, a task-preserving localisation pipeline and near-parallel resource covering 50 European languages and regional varieties, together with European-IFEval, a multilingual benchmark for verifiable instruction following. Depending on the example, our pipeline applies field-wise MT while preserving task-critical content or reconstructs a task-equivalent target-language instance, followed by validation of cross-field coherence and target-language consistency. Across LoRA experiments with four LLMs, training on directly translated data improves ROUGE-L and F-BERT on the Aya Evaluation Suite, but reduces accuracy on European-IFEval by 29.8% relative to the unadapted baseline. In contrast, adaptation with EuroAlpaca improves accuracy by 12.9% over the same baseline, reversing the degradation caused by direct MT, while also achieving the highest ROUGE-L and F-BERT scores on Aya. These results show that preserving task semantics is essential for multilingual instruction tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EuroAlpaca，一个任务保持（task-preserving）的多语言指令微调本地化流水线，覆盖50种欧洲语言及区域变体，并配套European-IFEval多语言指令跟随基准。实验表明，直接机器翻译虽能提升ROUGE-L和F-BERT分数，却使European-IFEval准确率相对下降29.8%；而使用EuroAlpaca适配后准确率相对提升12.9%，同时取得最高的ROUGE-L和F-BERT分数，证明保持任务语义对多语言指令微调至关重要。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译是扩展英语指令微调数据到多语言的可扩展途径，但直接翻译会扭曲任务关键约束和所需输出，产生损坏的训练样本，降低基于此类数据训练模型的性能。现有方法缺乏对任务语义保持的系统性处理。
AI.method: EuroAlpaca流水线采用两种策略：(1) 字段级机器翻译，保持任务关键内容不翻译；(2) 重建任务等价的目标语言实例。随后进行跨字段一致性和目标语言一致性的验证。同时构建European-IFEval多语言可验证指令跟随基准，并在四个LLM上进行LoRA实验评估。
AI.result: 在四个LLM的LoRA实验中，直接翻译数据使Aya评估套件的ROUGE-L和F-BERT提升，但European-IFEval准确率相对无适配基线降低29.8%；EuroAlpaca适配则相对提升12.9%，逆转直接翻译造成的退化，同时在Aya上取得最高ROUGE-L和F-BERT分数。
AI.conclusion: 保持任务语义是高质量多语言指令微调的关键前提。EuroAlpaca证明了在扩展现有指令数据到多语言时，采用任务保持的本地化方法能同时改善可验证指令跟随能力与生成质量。

title: MM-IFEval-Pro: A Multilingual and Attack-Resistant Benchmark for Instruction-Following in Vision-Language Models
summary: As vision-language models (VLMs) rapidly advance in image understanding, cross-modal reasoning, and complex instruction execution, instruction-following capability has become a key indicator of their reliability and practicality. However, existing multimodal instruction-following benchmarks still suffer from limited language coverage and insufficient adversarial safety scenarios, making them inadequate for evaluating real-world multilingual and safety-sensitive settings. To address these gaps, we present MM-IFEval-Pro, a multimodal instruction-following benchmark covering Chinese and English tasks as well as diverse instruction hijacking cases. MM-IFEval-Pro includes 4 major task categories and 24 subcategories and 8 instruction categories with 52 subcategories, with each sample containing an average of 3.0 constraints to realistically simulate complex instruction scenarios. We further construct a reinforcement-learning training set enriched with Chinese and adversarial instructions, which significantly improves model performance on MM-IFEval-Pro and transfers effectively to other mainstream multimodal benchmarks, demonstrating strong cross-task and cross-language generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MM-IFEval-Pro，一个覆盖中英双语及多种指令劫持场景的多模态指令遵循基准，包含4大类任务/24子类与8类指令/52子类，并构建了富含中文与对抗性指令的强化学习训练集，显著提升模型在该基准及主流多模态基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM指令遵循基准存在语言覆盖有限和对抗性安全场景不足的问题，无法真实评估多语言及安全敏感环境下的模型可靠性。
AI.method: 构建MM-IFEval-Pro基准，涵盖中英双语任务与多种指令劫持案例，平均每个样本含3.0个约束；同时构造富含中文和对抗性指令的强化学习训练集来提升模型性能。
AI.result: MM-IFEval-Pro训练集显著提升模型在基准上的表现，并有效迁移至其他主流多模态基准，展现强跨任务与跨语言泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的双语、多劫持场景基准及配套训练策略能有效增强VLM的指令遵循与安全鲁棒性，具备良好的跨语言、跨任务泛化能力。

title: RefDiT: Local Attribute Guidance in Reference-Based Image Generation
summary: Personalization models generate new images guided by a few subject references, while style transfer methods aim to produce images aligned with a global style derived from a reference image. Recent approaches perform well when the reference image contains a single object, effectively capturing a global style that encompasses all implicit attributes. However, when applied to complex real-world scenes containing multiple objects with distinct attribute characteristics, these methods, due to their global-level guidance, fail to localize relevant elements in the reference image. The global guidance restricts their ability to generate new images based on the local attributes in the reference image. Moreover, existing methods typically employ a single identifier token to capture all details from the reference, resulting in a lack of individual, attribute-level control. Motivated by these limitations, we propose RefDiT, a novel framework for reference-guided image generation. RefDiT takes as input a reference image, a text prompt, and an optional user-provided guidance context. RefDiT employs local region guidance using the attributes of local elements. It constructs an attribute-aware conditioning signal from the reference image by performing attribute-level decomposition of the identifier token and performs context adjustment in the inference prompt to train low-rank adapter (LoRA) blocks of a diffusion transformer (DiT)-based generative model. RefDiT learns the correspondence between identifier tokens and local regions in the reference image, enabling more effective local guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RefDiT，一个用于参考图像引导生成的框架，通过对参考图像进行属性级分解和局部区域引导，解决现有方法在复杂真实场景中无法定位和利用局部属性进行生成的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化生成和风格迁移方法在参考图像包含单一物体时表现良好，但在复杂真实场景中（包含多个具有不同属性特征的物体）因采用全局级引导而无法定位参考图像中的相关元素，且单一标识符令牌难以捕获所有细节，缺乏属性级别的独立控制。
AI.method: RefDiT采用局部区域引导，通过属性级分解标识符令牌从参考图像构建属性感知的条件信号，并在推理提示中进行上下文调整以训练基于扩散Transformer（DiT）生成模型的低秩适配器（LoRA）模块，学习标识符令牌与参考图像局部区域之间的对应关系。
AI.result: RefDiT能够实现更有效的局部引导，解决全局引导在复杂场景中的局限性，实现对参考图像局部属性的定向生成。
AI.conclusion: 通过在DiT架构中引入属性级分解和区域级对应学习，RefDiT在参考图像引导生成任务中实现了比现有全局引导方法更精准的局部属性控制。

title: Fractal basins trap latent reasoning
summary: Reasoning allows artificial intelligence models to revisit and correct their mistakes, enabling recent frontier advances in mathematical theorem solving, software engineering, and autonomous task planning. Reasoning models are widely observed to reason for longer on harder tasks, but the general mechanism responsible for these slowdowns is unknown. Here, we show that reasoning models exhibit transient chaos, a physical consequence of the computational complexity of difficult tasks. As a consequence, we show that diverse leading reasoning models are dynamical systems with fractal basins, with fractality increasing with task difficulty across diverse tasks like Sudoku and maze solving, visual puzzles, and mathematical logic. We show that transient chaos emerges due to reasoning becoming trapped for extended durations near saddle points, which we show correspond to nearly-correct attempted solutions of the underlying problem. Our results show that reasoning slowdowns are an inevitable consequence of problem hardness in modern artificial intelligence models, and establish reasoning traces as a rich new class of dynamical system.

AI.tldr: 本文发现推理模型展现出瞬态混沌现象，这是困难任务计算复杂性的物理后果。多种主流推理模型呈现出具有分形盆地的动力学系统特征，且分形程度随任务难度增加而提高。瞬态混沌源于推理在接近正确解（鞍点）附近长时间滞留，表明推理减速是问题难度的不可避免结果。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在更难任务上推理时间更长是广泛观察到的现象，但其背后的通用机制尚属未知。作者旨在揭示推理减速的根本物理机制，并建立推理轨迹作为新一类动力学系统的理论基础。
AI.method: 作者将推理模型视为动力学系统进行分析，采用瞬态混沌理论框架。通过测量不同任务（数独、迷宫求解、视觉谜题、数学逻辑）中的分形盆地维度评估分形程度，并识别推理轨迹中的鞍点（对应接近正确的尝试解），分析推理在鞍点附近的滞留现象。
AI.result: 众多主流推理模型均被证明是带有分形盆地的动力学系统，且分形程度随任务难度增加而上升。瞬态混沌由推理在鞍点附近长时间停留所引发，而这些鞍点对应于底层问题中接近正确的候选解。
AI.conclusion: 推理减速是推理模型面对问题难度时不可避免的物理后果，推理轨迹构成一类内容丰富的新型动力学系统。

title: A Structured Debate-Mixture-of-Agents Framework for Complex Clinical Diagnostic Decision Support
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show potential for medical tasks, but their single-turn question-answer format does not reflect how clinical diagnosis is performed in practice. As a result, they remain limited in complex diagnostic settings. We developed Debate-Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA), a novel multi-agent framework that structures role-based interaction to support iterative diagnostic reasoning. Base models and DMoA were evaluated on 297 rare disease cases and 1,719 challenging cases. Across both datasets, DMoA improved most likely diagnosis accuracy by 10.21 percentage points and safety rate by 11.36 percentage points over GPT-4o baseline. Ablation experiments showed that the gains were not simply due to the use of more models or longer outputs, but also reflected the contribution of the structured workflow. Further analyses examined how framework design, base model choice, and token budget affected performance. DMoA performed better with a 4*2 structure, stronger base models, and a larger token budget. These findings demonstrate the potential of DMoA for clinical tasks and suggest further investigation of multi-agent frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Debate-Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA)，一种用于临床诊断推理的多智能体框架，通过角色化结构化交互实现迭代诊断推理。在297个罕见病病例和1719个疑难病例上评估，相比GPT-4o基线，DMoA将最可能诊断准确率提升10.21个百分点，安全率提升11.36个百分点。消融实验表明性能提升不仅源于模型数量或输出长度，还来自结构化工作流的贡献。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医疗任务中展现出潜力，但其单轮问答模式不符合临床诊断的实际流程，导致在复杂诊断场景中表现受限。现有方法缺乏支持迭代诊断推理的多智能体交互框架。
AI.method: 提出Debate-Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA)多智能体框架，通过基于角色的交互结构来支持迭代诊断推理。采用4*2的结构配置（即4个智能体进行2轮辩论），并在297个罕见病病例和1,719个疑难病例上进行系统评估，同时进行消融实验以分离结构化工作流、模型数量、输出长度等因素的贡献。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上，DMoA相比GPT-4o基线将最可能诊断准确率平均提升10.21个百分点，安全率提升11.36个百分点。消融实验证实性能提升不仅来自更多模型或更长输出，结构化工作流本身也有实质贡献。进一步分析表明，4*2结构、更强的基础模型和更大的token预算均有利于DMoA性能。
AI.conclusion: DMoA展现了在临床任务中应用多智能体框架的潜力，为复杂诊断场景提供了更符合临床实践推理方式的解决方案，建议进一步探索多智能体框架在医疗领域的应用。

title: MZ-Rain: Moisture-Budget-Guided Zero-Inflated Model for Station-Level Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Accurate station-level precipitation nowcasting is critical for agriculture, water resource management, and disaster prevention, which typically is formulated as a time series forecasting problem. However, conventional time-series modeling techniques face two major challenges in addressing station-level precipitation nowcasting: (1) Lack of Physics-Guided Modeling}, where meteorological variables are treated as a homogeneous set without accounting for their distinct roles in precipitation formation, leads to predictions that deviate from the physical processes governing precipitation. (2) Severe zero inflation in precipitation, where dry intervals dominate the dataset, obscuring meaningful precipitation patterns and complicating the predictive modeling. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{MZ-Rain}, a moisture-budget-guided zero-inflated sLSTM framework for station-level precipitation nowcasting. Guided by the moisture budget equation, MZ-Rain decomposes the precipitation formation process into process-specific pathways corresponding to moisture storage, moisture transport, surface evaporation, and precipitation persistence, and captures their temporal evolution through dedicated sLSTM branches. To account for the zero-inflated nature of precipitation, MZ-Rain introduces an adaptive Tweedie modeling strategy that adaptively modulates the rainfall mean while jointly learning precipitation occurrence as an auxiliary task, enabling the model to better balance dry-wet discrimination and quantitative precipitation estimation. Extensive experiments across diverse geographical and climatic regimes demonstrate that MZ-Rain consistently outperforms strong baselines on multiple evaluation metrics, including CSI, FAR, MSE, and MAE. In particular, the model exhibits superior skill in forecasting heavy precipitation events, while benefiting from physically grounded process modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MZ-Rain框架，一种基于水汽收支方程引导的零膨胀sLSTM模型，用于站点级降水临近预报。通过将降水形成过程分解为四个物理过程特定路径（水汽存储、水汽输送、地表蒸发、降水持续性），并引入自适应Tweedie建模策略处理降水数据的零膨胀问题，在多种地理和气候区域上超越强基线模型。
AI.motivation: 站点级降水临近预报对农业、水资源管理和防灾至关重要，但传统时间序列建模面临两大挑战：(1) 缺乏物理引导建模——气象变量被当作同质集合处理，未考虑它们在降水形成中的不同角色，导致预测偏离物理过程；(2) 降水数据严重零膨胀——干期主导数据集掩盖了有意义的降水模式，使建模复杂化。
AI.method: MZ-Rain框架的核心方法包括：(1) 受水汽收支方程引导，将降水形成过程分解为水汽存储、水汽输送、地表蒸发和降水持续性四个过程特定路径，每个路径通过专用的sLSTM分支捕获时间演化；(2) 引入自适应Tweedie建模策略，自适应调节降雨均值，同时将降水发生作为辅助任务联合学习，以在干湿判别和定量降水估计之间取得更好平衡。
AI.result: 在多种地理和气候区域的广泛实验中，MZ-Rain在CSI、FAR、MSE和MAE等多个评估指标上一致优于强基线模型。特别地，该模型在强降水事件的预报中展现出卓越技能，同时受益于物理基础的建模。
AI.conclusion: MZ-Rain通过将水汽收支等物理约束融入深度学习框架并结合零膨胀感知的自适应损失建模，有效解决了传统时间序列方法在站点级降水临近预报中物理可解释性不足和零膨胀数据偏差的问题，尤其在强降水预报方面表现突出。

title: Temporal Residual Neural Radiance Fields for Monocular Video Dynamic Human Body Reconstruction
comment: Published in Journal of Electronic Imaging, 2024
summary: In the field of computer vision and graphics, high-quality reconstruction of the human body in static scenes has been achieved in recent years by a single multilayer perceptron (MLP) in a number of approaches. However, MLPs have capacity limitations, requiring substantial training time and computational resources for dynamic scene reconstruction. And the quality of reconstruction is significantly constrained. This paper proposes a method for effectively processing complex spatiotemporal signals in dynamic scene human 3D modeling. The proposed method uses Temporal Residual Neural Radiance Fields to achieve novel view rendering and new pose synthesis of human bodies.To address the problem of representing temporal signals in video sequences, we construct a temporal residual field which is not related to the MLP architecture. Secondly, to improve reconstruction efficiency, we propose an integrated approach that reduces trainable parameters and accelerates rendering, thereby enhancing the network's feature representation capability. Finally, we design a multi-dimensional loss function to accurately measure the loss between predicted and actual spatial pixel values. The experimental results show that our proposed approach improves the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM) accuracy metrics compared to the latest representative methods. It maintains similar accuracy to Anim-NeRF and Neural Body while achieving a nearly 780-fold increase in time efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于时间残差神经辐射场（Temporal Residual Neural Radiance Fields）的动态场景人体三维建模方法，用于实现新颖视角渲染和新姿态合成。该方法通过构建与MLP架构无关的时间残差场来表征视频序列中的时间信号，采用集成方法减少可训练参数并加速渲染，同时设计多维损失函数精确度量预测与实际像素值间的误差。实验结果表明，该方法在PSNR和SSIM指标上优于最新代表性方法，在保持与Anim-NeRF和Neural Body相近精度的同时，时间效率提升了约780倍。
AI.motivation: 虽然近年来通过单个多层感知机（MLP）在静态场景中实现了高质量人体重建，但MLP存在容量限制，在动态场景重建时需要大量训练时间和计算资源，且重建质量受到显著约束。因此需要一种能够高效处理动态场景中复杂时空信号的人体三维建模方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建时间残差场（Temporal Residual Field）以表征视频序列中的时间信号，该残差场与MLP架构无关。2) 提出集成方法减少可训练参数并加速渲染，同时增强网络的特征表征能力。3) 设计多维损失函数以精确度量预测与真实空间像素值之间的损失。
AI.result: 在PSNR（峰值信噪比）和SSIM（结构相似性指数）精度指标上均优于最新代表性方法；与Anim-NeRF和Neural Body相比保持相近精度，但时间效率提升了约780倍。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的时间残差神经辐射场方法有效解决了动态场景人体重建中MLP容量受限和训练效率低的问题，在保证重建精度的同时大幅提升了时间效率，为动态人体三维建模提供了一种高效且高质量的解决方案。

title: BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve superior problem-solving through extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation, but the resulting key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and creates severe memory bottlenecks, often exceeding GPU capacity for long reasoning traces. Existing KV cache compression methods rely on recent queries to estimate future token importance, implicitly assuming these serve as reliable proxies for future attention patterns. We demonstrate that this assumption fails in long-horizon reasoning: certain decoding steps generate Thought Revisiting Tokens (TRT) that re-attend to distant previous context, such as task-solving plans formulated early in the trace. Through systematic analysis, we discover that queries corresponding to the TRT cluster into a small number of similarity groups in the embedding space. Based on this insight, we propose BeaconKV, a training-free KV cache compression method that maintains beacon queries, compact representatives for each global query cluster, to anticipate which KV pairs will be revisited without storing the entire query history. Across four open-source LRMs and diverse reasoning benchmarks, BeaconKV generally outperforms existing compression methods, achieving up to $5.8\times$ memory reduction while nearly preserving full cache accuracy and improving throughput by over $4.3\times$.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BeaconKV，一种无需训练的KV缓存压缩方法，通过维护"灯塔查询"（beacon queries）作为全局查询聚类的紧凑代表，预测长链推理中哪些KV对将被重新访问，从而在保持精度的同时实现高达5.8倍的内存压缩和4.3倍以上的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过扩展思维链（CoT）生成实现卓越的问题求解能力，但KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，导致严重的内存瓶颈。现有KV压缩方法依赖近期查询作为未来注意力模式的代理，这种假设在长程推理中失效——某些解码步骤会生成"思维回访令牌"（TRT），重新关注早期形成的任务求解计划等远端上下文，导致现有方法无法准确预测KV对的未来重要性。
AI.method: 通过系统分析发现，TRT对应的查询在嵌入空间中聚集成少量相似性组。基于此洞察，论文提出BeaconKV：一种训练免费的KV缓存压缩方法，维护beacon queries作为每个全局查询聚类的紧凑代表，用以预测哪些KV对被重新访问而无需存储完整查询历史，从而有效压缩KV缓存。
AI.result: 在四个开源LRM和多种推理基准上，BeaconKV整体优于现有压缩方法，实现高达5.8倍的内存压缩（memory reduction），同时几乎保持全缓存的准确性，并将吞吐量提升超过4.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了一种新的长程推理现象——思维回访令牌的存在打破了传统KV压缩假设，并通过聚类的洞察提出了一种有效的免训练压缩策略。BeaconKV成功解决了LRM长推理轨迹中的KV缓存内存瓶颈问题，在不牺牲推理质量的前提下显著提升了推理效率。

title: Influence Score and Transformers interpretability: Measure of the Effective Impact of Attention Heads at inference time
summary: We propose an influence score to quantify the contribution of attention heads to classification decisions in Transformer-based models designed for prompt injection detection. The score combines directional influence on the logits with structural contribution within the residual stream, enabling a multi-scale analysis at the head, layer, and network levels. Applied to a DeBERTa model specialized for prompt injection detection, our framework reveals distinct decision behaviours between correct and erroneous predictions. Our method provides an effective compromise between fine-grained circuit analysis and global output-based methods, and offers a systematic way to study decision mechanisms in Transformer classifiers.

AI.tldr: 提出一种影响力分数，用于量化Transformer模型中注意力头对提示注入检测分类决策的贡献，结合logits方向影响与残差流结构贡献，实现多头、多层级、多网络规模的分析。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么过于细粒度（电路分析）要么过于粗略（基于全局输出的方法），缺乏在注意力头层面量化其对分类决策贡献的系统性方法，尤其是在提示注入检测这一特定安全任务中。
AI.method: 设计了一种结合方向性影响（对logits的方向影响）和结构性贡献（残差流中的结构贡献）的影响力分数，可在头、层、网络三个层面进行多尺度分析。
AI.result: 在专用于提示注入检测的DeBERTa模型上验证，该框架揭示了正确预测与错误预测之间不同的决策行为。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在细粒度电路分析与全局输出方法之间提供了有效折中，为系统研究Transformer分类器的决策机制提供了途径。

title: CoSkill: Joint Reinforcement Learning of Reasoning and Meta-Skill Agents for Hierarchical Skill Evolution
summary: Skill libraries improve the sample efficiency of agentic reinforcement learning (RL) by enabling large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge. Yet existing paradigms exhibit structural shortcomings: they either decouple skill evolution from policy optimization or instantiate meta-skills as fixed workflows. Both treat skills as passive objects to be managed, limiting the flexible evolution of skills and their co-adaptation with the reasoning agent. To address the limitations, we propose CoSkill, a unified multi-agent RL framework that recasts the static meta-skill workflow as a learnable Meta-Skill Agent and jointly trains it with a Reasoning Agent over a hierarchical skill library. By modeling the Reasoning and Meta-Skill Agents as a cooperative team sharing a single backbone, CoSkill enables end-to-end co-adaptation: the Reasoning Agent conditions its actions on a retrieved task skill and step skills selected from its child set, while its task performance guides the Meta-Skill Agent in refining those step skills. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that CoSkill substantially outperforms prior skill-based and RL baselines, achieving success rates of 98.4% and 90.6%, respectively (+3.5 and +6.2 pp). As shown in Figure 1, CoSkill achieves superior early-stage sample efficiency, asymptotic performance, and wall-clock efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/jinyuan-cookie/CoSkill.

AI.tldr: CoSkill是一个统一的多智能体强化学习框架，将静态的元技能工作流重构为可学习的元技能智能体，并与推理智能体共享单个骨干网络进行端到端联合训练，实现了技能库与推理策略的协同进化。在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别达到98.4%和90.6%的成功率，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能库范式的结构性缺陷：要么将技能进化与策略优化解耦，要么将元技能实例化为固定工作流，两者都将技能视为被动对象，限制了技能的灵活进化及其与推理智能体的协同适应能力。
AI.method: 提出CoSkill框架，将静态元技能工作流重新定义为可学习的元技能智能体（Meta-Skill Agent），并与推理智能体（Reasoning Agent）在分层技能库上联合训练。两者作为共享单个骨干网络的协作团队，实现端到端协同适应：推理智能体基于检索到的任务技能及其子集步骤技能来条件化动作，同时任务性能反馈指导元技能智能体细化步骤技能。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上，CoSkill显著优于先前的基于技能和强化学习的基线方法，分别达到98.4%和90.6%的成功率（相对提升+3.5和+6.2个百分点）。在早期样本效率、渐近性能和实时效率方面均表现优越。
AI.conclusion: CoSkill通过将技能视为可学习、可进化的动态组件并与推理策略进行协同优化，验证了技能与推理智能体双向适应范式在大规模语言模型智能体强化学习中的有效性，且代码已开源。

title: Compositional Reward Models for Conditional Medical Image Generation
summary:
Acquiring high quality annotated medical image data is critical for training deep learning models; however, annotation is expensive, time consuming, and requires domain expertise. Conditional diffusion models, such as ControlNet, offer an alternative by generating images conditioned on semantic masks and text. However, existing approaches fail to capture fine grained properties (e.g., intensity and texture), as well as semantic consistency expected by domain experts, limiting their effectiveness for downstream tasks. Recent attempts to address these issues using reinforcement learning fine-tuning remain limited due to the reliance on a single scalar reward, which conflates diverse failure modes and provides weak corrective signals. We propose PRISM, a Compositional Reward Model (CRM) framework for conditional medical image generation. Instead of assigning a single reward, we decompose image quality into verifier grounded stages, each evaluating a distinct aspect of correctness from fine to coarse properties, including low level attributes (intensity and texture), structural alignment with conditioning inputs, and high level semantic fidelity. These stage wise rewards are composed through a Hierarchical Constrained Propagation (HCP) mechanism that enforces a fine to coarse notion of correctness, ensuring that lower level deficiencies are resolved before higher level rewards are accrued, preventing easier objectives from masking critical failures.
  We evaluate PRISM across three datasets spanning diverse medical imaging tasks: PanNuke (multi-class cell segmentation), CeDeM (villi/crypt detection and measurement), and ISIC (skin lesion classification). Training downstream models with data generated by PRISM yields improvements over closest baselines, including a 2.3% increase in mDice on PanNuke, a 8.5% reduction in Mean Relative Error (MRE) on CeDeM, and increases ISIC F1 by 5.9%.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个用于条件医学图像生成的组合奖励模型框架，通过将图像质量分解为多个由验证器支撑的阶段级奖励（从细粒度到粗粒度），并采用层次化约束传播机制强制执行"由细到粗"的正确性概念，从而提升医学图像生成质量。在PanNuke、CeDeM和ISIC三个数据集上，使用PRISM生成的数据训练下游模型取得了显著改进（mDice提升2.3%、MRE降低8.5%、F1提升5.9%）。
AI.motivation: 高质量带注释的医学图像数据获取成本高昂且耗时。虽然条件扩散模型（如ControlNet）可以基于语义掩码和文本生成图像，但现有方法无法捕捉领域专家期望的细粒度属性（如强度和纹理）以及语义一致性，而基于强化学习微调的方案因依赖单一标量奖励而混淆不同失败模式、提供弱纠正信号，效果有限。
AI.method: PRISM提出组合奖励模型（CRM）框架，将图像质量分解为验证器支撑的多阶段评估：低层属性（强度与纹理）、与条件输入的结构对齐、高层语义保真度。这些分阶段奖励通过层次化约束传播（HCP）机制组合，强制执行从细到粗的正确性概念，确保底层缺陷先于高层奖励解决，防止容易的目标掩盖关键失败。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的评估显示：PanNuke上mDice提升2.3%，CeDeM上平均相对误差（MRE）降低8.5%，ISIC上F1分数提升5.9%，均优于最接近的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过分解奖励信号并引入层次化约束传播机制，有效解决了单一奖励在医学图像生成微调中的局限，生成的数据能显著提升下游任务的性能，验证了组合奖励建模在条件医学图像生成中的有效性。

title: Beyond Homoscedasticity: Decoupled Uncertainty Optimization for Deep Imbalanced Regression
comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). Main paper with supplementary material
summary: Deep Imbalanced Regression (DIR) is pervasive in continuous prediction tasks across diverse modalities, such as age estimation, depth prediction, and protein mutation activity prediction, where label-scarce tail samples often carry higher practical value. However, most existing methods still learn deterministic point mappings under mean squared error or its simple variants, implicitly assuming a uniform uncertainty level across all samples and thereby overlooking the instance-wise heteroscedasticity that is widespread in long-tailed data. We further point out that even heteroscedastic negative log-likelihood suffers from a gradient coupling issue, which, under DIR scenarios, weakens the learning signal of hard tail samples and leads to optimization inertia as well as tail underfitting. To address this, we propose DUO, an uncertainty-aware long-tailed regression framework. Specifically, the proposed method models the regression target as a conditional Gaussian distribution to explicitly characterize instance-level predictive uncertainty, and transforms uncertainty into a dynamic enhancement signal for tail samples through decoupled mean-variance optimization. Furthermore, we design a distribution-guided contrastive learning mechanism that adaptively constructs positive and negative pairs based on the overlap between sample distributions, thereby alleviating feature looseness and cross-label semantic entanglement. Across visual and biological DIR benchmarks, DUO achieves the best few-shot bMAE and GM on IMDB-WIKI-DIR, AgeDB-DIR, and AAV2-DIR while remaining competitive on few-shot MAE.

AI.tldr: DUO是一个针对深度不平衡回归（DIR）的不确定性感知框架，通过条件高斯分布建模实例级预测不确定性，并将不确定性转化为尾部样本的动态增强信号，同时利用分布引导的对比学习缓解特征松散和跨标签语义纠缠问题，在多个多模态DIR基准上取得最优few-shot性能。
AI.motivation: 深度不平衡回归中尾部样本通常具有更高价值但样本稀缺，现有方法大多采用确定性的点映射（如MSE及其变体），隐含假设所有样本的不确定性水平一致，忽略了长尾数据中广泛存在的实例级异方差性。此外，异方差负对数似然在DIR场景下存在梯度耦合问题，削弱了困难尾部样本的学习信号，导致优化惰性和尾部欠拟合。
AI.method: DUO框架包含三大核心组件：(1) 将回归目标建模为条件高斯分布，显式刻画实例级预测不确定性；(2) 通过解耦的均值-方差优化，将不确定性转化为尾部样本的动态增强信号；(3) 设计分布引导的对比学习机制，基于样本分布之间的重叠度自适应构建正负样本对，从而缓解特征松散和跨标签语义纠缠。
AI.result: 在视觉（IMDB-WIKI-DIR、AgeDB-DIR）和生物学（AAV2-DIR）多个DIR基准上，DUO在few-shot bMAE和GM指标上达到最优，同时在few-shot MAE上也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DUO通过不确定性建模与解耦优化有效解决了长尾回归中的尾部欠拟合问题，验证了不确定性感知机制在深度不平衡回归任务中的有效性。

title: Improving Language Identification for Code-Switched Utterances with Integer Linear Programming
summary: Automatic identification of code-switched (CS) utterances remains a challenge for language identification (LID) systems, causing such texts to be underrepresented in the training data of Large Language Models. In this paper, we revisit MaskLID, a state-of-the art approach for CS identification, which requires no training and detects arbitrary language combinations. We make three main contributions: (a) we reveal, and address, a major issue of MaskLID: its overreliance on word-level language association scores; (b) we reformulate the underlying optimization algorithm as an Integer Linear Program, enabling us to experiment with a large set of clear and interpretable constraints; (c) each of these improvements vastly improves the baseline system, as we illustrate in experiments involving 10~diverse languages, where we observe a strong boost in performance on CS benchmarks. We release our code and data for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了MaskLID这一无需训练的语码转换（CS）语言识别方法，发现并解决了其过度依赖词级语言关联分数的问题，将该优化问题重构为整数线性规划（ILP）以引入清晰可解释的约束，并在10种语言的实验上大幅提升了CS基准性能。
AI.motivation: 语码转换（CS）话语的自动识别对语言识别（LID）系统仍具挑战性，导致这类文本在大型语言模型的训练数据中占比不足。MaskLID作为无需训练且能检测任意语言组合的最先进方法存在一个重要缺陷——过度依赖词级语言关联分数，需要解决这一问题以提升CS识别的准确性。
AI.method: 本文提出了三项主要贡献：(a) 揭示并解决了MaskLID过度依赖词级语言关联分数这一关键问题；(b) 将底层的优化算法重构为整数线性规划（ILP），从而能够实验大量清晰且可解释的约束条件；(c) 通过上述改进在包含10种不同语言的实验中对基准系统进行大幅提升。
AI.result: 在涉及10种不同语言的实验中，本文提出的改进方法在CS基准测试上观察到了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决MaskLID的缺陷并将其优化问题形式化为ILP，所提出的各项改进均大幅优于基线系统，并已发布代码和数据以支持可复现性研究。

title: LLM-Assisted Behavioural and Scenario Augmentation for Agent-Based Energy Adoption Models
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) create opportunities to enrich simulation-based energy policy analysis, particularly by supporting structured behavioural assumptions and exploratory techno-economic scenarios. However, directly replacing adoption models with LLM reasoning raises concerns regarding interpretability, reproducibility, and behavioural validity. This paper proposes a hybrid framework for LLM-assisted specification design, integrating bounded behavioural rubrics and structured scenario specifications into a calibrated agent-based model (ABM) of solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption by Irish dairy farms. The proposed approach preserves the original techno-economic adoption mechanism while augmenting it with bounded behavioural modulation and scenario-driven uncertainty analysis. Behavioural effects are represented through interpretable conservative, balanced, and optimistic rubrics, while future policy and market conditions are explored through fixed, rule-validated scenario specifications. Experimental results across multiple policy settings, Monte Carlo worlds, and random seeds demonstrate stable and economically plausible behaviour, with adoption outcomes remaining bounded and monotonic across behavioural regimes. The framework achieves up to approximately 13% behavioural adoption increase relative to the corresponding logistic case without producing unstable or unrealistic saturation dynamics. The results demonstrate that LLM-assisted specifications can be integrated into calibrated energy ABMs in a controlled, reproducible, and policy-relevant manner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个混合框架，将大语言模型辅助的规范设计（包括有界行为量规和结构化情景规范）整合到爱尔兰奶牛场太阳能光伏采用的校准智能体模型中。该方法保留原始技术经济采用机制，同时通过保守、平衡和乐观量规引入可解释的行为调控，并通过固定、规则验证的情景规范探索未来政策与市场条件。结果在多种政策设置、蒙特卡洛世界和随机种子下表现出稳定且经济合理的行为，行为采用率较逻辑回归基线最多提升约13%，且无不稳定或不现实的饱和动态。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型为能源政策分析中的仿真建模带来机会，但直接用LLM推理替代采用模型会引发可解释性、可复现性和行为有效性问题。因此需要一个混合方法，在不牺牲这些属性的前提下利用LLM的能力。
AI.method: 提出混合框架，包括：1) 将有界行为量规（conservative/balanced/optimistic）与结构化情景规范整合进校准的ABM中；2) 保留原技术经济采用机制，叠加有界行为调制；3) 通过固定且规则验证的情景规范执行策略与市场条件的不确定性分析。
AI.result: 实验在多个政策设置、蒙特卡洛世界和随机种子下展现了稳定且经济合理的行为；采用结果在不同行为制度间保持有界且单调；框架相较对应逻辑回归情形实现约13%的行为采用增长，且未产生不稳定或不现实的饱和动态。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助规范可以以受控、可复现且面向政策的方式整合到校准的能源智能体模型中，为仿真驱动的能源政策分析提供了可行路径。

title: PuTR-CouT: Counting-by-Tracking in Camera-Trap Image Sequences
summary: Species identification in camera trap images has been widely studied, but key ecological modeling tasks such as species abundance or density estimation also require counting individual animals. However, the lack of counting labels in most datasets and low frame rates (typically ~1 frame per second) make sequence-level tracking and count estimation particularly challenging. In this work, we present PuTR-CouT, a counting-by-tracking framework built on a transformer-based learned association mechanism for sequence-level animal counting in camera trap images. To address the scarcity of annotated tracking data, we generate synthetic training data by exploiting structural priors, such as static backgrounds and short temporal bursts, to heuristically create pseudo-tracking labels in a weakly supervised manner. The resulting tracker associates detections across frames, using these tracks to estimate per-species counts. We also refine the MaxBoxCount heuristic used by the top solutions of the iWildCam 2021 challenge as a strong baseline, setting the highest score reported to date. When evaluated on the iWildCam 2021 benchmark, our framework PuTR-CouT delivers competitive counting results compared to the improved MaxBoxCount, with the added capability of multi-species predictions and track-level verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PuTR-CouT框架，一种基于Transformer学习关联机制的counting-by-tracking方法，用于相机陷阱图像中的序列级动物计数。通过利用静态背景和短期时间突发等结构先验生成合成训练数据，以弱监督方式创建伪跟踪标签，从而解决跟踪数据标注稀缺的问题。在iWildCam 2021基准上取得与改进后的MaxBoxCount相当的计数结果，并能进行多物种预测和轨迹级验证。
AI.motivation: 相机陷阱图像中的物种识别已被广泛研究，但关键的生态建模任务（如物种丰度或密度估计）还需要对个体动物进行计数。然而，大多数数据集缺乏计数标签，且低帧率（约1帧/秒）使得序列级跟踪与计数估计极具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出PuTR-CouT计数跟踪框架：(1) 利用结构先验（静态背景、短时间突发）以弱监督方式启发式生成伪跟踪标签，构建合成训练数据以缓解标注数据稀缺；(2) 基于Transformer学习关联机制将跨帧检测进行关联；(3) 利用跟踪轨迹估计每物种数量；(4) 改进iWildCam 2021挑战赛中顶尖方案采用的MaxBoxCount启发式方法，作为强基线。
AI.result: 在iWildCam 2021基准上，PuTR-CouT相比改进后的MaxBoxCount取得了具有竞争力的计数结果，具备多物种预测和轨迹级验证能力；此外，改进的MaxBoxCount基线达到了迄今为止报告的最高分数。
AI.conclusion: PuTR-CouT展示了通过弱监督合成数据和Transformer关联机制解决低帧率相机陷阱图像中序列级动物计数的可行性，能同时支持多物种计数与轨迹验证，为生态建模提供更可靠的计数手段。

title: NS-ST-GraphRAG: Neuro-Symbolic Spatio-Temporal GraphRAG for Literary Knowledge Processing
comment: Submitted to Information Processing and Management
summary: Long-form literary narratives pose a distinctive information-processing challenge for retrieval-augmented generation: relevant evidence is distributed across chapters, relations evolve over narrative time, and correct answers may depend jointly on temporal, spatial, and relational constraints. We propose NS-ST-GraphRAG, a neuro-symbolic spatio-temporal GraphRAG framework that integrates ontology-guided extraction, deterministic constraint checking, dual temporal coordinates, spatial scene attributes, and dynamic sub-graph retrieval. Instead of retrieving from a single corpus-level graph, the framework selects the graph state valid for the temporal and spatial scope of a query and grounds generated answers in traceable evidence. We further introduce Red-Chamber-QA, to our knowledge the first open multi-hop question-answering benchmark for classical Chinese literature, with time-, space-, and general-question categories, per-part evidence spans, and deterministic shortcut controls. On a 120-question held-out split, NS-ST-GraphRAG achieves mechanical answer reproduction of 0.733 versus 0.675 for the frozen window baseline and 0.083 for a closed-book model (McNemar exact p = 0.092, directionally favorable but not significant); semantic-judge accuracy is 0.866 versus 0.850. The pre-specified constrained-category condition of H2 is not supported by the delivered comparison. These results show how temporal graph representation, constrained extraction, and auditable evaluation integrate into a unified framework for verifiable knowledge processing over long-form narrative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NS-ST-GraphRAG，一个面向长篇文学叙事的神经符号时空GraphRAG框架，结合本体引导抽取、确定性约束检查、双时间坐标、空间场景属性和动态子图检索，并引入红学领域首个开放多跳问答基准Red-Chamber-QA。
AI.motivation: 长篇文学叙事为检索增强生成（RAG）带来了独特的信息处理挑战：相关证据分散于各章节、关系随叙事时间演化、正确答案可能同时依赖于时间、空间和关系约束。现有从单一语料级图检索的方法难以处理上述时空动态性。
AI.method: NS-ST-GraphRAG集成了五个关键组件：(1)本体引导抽取（ontology-guided extraction）；(2)确定性约束检查（deterministic constraint checking）；(3)双时间坐标（dual temporal coordinates）；(4)空间场景属性（spatial scene attributes）；(5)动态子图检索（dynamic sub-graph retrieval）。框架根据查询的时间与空间范围选择有效图状态，而非从单一整体图检索，并将生成答案锚定于可追踪证据。同时引入Red-Chamber-QA基准，包含时间类、空间类和一般类问题、每部分证据跨度以及确定性捷径控制。
AI.result: 在120题留出测试集上，NS-ST-GraphRAG的机械答案复现率为0.733，优于冻结窗口基线（0.675）和闭卷模型（0.083）；McNemar精确检验p=0.092，方向有利但未达显著。语义裁判准确率为0.866对0.850。预设的约束类别假设H2未被支持。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明时间图表示、约束抽取与可审计评估如何集成到一个统一框架中，实现长篇叙事上的可验证知识处理。

title: From Interaction Traces to Persistent Skills: Online Evolution for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents can execute increasingly complex tasks in graphical interfaces, but their interaction experience is typically transient: procedural knowledge acquired from one rollout is not systematically retained, refined, and reused in later tasks. Existing skill libraries provide external procedural knowledge, yet their incremental value over the same agent operating without skills, as well as their longitudinal dynamics under repeated interaction, remain insufficiently characterized. We present an online skill-evolution framework that converts interaction trajectories and evaluator feedback into a persistent, versioned library of reusable procedures. Each iteration executes against a frozen library snapshot, and evidence-guided skill updates become available in subsequent iterations without changing model parameters. We compare the full evolving-library system with a configuration-matched empty-library control across four OSWorld application domains under the same fixed action-generation and GUI-grounding stack, task sets, and iteration horizons. Following a five-iteration empty-library warm-up, Full attains a higher post-warm-up mean evaluator score in all four observed domain runs, with mean differences ranging from 5.7 to 18.6 percentage points and domain-dependent temporal stability. In GIMP, provenance-aware analysis reveals retrieval across task-of-origin boundaries and revision churn, where repeated accepted edits fail to recover the originating task. These findings characterize evolving skill libraries as auditable, shared procedural memory that can improve a fixed computer-use stack, while showing that their benefits are conditional and repeated revision does not guarantee recovery. Code is released at https://github.com/LongtaoHu/Skill-Evo4GUI.

AI.tldr: 提出一个在线技能演化框架，将交互轨迹和评估反馈转化为持久化、带版本的可复用技能库。经过五次迭代预热后，完整技能库系统在四个OSWorld应用域中的平均评估分数均高于空库对照组，差异为5.7至18.6个百分点。GIMP中的溯源分析揭示了跨任务技能检索和修订振荡现象。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用代理在图形界面中执行的任务日益复杂，但其交互经验通常是瞬态的：一次rollout中获得的过程性知识未被系统性保留、提炼和在后续任务中复用。现有技能库虽提供外部过程性知识，但其相对于无技能代理的增量价值以及重复交互下的纵向动态尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 提出在线技能演化框架：将交互轨迹和评估者反馈转换为持久的、带版本的可复用过程库。每次迭代在冻结的库快照上执行，证据驱动的技能更新在后续迭代中生效，但模型参数保持不变。采用配置匹配的空技能库作为对照组，在OSWorld四个应用域中使用相同的动作生成和GUI接地栈、任务集及迭代范围进行比较。
AI.result: 经过五次空库预热迭代，完整技能库系统在所有四个域中的预热后平均评估分数均更高，平均差异为5.7至18.6个百分点，且存在领域依赖的时间稳定性。GIMP中的溯源分析揭示了跨任务来源边界的检索和修订振荡，即反复接受的编辑未能恢复原始任务。
AI.conclusion: 演化技能库可被刻画为可审计的、共享的过程性记忆，能够改进固定的计算机使用技术栈；但其收益是有条件的，且重复修订并不保证恢复原始任务。

title: Efficient Multi-Timescale Event Representations for Feed-Forward Object Detection
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Neuromorphic Vision (NEVi) at ECCV 2026, 16 pages
summary: Autonomous systems require robust low-latency perception under rapidly changing scene dynamics and challenging illumination. In event cameras object detection commonly relies on recurrent architectures to accumulate sparse temporal information over time. This work investigates how temporal information can be encoded directly within the event representation. We propose a confidence-normalized continuous multi-timescale representation based on logarithmic B-spline temporal encoding together with a geometry-aware local confidence mechanism that exploits the spatial structure of event generation. Using a fixed feed-forward EventCenterNet detector, we show that the proposed representations consistently outperform the compact CSTR representation on PEDRo and Gen1 datasets. We further introduce a recursive exponential-polynomial approximation that enables efficient event-by-event updates while largely preserving detection performance. These results demonstrate that carefully designed event representations can capture a substantial portion of the temporal information learned through recurrent temporal modeling, providing a promising foundation for efficient feed-forward, event-driven, and future neuromorphic object detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于对数B样条时间编码和几何感知局部置信机制的连续多时间尺度事件表示方法，用于事件相机目标检测。该表示方法在PEDRo和Gen1数据集上使用固定前馈EventCenterNet检测器，持续优于紧凑的CSTR表示，并通过递归指数多项式近似实现逐事件高效更新。
AI.motivation: 自主系统需要在高动态场景和复杂光照条件下进行鲁棒低延迟感知。事件相机中的目标检测通常依赖循环架构来累积稀疏的时间信息，但循环架构计算开销大、延迟较高。作者希望探究如何将时间信息直接编码进事件表示中，从而支持高效的前馈检测架构。
AI.method: 提出一种基于对数B样条时间编码的连续多时间尺度表示法，并引入几何感知局部置信机制来利用事件生成的空间结构。此外，引入递归指数多项式近似实现逐事件高效更新。
AI.result: 在PEDRo和Gen1数据集上，所提出的表示法在使用固定前馈EventCenterNet检测器时持续优于紧凑CSTR表示。递归指数多项式近似在大幅保持检测性能的同时实现了高效的事件级更新。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的事件表示足以捕获循环时间建模所学习的大部分时间信息，为高效的前馈、事件驱动以及未来的神经形态目标检测提供了有前景的基础。

title: Amortizing Scaling Law Construction Costs
summary: Scaling laws guide the design choices for training large foundation models, but deriving them involves training an exhaustive grid over hyperparameters, token budgets, and parameter counts, which is computationally expensive. Fitting a scaling law, however, only requires the best-loss frontier across compute scales, discarding most of the trained configurations. We propose a framework for efficient scaling law construction that formulates data collection as a Bayesian optimization problem, and introduce metrics for comparing scaling law fitting methods under constrained compute budgets. We find that progressively expanding the compute budget during acquisition, mirroring the compute-ordered evaluation of configurations in practice, substantially improves recovery efficiency. Augmenting the observed configurations with surrogate-fantasized evaluations then recovers the broader experimental grid, allowing accurate scaling law fitting without training every configuration. Together, these can closely match scaling law fits over a full dense grid at computational savings of up to $10\text{--}100\times$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的Scaling Law（缩放定律）拟合框架，将数据收集形式化为贝叶斯优化问题，通过渐进扩展计算预算和代理幻想评估技术，在计算成本降低10-100倍的情况下，仍能获得与全密集网格训练相当的缩放定律拟合精度。
AI.motivation: 现有推导缩放定律的方法需要对超参数、token预算和参数量进行穷举网格训练，计算开销极大；然而最终拟合缩放定律仅需要最佳损失前沿，大部分训练配置被丢弃，存在严重的计算浪费。
AI.method: 提出将数据收集过程形式化为贝叶斯优化问题，并引入用于在受限计算预算下比较缩放定律拟合方法的指标。核心技术包括：(1) 在采集过程中渐进扩展计算预算，模拟实践中按计算量排序的配置评估顺序，显著提升恢复效率；(2) 用代理模型的幻想（fantasized）评估结果来扩充观测配置，从而恢复更广泛的实验网格，无需训练所有配置即可精确拟合缩放定律。
AI.result: 该方法在计算成本节省高达10-100倍的情况下，能够紧密匹配在全密集网格上训练的缩放定律拟合结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过贝叶斯优化驱动的智能配置采集与代理增强，可以在大幅降低计算开销的同时保持缩放定律拟合的准确性，为大规模基础模型的缩放定律推导提供了高效的替代方案。

title: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for AI-Assisted Scoring in Large-Scale Writing Assessment
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), into educational assessment has opened new opportunities to enhance the efficiency and scalability of grading processes. This study presents the design and validation of an AI-assisted scoring framework for written responses in a large-scale national assessment. The proposed approach focuses on short written texts of approximately 150-200 words and incorporates a human-in-the-loop strategy to preserve assessment quality while reducing manual workload. The study is grounded in a real operational context, using data from two recent editions of a nationwide test, each comprising approximately 5,000 student responses. We analyze the alignment between AI-generated scores and human raters across multiple rubric dimensions, as well as the impact of the proposed decision flow on pass/fail outcomes. Results show moderate to high agreement between the model and human evaluations in most dimensions, supporting the feasibility of AI assistance in this setting. Moreover, the proposed correction workflow identifies cases where human review is most valuable, enabling a more efficient allocation of expert effort. The findings suggest that AI-assisted scoring can be safely integrated into large-scale assessment processes only when combined with carefully designed human oversight. The paper concludes by discussing practical implications for deployment in national assessment systems and outlining future research directions, including longitudinal monitoring of model-human alignment and the analysis of potential cognitive bias introduced by AI-supported review workflows.

AI.tldr: 本研究设计并验证了一个AI辅助评分框架，用于全国性大规模评估中的短文写作评分（约150-200字），采用人在环路策略在保持评估质量的同时减少人工工作量。基于两届国家级考试约5000份学生作答数据，结果表明模型与人类评分者在多数维度上达到中高度一致，校正工作流能有效识别最需要人工复核的案例，但AI评分的安全生产需配合精心设计的人类监督机制。
AI.motivation: 将AI（尤其是大语言模型）整合到教育评估中可提升评分的效率与可扩展性，大规模国家级评估中的人工作业负担亟待减轻，同时需要保证评估质量不受损害。
AI.method: 提出一个AI辅助评分框架，针对约150-200字的短文写作，采用人在环路（human-in-the-loop）决策策略。使用两届国家级考试数据（各约5000份学生作答）在实际运行环境中验证，分析AI评分与人类评分者在多个评分维度上的一致性，并评估决策流程对通过/未通过结果的影响。
AI.result: AI模型与人类评分者在大多数评分维度上表现出中到高度的一致性；所提出的校正工作流能够有效识别最需要人工复核的案例，从而更高效地分配专家审查资源；验证了AI辅助评分在该场景下的可行性。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助评分只有在辅以精心设计的人类监督机制时才能安全地整合进大规模评估流程。论文讨论了在国家评估系统中部署的实际意义，并提出了未来研究方向，包括模型-人类一致性的纵向监测以及AI支持审查工作流可能引入的认知偏差分析。

title: CHAMP: Cross-domain Hybrid Architecture for Matchmaking and Prediction in Online Multi-Player Games
summary:
Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) games rely on matchmaking to maintain competitive balance. Our prior work, CUPID, framed matchmaking as an assignment re-optimization problem and showed that a single-mode win-rate predictor can meaningfully rebalance teams. However, deploying such a system across diverse player populations exposes three practical bottlenecks: most queueing players lack sufficient in-mode match history (cold start), skill distributions shift drastically across rank tiers (distribution inconsistency), and extreme skill segments are severely data-starved.
  We present CHAMP, a cross-domain matchmaking framework that resolves these deployment bottlenecks. To address data sparsity and cold starts, CHAMP replaces the target-mode-only player profile with a hybrid domain feature collection: a timestamp-ordered cross-mode short-term sequence whose slices are annotated with target-domain features, plus per-mode breakdowns of long-term, real-time and team statistics. We further propose the Domain-Aware Win-rate Network (DAWN): a Domain-aware Knowledge Extractor (DAKE) compiles target-mode attributes into learnable representations that feed Domain-Aware Temporal/Spatial/Permutation OmniNet Encoders (DATOE/DASOE/DAPOE), so that mode-conditioned representations and per-mode debiasing are learned jointly inside a single shared network. Online, one trained DAWN serves every supported mode, with per-mode position-satisfaction thresholds as the only mode-specific knob.
  Offline, DAWN achieves 67.73% win-rate prediction accuracy, outperforming all evaluated attention and sequence baselines. Online A/B tests across the entire League ladder of a large-scale MOBA game, from novice players up to the top-expert players served by Elite Mode, demonstrate consistent drops in imbalanced matches. For lower-tier players, CHAMP reduces the 5-minute kill crushing rate by up to 20.73%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHAMP，一个跨域（跨模式）MOBA游戏匹配框架，解决实际部署中单一模式胜率预测器的三大瓶颈：冷启动、分布不一致和数据匮乏。核心是DAWN网络（Domain-Aware Win-rate Network），通过领域感知知识提取器和OmniNet编码器，在不同游戏模式间共享训练，实现单网络为所有模式服务的匹配重平衡。
AI.motivation: 先前的CUPID系统将匹配问题建模为分配再优化，但实际部署到多样化玩家群体时面临三个瓶颈：（1）大多数排队玩家的目标模式对战历史不足（冷启动问题）；（2）技能分布在不同段位间变化剧烈（分布不一致）；（3）极端技能段位的数据严重不足（数据匮乏）。这些问题限制了单一模式胜率预测器在真实场景中的应用效果。
AI.method: CHAMP框架的核心方法包括：（1）采用混合域特征构建：用户画像从仅目标模式替换为时间戳排序的跨模式短期序列（片段带目标域标注）加上各模式的长/短期、实时和团队统计分解；（2）提出DAWN网络：DAKE将目标模式属性编译为可学习表征，馈入三种OmniNet编码器（时间/空间/排列），在同一共享网络内联合学习模式条件化表征和逐模式去偏；（3）在线部署时，单个训练好的DAWN即可服务所有支持的模式，仅需调整逐模式位置满意度阈值。
AI.result: 离线实验中DAWN达到67.73%的胜率预测准确率，优于所有评估的注意力和序列基线。在大型MOBA游戏整个排位天梯的在线A/B测试中（从新手到顶级专家玩家所用的Elite模式），各组别均出现不平衡对局的一致下降。对低段位玩家，CHAMP将5分钟击杀碾压率降低了最高20.73%。
AI.conclusion: CHAMP通过跨模式知识共享有效地解决了MOBA匹配系统的冷启动、分布不一致和数据匮乏问题，验证了跨域方法在真实大规模游戏部署中的可行性，且单模型多模式架构带来了部署上的简洁性和效率。

title: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Temporal Modeling for Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
summary: As the scale of video surveillance data outpaces manual annotation capacities, weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD) has emerged as a critical research frontier. Most existing approaches formulate WSVAD within a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that relies on rigid, hand-crafted temporal priors to supervise anomaly scoring. However, such formulations exhibit limited adaptability to the wide variation in anomaly durations and temporal dynamics observed in real-world videos, often leading to unstable or unreliable snippet-level predictions. To address this limitation, we propose an adaptive temporal modeling framework for WSVAD that explicitly accounts for variations in video dynamics across multiple temporal granularities. First, we introduce a Temporal Refinement Module (TRM) that leverages dynamic positional encoding and a learnable class token to model long-range temporal dependencies while distilling a stable global video-level representation. Second, to capture anomalous events with varying frequency and duration, we develop an adaptive Event Segmentation Module (ESM) that identifies event boundaries through temporal discontinuity analysis and aggregates snippet features into discriminative event-level representations. Finally, for snippet-level and event-level predictions, we propose an adaptive similarity-based fusion strategy that dynamically integrates anomaly scores into video-level predictions, replacing fixed top-k aggregation heuristics with global semantic relevance. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向弱监督视频异常检测（WSVAD）的自适应时序建模框架，通过时序细化模块（TRM）和自适应事件分割模块（ESM）从多时间粒度捕捉异常事件，并以基于语义相似度的动态融合策略替代传统top-k聚合，在两个基准数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有WSVAD方法多基于多实例学习（MIL）框架，依赖刚性手工设计的时序先验来监督异常评分，难以适应真实视频中异常事件时长与动态变化范围大、差异多的特点，导致片段级预测不稳定或不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 提出时序细化模块（TRM）：利用动态位置编码和可学习类别token建模长程时序依赖，并蒸馏出稳定的全局视频级表示。2) 提出自适应事件分割模块（ESM）：通过时序不连续性分析识别事件边界，将片段特征聚合为判别性事件级表示，以捕捉不同频率和时长的异常事件。3) 提出自适应相似度融合策略：基于全局语义相关性动态整合片段级与事件级异常分数到视频级预测，替代固定的top-k聚合启发式。
AI.result: 在两个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的框架性能始终优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过多时间粒度自适应的建模方式，有效缓解了传统MIL框架对刚性时序先验的依赖，为弱监督视频异常检测提供了更稳健且适应真实视频动态变化的新方案。

title: Confounding-Valid Conformal Inference for Counterfactual KPIs in Wireless Networks
summary: Conformal counterfactual inference enables network operators to use logged telemetry to reliably answer 'what-if' questions about network operation. These answers typically take the form of prediction sets that contain, with a user-defined probability, the key performance indicators (KPIs) that would have been observed under alternative control actions. A key challenge is that logged telemetry may omit variables used by the controller, resulting in hidden confounding and invalidating the statistical guarantees of counterfactual analysis. In principle, this issue can be addressed using randomized telemetry, collected by assigning control actions independently of the network state. However, because such randomization may disrupt normal operation, randomized telemetry is typically scarce, causing counterfactual analysis based solely on it to produce uninformative prediction sets. To address these challenges, we propose Confounding-Valid Counterfactual Conformal Inference (CV-CCI), which combines abundant, potentially confounded observational telemetry with limited randomized data through the General Synthetic-Powered Inference (GESPI) principle. CV-CCI leverages observational data to improve efficiency while using randomized data to retain finite-sample coverage guarantees under arbitrary hidden confounding. Experiments on two representative radio access network (RAN) control tasks show that CV-CCI remains valid under hidden confounding while producing more efficient prediction sets than state-of-the-art confounding-valid baselines.

AI.tldr: CV-CCI通过GESPI框架结合观测遥测数据与有限的随机化数据，在任意隐藏混淆下提供有限样本覆盖保证的反事实推断预测集，同时提高效率。
AI.motivation: 网络运营商需要利用日志遥测数据进行反事实推断（"what-if"问题），但日志数据常省略控制器使用的变量导致隐藏混淆，使统计保证失效。虽然随机化遥测可以解决该问题，但因其会干扰正常运营而数量稀缺，仅基于随机化数据会生成信息量不足的预测集。
AI.method: 提出Confounding-Valid Counterfactual Conformal Inference (CV-CCI)，基于General Synthetic-Powered Inference (GESPI)原理，将大量可能混淆的观测性遥测数据与有限的随机化数据结合。利用观测数据提升效率，同时通过随机化数据保证在任意隐藏混淆下的有限样本覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在两个代表性无线接入网(RAN)控制任务上的实验表明，CV-CCI在隐藏混淆下保持有效性，且生成的预测集比最先进的混淆有效基线更高效（更紧凑）。
AI.conclusion: CV-CCI为存在隐藏混淆的反事实推断提供了一种具有严格覆盖保证且高效的方法，有效平衡了观测数据的丰富性与随机化数据的可靠性的权衡。

title: From Vision to Language: Investigating Causal Information Flow in Multimodal Decision-Making
summary: Vision-Language Models are commonly evaluated through their final predictions, but understanding whether these decisions are grounded in visual evidence requires tracing how visual information contributes to language-based decisions. With this purpose in mind, we investigate cross-modal information flow in a video-based generative multiple-choice-like setting by applying a layer-wise causal intervention on video-text attention pathways. We target spatial, causal, and temporal visual reasoning. Our results show that visual information is mainly integrated while the model processes the candidate answer options, which serve as the primary textual grounding sites for the final decision. We further show that nouns play an important role as semantic anchors during multimodal enrichment, while verbs are more relevant when temporal relations are processed. Finally, we identify a distinct pattern in temporal reasoning, suggesting that VLMs struggle to reconstruct sequential information across video frames, but we remark that such fragility may also reflect linguistic biases associated with specific temporal expressions used for defining the relation between events within a scene.

AI.tldr: 本文通过逐层因果干预视频-文本注意力路径，研究视频语言模型（VLM）中跨模态信息流如何支持基于视觉证据的决策。研究发现视觉信息主要在处理候选答案选项时被整合，名词作为语义锚点起关键作用，动词在时间关系处理中更为相关；同时发现VLM在跨帧重建时序信息方面存在脆弱性，可能反映时间表达相关的语言偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM评估多聚焦于最终预测结果，缺乏对决策是否真正基于视觉证据的理解。作者旨在追溯视觉信息如何贡献于基于语言的决策，揭示模型中跨模态信息流的机制。
AI.method: 采用逐层因果干预方法，在视频生成式多项选择设置中扰动视频-文本注意力通路，针对空间、因果和时间三种视觉推理类型进行系统分析。
AI.result: 视觉信息主要在模型处理候选答案选项时被整合，答案选项是最终决策的主要文本锚定位置；名词在多模态信息丰富过程中是重要语义锚点，动词在处理时间关系时更为关键；时间推理呈现独特模式，VLM难以跨视频帧重建顺序信息，但此脆弱性可能包含特定时间表达相关的语言偏差影响。
AI.conclusion: VLM的视觉证据整合具有结构选择性（集中在答案选项处理阶段），且不同词性与不同推理类型存在功能分工。时间推理的脆弱性提示需要区分模型架构局限与语言先验偏差的影响。

title: AutoLR: Automating the Path from Research to Launch Review in Industrial Recommender Systems
summary: Improving an industrial recommender is an iterative research-and-engineering process rather than a direct path from idea to deployment. In \textbf{DASHEN, NetEase's gaming-community app}, algorithm engineers typically identify promising directions from research papers, technical reports, and prior production experiments; reproduce or adapt the underlying methods; implement them in the production codebase; and evaluate the resulting models through training and offline experiments. Promising candidates are then advanced to online A/B tests, and those demonstrating robust gains are submitted to Launch Review---the internal gate for full-traffic rollout. Large language models (LLMs) can assist with individual stages of this workflow, but the overall process remains human-dependent without a harness that can reliably coordinate them across long-running, often multi-day experimental cycles. We present \textbf{AutoLR}, initially built as \textbf{Auto Launch Review} and later extended upstream into an autonomous research-to-launch harness. AutoLR combines three system mechanisms: a \textbf{multi-expert council} that debates and adversarially reviews proposals; a \textbf{deterministic evidence-weighted exploration--exploitation selector} that allocates a limited trial budget across candidate directions and uses Council reranking; and a layered knowledge system that combines external research, production-system knowledge, and DASHEN-specific domain knowledge---such as game communities, player characteristics, and content-interaction patterns---with posterior evidence from configurations, patches, logs, failures, and offline outcomes. LLM agents perform semantic reasoning and code generation, while deterministic controllers retain authority over execution, metric extraction, guardrails, and persistent state transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍AutoLR，一个由NetEase为其游戏社区应用DASHEN开发的自主"研究到上线"（research-to-launch）自动化框架。AutoLR将工业推荐系统的迭代流程（从论文调研、方法复现、离线实验到在线A/B测试和Launch Review）自动化，通过多专家委员会辩论评审、确定性证据加权探索-利用选择器以及分层知识系统三个核心机制，结合LLM代理的语义推理与代码生成能力和确定性控制器的执行管控，实现了整个推荐模型迭代周期的自主运行。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统的改进本质上是一个长期的迭代式研究与工程过程，涉及从研究论文/技术报告中识别方向、复现或改造方法、集成到生产代码库、离线评估、在线A/B测试直到Launch Review审批的完整流程。虽然大语言模型（LLM）可以在个别阶段提供辅助，但整个流程仍然高度依赖人工协调，尤其是在跨越数天的多轮实验循环中缺乏可靠的整体管控机制（harness）。因此需要构建一个能自主协调各阶段、覆盖完整研究到上线链路的自动化系统。
AI.method: AutoLR包含三大系统机制：(1) 多专家委员会（multi-expert council）——通过辩论和对抗性审查来评估候选提案；(2) 确定性证据加权探索-利用选择器——在有限试验预算内分配资源，并利用委员会重排序；以及(3) 分层知识系统——整合外部研究文献、生产系统知识和DASHEN特定领域知识（如游戏社区、玩家特征、内容交互模式），并结合来自配置、补丁、日志、故障和离线结果的后验证据。系统架构上，LLM代理负责语义推理和代码生成，而确定性控制器保留对执行、指标提取、安全护栏和持久状态转移的最终权威控制。
AI.result: 论文展示了AutoLR从最初仅支持Launch Review阶段（Auto Launch Review）逐步向上游扩展到完整研究到上线链路的演进过程。该系统的设计目标是可靠地协调LLM在各实验阶段的工作，实现跨多日实验周期的自主运行，最终帮助工业推荐团队在模型迭代过程中减少人工依赖的同时保持严格的质量控制和风险评估。
AI.conclusion: AutoLR代表了LLM驱动的自动化在工业推荐系统研发流程中的系统性应用，其核心思想是"让LLM做聪明的推理，让确定性系统做可靠的执行"——通过多专家辩论提升决策质量、确定性选择器合理分配试验预算、分层知识系统提供充分的上下文支撑，从而将原本高度依赖人工协调的研究到上线的迭代过程转化为可自主运行的闭环系统。

title: MultiAttenGastro: Multi-Dimensional Attention Augmentation for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Classification
summary: Automated gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy classification requires models that generalize across diverse modalities and class distributions, often far from natural-image pretraining. We propose MultiAttenGastro, a plug-and-play attention framework with parallel 1-D channel, 2-D spatial, and 3-D contextual heads, and present the first systematic cross-dataset evaluation across eight CNN and transformer backbones on five public GI datasets (80 backbone--dataset runs). We find that attention effectiveness is not universal but tracks the representational gap between ImageNet features and the target distribution: MultiAttenGastro improves 6 of 8 backbones on Kvasir-Capsule (14-class WCE, large gap; best macro F1 98.33\%), is uniformly negative on the small-gap Kvasir-v2 benchmark (0/8), and shows mixed outcomes on datasets with intermediate gap. Five-seed ablation on the strongest case (Kvasir-Capsule, ConvNeXt-Tiny) shows this improvement is directionally consistent, but not statistically decisive (paired $t$: $p=0.47$; Wilcoxon: $p=0.63$), and that individual attention heads are not uniformly beneficial in isolation only their combination yields a positive mean effect. Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) analysis links this pattern to representational redundancy: low inter-head CKA under large domain gaps coincides with the framework's only consistent gains, while high redundancy under small gaps coincides with its losses. We report these results, including the non-significant margins, as evidence for when and why multi-dimensional attention helps GI endoscopy classification, rather than as a claim that MultiAttenGastro is a strictly superior architectural choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MultiAttenGastro，一个并行1-D通道、2-D空间和3-D上下文头的即插即用注意力框架，并在5个公开GI内镜数据集、8个CNN和Transformer骨干上进行了首次系统性的跨数据集评估（共80次骨干-数据集组合）。研究发现注意力有效性并非普遍适用，而是与ImageNet特征和目标分布之间的表征差距相关：在大差距数据集（Kvasir-Capsule）上改善6/8骨干，在小差距基准（Kvasir-v2）上对8/8骨干均有害。五种子消融实验显示改善方向一致但统计上不显著（p=0.47/0.63），CKA分析将其归因于表征冗余度。
AI.motivation: 胃肠道内镜分类通常遇到包含多种模态和类别分布的场景，与自然图像预训练特征差异大。现有的注意力机制多基于自然图像领域开发，其对GI内镜任务的适用性缺乏系统性验证，因此需要回答"多维注意力在何种条件下、为何能帮助GI内镜分类"这一关键问题。
AI.method: 提出MultiAttenGastro框架，包含并行的一维通道注意力头、二维空间注意力头和三维上下文注意力头。在5个公开GI数据集上、对8种CNN与Transformer骨干进行交叉数据集系统评估（80次骨干-数据集运行），并通过五种子的消融实验和Centered Kernel Alignment（CKA）分析来量化表征冗余与注意力有效性的关系。
AI.result: MultiAttenGastro在Kvasir-Capsule（14类WCE，大表征差距）上改善了8个骨干中的6个，最优macro F1达98.33%；在小差距的Kvasir-v2基准上对全部8个骨干均为负面效果；在中间差距数据集上结果混合。五种子消融显示性能提升方向一致但统计上不显著（配对t检验p=0.47，Wilcoxon p=0.63），且单个注意力头单独使用时并非普遍有益，仅三者组合产生正向平均效应。CKA分析表明大领域差距时低层间CKA对应一致性增益，小差距时高冗余对应性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 多维注意力的有效性取决于预训练特征与目标领域之间的表征差距，而非一种普遍严格的架构优势。作者诚实报告了包含统计不显著边界的全部结果，将其作为理解"何时以及为何"多维注意力有助于GI内镜分类的证据，而非主张MultiAttenGastro是严格更优的架构选择。

title: Deep Microcompression: Structured Pruning and Bit-packed Quantization for Microcontrollers
comment: Presented at the Global South ML Workshop at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026), Seoul, South Korea
summary: This paper introduces Deep Microcompression (DMC), a hardware-aware pipeline for deep learning inference on bare-metal microcontrollers. DMC integrates structured pruning, quantization-aware training, and fixed-length bit-packing to achieve a 55.8$\times$ weight compression ratio on LeNet-5 (98.77\% accuracy), generating a dependency-free C library with deterministic latency. On the RP2040 (Cortex-M0+), DMC reduces binary size by 3$\times$ versus TensorFlow Lite while matching its accuracy. Critically, DMC enables the first documented deployment of a standard CNN on the ATmega328P, a device constrained to 2KB SRAM, previously considered infeasible for CNN inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deep Microcompression (DMC)，一种面向裸机微控制器的硬件感知深度学习推理流水线，集成结构化剪枝、量化感知训练和定长位打包技术，在LeNet-5上实现55.8倍权重压缩比（98.77%准确率），首次实现标准CNN在仅2KB SRAM的ATmega328P上的部署。
AI.motivation: 裸机微控制器（特别是资源极度受限的设备如ATmega328P，仅2KB SRAM）此前被认为无法进行CNN推理，现有框架如TensorFlow Lite在Cortex-M0+级别的处理器上仍占用过大二进制体积，亟需一种硬件感知的压缩流水线使深度学习推理在极低资源环境下成为可能。
AI.method: DMC包含三个核心组件：结构化剪枝（structured pruning）、量化感知训练（quantization-aware training）和定长位打包（fixed-length bit-packing），三者协同实现在不影响精度的前提下最大化权重压缩；最终生成无依赖的C库，提供确定性延迟特性。
AI.result: 在LeNet-5上实现55.8倍权重压缩比且准确率达98.77%；在RP2040（Cortex-M0+）上，与TensorFlow Lite相比二进制体积减少3倍且准确率持平；首次成功在ATmega328P（2KB SRAM）上部署标准CNN，突破了此前认为不可行的资源瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: DMC证明了通过精心设计的硬件感知压缩流水线，标准CNN可以在极端资源受限的裸机微控制器上高效运行，显著拓展了TinyML的部署边界。

title: Compression Beyond the Uncompressed: A Two-Stage Training Recipe for Soft Context Compression in RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances language models with external knowledge, but the lengthy retrieved context inflates the input and degrades inference efficiency. Soft context compression encodes each document into a substantially shorter embedding sequence. However, most existing approaches are trained by distilling outputs from uncompressed RAG systems, inherently limiting their performance relative to the original model. To address this limitation, we propose DEX-Comp, a two-stage training recipe: Pure Distillation warm-starts the compression model on the uncompressed RAG's correct responses only, and Hard Exploration then runs reinforcement learning solely on queries the uncompressed RAG fails, forcing the model to explore computation patterns better suited to compressed representations. On five open-domain QA benchmarks at retrieval depths from top-5 to top-30, DEX-Comp compresses retrieved contexts by $16\times$ and accelerates inference by $4\times$--$24\times$, while achieving performance comparable to or exceeding the uncompressed RAG baseline across retrieval depths. Ablations and evaluations across diverse datasets and backbones further confirm the contribution of each stage and the generalization of our approach.

AI.tldr: DEX-Comp是一种两阶段训练策略，用于软性上下文压缩的检索增强生成（RAG）。它通过"纯蒸馏"从无压缩RAG的正确响应中预热压缩模型，再通过"硬性探索"（强化学习）仅针对无压缩RAG失败的查询进行训练，使模型探索更适合压缩表示的计算模式。在五个开放领域QA基准上，DEX-Comp实现16倍上下文压缩和4-24倍推理加速，同时性能达到或超过无压缩RAG基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的RAG系统虽然通过外部知识增强了语言模型，但冗长的检索上下文会导致输入膨胀、推理效率下降。软性上下文压缩（将每个文档编码为更短的嵌入序列）是一种解决方案，但大多数现有方法通过蒸馏无压缩RAG系统的输出来训练，这从本质上限制了其性能上限，使其无法超越原始模型。因此需要一个不局限于蒸馏压缩模型性能的新的训练方法。
AI.method: 提出了DEX-Comp两阶段训练配方：(1) 纯蒸馏（Pure Distillation）阶段：仅使用无压缩RAG产生正确响应的查询来预热压缩模型；(2) 硬性探索（Hard Exploration）阶段：仅针对无压缩RAG失败的查询运行强化学习，强迫压缩模型探索更适合压缩表征的计算模式，从而超越蒸馏带来的性能瓶颈。
AI.result: 在五个开放领域问答基准上，在top-5到top-30的检索深度下，DEX-Comp将检索上下文压缩16倍，推理速度提升4-24倍，同时性能与无压缩RAG基线相当或更优。消融实验和跨数据集及不同骨干模型的评估进一步验证了每个训练阶段的贡献和方法的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将训练从蒸馏"正确响应"扩展到针对"失败查询"的强化学习探索，DEX-Comp突破了传统蒸馏压缩方法无法超越原始RAG系统的性能限制，实现了高效率与高性能的兼得。

title: MARLA: A Conceptual Scaffold for Regulatory Learning under the EU AI Act
summary: The EU AI Act positions regulation as part of the infrastructure for safe, trustworthy and market-ready innovation. Realising this ambition requires regulatory learning: the evidence generated during implementation must be translated into governance and legal knowledge that supports consistent interpretation, effective oversight, and adaptation as technologies evolve. Yet the actors who produce this evidence and those who rely on it operate in different professional worlds. This paper proposes MARLA (Map, Assess, Report, Learn, Adapt), a conceptual scaffold organising regulatory learning as a five-stage cycle centred on the implementation of legal requirements into socio-technical practices, situated at the Local, National and European levels of the AI Act's governance architecture. Deliberately non-prescriptive, MARLA gives technical and legal stakeholders a shared vocabulary in which each of the first three stages generates its own documentable form of regulatory learning. We illustrate the scaffold with two piloted case studies and a prospective National-to-European illustration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MARLA概念框架，将AI法案下的监管学习组织为五个阶段循环（Map, Assess, Report, Learn, Adapt），旨在为技术和法律利益相关者提供共享词汇，将实施过程中产生的证据转化为治理和法务知识。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案将监管定位为安全、可信、市场就绪创新的基础设施，实现这一目标需要监管学习——实施中产生的证据必须转化为支持一致解释、有效监督和技术演进的治理与法律知识。然而，产出证据的行动者与依赖这些证据的行动者处于不同的专业世界，缺乏共享的沟通框架。
AI.method: 提出MARLA（Map, Assess, Report, Learn, Adapt）概念性脚手架，将监管学习组织为五个阶段循环，聚焦于法律要求向社会实践实施的转化，并定位于AI法案治理架构的地方、国家和欧洲三个层面。框架刻意保持非规定性，前三个阶段各自生成可记录形式的监管学习。通过两个试点案例研究和前瞻性的国家到欧洲说明进行验证。
AI.result: MARLA为技术和法律利益相关者提供了共享词汇，案例研究和说明展示了该框架在实际场景中的适用性，表明其能够帮助跨越专业世界之间的鸿沟，实现AI法案架构不同层级间的监管学习。
AI.conclusion: MARLA作为非规定性的概念脚手架，有潜力促进欧盟AI法案框架下监管学习的系统性组织，弥合技术与法律利益相关者之间的沟通差距，支持AI治理架构在地方、国家和欧洲层面的适应与演进。

title: Training-Free Logical and Structural Anomaly Detection via Calibrated Fusion
summary: Industrial anomaly detection must handle two distinct defect families: structural anomalies, which manifest as local texture corruptions, and logical anomalies, which violate global rules on object count, composition, or arrangement. Existing detectors typically favor one family at the expense of the other. In particular, training-free methods effectively exploit frozen representations but lack an explicit notion of object count, while methods that reason about counts usually rely on category-specific component modeling. We show that counting ability can be introduced into training-free anomaly detection without additional training or part-level supervision. Our key idea is a normal-set calibration that aligns heterogeneous anomaly cues using statistics from normal images, enabling their direct fusion within a unified training-free framework. Built upon this calibration, our detector combines complementary frozen cues to address both logical and structural anomalies. On MVTec-LOCO, our method achieves image-level AUROCs of 89.0 and 95.9 on logical and structural anomalies, respectively, yielding a 92.5 average---the best among training-free detectors in our comparison. It remains competitive with methods requiring network training or part annotations, while its structural variant matches PatchCore on MVTec-AD (99.1 image-AUROC), suggesting that the proposed calibration generalizes beyond logical anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练、无需部件级标注的工业异常检测框架，通过"正常集校准"技术将计数能力引入训练无关检测器，统一融合异构异常线索，同时处理逻辑异常（违反全局规则）和结构异常（局部纹理损坏）。在MVTec-LOCO上达到图像级AUROC 92.5的平均值，在训练无关检测器中表现最优，并与需网络训练或部件标注的方法竞争力相当。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测需同时处理两类缺陷：结构异常（局部纹理损坏）和逻辑异常（违反物体数量、构成或排列等全局规则）。现有检测器往往顾此失彼——训练无关方法能有效利用冻结表示但缺乏对物体数量的显式建模，而能推理数量的方法又通常依赖类别特定的部件建模。因此需要一个统一框架同时兼顾两类异常。
