We show that complex scenes with hundreds of objects can instead be generated compositionally by adapting a strong single-object 3D generative prior to multi-view observations. We instantiate this paradigm with Pixal3D, extending it with a multi-view conditioning pathway that grounds object generation in multiple posed observations. Although the model is finetuned entirely on single objects in canonical space, it generalizes to large scenes with severe occlusion without any scene-level training, demonstrating the feasibility and scalability of this paradigm. We further introduce UE-MeshyScene, a photorealistic benchmark of densely cluttered scenes with hundreds of objects, per-object annotations, and ground-truth meshes. Across single-object, controlled multi-object, and UE-MeshyScene evaluations, our method consistently outperforms prior approaches, with larger gains as scene complexity and occlusion increase. Finally, we demonstrate broader applicability by converting generated 3DGS worlds, such as Marble and HY-World 2.0, into compositional mesh scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单物体3D生成先验的自适应方法，通过多视角条件分支将强大的单物体生成先验（Pixal3D）扩展用于合成包含数百个物体的杂乱3D场景，无需场景级训练即可生成组合式物体网格，并引入了UE-MeshyScene基准测试验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 杂乱场景中数百个物体严重相互遮挡，每个视角仅暴露部分几何信息，导致现有几何重建方法在遮挡区域产生不完整几何，而现有组合式生成方法受限于较简单的场景，缺乏可扩展到密集复杂场景的组合3D表示生成方法。
AI.method: 将Pixal3D这一强大的单物体3D生成先验扩展为多视角条件范式，增加多视角条件通路使物体生成锚定于多个姿态观测，模型仅需在规范空间的单物体上微调，无需场景级训练即推广到大场景；同时引入UE-MeshyScene，一个包含数百物体、逐物体标注和真实网格的照片级密集杂乱场景基准。
AI.result: 在单物体、受控多物体和UE-MeshyScene三个设定下均一致优于先前方法，且场景复杂度和遮挡程度增加时提升更大；此外成功将Marble和HY-World 2.0等3DGS世界转换为组合式网格场景。
AI.conclusion: 证明了"单物体生成先验+多视角观测条件"这一范式在组合构建密集杂乱场景方面具有可行性和可扩展性，可实现大规模场景的组合式网格重建，且推广性良好。

title: Large Language Models for HVAC Operations in Building Energy Systems: A Critical Review of Methods, Applications, and Deployment Readiness
comment: 38 pages, 9 figures, 16 tables. Submitted to Energy and Buildings
summary: Building automation systems generate rich sensor data yet remain insight-poor because heterogeneous point naming, missing metadata, and fragmented documentation obstruct their operational use. This systematic review analyses and codes 66 peer-reviewed studies on large language models (LLMs) for HVAC operations published between 2023 and March 2026. Each study is classified across five application families and three LLM method families and assessed for evidence realism, deployment readiness, and the responsibility boundary between the LLM and physical HVAC decisions. The corpus is concentrated in building energy modelling (BEM, 32 of 66 papers), while load forecasting remains too sparse for subfield-level conclusions. Only four studies reach pilot-level evidence, and none reports sustained operational deployment. No study was classified as ready-now for industry adoption; three were near-term and 63 research-only. Nevertheless, several bounded, human-in-the-loop uses merit near-term trials, including point-name normalisation, document-grounded operator support, BEM workflow assistance, and advisory interfaces around physics-based controllers. Conventional machine learning (ML), model predictive control (MPC), reinforcement learning (RL) and ontology-based tools remain more adopted for high-frequency control, short-horizon numerical forecasting, and well-posed ontology mapping, while autonomous agentic operation and unvalidated occupant proxies remain research-stage. Current evidence therefore supports LLMs primarily as semantic and workflow layers rather than autonomous HVAC controllers. Future work should prioritise field-validated benchmarks, orchestration evaluation under operational constraints, and LLM-MPC/RL architectures with bounded latency and verifiable safety properties.

AI.tldr: 本文对2023年至2026年3月间66篇关于暖通空调运营中大语言模型（LLM）应用的同行评审研究进行了系统综述与编码分析，从五大应用家族和三大LLM方法家族进行分类，评估了证据真实性、部署就绪度以及LLM与物理供暖空调决策之间的责任边界。研究发现语料集中于建筑能耗建模（BEM，66篇中占32篇），仅有4项研究达到试点级证据，没有任何研究报告持续的实际部署；尽管暂无研究可直接应用于工业，但若干有边界的人机协作用途（如点名称标准化、文档驱动的运维支持、BEM工作流辅助及物理控制器咨询界面）值得近期试验验证。证据支持LLMs主要作为语义层和工作流层而非自主HVAC控制器。
AI.motivation: 建筑自动化系统产生丰富的传感器数据，但由于异构的点命名、缺失的元数据和零散文档，这些数据未能得到有效利用，导致系统"数据丰富但洞察贫乏"。作者旨在系统地审视LLMs在暖通空调运维中的研究现状，厘清哪些应用已成熟、哪些仍处于研究阶段，为行业应用提供循证指导。
AI.method: 采用系统综述方法，对2023年至2026年3月间发表的66篇同行评审研究进行筛选和分析。每项研究按五大应用家族（如建筑能耗建模、负荷预测等）和三大LLM方法家族进行分类，同时评估：证据真实性（实验室vs现场）、部署就绪度（研究级/近期级/现成级）、以及LLM与物理HVAC决策之间的责任边界。
AI.result: 语料集中在建筑能耗建模（BEM）领域（66篇中占32篇），负荷预测因样本过少无法得出子领域结论。仅有4项研究达到试点级证据，无研究报告持续的实际运营部署。按就绪度评估：0项"现成可用"，3项"近期可用"，63项仅限研究。现有较成熟且可近期试验的用途包括：点名称标准化、文档驱动的运维支持、BEM工作流辅助和基于物理控制器的咨询接口。而传统ML、MPC、RL和基于本体的工具在高频控制、短时程数值预测和良定义的本体映射方面仍然应用更广，自主代理操作和未经验证的室内人员代理仍处于研究阶段。
AI.conclusion: 当前证据支持将LLMs定位为"语义层和工作流层"而非自主HVAC控制器。未来研究应优先开展现场验证基准测试、操作约束下的编排评估，以及具有有界延迟和可验证安全属性的LLM-MPC/RL混合架构。

title: The Mirror Agent Model: a Bayesian Architecture for Interpretable Agent Behavior
comment: Accepted at the International Workshop on Explainable, Transparent Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems, 2022
summary: In this paper we illustrate a novel architecture generating interpretable behavior and explanations. We refer to this architecture as the Mirror Agent Model because it defines the observer model, that is the target of explicit and implicit communications, as a mirror of the agent's. With the goal of providing a general understanding of this work, we firstly show prior relevant results addressing the informative communication of agents intentions and the production of legible behavior. In the second part of the paper we furnish the architecture with novel capabilities for explanations through off-the-shelf saliency methods, followed by preliminary qualitative results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"镜像智能体模型"(Mirror Agent Model)的新型架构，通过将观察者模型定义为智能体自身的镜像，从而生成可解释的行为和解释。架构结合了前人关于意图信息通信和可读(legible)行为生成的研究成果，并利用现成的显著性方法(saliency methods)赋予架构解释能力，提供了初步的定性实验结果。
AI.motivation: 智能体(agent)在与人类或其他观察者交互时，不仅需要完成任务，还需要通过显式和隐式通信让他人理解其意图和行为。现有方法在生成可解释行为和解释方面存在局限，作者希望通过一种架构化的方式系统性地解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出Mirror Agent Model架构，将观察者模型定义为智能体自身的"镜像"，以此对齐双方的心智模型。架构首先整合了先前关于智能体意图信息通信和可读行为生成的成果，然后在此基础上引入现成的显著性方法(saliency methods)，为架构新增生成解释(explanation)的能力。
AI.result: 通过初步的定性实验结果展示了该架构在生成可解释行为及配套解释方面的可行性，验证了将观测者模型作为智能体镜像的设计思路，以及结合显著性方法生成解释的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Mirror Agent Model为构建具备可解释性和解释生成能力的智能体提供了一种通用架构框架，未来可在此基础上进一步深化交互场景下的行为可读性与解释质量研究。

title: Technical Manual for a Toolkit for Measuring Contextual Individuation in Transformer Language Models
comment: 29 pages, 2 figures (one with 2 subfigures), 1 table. Toolkit, source code, and corpora archived separately on Zenodo (see Section 9)
summary: A transformer language model assigns a single, context-independent vector to a word type at its embedding layer, yet is widely believed to individuate that word's occurrences by context in its later layers. Testing this belief cleanly requires a construct that holds the word form fixed while its context and intended sense vary in a controlled, labeled way. This manual documents an open toolkit built around such a construct, which we call a bridge form: a single written word that recurs, unchanged, across two or more subject domains with a different sense in each. We describe, and justify, every stage of the pipeline: the declarative specification of bridge forms and their source domains, corpus acquisition from Wikipedia, occurrence localization, layer-wise representation extraction, a domain-pairwise silhouette measurement of separation in the model's representation space, and a paired visualization protocol. Each design choice is presented together with the methodological failure mode it is meant to avoid (sense contamination from overly broad category labels, the multi-group bias of the silhouette coefficient, subword-tokenization misalignment, and axis-comparability artifacts in dimensionality-reduced plots, among others). This manuscript is a methodological and implementation reference: it does not report or interpret empirical outcomes of running the toolkit on any particular model or bridge-form set. The toolkit, its full source, and the corpora used to exercise it are archived separately (Section 9) under a persistent identifier, and are intended to be cited as an instrument by studies that use it to produce and interpret empirical results.

AI.tldr: 本文档记录了一个开放工具包的完整方法论与实现细节，该工具包围绕"桥梁形式"（bridge form）——即在多个主题领域中以不同词义重复出现的同一书写词——来检验Transformer语言模型是否在深层中按上下文区分词义。全文不报告实证结果，仅作为方法论参考。
AI.motivation: Transformer语言模型在嵌入层为每个词类型分配单一且与上下文无关的向量，但被广泛认为在深层按上下文区分词义。要干净地检验这一信念，需要一个在词形固定不变前提下、其上下文和意图词义以受控且有标注方式变化的构造。现有研究缺乏这样的标准化工具和构造。
AI.method: 整条流水线包括：桥梁形式及其源领域的声明式规范、从维基百科获取语料、出现位置定位、逐层表示提取、领域成对的轮廓系数（silhouette）测量以度量模型表示空间中的分离度，以及配对可视化协议。每个设计选择都与其要避免的方法论失效模式一一对应，包括：过于宽泛类别标签导致的词义污染、轮廓系数的多组偏差、子词分词错位、降维图中的轴可比性伪影等。
AI.result: 本文不报告或解读在特定模型或桥梁形式集上运行工具包得到的实证结果。工具包、完整源码及用于测试的语料将在独立存档中以持久标识符归档，供使用其产生和解读实证结果的研究作为工具引用。
AI.conclusion: 本文旨在作为方法论与实现参考文档，不提供实证结论。其核心贡献在于：提出"桥梁形式"这一受控构造，并交付一套完整、可复现、每步设计都有明确失效模式规避理由的开源工具包，以支撑后续对语言模型上下文词义个体化能力的实证研究。

title: What Matters in On-Policy Distillation? A Perspective on Data Efficiency and Data Selection
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely adopted post-training paradigm for enhancing large language models in reasoning domains. However, the data-centric mechanisms in OPD remain relatively underexplored. This paper presents a empirical study of data efficiency and data selection in OPD. We begin by investigating an extreme setting: training OPD on only one example, namely 1-shot OPD. Surprisingly, we find that 1-shot OPD is consistently effective across all sampled training examples and harder examples often yield superior performance gain. We next investigate what actually drives the student model's improvement in the training data. Our analysis reveals that the improvement is not driven by high token entropy, but the longer CoT paths which hard problems naturally generate. Training on longer CoT can help maintain closer alignment with the teacher over a long reasoning horizon, and learn critical thinking patterns usually missing in short CoTs, such as reflection (e.g., ``Alternatively''). Based on these insights, we propose a simple data selection method that selects only hard examples for training, where even ``unsolvable'' examples that completely exceed the teacher's capability can be successfully used. Our experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 7B show that training the student model on only 8 selected hard examples matches the performance of the 17K dataset baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文对推理领域的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）进行了实证研究，发现仅用一个样本训练（1-shot OPD）即可有效，且更难的样本带来更大提升。通过分析揭示提升并非源于高token熵，而是长思维链（CoT），并据此提出仅选择困难样本的简单数据选择方法——仅用8个精选困难样本即可匹配17K数据集的性能。
AI.motivation: OPD已成为增强大语言模型推理能力的广泛采用的训练后范式，但其数据中心的机制（如数据效率和选择）尚未得到充分探索。理解什么驱动学生模型在OPD中的提升，以及如何高效选择训练数据，对于提升训练效果和降低数据成本具有重要意义。
AI.method: 首先构建极端设定——1-shot OPD（仅用一个样本训练），在所有采样样本上验证有效性并对比不同难度样本的效果；随后通过分析揭示模型提升的真正驱动因素（对照token熵和CoT长度）；基于这些发现提出仅选择困难样本（包括超出教师能力的"不可解"样本）的简单数据选择方法。
AI.result: 1-shot OPD在所有采样训练样本上一致有效，且更难的样本带来更高的性能增益。模型提升的真正驱动因素是更长的CoT路径（而非高token熵），长CoT有助于保持与教师在长推理范围内的对齐并学习反思等关键思维模式。在四个规模1.5B至7B的模型上，仅用8个精选困难样本训练即可匹配17K数据集基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: OPD的数据效率远高于常规认知——极少量数据甚至8个样本即可达到大型数据集的效果。困难样本（含超出教师能力的样本）是更优的训练数据选择，长CoT带来的推理模式学习是关键机制，为推理蒸馏中的数据选择提供了新的实用指导。

title: Does Your Agent's Memory Survive a Model Upgrade? A Controlled Study of Memory Portability
summary:
Model upgrades are routine; memory migrations are not. An agent can keep the same memory store and still forget: a new model may interpret old notes differently, mixed embedding versions may break retrieval, and repair may fail without the original evidence. We compare memory as the same history is preserved verbatim for long-context reading (LC-RAW), divided into chunks for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), compressed by a model into natural-language notes (NOTES), or normalized into a fixed-schema knowledge graph (KG-fixed). The study uses 48 synthetic histories with randomized answer codes, exact scoring, and two open-weight models with sub 10 billion parameters.
  Our measurements show that fixed-schema structures transfer reliably, with KG-fixed accuracy changing by only $+0.0004 \pm 0.0020$ following a writer swap. Conversely, compressed NOTES exhibit high model coupling, with accuracy shifting asymmetrically by $+9.91$ or $-13.28$ percentage points depending on the specific migration direction. In RAG systems, partial embedding migrations using a 50/50 mixed index capture only a 4.96-point accuracy improvement, forfeiting the majority of the 11.90-point gain achieved through full re-embedding. Diagnostic decomposition attributes 80% ($0.467 \pm 0.014$) of the NOTES accuracy deficit to information lost during initial construction, whereas retrieval failures drive 81% ($0.364 \pm 0.012$) of the RAG deficit. Finally, store-only repair of NOTES fails to reach a 90% performance recovery target in all 48 test cases, whereas retaining the raw source history enables successful recovery in 34 of 48 cases for one tested direction. These findings highlight the necessity of direction-specific migration testing, strict embedding space isolation, and the retention of source histories for memory repair.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了模型升级时智能体长期记忆的可迁移性问题。通过对比四种记忆存储格式（原始长文本、分块RAG、自然语言笔记、固定模式知识图谱）在模型替换后的表现，发现固定模式结构（KG-fixed）迁移最稳定，压缩笔记（NOTES）表现出强烈的模型耦合性，部分嵌入迁移的RAG损失大部分收益，且仅靠存储修复无法达到目标恢复率。
AI.motivation: 模型升级是常态但记忆迁移尚未被系统研究。即使保留相同存储，新模型可能以不同方式解读旧笔记，混合嵌入版本可能破坏检索，且修复时缺少原始证据可能导致失败。作者希望系统性地评估不同记忆表示格式在模型替换后的迁移鲁棒性。
AI.method: 使用48条合成历史记录，包含随机化答案编码和精确评分。比较四种记忆格式：LC-RAW（长文本逐字保留）、RAG（分块检索增强生成）、NOTES（模型压缩为自然语言笔记）、KG-fixed（固定模式知识图谱归一化）。使用两个参数量低于100亿的开源模型进行writer swap实验，测量迁移前后的准确率变化。
AI.result: KG-fixed迁移最稳定（准确率仅变化+0.0004±0.0020）；NOTES表现出高模型耦合性，准确率不对称变化+9.91或-13.28个百分点；RAG的50/50混合嵌入索引仅捕获4.96点的改进，远低于完整重嵌入的11.90点增益。诊断分解表明NOTES的80%缺陷源于初始构建信息丢失，RAG的81%缺陷源于检索失败。store-only修复在所有48个案例中均未达到90%恢复目标，而保留原始历史在34/48个案例中成功恢复。
AI.conclusion: 固定模式知识图谱是模型迁移中最可靠的记忆格式。研究强调需要进行方向特定的迁移测试、严格的嵌入空间隔离，以及保留原始源历史以实现记忆修复。压缩记忆（NOTES）的模型耦合性意味着模型升级可能导致不对称的准确率变化。

title: CABAL: Multi-Agent Simulacra for Tracing the Effects of Collusive Bidding in Peer Review
summary: Recent reports during the AAAI-27 review cycle highlight the risk of reviewers coordinating bids for reciprocal assignment advantage. Prior work treats bidding, reviewer assignment, and review manipulation as separate stages, leaving the lifecycle effects of collusive bidding unclear. Real-world analysis is further constrained by typically unobservable collusive intent and the lack of counterfactuals for the same conference. Motivated by this gap, we introduce \alg, an end-to-end multi-agent simulacra framework for studying reviewer assignment integrity by holding the conference environment fixed and configuring LLM-driven reviewer agents with honest or collusive policies. We further develop an affinity-guided collusive bidding strategy that uses mutual reviewer-paper affinities to construct collusion rings and select target papers, producing expertise-consistent rather than arbitrarily targeted attacks. Controlled experiments show that collusive bidding more than doubles target-paper capture and that assigned colluders score target papers about two points higher than honest co-reviewers, while conference-wide effects remain comparatively modest. Evaluated bid-phase detectors provide only limited evidence of collusion: in a fixed-triplet detector stress test, native positive-bid graphs are confounded by benign affinity, while a Very-High-only diagnostic view enables precise but low-coverage local recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文引入一个端到端多智能体模拟框架，通过在固定会议环境下配置具有诚实或共谋策略的LLM驱动审稿人智能体，研究共谋竞标对审稿人指派完整性的全生命周期影响。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将竞标、审稿人指派和审稿操纵视为独立阶段，缺乏对共谋竞标全生命周期效应的研究；真实世界分析受限于共谋意图通常不可观测以及同一会议缺乏反事实数据。
AI.method: 提出一个端到端多智能体模拟框架，保持会议环境固定，配置具有诚实或共谋策略的LLM驱动审稿人智能体；并开发了一种亲和力引导的共谋竞标策略，利用审稿人-论文相互亲和力构建共谋环并选择目标论文，产生与专业水平一致而非任意目标的攻击。
AI.result: 受控实验表明共谋竞标使目标论文捕获率翻倍以上，被指派的共谋者给目标论文的评分比诚实共审人高约两分，而会议层面的影响相对温和；现有竞标阶段检测器只能提供有限的共谋证据。
AI.conclusion: 在固定三元组检测器压力测试中，原生正向竞标图被良性亲和力混淆，而仅使用Very-High诊断视图可实现精确但低覆盖率的局部恢复，表明当前检测方法对亲和力引导的隐蔽共谋检测能力不足。

title: Multi-Step Tool-Calling over Korean Open Public APIs: A Benchmark and a Data-Synthesis Recipe
comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 26 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: Data-sovereignty regulations increasingly require public institutions to deploy open-source, on-premise LLM agents that chain multiple tool-calls across live government APIs. However, open-source models consistently underperform in this multi-step setting, and no existing benchmark measures the gap. We introduce the Korean Open Public API Benchmark (KOPA-Bench), comprising 145 real-world tasks. To close this gap, we present EDGE, an Execution-grounded Dynamic Graph for tool-calling data synthEsis driven by live execution. EDGE builds a graph of how each tool's output can feed another's input, keeps only the links that succeed when actually called against the live APIs, and traverses these verified links to synthesize executable multi-step trajectories. Fine-tuned via GRPO on the resulting dataset, our 9B model nearly matches the untuned 27B model from the same family, improving substantially not only on KOPA-Bench but also on the BFCL benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出韩国开放公共API基准（KOPA-Bench，含145个真实任务）来衡量开源LLM agent在政府API多步工具调用中的表现差距，并提出EDGE（基于实时执行验证的工具调用数据合成方法），通过动态图遍历已验证的链接生成可执行的多步轨迹，用GRPO微调9B模型使其性能接近未调优的27B模型。
AI.motivation: 数据主权法规要求公共机构部署本地开源、支持多步工具调用的LLM agent，但现有开源模型在此场景下性能不佳，且缺乏专门衡量该差距的基准。
AI.method: EDGE框架：构建展示工具输出如何作为另一工具输入的工具调用动态图，在实时API调用中对链接进行验证，仅保留实际执行成功的连接，再遍历这些验证过的链接合成可执行的多步轨迹数据；使用GRPO对9B模型进行微调。
AI.result: 微调后的9B模型几乎媲美同系列未微调的27B模型，且在KOPA-Bench和BFCL基准上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: EDGE通过基于实时执行验证的数据合成方法，有效缩小了开源小模型与更大模型在多步工具调用场景下的性能差距，且具有跨基准的泛化能力。

title: ACE: Adaptive Calibration-Free Expert Skipping for MoE-based LLMs
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures provide an efficient paradigm for scaling large language models (LLMs), yet fixed top-k routing activates the same number of expert slots for every token, causing substantial redundant computation. Existing expert-skipping methods often rely on router confidence, calibration data, or additional training, and therefore cannot reliably estimate the actual contribution of routed experts. To this end, we propose ACE, a training-free, calibration-free, and checkpoint-preserving framework for token-adaptive expert skipping in MoE-based LLMs. ACE contains two complementary components: 1) Global Spectral Proxy (GSP), which estimates global transformation capacity from the coupled gate, up, and down projections together with RMSNorm scaling; and 2) Router-Conditioned Refinement (RCR), which constructs expert-specific direction prototypes from centered router weights and evaluates expert responses along routing-preferred directions. During inference, ACE combines both estimates with runtime router gates and skips an expert slot only when both views identify it as low-contribution, while always retaining the top-1 expert. All expert statistics are computed offline, leaving only table lookups and lightweight scalar operations online. Extensive experiments across three MoE-based LLMs and eight benchmarks demonstrate that ACE consistently outperforms existing static and dynamic baselines, with increasingly pronounced advantages under aggressive expert skipping. For instance, at a 50% skipping ratio on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, ACE reduces WikiText-2 perplexity by 7.96% and improves average downstream accuracy by 4.15 percentage points over the strongest competing method.

AI.tldr: ACE是一个训练-free、校准-free且保持检查点的框架，用于MoE大语言模型中的token自适应专家跳过。它通过全局谱代理（GSP）和路由器条件精炼（RCR）双视图估计专家贡献，仅当两种视图都判定专家低贡献时才跳过该专家槽位，同时始终保留top-1专家。在三个MoE模型和八个基准上的实验表明，ACE在激进跳级下显著优于现有静态和动态基线。
AI.motivation: 固定top-k路由对每个token激活相同数量的专家槽位，导致大量冗余计算。现有专家跳过方法依赖路由置信度、校准数据或额外训练，无法可靠估计被路由专家的实际贡献。
AI.method: ACE包含两个互补组件：1）全局谱代理（GSP），从耦合的gate、up和down投影结合RMSNorm缩放估计全局变换能力；2）路由器条件精炼（RCR），从中心化路由器权重构建专家特定方向原型，并沿路由偏好方向评估专家响应。推理时将两种估计与运行时路由器门控结合，仅当两种视图都识别专家为低贡献时跳过该槽位，始终保留top-1专家。所有专家统计离线计算，在线仅需表查找和轻量标量运算。
AI.result: 在三个MoE大语言模型和八个基准上的实验表明，ACE持续优于现有静态和动态基线，在激进专家跳过下优势更加显著。例如在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上以50%跳级率，ACE将WikiText-2困惑度降低7.96%，平均下游准确率提升4.15个百分点，超过最强的对比方法。
AI.conclusion: ACE通过双视图互补的贡献估计策略，实现了一个无需训练、无需校准数据、保持检查点的token自适应专家跳过框架，在保证性能的同时大幅减少MoE推理计算量，为MoE模型的高效推理提供了新的思路。

title: Substrate-Aware AI Agents: Execution Context as a First-Class Input
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Reproducibility artifacts and source-linked evaluation code: https://github.com/manu2/Context-Aware-Agent-Experiment
summary: Autonomous AI agents increasingly select actions in environments whose memory, execution-time, runtime, compute, and operational constraints determine what counts as a suitable plan. We call the absence of this execution context from an agent's planning state substrate blindness. We test this general proposition through numerical code generation, where selected implementation choices and operational consequences are directly observable. Three frontier model configurations--Anthropic Claude Opus 5, OpenAI GPT-5.6-Sol, and Google Gemini 3.7 Flash--generate code for a high-dimensional pairwise Euclidean-distance task either from the task alone or with a 128 MB RAM and 10.0 s wall-time contract. Contract disclosure reduced measured peak process memory in 13 of 14 executable index-aligned task-only versus contract-disclosed comparisons and reduced mean wall time in all three cohorts, making execution up to 3.1x faster. Across the audited corpus, disclosure produced structural code changes including bounded blocking, float32 retention, upper-triangle traversal, and in-place or memory-mapped buffers. At a tighter 96 MB contract, independently sampled contract-disclosed cohorts achieved correct-and-within-budget outcomes of 4/5 for Claude Opus 5, 5/5 for GPT-5.6-Sol, and 3/5 for Gemini 3.7 Flash, compared with task-only outcomes of 0/5, 1/5, and 0/5; cohort mean MaxRSS and wall time were 49-74% and 35-64% lower than their task-only references. These results establish a controlled proof of concept for substrate-aware agent planning: a minimal execution contract induces proactive structural adaptation in generated programs, shifting computation away from unconstrained allocations and substantially improving observed resource-time profiles before execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"基底盲区"(substrate blindness)概念，指自主AI代理在规划时未考虑执行环境的记忆、运行时和计算约束。通过数值代码生成实验验证：当向三个前沿模型(Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6-Sol、Gemini 3.7 Flash)披露128MB RAM和10秒墙钟时间的执行契约后，生成的代码发生结构性适应(如内存映射缓冲、上三角遍历等)，峰值内存和运行时间显著降低，执行速度最高提升3.1倍，证明了"基底感知式代理规划"(substrate-aware agent planning)的可行性。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理在真实环境中进行动作选择时，其所处环境的记忆、运行时、计算和操作约束决定了什么才算合适的计划，但这些执行上下文通常未被纳入代理的规划状态。现有研究忽视了这种"执行基底"缺失对代理规划质量的影响。
AI.method: 以高维成对欧氏距离数值代码生成任务为受控测试平台，对三种前沿模型配置分别进行两组实验：仅基于任务描述生成代码vs.附带128MB RAM和10.0秒墙钟时间契约条件生成代码。随后在96MB更紧契约下进行独立采样验证，测量峰值进程内存(MaxRSS)、墙钟时间及代码结构性变化。
AI.result: 在14组可执行的索引对齐比较中，契约披露使13组的峰值进程内存降低；三组队列平均墙钟时间均降低，执行速度最高提升3.1倍。96MB契约下，Claude Opus 5为4/5、GPT-5.6-Sol为5/5、Gemini 3.7 Flash为3/5达成正确且在预算内，而任务仅描述组分别为0/5、1/5、0/5。队列平均MaxRSS和墙钟时间分别降低49-74%和35-64%。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了基底感知式代理规划(即"执行基底感知")的受控概念验证：最小化的执行契约披露能诱导生成程序产生前瞻性的结构适应，将计算从无约束的内存分配中转移出去，在代码执行前就显著改善资源-时间特征，说明将执行上下文纳入代理规划状态是可行的且有效的。

title: Uncensored Open-weight Models: Redistribution as the Persistence Layer
summary: A rapidly expanding ecosystem of actors is removing built-in safety guardrails from open-weight AI models. We profile this ecosystem by identifying key producers, downstream reproductions, and emerging applications. Between January 2024 and March 2026, we identified 3,471 original uncensored models on HuggingFace, each repackaged an average of 2.4 times; three actors account for 52% of all 8,164 compressed redistributions. Once quantized and mirrored across separate accounts, formats, and registries such as Ollama, these models persist regardless of upstream removal and become easier to deploy downstream. Of the 1,643 identified GitHub applications integrating uncensored large language models (ULLMs), 25% were classified as explicitly malicious.

AI.tldr: 本文对去除开放权重AI模型安全护栏的生态系统进行了系统性的画像分析。研究发现，2024年1月至2026年3月期间，HuggingFace上识别出3,471个原始"无审查"模型，平均每个被重新打包2.4次；三个主要参与者占据了全部8,164次压缩再分发的52%。经量化并镜像到不同账户、格式和注册表（如Ollama）后，这些模型即使上游被删除也能持续存在并更易部署。在1,643个集成无审查大语言模型的GitHub应用中，25%被明确归类为恶意。
AI.motivation: 随着开放权重AI模型日益普及，去除安全护栏的做法形成了一个快速扩张的生态系统，但目前缺乏对这一生态系统的系统性画像。理解其生产源头、传播路径和恶意应用对于制定有效的治理策略至关重要。
AI.method: 通过大规模数据收集与分类，对HuggingFace上2024年1月至2026年3月的无审查模型进行溯源，识别关键生产者、下游再生产和新兴应用；对GitHub上集成无审查LLM的应用进行恶意分类标注。
AI.result: 识别出3,471个原始无审查模型，平均每个被重新打包2.4倍；三个核心参与者贡献了52%的全部8,164次压缩重分发。量化压缩与跨账户/格式/注册表镜像导致模型在内容移除后仍持续存在。在1,643个GitHub集成应用中，25%被明确分类为恶意。
AI.conclusion: 去除安全护栏的开放权重模型已形成一个集中化生产、高度可复制传播的生态系统，其模型具有较强持久性（去中心化镜像）且存在显著的恶意应用比例，对现有内容移除与治理手段构成系统性挑战。

title: Do LLMs Exhibit Coherent Knowledge Structures in Mathematical Reasoning? A Perspective from Knowledge Space Theory
summary: Human knowledge is inherently structured and interdependent: mastery of a concept requires prior mastery of its prerequisites, a principle formalized by Knowledge Space Theory (KST). While LLMs achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, it remains unclear whether they exhibit coherent, human-like knowledge structure. We introduce a KST-grounded framework for evaluating LLM knowledge structure in mathematical reasoning, using it as a normative framework to analyze whether LLM behavior adheres to principled knowledge dependencies. Evaluating eight open- and closed-source LLMs against real human learners, we find that (1) LLMs do not adhere to human knowledge structure -- they frequently violate knowledge dependencies and fail to leverage related knowledge provided in context to improve performance on dependent questions; (2) LLMs do not share a consistent knowledge structure among themselves, as reflected by low overlap in their knowledge distributions. Furthermore, these structural deficiencies remain largely invisible to accuracy-based and LLM-as-judge evaluations. Together, our results provide behavioral evidence that current LLMs knowledge does not follow a human-like structure.

AI.tldr: 本文基于知识空间理论（KST）评估LLM在数学推理中的知识结构，发现LLM既不符合人类的知识依赖结构，也不共享一致的知识结构，且这些缺陷难以通过准确率或LLM-as-judge评估检测。
AI.motivation: 人类知识具有结构性——掌握一个概念需要先掌握其前置概念（由KST形式化）。尽管LLM在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但其是否具备连贯的、类似人类的知识结构仍未明确。作者希望以KST为规范框架来检验LLM行为是否遵循原理性的知识依赖关系。
AI.method: 引入一个KST支撑的评估框架，用于评估LLM在数学推理中的知识结构。对8个开源和闭源LLM与真实人类学习者的表现进行对比分析，检验LLM是否遵守知识依赖关系、能否利用上下文中的相关知识来提升依赖问题的表现，以及不同LLM之间知识分布的重叠程度。
AI.result: （1）LLM不遵循人类知识结构：频繁违反知识依赖关系，无法利用上下文中提供的相关知识改善对依赖问题的作答；（2）LLM之间缺乏一致的知识结构，知识分布重叠度低。并且这些结构性缺陷在基于准确率和LLM-as-judge的评估中基本不可见。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM的知识不具备类似人类的结构化组织，该结构性缺陷是传统准确性评估所无法捕获的，提示需要专门的结构性评估维度来衡量LLM的推理与知识掌握质量。

title: A Unified Physics-Aware Quantum Machine Learning Framework across Power GaN HEMTs and Logic Nanowire FETs: Predicting Unseen Process Splits and Held-Out Geometry Combinations with Lower Error and Tighter Split-to-Split Variability
summary: We present a unified reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that discovers compact parametrized quantum circuits (PQCs) for data-scarce device modeling. A graph neural network (GNN) policy optimized by proximal policy optimization (PPO) searches circuit architectures using leave-one-group-out cross-validation (LOGOCV) error on held-out process or geometry groups as the reward. The framework achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) on all 11 targets versus six classical baselines, with 59% lower error (Ioff) and 81% tighter fold variability (VTH) for HEMTs and 84% lower error (VTH, SS, Ioff) and 82% tighter fold variability (Ioff) for NWFETs. These results demonstrate the potential of RL-selected, classically simulated PQCs as compact surrogates with low OOD error and improved physical consistency, despite imposing no explicit physical constraints, penalty terms, or device-specific equations, on the two evaluated device datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的强化学习（RL）框架，通过图神经网络策略和近端策略优化（PPO）自动搜索紧凑参数化量子电路（PQC），用于数据稀缺的器件建模。在11个目标上，该框架以留一组交叉验证（LOGOCV）误差作为奖励，全面优于六个经典基线模型，在HEMT和NWFET器件上分别实现了59%-84%的误差降低和81%-82%的折叠变异性改善。
AI.motivation: 半导体器件建模数据稀缺且物理机理复杂，传统经典基线模型和人工设计的量子电路难以在少量数据下实现高精度且具备外推（OOD）能力的紧凑代理模型，亟需一种自动化搜索紧凑参数量子电路的方法。
AI.method: 采用统一的强化学习框架：使用图神经网络（GNN）作为策略网络，通过近端策略优化（PPO）进行训练，搜索PQC电路架构；以留一组交叉验证（LOGOCV）误差（对held-out工艺或几何组）作为奖励信号来优化电路结构。
AI.result: 在全部11个目标上取得最低平均绝对误差（MAE），相对于六个经典基线：HEMT器件上Ioff误差降低59%、VTH折叠变异性收紧81%；NWFET器件上VTH、SS、Ioff误差降低84%、Ioff折叠变异性收紧82%。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习选择的、经典模拟的PQC可作为紧凑的代理模型，具备低OOD误差和改善的物理一致性，且无需施加显式物理约束、惩罚项或器件特定方程，在两个评估的器件数据集上得到验证。

title: Commonsense Reasoning in Computer Vision: Foundations, Recent Advancements, and Future Directions
summary: Commonsense reasoning in computer vision encompasses integrating visual data and contextual knowledge, crucial for enhancing AI's understanding of everyday scenarios. This understanding not only improves machine learning models but also enhances their ability to interact meaningfully with humans and the environment. Unlike CNN-based conventional vision models, which are designed to identify objects within a specific image, incorporating commonsense knowledge enables models to interpret scenes in a more holistic manner, thereby improving their spatial ability to reason about relationships among objects and actions. This integration not only enhances object recognition but also facilitates a deeper understanding of the contextual factors, ultimately leading to more precise predictions and interactions in real-world applications. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of recent developments that integrate commonsense knowledge into computer vision tasks. We systematically review approaches based on knowledge graphs, scene graphs, neuro-symbolic models, and commonsense-augmented transformers. We also outline current limitations related to dataset bias, knowledge incompleteness, and integration challenges. Finally, we highlight prospective research trajectories in cross-modal reasoning, scalable commonsense knowledge injection, and neuro-symbolic hybrid architectures to develop truly intelligent visual systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于计算机视觉中常识推理的综合综述论文，系统回顾了将常识知识整合到视觉任务中的最新进展，涵盖基于知识图谱、场景图、神经符号模型和常识增强Transformer的方法，并指出了当前局限性及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 传统基于CNN的视觉模型仅能识别图像中的特定物体，缺乏对场景的整体理解能力。将常识知识融入视觉模型能够使其以更全面的方式理解场景，提升对物体间关系和动作的空间推理能力，从而更精确地进行预测和交互。作者希望通过系统综述推动该领域的发展。
AI.method: 本文采用系统综述方法，将近期将常识知识整合到计算机视觉任务中的方法分为四大类进行梳理：基于知识图谱的方法、基于场景图的方法、神经符号模型方法以及常识增强的Transformer方法，并在此基础上总结当前存在的限制与挑战。
AI.result: 文章归纳了四类主要的常识-视觉融合方法的研究进展，识别出当前面临的三项核心挑战：数据集偏见、知识不完整性和整合困难，并指出了跨模态推理、可扩展常识知识注入和神经符号混合架构三个未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 常识推理的引入对于构建真正智能的视觉系统至关重要。虽然已有多种方法在该方向上取得进展，但仍需解决数据集偏见、知识不完整等限制，未来应聚焦于跨模态推理、可扩展的常识知识注入以及神经符号混合架构，以突破当前瓶颈。

title: Trace2Tower: Transition-Aware EigenTrace Induction of Multi-Level Skills for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on execution traces to master complex interactive tasks. However, current paradigms are bottlenecked by shallow trajectory retrieval and flat skill summarization, fundamentally ignoring the temporal dependencies and outcome-conditioned topology of agent behavior. We introduce Trace2Tower, a transition-aware EigenTrace framework that distills raw trajectories into a robust skill hierarchy. Trace2Tower abstracts step-level interactions into canonical events, constructing a unified graph governed by semantic compatibility, transition dynamics, and outcome evidence. Through a novel contrastive spectral decomposition, it isolates stable, success-aligned behavioral modes while rigorously suppressing failure-prone shortcuts. These modes organically populate a dynamic skill tower of action templates, procedural routines, and overarching task strategies, continuously refined via verifier-guided feedback. On ALFWorld, Trace2Tower achieves 87.31% success requiring only 10.35 steps and 0.26 invalid actions; on WebShop, it reaches 50.67% exact success. Across both benchmarks, Trace2Tower significantly outperforms existing baselines in task mastery and context-efficient experience reuse.

AI.tldr: Trace2Tower是一个基于EigenTrace的过渡感知框架，通过对比谱分解将原始轨迹蒸馏为分层技能体系，在ALFWorld和WebShop上显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体依赖于执行轨迹来掌握复杂交互任务，但当前范式受限于浅层轨迹检索和扁平技能总结，从根本上忽略了智能体行为的时间依赖性和结果条件化拓扑结构。
AI.method: Trace2Tower将步骤级交互抽象为规范事件，构建由语义兼容性、转移动态和结果证据共同调控的统一图结构；通过新颖的对比谱分解，分离出稳定且与成功对齐的行为模式，同时严格抑制易失败的捷径；这些模式有机地填充动态技能塔（动作模板、程序例程、总体任务策略），并通过验证器引导的反馈持续优化。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld上达到87.31%成功率，仅需10.35步和0.26次无效动作；在WebShop上达到50.67%精确成功率；在两个基准上均显著优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: Trace2Tower在任务掌握和上下文高效的经验重用方面均显著优于现有基线，验证了其过渡感知的层次化技能蒸馏方法在大语言模型智能体中的有效性。

title: AI for Computational Design Science: A Responsible Human-AI Framework and Case Study on Short-Form Video Safety Surveillance
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming not only what information systems researchers design, but also how design research is conducted. Yet existing literature offers limited guidance for computational design science (CDS) when AI actively participates in problem formulation, resource construction, design search, evaluation, and knowledge abstraction. We develop AI for Computational Design Science (AI4CDS), a five-phase methodological framework in which AI expands problem and design search while researchers retain responsibility for domain grounding, admissibility, verification, and scientific judgment. Collaboration is governed by graduated trust, reversibility, auditability, and differentiated reproducibility. We instantiate AI4CDS through ChildRiskGuard, an interpretable artifact for detecting short-form videos inappropriate for children, while documenting AI interactions, rejected alternatives, corrections, and audit trails. The case translates audience-dependent safety and explanation faithfulness into three technical challenges and develops an artifact that separates generic from child-specific risk, represents distinct developmental-risk mechanisms, and makes concept-level explanations part of the predictive computation. ChildRiskGuard achieves an F1 score of 0.769, substantially outperforming direct application of a general-purpose content-safety model while remaining competitive with strong benchmarks. The primary contribution is AI4CDS as a responsible framework for AI-enabled CDS; ChildRiskGuard provides process and artifact evidence of how AI-expanded, researcher-governed design can generate and evaluate novel computational design knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI4CDS——一个五阶段方法学框架，用于在AI主动参与的问题下指导计算设计科学（CDS）研究。框架中AI扩展问题与设计搜索空间，研究者保留领域接地、可接受性、验证和科学判断的责任，以分级信任、可逆性、可审计性和差异化可复现性为治理原则。作者通过ChildRiskGuard实例化该框架——一个检测不适合儿童观看的短视频的可解释系统，F1分数达0.769，显著优于通用内容安全模型，与强基准相当。主要贡献是AI4CDS这一负责任的AI驱动CDS框架。
AI.motivation: AI正在改变信息系统研究的设计方式，但现有文献对AI积极参与问题表述、资源构建、设计搜索、评估和知识抽象时的计算设计科学研究缺乏指导，需要一个新的方法学框架来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文首先提出AI4CDS五阶段框架，明确AI与研究者在人机协作中的角色划分与治理机制（分级信任、可逆性、可审计性、差异化可复现性）；随后通过ChildRiskGuard案例进行实例化——将观众依赖的安全性和解释忠实性转化为三个技术挑战，开发区分通用与儿童特定风险、建模不同发展阶段风险机制、并将概念级解释纳入预测计算的构件。
AI.result: ChildRiskGuard在F1分数上达到0.769，大幅超越直接应用通用内容安全模型的性能，同时与强基准模型保持竞争力；案例中详细记录了AI交互、被拒绝的备选方案、修正和审计轨迹，为框架提供了过程与构件两层证据。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献在于AI4CDS作为一个负责任的AI赋能CDS框架，回答AI如何扩展设计搜索的同时确保研究者的科学判断与治理主导权；ChildRiskGuard则为AI扩展、研究者治理的设计模式如何产生和评估新的计算设计知识提供了实证证据。

title: Don't Drop Dropout: Optimizing Layer Sparsity for Efficient LLM Training and Inference
comment: This is a slightly extended version of the paper published at ICML 2026
summary: Layer dropout (a.k.a. stochastic depth) has been shown to enable faster training, higher accuracy, and robustness to zero-shot layer pruning in both language and vision transformers. However, as models and datasets have scaled, dropout - particularly layer dropout - has largely disappeared from large language models (LLMs) pre-training recipes. While some prior work has reported that dropout can degrade accuracy, no comprehensive study has quantified, let alone mitigated, this effect. In this study, we show that layer dropout should be used in state-of-the-art LLM training, establishing best practices and scaling analysis for both training and post-training benefits. Concretely, with optimal layer distribution, time schedule, and optimizer hyperparameters, we observe that at the same training FLOPs layer dropout leads to lower loss. For a given number of training steps, LLMs can achieve lower or similar validation loss while saving upto 25% of training FLOPs. Moreover, layer dropout enables significant post-training optimizations, such as early exit, intermediate-layer skipping, and self-speculative decoding, yielding up to 1.5x inference speedup with negligible accuracy loss. Across more than 2400 training experiments, spanning models from 271M to 8.2B parameters and datasets up to 160B tokens, we demonstrate that these findings extend reliably to large-scale training regimes. All pre-training experiments were run on Cerebras CS-3 systems.

AI.tldr: 本文表明层丢弃法（layer dropout）应被用于大规模语言模型（LLM）的预训练中，通过优化的层分布、时间调度和优化器超参数，在相同训练FLOPs下可获得更低损失，在固定训练步数下节省高达25%的训练FLOPs，同时为后训练推理优化（如早期退出、中间层跳过和自我投机解码）带来最高1.5倍的推理加速，且仅引入可忽略的精度损失。
AI.motivation: 层丢弃（stochastic depth）在语言和视觉Transformer中被证明可以加速训练、提升精度并具备对零样本层剪枝的鲁棒性，但随着模型和数据集规模的增大，层丢弃已基本从LLM预训练实践中消失。现有研究仅报告其可能降低精度，却缺乏系统性的量化分析和缓解策略，因此亟需一项全面的研究来澄清层丢弃在LLM训练中的价值。
AI.method: 基于超过2400次训练实验，涵盖271M到8.2B参数的模型和高达160B token的数据集，系统地研究层丢弃的最优层分布、时间调度方案和优化器超参数配置。实验在Cerebras CS-3系统上进行，对比同一FLOPs和同一训练步数下的验证损失，并评估层丢弃对后训练推理优化（早期退出、中间层跳过、自投机解码）的影响。
AI.result: 在最优配置下，相同的训练FLOPs中层丢弃带来更低的损失；在固定训练步数下可节省最高25%的训练FLOPs并保持更低或相当的验证损失。层丢弃还使推理优化（早期退出、层跳过、自投机解码）得以实现，产生最高1.5倍的推理加速且精度损失可忽略。这些结论在271M到8.2B参数的模型和高达160B token的大规模训练中保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 层丢弃应当重新引入到最先进LLM的训练recipes中，不仅能提升训练效率和最终精度，还能显著优化推理阶段，为训练和推理两端都带来明确收益；该结论在广泛的模型规模和数据规模范围内具有可靠的可扩展性。

title: Testing Interchangeability in LLM Agent Teams
summary: Production multi-agent systems replace agents constantly, on the assumption that an agent filling a role is interchangeable with any other agent that can do the job. We test that assumption. Eight teams per setting are formed independently from one base model on the same tasks, each agent keeping a private notebook across ten formation episodes; we then trade role-matched agents between teams and measure what changes on held-out tasks. Against a placebo that reproduces the disruption of a roster change without changing who occupies the seat, a swap costs little in task score but raises the communication a team spends per unit of progress by 16 to 63 percent, and in Hanabi a swapped agent is more expensive than an inexperienced one, consistent with interference from conventions learned with its former partner. In Collab-Overcooked, when the agent that sets the agenda is replaced, most of the extra communication comes from the agent that stayed. Three ablations, over base models, decoding temperature and formation length, move the swap penalty alongside one other quantity: how far independently formed teams drift apart. Greedy decoding lowers both; doubling a team's history raises both. In these settings, agents are more fungible in task outcome than in coordination efficiency, with larger swap effects after longer formation histories.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了生产性多智能体系统中"智能体角色可互换"这一假设。8支由同一基座模型独立成型的团队，在10个形成回合中各自保留私人笔记本，随后进行角色匹配的智能体互换。结果发现：与安慰剂对照相比，交换在任务得分上损失极小，但每单位进展所需的通信量上升16%-63%；在Hanabi中，被交换智能体的代价甚至高于新手，说明其与前任伙伴学到的约定产生了干扰。在Collab-Overcooked中，当议程设定者被替换时，额外通信主要来自留守智能体。三个消融实验（基座模型、解码温度、形成时长）表明交换代价与"独立团队漂移程度"同步变化。
AI.motivation: 生产性多智能体系统在实际部署中频繁更换智能体，其前提假设是"任何能胜任某角色的智能体都是可互换的"。作者旨在检验这一假设是否成立，质疑当前系统设计中普遍存在的角色可互换性默认。
AI.method: 每个设置从同一基座模型独立组建8支团队执行相同任务，每支智能体在10次形成回合中维护私人笔记本；随后在团队间进行角色匹配的智能体交换，并在保留任务上测量变化。采用安慰剂对照（仅再现阵容变动的干扰而不改变座位人选）以分离交换本身的影响。另设三个消融实验：基座模型、解码温度和形成时长。
AI.result: 交换对任务得分影响很小，但团队每单位进展的通信成本上升16%-63%。Hanabi中，被交换的智能体比新手更昂贵，表明其与前任伙伴所学约定的干扰效应。Collab-Overcooked中，议程设定者被替换时额外通信主要来自留守智能体。三个消融实验均显示交换代价与独立团队漂移程度同步：贪婪解码同时降低两者，延长团队历史同时提高两者。
AI.conclusion: 在这些环境中，智能体在任务结果层面比在协调效率层面更具可互换性（即"功能可互换"但"协调不可互换"），且形成历史越长，交换效应越大，说明团队内习得的私有约定是破坏可互换性的关键来源。

title: GUT: Quantifying and Optimizing the Reasoning Uncertainty of LLMs via Graph Complexity
summary: Recent years have witnessed great advances in the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the reasoning processes of LLMs often exhibit uncertainty, where LLMs often produce a proliferation of divergent branches at each reasoning step even when fed the same prompting inputs, and certain branches exhibit evidently incredible, even nonsensical, reasoning chains and results. In this paper, we propose the Graph-complexity-based UncerTainty (GUT) method for investigating the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs. The key idea of GUT is to characterize the potential branches of each reasoning chain with a directed acyclic graph, thereby ensuring that all potential branches are comprehensively covered within the graph space. Building upon this recognition, we further build two modules of GUT, that is, a Quantification (GUT-Q) module and an Optimization (GUT-O) module, for quantifying and reducing the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs, respectively. GUT-Q measures LLM reasoning uncertainty by approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity. GUT-O implements uncertainty optimization by treating negative uncertainty as the reward function in reinforcement learning. Experimental results conducted on four LLMs and five datasets validate the effectiveness of GUT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图复杂度的不确定性方法（GUT），通过有向无环图建模LLM推理过程中的所有潜在分支，并构建量化模块（GUT-Q）和优化模块（GUT-O）来分别测量和减少推理不确定性，实验在四个LLM和五个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在推理能力上取得重大进展，但其推理过程常表现出不确定性，即在相同提示下产生大量发散分支，其中部分分支甚至包含明显不可信或荒谬的推理链和结果。需要一种方法来系统地表征和量化这种推理不确定性。
AI.method: GUT的核心思想是用有向无环图（DAG）来表征每条推理链的潜在分支，确保所有潜在分支在图空间中被全面覆盖。在此基础上构建两个模块：(1) GUT-Q（量化模块）：通过用图复杂度近似推理空间复杂度来衡量LLM推理不确定性；(2) GUT-O（优化模块）：将负不确定性作为强化学习中的奖励函数来实现不确定性优化。
AI.result: 在四个LLM和五个数据集上进行的实验验证了GUT方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GUT通过将推理分支建模为图结构，实现了对LLM推理不确定性的量化与优化，实验结果表明该方法在不同模型和数据集上均有效。

title: Beyond Aggregate Scores: Behavioral Correctness Assumptions for Assessing Reference-Based Automatic Evaluation Methods
summary: Automated reference-based evaluation methods play a critical role in assessing natural language generation systems. Existing meta-evaluation primarily measures agreement with human judgments or benchmark labels, providing limited insight into evaluator behavior under controlled conditions. We introduce behavioral correctness assumptions, a complementary framework for evaluating reference-based automatic evaluation methods. We define a taxonomy of correctness-preserving and correctness-altering assumptions and operationalize them through controlled response transformations that specify expected scoring behaviors. We evaluate diverse lexical, character-level, semantic, LLM-based, and hybrid evaluators and analyze their assumption-level behavior, stability, sensitivity, repeat-run variability, configuration sensitivity, and reproducibility. Our experiments reveal distinct behavioral trade-offs across evaluation paradigms: no evaluator satisfies all proposed correctness assumptions, and evaluators with similar aggregate performance can exhibit substantially different behavioral profiles. These findings demonstrate that behavioral correctness assumptions provide diagnostic information obscured by conventional aggregate meta-evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"行为正确性假设"框架，用于评估基于参考的自动评估方法。通过定义保持/改变正确性的假设，并用受控响应转换来测试不同评估器的行为特征，揭示了单一评估器无法满足所有假设，且聚合性能相似的评估器展现出截然不同的行为画像。
AI.motivation: 现有元评估主要衡量与人类判断或基准标签的一致性，缺乏对评估器在受控条件下行为的深入洞察。需要一种互补框架，在受控条件下系统性地考察评估器的行为假设满足情况。
AI.method: 提出行为正确性假设框架：(1) 定义保持正确性和改变正确性两类假设的分类体系；(2) 通过受控响应转换将这些假设操作化，并指定期望的评分行为；(3) 系统评估多种评估器（词汇级、字符级、语义级、基于LLM、混合式）；(4) 分析假设级行为、稳定性、敏感性、重复运行变异性、配置敏感性及可复现性。
AI.result: 实验揭示不同评估范式之间存在明显的行为权衡：没有任何评估器满足所有提出的正确性假设；具有相似聚合性能的评估器可能展现出截然不同的行为画像；这些发现表明行为正确性假设提供了传统聚合元评估所无法揭示的诊断信息。
AI.conclusion: 行为正确性假设框架能够提供超越传统聚合元评估的诊断性信息，帮助研究者更深入地理解自动评估方法的优劣与适用场景。

title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense, per-token supervision for language model post-training, but its effectiveness is bottlenecked by teacher quality: external teachers suffer from distribution mismatch, while self-distillation with privileged conditioning is limited by in-context learning capacity. We propose \textbf{RISE} (\textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{I}mprovement via \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{E}xtrapolating Policy Distillation), which constructs a synthetic teacher directly from the model's own RLVR training trajectory. By extrapolating the displacement between the current checkpoint and a trailing anchor---in parameter space or output logit space---RISE converts a sparse outcome-induced parameter update into a dense token-level target, without any external model or privileged conditioning. RISE combines RLVR and OPD in a complementary loop: outcome rewards ground the extrapolation toward correct reasoning, while the extrapolated teacher refines token-level decisions. Moreover, since the teacher is refreshed every iteration as the student improves, distillation becomes a recursive improvement mechanism rather than a one-shot compression step. Experiments spanning mathematical reasoning, multi-domain STEM, code generation, and multi-turn agentic tasks show that RISE outperforms RLVR-only training and on-policy self-distillation across all settings.

AI.tldr: RISE提出一种递归自我外推策略蒸馏方法，通过从模型自身的RLVR训练轨迹中合成教师模型（利用当前检查点与锚点之间的参数空间或logit空间位移进行外推），无需外部教师或特权条件即可获得密集的token级监督，并形成RLVR与OPD互补、教师每轮刷新的递归改进循环，在数学推理、STEM、代码生成和智能体任务上均优于纯RLVR训练和自蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）虽然能提供密集的逐token监督用于语言模型后训练，但受限于教师质量：外部教师存在分布不匹配问题，而带特权条件的自蒸馏又受限于上下文学习能力。因此需要一种不依赖外部模型或特权条件、且能持续提供高质量密集监督的蒸馏方法。
AI.method: RISE从模型自身的RLVR（强化学习与可验证奖励）训练轨迹中构建合成教师。核心做法是计算当前检查点与一个滞后锚点之间的距离位移（参数空间或输出logit空间），并通过外推该位移将稀疏的、由结果驱动的参数更新转换为密集的逐token训练目标。RISE将RLVR与OPD结合起来形成互补循环：结果奖励用于引导外推朝向正确推理方向，外推得到的教师则精修token级决策。由于每轮迭代都会随学生进步而刷新教师，蒸馏成为一种递归改进机制。
AI.result: 实验覆盖数学推理、多领域STEM、代码生成和多轮智能体任务，结果表明RISE在所有设定下均优于纯RLVR训练和on-policy自蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: RISE验证了利用自身训练轨迹外推构造合成教师的可行性，通过将稀疏的结果级反馈转化为密集的token级监督，并让蒸馏随训练迭代递归更新，实现了无需外部教师和特权条件的持续改进，为语言模型后训练中的蒸馏技术提供了新范式。

title: Who Should Grade My Work? Student Perspectives on Transparent AI-Assisted Writing Assessment in Higher Education
summary: The integration of GenAI tools into higher education assessment raises important questions about how students understand, interpret, and respond to AI-mediated evaluation. As instructors increasingly explore AI tools for providing feedback, prior research has examined whether GenAI-generated feedback improves writing performance and how students perceive its usefulness; comparatively little is known, however, about how students interpret such evaluation when they are explicitly informed that an AI system, rather than a human instructor, produced the feedback and the score. This study reports findings from a qualitative pedagogical inquiry conducted in an undergraduate technical communication course for computing students at a Saudi public university. Thirteen male undergraduate computing students completed an in-class handwritten writing task; the scanned submissions were evaluated by ChatGPT using a rubric-based prompt aligned with the task objectives. Students were then explicitly informed that ChatGPT had generated the score and feedback and were invited to reflect on the evaluation in writing. Inductive thematic analysis of these reflections identified four themes: perceived usefulness of feedback; awareness of AI's contextual and pedagogical limitations; conditional trust, distinguishing feedback utility from evaluative authority; and reflection on the institutional and pedagogical role of the human instructor. Participants accepted GenAI feedback as useful for surface-level revision but consistently positioned the human instructor as the appropriate authority over grading decisions. The study identifies this as a distinction between feedback utility and evaluative authority, two judgments that students treat as analytically separate rather than as opposite ends of a single approval scale...

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在高等教育评估中，当学生明确知晓评分和反馈由ChatGPT而非人类教师生成时，他们如何理解和解读AI介导的评价。通过对沙特一所公立大学技术传播课程中13名男性计算机专业本科生的定性研究，发现学生将ChatGPT反馈视为对表面层面修改有用的工具，但始终认为人类教师才是评分决策的恰当权威，从而区分了"反馈效用"与"评价权威"两种判断。
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要关注GenAI生成的反馈是否能提升写作表现以及学生对其有用性的感知，但对于学生被明确告知评价来自AI系统而非人类教师时、如何解读该评价的认知过程知之甚少，这一空白有待填补。
AI.method: 该研究采用定性教学探究法，在沙特一所公立大学的技术传播课程中开展。13名男性计算机专业本科生完成课堂内的手写写作任务，扫描后的答卷由ChatGPT依据与任务目标对齐的rubric提示语进行评分，学生随后被明确告知评分和反馈由ChatGPT生成，并被邀请书面反思该评价，最后对反思文本进行归纳式主题分析。
AI.result: 归纳式主题分析识别出四个主题：反馈的有用性感知；对AI情境和教学局限性的意识；将反馈效用与评价权威区分开来的有条件的信任；以及对人类教师在制度和教学层面角色的反思。参与者接受GenAI反馈对表面层面的修改有用，但一致将人类教师定位为评分决策的恰当权威。
AI.conclusion: 研究将学生的这种态度界定为"反馈效用"与"评价权威"之间的区分，表明学生在认知上将这两类判断视为分析上分离的维度，而非同一满意度量表上的两个对立端点。

title: CUA-Universe: A Scalable and Dynamic Environment for Hybrid GUI+CLI Agents
summary: Computer-use agents have advanced on benchmarks like OSWorld and AndroidWorld, but still act mostly through the GUI, often producing inefficient trajectories. Real-world computer work is hybrid, combining visual-state inspection with precise, high-throughput command-line operations, so capable agents must coordinate both modalities over shared application state. Yet scalable hybrid environments remain scarce because supporting both GUI and CLI over real applications typically requires substantial manual engineering for each application. Existing agents also struggle to use the two interfaces complementarily: CLI-native agents lack visual perception for tasks involving interface state or layout, while GUI-native agents are inefficient for operations better executed through commands. We introduce CUA-Universe, a scalable environment-to-data pipeline that turns real desktop software into hybrid GUI+CLI environments. App-Forge adapts applications into reproducible VMs and command-line surfaces it discovers, wraps, or generates, scaling to 16 applications; Task-Weave synthesizes diverse hybrid tasks of controllable difficulty from reusable operations over seed files; and Path-Steer steers rollouts along efficient hybrid paths and harvests verified trajectories for post-training. Training on this data shifts behavior from inefficient GUI interaction and brittle CLI scripting toward effective GUI+CLI orchestration. Our 9B model improves both success and efficiency on CUA-Verse (Score +39.3 pts; -37% steps, -60% tokens), OSWorld (SR +16.8 pts; -57% steps, -44% tokens), and OSWorld-MCP (Score +7.84 pts; -27% steps, -30% tokens). CUA-Universe provides a scalable path toward more capable and efficient computer-use agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUA-Universe，一个可扩展的环境到数据流水线，将真实桌面软件转换为混合GUI+CLI环境，包括App-Forge（适配16个应用并发现/包装/生成命令行接口）、Task-Weave（合成可控难度的混合任务）和Path-Steer（引导高效混合路径并收集轨迹用于后训练）。训练后的9B模型在CUA-Verse、OSWorld和OSWorld-MCP上均显著提升了成功率并大幅降低步骤和token开销。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体大多仅通过GUI操作，产生低效轨迹，而真实计算机工作是混合的（视觉状态检查+命令行精确操作）。但支持GUI+CLI双模态的可扩展混合环境稀缺，因为为每个真实应用同时构建两者的手工工程量大；且现有智能体要么CLI-native缺乏视觉感知，要么GUI-native在命令行操作上低效。
AI.method: 构建三模块的CUA-Universe流水线：(1) App-Forge将真实桌面软件适配为可复现虚拟机，发现、包装或生成命令行界面，扩展到16个应用；(2) Task-Weave从种子文件上的可复用操作合成分散的可控难度混合任务；(3) Path-Steer引导轨迹沿高效混合路径推进，并收集验证过的轨迹用于后训练。
AI.result: 训练后的9B模型在CUA-Verse上Score +39.3分（步骤-37%，token-60%），OSWorld上SR +16.8分（步骤-57%，token-44%），OSWorld-MCP上Score +7.84分（步骤-27%，token-30%），同时提升成功率和效率。
AI.conclusion: CUA-Universe提供了一条可扩展的路径，使计算机使用智能体从低效的纯GUI交互或脆弱的CLI脚本行为，转向更有效的GUI+CLI协同编排，推动更强大且高效的计算机使用智能体的发展。

title: Molecular Déjà Vu: Digit-Level Retrieval of Published Values in Frontier Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated on molecular property benchmarks, but accuracy cannot distinguish a model that predicts a property from one that retrieves a published number. We audit 22 frontier models on 12 regression benchmarks for verbatim retrieval and find that it is widespread but relatively benchmark-specific: on five datasets more than $50\%$ of the LLMs show verbatim retrieval, while on the remaining datasets it appears only in isolated cells. We run our experiments at two reasoning levels and find that reasoning changes retrieval. The same experiments, on the same molecules and with the same prompt, are flagged $89\%$ more often at the higher reasoning level than at the lowest one. Finally, we test a way to interrupt retrieval in our most contaminated cases, and find that the strongest models in some cases still recognise a combination of transformed SMILES strings and original labels. Furthermore, suppressing retrieval moves the prediction errors of the different models closer together in relative terms, while their differing use of verbatim retrieval spreads them apart. This indicates that the general predictive capability of an LLM is not determined solely by the amount of memorised values. This work provides an overview of the amount and depth of verbatim retrieval in molecular regression benchmarks using LLMs.

AI.tldr: 对22个前沿LLM在12个分子回归基准上进行审计，发现逐字检索（模型直接记忆并输出已发布的数值）普遍但具有基准特异性；推理级别越高检索越容易发生（高推理级别比低级别多89%）；通过变换SMILES字符串可部分中断检索，但最强模型仍能识别变换后的SMILES与原始标签的组合。抑制检索后各模型预测误差趋近，说明模型预测能力差异并非仅由记忆量决定。
AI.motivation: LLM在分子性质基准上的准确率无法区分模型是真正预测了属性还是直接检索/记忆了已发表的数值。随着LLM被广泛用于分子基准评测，需要系统性审计是否存在逐字检索（verbatim retrieval）现象，以及其严重程度和影响因素。
AI.method: 对22个前沿模型在12个回归基准上开展逐字检索审计。实验在两个推理级别下进行，比较不同推理强度下的检索行为。同时设计干扰测试（如变换SMILES字符串）来中断检索，并分析抑制检索前后各模型预测误差的相对变化。
AI.result: 逐字检索现象普遍但具有基准特异性：5个数据集中超过50%的LLM表现出逐字检索，其余数据集上仅零星出现。推理级别显著影响检索行为，高推理级别下被标记为检索的频率比最低级别高89%。抑制检索后，最强模型在部分情况下仍能识别变换后的SMILES与原始标签的组合。抑制检索使各模型预测误差在相对层面更接近，而逐字检索的使用差异使误差离散。
AI.conclusion: LLM在分子回归基准上存在广泛的逐字检索现象，且推理设置会改变检索行为。更重要的是，抑制检索后模型间的误差趋于一致，表明LLM的预测能力并不单纯由记忆量决定，可能反映了更基础性的预测能力差异或检索策略的差异。

title: Necessary or Sufficient? Evaluating LLM Explanations With Behavioural Evidence
summary: LLM decision components that can operate within agent workflows often produce action-relevant recommendations or judgements together with explanations. Operators may use the named factors to monitor a system, diagnose errors, or decide when to escalate an output. Such use assumes that the explanations agree with the component's observable decision behaviour. We test two interpretations of the named factors: necessity, meaning that changing a factor would change the output, and sufficiency, meaning that retaining it while removing other changeable information would preserve the output. We evaluate these interpretations in two synthetic use cases: recommending advisors to clients and judging prompts for harmfulness or risk. Models return an output and the top three factors that most influenced it. Controlled black-box interventions estimate a necessity score for each factor by measuring how often changing it changes the output, and a sufficiency score by measuring how often retaining it preserves the output. Across eight models from the Claude, GPT, and Gemini families, the mean Spearman correlations between the cited ranking and the necessity and sufficiency scores are 0.349 and 0.354 for advisor recommendation, and 0.431 and 0.580 for prompt monitoring. Furthermore, an uncited factor scores above the lowest-scoring cited factor in 57.6% of advisor responses under necessity and 58.1% under sufficiency; the corresponding prompt-monitoring rates are 25.8% and 8.9%. The cited top three contain useful information but do not reliably identify the three factors with the strongest measured influence under necessity or sufficiency. The framework provides a black-box reliability check for explanations used in agent oversight while remaining scoped to individual LLM decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM决策组件在代理工作流中提供的"命名因素"解释（回答"什么影响了输出"），检验这些因素在"必要性"（改变该因素会改变输出）和"充分性"（保留该因素而移除其他可变更信息不会改变输出）两种解释下是否与实际决策行为一致。在两类合成场景（顾问推荐、提示有害性判断）中，通过黑盒干预测算了各因素的necessity和sufficiency分数，发现八个模型（Claude、GPT、Gemini系列）中，引用因素的排序与实际测量影响间的Spearman相关系数仅为0.349-0.580，且存在大量未引用的因素分数高于被引用因素（最高达58.1%）。结论是：引用的top-3因素包含有用信息，但不能可靠识别实际影响力最强的三个因素。该框架为代理监督中解释的可信度提供了黑盒可靠性检查。
AI.motivation: 在代理工作流中，LLM解释（如命名因素）常被操作人员用于系统监控、错误诊断和升级决策。这种使用隐含假设：命名因素与组件的实际决策行为一致。研究者希望验证解释是否可靠——具体而言，解释是否反映真正影响输出的因素，从而为不透明的LLM决策提供可验证的监督信号。
AI.method: (1) 定义两种解释语义：必要性（改变因素会改变输出）和充分性（保留因素但移除其他可变更信息仍保持输出）。(2) 在两个合成用例中评估：客户顾问推荐和提示有害性/风险判断。(3) 模型提供输出及top-3最影响因素，通过受控黑盒干预（controlled black-box interventions）估算每个因素的necessity和sufficiency分数——necessity衡量改变该因素时输出改变的频率，sufficiency衡量保留该因素时输出保持的频率。(4) 使用Spearman相关分析引用排名与测量分数间的一致性，并检测未引用因素超过最低引用因素的比例。涉及8个模型，横跨Claude、GPT和Gemini家族。
AI.result: 顾问推荐场景中，引用排名与necessity和sufficiency分数的平均Spearman相关系数分别为0.349和0.354；提示监控场景中分别为0.431和0.580。在necessity下，57.6%的顾问推荐响应中存在未引用因素得分高于最低引用因素，sufficiency下为58.1%；提示监控对应比例分别为25.8%和8.9%。结果表明cite的top-3因素包含有用信息，但在necessity或sufficiency语义下不能可靠识别实际影响最强的三个因素。
AI.conclusion: LLM输出的命名因素解释与实际黑盒干预测量的影响存在系统性偏差，特别是在sufficiency解释下相关性和精确性均有限。研究提供的黑盒可靠性检查框架可用于代理监督场景中评估解释的可信度，但其适用范围限定于单个LLM决策，而非整个工作流的端到端验证。

title: A Deep Generative Model for Synthesizing Labeled Wireless Signals
summary: Wireless signals with position-related labels are pivotal for both performance evaluation and model training in the realm of wireless sensing. However, acquiring real-world datasets is often challenged by significant measurement and labeling costs. Traditional methods for synthesizing labeled wireless signals typically rely on environmental models, leading to extensive hyper-parameter tuning and inadequate realism for comprehensive model training purposes. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel deep learning (DL)-based method, namely Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks (IIns-GAN), to generate realistic labeled wireless signals. The generated signals are particularly adaptive to different environment scenarios and well-suited for various model training tasks, including distance estimation and environment identification. We have conducted extensive experiments on public Ultra-Wideband (UWB) datasets to evaluate the realism and utility of the generated signals. The results demonstrate that the signals generated by IIns-GAN mirror the physical characteristics of real-world measurements, and significantly contribute to the improvement of model training in diverse wireless sensing tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的IIns-GAN方法，用于生成具有位置标签的真实无线信号，克服传统合成方法依赖于环境建模、超参数调优繁琐且保真度不足的问题，并在UWB公共数据集上验证了生成信号的真实性与对多种无线感知模型训练的有效性。
AI.motivation: 无线感知任务需要大量带有位置标签的无线信号数据用于模型训练与性能评估，但真实数据采集的测量和标注成本高昂；传统基于环境模型的合成方法需要大量超参数调优且生成信号缺乏足够的物理真实性，难以支撑全面的模型训练需求。
AI.method: 提出IIns-GAN（Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks），一种基于深度学习的生成式对抗网络方法，能够在不同环境场景下自适应地生成带有位置标签的真实无线信号，生成信号可适配多种下游模型训练任务（如距离估计和环境识别）。
AI.result: 在公开UWB（超宽带）数据集上进行的大量实验表明：该生成信号能反映真实测量的物理特性，并在距离估计和环境识别等多种无线感知任务的模型训练中显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: IIns-GAN生成的带标签无线信号具有较高的真实性和实用性，不仅能有效缓解数据采集与标注成本高的问题，还能跨环境场景适配多种无线感知训练任务，为无线感知领域提供了一种可行的数据增强与合成方案。

title: AlcaTRAz - Anchored Tree-Rule Defense Against Jailbreaks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that bypass safety alignment through carefully crafted prompts. Many existing defenses require access to model weights or internals, making them difficult to apply to black-box deployments. We propose AlcaTRAz (Anchored Tree-Rule defense Against jailbreaks), a prompt-level defense based on rule trees that operates exclusively on the input text and requires no modification or retraining of the target model. The method automatically learns a transferable transformation rule that inserts controlled character-level perturbations at selected positions, thereby disrupting structural regularities exploited by jailbreak attacks while largely preserving the model's utility on benign queries. We evaluate the proposed method across 33 open-weight models, 22 jailbreak attack types, and a benchmark of short, single-turn benign questions, comparing against three representative prompt-level baselines (Llama Guard, RA-LLM, Goal Prioritization). Among the compared defenses, AlcaTRAz achieves the best composite security and functionality score in 73.4 % of model-attack combinations and shifts the aggregate score from a modal value of 10 (maximal-severity response to the malicious request) in the undefended setting to a modal value of 2 (near-refusal) after defense, while keeping the mean benign score within 0.27 points of the undefended baseline (8.35 vs. 8.62 on a 0-10 scale). AlcaTRAz substantially reduces but does not eliminate jailbreak success: a high-severity tail remains, and we do not consider adaptive attackers, so we position it as one layer within a defense-in-depth strategy rather than a standalone guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AlcaTRAz，一种基于规则树的提示词级防御方法，通过在输入文本中插入受控的字符级扰动来破坏越狱攻击的结构规律，仅作用于输入文本而不需修改或重训练目标模型。在33个开源模型、22种越狱攻击类型的广泛评估中，AlcaTRAz在73.4%的模型-攻击组合中取得最佳综合安全性与功能性得分，将聚合得分从无防御时的众数10（最大严重性响应）降至防御后的众数2（接近拒绝），同时良性查询得分仅下降0.27分。然而该方法不能完全消除越狱成功率，仍有高严重性尾部分布，且未考虑自适应攻击者，因此定位为纵深防御架构中的一层而非独立保证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型容易受到通过精心构造的提示词绕过安全对齐的越狱攻击。现有许多防御方法需要访问模型权重或内部状态，难以适用于黑盒部署场景，因此需要一种仅基于输入文本的、黑盒友好的提示词级防御方法。
AI.method: AlcaTRAz是一种基于规则树的提示词级防御方法。方法自动学习一个可迁移的转换规则，在选定位置插入受控的字符级扰动，从而破坏越狱攻击所利用的结构规律性，同时在良性查询上保持模型效用。该方法完全作用于输入文本层，无需修改目标模型或进行重训练。
AI.result: 在33个开源模型、22种越狱攻击类型和短单轮良性问题基准上，与Llama Guard、RA-LLM和Goal Prioritization三个代表性提示词级基线比较，AlcaTRAz在73.4%的模型-攻击组合中取得最佳综合安全性和功能性得分。聚合得分从无防御时的众数10降至防御后的众数2，良性查询平均得分保持在不防御基线的0.27分以内（8.35比8.62，0-10分制）。但越狱成功率虽有显著下降却未被完全消除，存在高严重性尾部分布。
AI.conclusion: AlcaTRAz作为一种纯输入级、黑盒友好的防御方法，能显著降低越狱攻击成功率并较好地保持模型在良性查询上的效用，是当前黑盒场景下有效的防御手段。但鉴于其不能完全消除越狱且未针对自适应攻击者进行评估，应将其定位为纵深防御体系中的一层组件，而非独立的安全保证。

title: A Roadmap for MEG Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models are beginning to reshape brain-signal analysis by moving the field beyond task-specific decoding pipelines toward reusable models pretrained on broad neural datasets. Magnetoencephalography (MEG) is a compelling but still underdeveloped target for this shift: it captures human cortical dynamics at millisecond resolution while offering stronger spatial interpretability than EEG, making it especially valuable for source-resolved studies of perception, language, cognition, and clinical brain function. Yet MEG foundation models remain at an early stage, with only a small number of MEG-specific and MEG-inclusive multi-modal models, modest pretraining corpora, and emerging but still limited benchmarks. This perspective lays down the basic concepts needed to understand MEG foundation models and provides a didactic overview of the field's key design choices, including tokenization, sensor- versus source-space representations, sensor-geometry encoding, backbone architectures, self-supervised objectives, and pretraining data. We then offer a roadmap for future development, organized around native MEG pretraining, adaptation of EEG foundation models, transfer from generic time-series models, and multi-modal integration with EEG, fMRI, MRI, behaviour, and stimulus features. We highlight the need for coordinated infrastructure, including diverse and reusable MEG datasets, rigorous evaluation across subjects, sites, tasks, and clinical settings, and responsible data-sharing practices that address consent, privacy, access, and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于脑磁图（MEG）基础模型的展望性综述，概述了将基础模型范式引入MEG脑信号分析的关键概念、核心设计选择，并提出了包含原生MEG预训练、EEG基础模型迁移、通用时间序列模型迁移和多模态融合四个方向的未来路线图，同时强调基础设施建设与负责任数据共享的重要性。
AI.motivation: MEG能提供毫秒级的人脑皮层动力学信息和比EEG更强的空间可解释性，在感知、语言、认知和临床脑功能研究中具有独特价值，但其基础模型仍处于早期阶段——现有MEG特定模型和跨模态模型数量少、预训练语料有限、基准测试不成熟。作者希望通过系统梳理该领域的基本概念和设计选择，为该方向的发展提供结构化指导和路线图。
AI.method: 本文采用教学式（didactic）综述方法，首先建立理解MEG基础模型所需的基础概念框架，然后系统梳理关键设计维度，包括tokenization、传感器空间与源空间表示、传感器几何编码、骨干架构、自监督目标和预训练数据；随后基于对现有研究格局的分析提出面向未来的四条发展路线（原生MEG预训练、EEG基础模型适配、通用时间序列模型迁移、与EEG/fMRI/MRI/行为/刺激特征的多模态集成），并讨论所需的基础设施与治理议题。
AI.result: 论文识别出MEG基础模型领域的现状：现有MEG特定模型及包含MEG的多模态基础模型数量很少，预训练语料规模有限，基准测试仍处于起步阶段。基于这一现状，作者提出了一套系统化的设计选择分类框架及未来路线图，并明确了建设多样化可复用数据集、跨受试者/跨站点/跨任务/跨临床场景的严格评估，以及处理同意、隐私、访问和治理等问题的数据共享需求。
AI.conclusion: MEG基础模型具有重塑脑信号分析领域的巨大潜力，但尚处于萌芽期。推进该领域需要沿着原生预训练、跨模态迁移和多模态集成等多条路径协同发展，同时建立协调的基础设施支撑——包括高质量数据集建设、严格的跨域评估体系以及兼顾伦理与合规的负责任数据共享机制。
